nodes.title: Mistcloak Strike
nodes.intro:
Aalto is an enigmatic Information Broker, known for his elusive nature and welcoming smile.

Rumor has it he'll provide any information at the right price.

He was invited to join the Black Shores, a mysterious organization based on an isolated island, for his intel-gathering expertise.

Both working for the Black Shores as Consultants, Aalto and Encore have become an inseparable and lively duo during missions.

Despite his skittish demeanor, Aalto's true character shines through as a reliable and attentive individual.

nodes.title: Magnetism Before Light
nodes.intro: Augusta is the undefeated gladiator in the arena and a fearless leader with a will of iron. She is a mere mortal, but has reached heights of glory attempted by only a few, and her blade speaks her power loud and clear.

nodes.title: Healing You'tan
nodes.intro:
Baizhi, a researcher at Huaxu Academy, is known for her sharp intellect and precise methods.

Despite appearing aloof, she is approachable to those who seek knowledge.

Her insatiable thirst for understanding drives her to tirelessly study Remnant Energy.

She will stop at nothing until its mysteries are unraveled, even if it means dedicating her entire life to the pursuit.

nodes.title: Flamebound Compass
nodes.intro:
As captain of the Fool's Troupe, Brant exudes a carefree, easygoing charm, unbound by convention. 
Beneath his flamboyant persona lies a genuine heart, deeply devoted to his family and companions. His life is dedicated to securing a safe haven for the Troupe's members

nodes.title: Sanguine Blossom
nodes.intro: Bloom Bearer from the Black Shores, Camellya is a laid-back character free from shackles, with her personal aroma of "danger." Intrigued by the belief in fate, she wanders the lands of her own accord, following such a chain of scenarios and its vague guidance.

nodes.title: Sea of Dreams
nodes.intro:
The Fisalia family's thirty-sixth head, Cantarella Fisalia. 
She locks your gaze with eyes as deep as the ocean, where dark tides seem to surge and swirl. 
For a moment, you think you glimpse something in the ocean's depths—but you are unsure if it is the shadow of a giant sea creature... or the tail feathers of the Celestial Steed.

nodes.title: Crystal Remorph
nodes.intro: Carlotta, the second daughter of the esteemed Montelli family, embodies innate nobility and a refined appreciation for art. Her elegance is matched by her unconventional spirit, unshackled by tradition. To ensure her family’s future, she alternates between dual roles, addressing delicate "troubles" behind the scenes.

nodes.title: Feathered Tempest
nodes.intro: The powers of the Sentinel and Threnodian clash and unite within her, propelling her into an uncertain future. Whether the future is bright or dim, she will hold the blade firmly and confront all that comes her way.

nodes.title: Gallant Blaze
nodes.intro:
Chixia is a junior Jinzhou Patroller.

She roams Jinzhou City, leaving her fiery mark on every alley she stamps through.

As the starring hero among her community, Chixia is always ready for anyone in need.

nodes.title: Woven Melodies
nodes.intro:
Ciaccona, the bard of Rinascita, is free-spirited, romantic, sincere, and passionate. 
On her journey, she sang radiant poems of saints and heroes, weaving tales of people, miracles, turmoil, and suffering—along with the sorrow of death and farewell.

nodes.title: Wooly–counting Game
nodes.intro:
Encore, a consultant from the Black Shores, is a quirky, lively, and spunky girl who loves to recount her friendships and adventures through fantasy and fairy tales.

She always has two Woolies with her, who are Encore's best friends and protectors.

With Cosmos and Cloudy, Encore travels all over the world!

nodes.title: Stasis, Cycle, Renewal
nodes.intro: Iuno is a Priestess well-known in Septimont for being a prodigy. She is blessed with the infallible ability to see the future by studying how moonlight changes.

nodes.title: Thawborn Renewal
nodes.intro: Being the Magistrate of Jinzhou, Jinhsi bears her noble and weighty share of duties. Through repeated ages, the Lament has preyed upon mankind's vulnerable hope. Yet, grasping the nettle, she strives with all her might to forge a path toward tomorrow.

nodes.title: Windborne Rider
nodes.intro:
Jiyan is the General of Midnight Rangers stationed in Jinzhou, embracing strong sense of justice and resolution.

Born in a family devoted to medicine, Jiyan is both skilled and attentive.

Later, in a bid to fend off the encroaching Tacet Discords, he relinquished his role in medicine and took up arms as a soldier.

nodes.title: Kaleido Refraction
nodes.intro:
From dense forests to vast wilderness, places where navigator of Lollo Logistics Lumi has traveled bear witness to her charming personality, like a shaft of sunlight.

Born disciplined, she is now enjoying her daily tasks as a diligent courier, honoring her duty of punctual delivery.

nodes.title: Howling Flame
nodes.intro: The star gladiator of Septimont, a warrior with a pure heart, untamed spirit, intense passion, and immense potential. She will relentlessly pursue the things she admires, cherishing each moment that allows her to indulge in competition and self-expression on stage.

nodes.title: Dragon's Breath
nodes.intro: Born into the upper class, Mortefi is a lofty man with an erudite look. Renowned for his exceptional talent in scientific research, Mortefi was once famed as the youngest genius in the New Federation. Driven by a thirst for knowledge, Mortefi later abandoned his privileged life to work as an International Research Fellow at the Huaxu Academy. It's not hard to win Mortefi's favor: Just remember to talk nicely, and always shower him with ample praise.

nodes.title: Graceful Luminescence
nodes.intro:
Phoebe, an Acolyte of the Order of the Deep, always carries herself with warmth and grace. 
Devout and steadfast in her adherence to the Order's doctrines, she embodies exceptional self-discipline. Yet beneath her composed exterior burns a vibrant spirit, alight with heartfelt joy for all she holds dear.

nodes.title: Stage in the Box
nodes.intro: Roccia is a gifted improvisational comedian and the First Mate of the Fool's Troupe, known for her mastery of stage props. With a tranquil, composed disposition, she navigates the ship's quarters, perched atop her giant box, meticulously ensuring the Troupe remains orderly and tidy.

nodes.title: Snow Waltz
nodes.intro:
A loyal and reliable guard for Jinhsi, Sanhua is composed and reserved.

Sanhua perceives a world distinctly different from that in the eyes of others, and her body temperature is below normal

Her Forte allows her to cool the surrounding air and conjure snow.

To maintain emotional stability and prevent Overclocking, Sanhua finds solace in the art of swordplay.

This allows her to master her Forte with graceful ease and alleviates the burden on her body.

nodes.title: Euphonic Chrysalis
nodes.intro:
The Shorekeeper of the Black Shores, a mysterious divine being governing the essence of aloofness, emerges in response to your summon. 
Having spent eons in guardianship, the first stirrings of emotion and desire awaken within her heart, fostering a firm determination to connect with the world — and with you.

nodes.title: Blossom of Slashes
nodes.intro: Taoqi oversees Jinzhou's border defense at the Ministry of Development. Despite her unhurried demeanor, she is an exceptionally dependable individual who works tirelessly to protect others and provide a peaceful haven. With effortless efficiency, she balances her work and personal life, steadily moving towards her ultimate goal: creating a future of true safety for all.

nodes.title: Breath of Winds
nodes.intro:
Yangyang journeyed far away from home to become an Outrider in Jinzhou.

Instead of seeking the spotlight, Yangyang chooses to provide comfort through quiet companionship for others.

After enduring hardships and anguish, she has found a clear purpose: to be a beacon of guidance and an aiding presence in a world still in need of healing.

nodes.title: Cryogenic Wonders
nodes.intro: A voluble and whimsical antique appraiser. Known for creating limericks on the spot, she presents her appraisals with flair and precision. She sets up a stall on the street, ensuring antiques find their way to those who truly cherish them.

nodes.title: Scorched Radiance
nodes.intro:
Zani, a serious and reliable Montelli employee, follows a strict routine and manages tasks with ease. 
For years, she has clocked in on time without fail, finding as much enjoyment in her well-ordered life as in her carefully planned moments of leisure.

voiceline.title: About Encore
voiceline.text: Sometimes not even I can figure out just where Encore's getting all that energy from. As soon as we arrive somewhere, she's off making friends and sharing stories with the local kids in no time. I even got some of my intel from her buddies, believe it or not.

voiceline.title: About Aalto
voiceline.text: Aalto's money this and money that all day, but did you know? Sometimes he helps people for free! He just wouldn't tell me why... Hmph. Then it's up to me to find out!

mention.title: Favorite Food
mention.text: Encore's Coral Bowl looks weird, but it sure tastes great.

mention.title: A Perfect Duo
mention.text: Encore will get it done real quick, as long as Aalto doesn’t drag behind me!” Encore, you broke my heart.

mention.text: At least, that’s how Encore saw it. As today’s story came to an end, Encore couldn’t help but ask, “I didn’t know you’d help people for free!”
mention.source: Aalto's character story “A Free Service”

mention.source: Encore's voice line “Favorite Food”

mention.title: About Calcharo
mention.text: That strange big guy Aalto's been working with is actually... a doggy person!
mention.source: Encore's voice line “About Calcharo”

mention.title: A New Story, A New Adventure
mention.text: Encore's initial impression of Aalto fell somewhere between good and bad. Aalto removed his sunglasses, scrutinizing Encore with care.
mention.source: Encore's character story “A New Story, A New Adventure”

mention.title: Rewinding Raindrops
mention.text: That's enough Encore, you're freaking our precious client out.
mention.source: Aalto brings up Encore in “Rewinding Raindrops” (6×)

mention.title: Through the Sea Thou Break
mention.text: Encore's off on a mission! Camellya's out too! Yelling's not gonna save you!
mention.source: Aalto brings up Encore in “Through the Sea Thou Break”

mention.title: Rewinding Raindrops
mention.text: Uncle Aalto sells stuff without a license, he listens in on people for commercial secrets, and he loves pulling pranks on us kids... But he's not a bad guy, really!
mention.source: Encore brings up Aalto in “Rewinding Raindrops” (13×)

mention.title: Small Wooly, Big Adventures
mention.text: Of course, they do. Everyone at Black Shores is really nice. Even someone as busy as Aalto gets to have them.
mention.source: Encore brings up Aalto in “Small Wooly, Big Adventures” (4×)

mention.title: The One that Impresses
mention.text: Oh, hi there, KU-Lolo! Aalto is not here. Encore was just making Cubes when a weird Cube Called "Abbowser" showed up and ate the Anniversary Cake.
mention.source: Encore brings up Aalto in “The One that Impresses”

voiceline.title: About Jiyan
voiceline.text: Being the Jinzhou Garrison's General is no walk in the park. You gotta have that big-picture thinking, be on top of everything, and make decisions like they're nothing. Just take a look at General Jiyan—he's got all those boxes checked off and then some.

voiceline.title: About Aalto
voiceline.text: Fog can be an enemy to soldiers on the march, as it limits visibility and complicates situational awareness. However, deploying fog strategically can be an effective move on the battlefield. I have had the opportunity to work with Aalto before, and he is an interesting person indeed.

mention.title: About Encore
mention.text: Are you referring to the little girl who is always seen by Aalto's side?
mention.source: Jiyan's voice line “About Encore”

sample.text: Hey, I'm Patroller Chixia. Sir, business license, please.

sample.speaker: Aalto
sample.text: B-Business license? Uuuhh... Oh! I'm Aalto, just a humble information broker. I've been travelling around, helping people out in my own small way...

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: I see. So, no license. I bet you don't have a fixed business location either, huh?

sample.speaker: Aalto
sample.text: ...Business location? Why would I need that?

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Hmph, now show me your Organizational Accreditation, please.

sample.speaker: Aalto
sample.text: Well... I am an honest broker of information, always open to negotiations at the right price! I'm the all-time intel champ, with more Best Seller certificates than I can count...

voiceline.title: About Verina
voiceline.text: That little girl from Rigg's Explorers? Yeah, I bumped into her once, back in the New Federation. Offered me a Starflower for the whereabouts of her mother. But the deal fell through, because she didn't have what I was asking for. And what was that, you ask? Well… I asked for a never-withering flower. In reply, she told me plants have their life cycle, and wilting is just a natural part of it. I remember telling her, "The same can be said for humans."

Before he could finish, Encore had already dashed out with Cloudy and Cosmos, leaving Aalto’s words hanging in the air. “

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I never got the chance to thank you.

sample.speaker: Aemeath
sample.text: Thank me?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: The day the Eye of the Threnodian appeared, you drove it back and saved me.

sample.speaker: Aemeath
sample.text: Did I? …Sorry, I don't remember that.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (She doesn't sound like she's lying. Then how...)

sample.speaker: Aemeath
sample.text: A Synchronist… Rover… Hahaha!

dialogue.desc: Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.

sample.speaker: Aemeath
sample.text: It was the explorers who fell into the Voidmatter. They're the ones who mapped that data on me and the Exostrider inside the Threnodian's black hole. All I did was burn their findings onto a Cassette for you.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: And it was the people of Lahai-Roi who decoded the Cassette and forged the Drive Replica. That's what let the Exostrider finally cast the Threnodian out.

sample.speaker: Aemeath
sample.text: So... this wasn't a story about heroes saving the world. It was the world saving its heroes. Right?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Yes. And now… we're home.

sample.speaker: Hiyuki
sample.text: You're back?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Yeah, I'm back now.

dialogue.desc: Though the Threnodian Aleph-1 was banished, Lucilla finds herself in yet another predicament. In the absence of the Exostrider, funders are questioning whether the Synchronist program—and even the Rabelle College itself—should continue to exist. As both a professor and the head of the Academy, Lucilla must now choose between harsh reality and her ideals.

sample.speaker: Aemeath
sample.text: So what if they don't care about your contributions? If they actually want you on their side, they'll have to listen anyway. That's how leverage works.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: If we lean on that kind of leverage now, we'll be held to it later. My experience has shown me that it's often better to act as an individual.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Since you're planning on the "savior" career path, I think you'll understand what I mean, Aemeath.

sample.speaker: Aemeath
sample.text: Hmm, makes sense. Kinda old-school thinking, though.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (I need to figure out what Lucilla is really thinking. Then I'll play it by ear.)

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: If I want them to protect the Synchronists when I can't, I've got to work inside their system. That's just how this game works.

dialogue.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

sample.speaker: Aemeath
sample.text: So don't act all shocked when we just show up one day, 'kay?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Everyone, thank you.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Well then... See you, Startorch Academy.

phoneSample.speaker: Aemeath
phoneSample.text: Who knows, you might even start hearing legends about "the one and only Aemeath" before we see each other again.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: I'll be looking forward to it.

phoneSample.speaker: Aemeath
phoneSample.text: All right! Get ready to be blown away!

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: Have no fear, Aemeath's here!

phoneSample.speaker: Aemeath
phoneSample.text: Hehe, just hearing you say that already makes me all giddy!

phoneSample.speaker: Aemeath
phoneSample.text: Anyway, if anything comes up, I'll just find you in WavesLine real quick. As a digital ghost, my ping is kinda off the charts.

dialogue.desc: Aemeath appears to be waiting for you. You should go see her.

sample.speaker: Aemeath
sample.text: The savior and the world, saving each other at last! A tale for the ages!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Aemeath, there's something I want to ask you.

sample.speaker: Aemeath
sample.text: Hmm? What is it?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: After you were sealed beyond the Stridergate... how long were you out there? Alone?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: You've been dodging this. But I don't want you to keep choosing to handle this alone.

dialogue.quest: So as the Melting Snow Desires
dialogue.desc: You receive word from Lucilla requesting your presence at the Academic Affairs office to discuss plans. In place of the busy President, Hiyuki will be meeting with you.

sample.speaker: Aemeath
sample.text: The savior and the world, saving each other at last! A tale for the ages!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Aemeath, there's something I want to ask you.

sample.speaker: Aemeath
sample.text: Hmm? What is it?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: After you were sealed beyond the Stridergate... how long were you out there? Alone?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: You've been dodging this. But I don't want you to keep choosing to handle this alone.

sample.speaker: Aemeath
sample.text: By the way, why didn't you message me on WavesLine before coming all the way here? I could've picked you up.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Are you looking at where Lahai-Roi disappeared?

sample.speaker: Aemeath
sample.text: Yeah... I don't know. I feel a bit conflicted about it.

sample.speaker: Aemeath
sample.text: It's still out there, beyond the Stridergate. Guarding this world all alone, day after day. It's gotta be wearing down. Who knows how much longer it can hold on.

sample.speaker: Aemeath
sample.text: Can't help worrying... What if it just breaks down one day?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I think, before that day comes, the people of Lahai-Roi will find a way to cross the Etheric Sea.

scene.desc: The gateway to Lahai-Roi is now open! What burns beneath the frostlands is waiting for your return!

mention.title: Every Unspoken Word
mention.text: Tomorrow, she and Rover would stand before the Exostrider. Rover looked happy.
mention.source: Aemeath's character story “Every Unspoken Word”

mention.source: Rover brings up Aemeath in “Starlights from Yesterdays” (12×)

mention.title: All That Sunlight Touches
mention.text: I trust Aemeath. What we experienced together proved she was telling me the truth. And there's a connection there I can't ignore.

dialogue.desc: While waiting for contact from the Ephor's Palace, you and Abby arrive at Solis Tavern, where you run into a blind wandering bard—Nestor. Having learned of the Ephor's invitation to the hunt, Nestor shares with you Augusta's stories before she rose to power.

sample.speaker: Iuno
sample.text: Fine. Go ahead. You'll come back to me sooner or later.

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: That, I can't deny.

sample.speaker: Iuno
sample.text: Ha! I knew it. So you do need me for this hunt.

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: Thank you, Iuno.

sample.speaker: Iuno
sample.text: ...Why are you saying this?

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: The storm is coming...

dialogue.summary: Iuno has some reservations about the upcoming hunting operation and their plans due to the prophecy she saw, but Augusta assures her firmly that she will fight to the very end.

dialogue.desc: As the High Tide draws near, a lurking calamity stirs, with its gaze fixed upon the borders of Septimont. Ephor Augusta invites you to the Sanguis Plateaus for a fateful hunt, the one that may decide the realm's survival...

sample.speaker: Iuno
sample.text: The sooner you settle this, the sooner I get to leave this boring place.

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: Iuno, one last question.

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: For someone without an unwritten fate... is it true they can never break free, no matter how hard they struggle?

sample.speaker: Iuno
sample.text: I... don't know.

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: That's alright.

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: Let's go, Rover.

dialogue.desc: With the Sovereign slain, you attend the victory ceremony by invitation of Ceremonial Officer Bruno. The celebration honors the new Hero of Heroes and those who stood by their side amidst the crackling bonfire and joyous cheers of the crowd... Now that the countless petals are to be thrown into the sky to become the rain of glory and triumph, you might finally reunite with the girl you have never forgotten in a way even beyond fate's grasp.

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: Existence always leaves a trace. Beyond feeling, memory, and perception, is there anything that can prove this "Iuno" isn't an illusion?

sample.speaker: Iuno
sample.text: After this, I shall likely sleep like I've never slept before.

sample.speaker: Iuno
sample.text: Say, I heard the Montelli family imported some device that aids sleep. It's all the rage... Augusta, I trust you will acquire one for me? I wish to try it myself.

sample.speaker: Iuno
sample.text: Scented candles are fine, though the scent of the forest is most pleasing. As for pillows and bedding...

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: That's enough. I allow requests... but only three.

sample.speaker: Iuno
sample.text: Hmph. Apologies, but I need my rest if I'm to be at full power. Do bear with it. It's for your own good, after all.

dialogue.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: Iuno. We know each other.

sample.speaker: Iuno
sample.text: Å lot happened while you were off adventuring. You missed some fun.

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: It is strange... From the moment we met, it felt like we were cut from the same cloth. Like we'd known each other before. She might seem unmoored, but when the storm hits, she holds fast.

sample.speaker: Iuno
sample.text: Alright then, Augusta. What's the situation?

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: Theoretically, the Dark Tide flows here from the Blightcloud above the Plateaus. High Tides have always followed its movements.

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: But this time, nothing. No Blightcloud anomalies. No frequency fluctuations near the Three Heroes' Crest.

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: The High Tide draws near. I want all warriors heading to the hunting grounds to remember this.

sample.speaker: Iuno
sample.text: Hmm? That's interesting.

sample.speaker: Iuno
sample.text: Augusta, look! Another two have earned Arsinosa's blessing.

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: You've done incredibly well.

dialogue.summary: During this time, you ask her about Ephor Augusta and Priestess Iuno.

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: May... your journey... be... smooth, my friend.

sample.speaker: Iuno
sample.text: Come back soon! (I'm only asking for the sake of everyone else!)

voiceline.title: About Iuno
voiceline.text: Iuno and I became friends because we're so alike—stubborn, headstrong, and relentless in the face of defeat. In many ways, we walked in each other's footsteps, each unwilling to fall behind, and so we ended up on the same path. Even so, there are times I wish she could live more freely. I know the pain she carries runs deeper than what she's ever told me. To others, she may seem arrogant or willful, but that defiance stems from her certainty that every step she takes must be the right one. And such certainty… always demands a price.

voiceline.title: About Augusta
voiceline.text: Here's a little secret even Augusta doesn't know. When we first met, I told her she'd lead Septimont into a new era, and she believed it to be one of my prophecies. But really, it was just a hunch. I never peep into her fate because it's always been in her hands. She's the kind of ruler who'd sacrifice everything for her people, even her own flesh and blood. You don't need a coronation to see that. It's obvious at a glance. Yet, that kind of responsibility she carries is heavier than anyone else can imagine. Even though I know she can handle it alone, I still want to help somehow. As a Priestess, as a friend... or even as someone she has forgotten.

mention.title: Favorite Food
mention.text: Iuno always says my choice in food leaves much to be desired.
mention.source: Augusta's voice line “Favorite Food”

mention.title: By Sun's Burning Hand
mention.text: It all started when Augusta shook things up the moment she became Ephor. Especially in rooting out corruption within the Gladiator's Agon while ignoring the senators in the process.
mention.source: Iuno brings up Augusta in “By Sun's Burning Hand” (26×)

mention.title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
mention.text: It doesn't make sense. The Earthrend Wedge is still holding back the Dark Tide at its depths... At any rate, Augusta's already led a team to the Sanguis Plateaus to investigate.
mention.source: Iuno brings up Augusta in “Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides” (6×)

mention.title: By Moon's Fated Light
mention.text: Did something happen in Septimont? Is it Augusta or the others? No, that's impossible... I should've disappeared by now. Why do I feel so tired? Like I'm walking the same path, over and over again without end...
mention.source: Iuno brings up Augusta in “By Moon's Fated Light” (4×)

mention.title: Shadow of Glory
mention.text: Augusta, look! Another two have earned Arsinosa's blessing.
mention.source: Iuno brings up Augusta in “Shadow of Glory” (3×)

mention.title: Rust, Sword and the Sun
mention.text: You're overthinking it, Augusta. I'm here to see that person.
mention.source: Iuno brings up Augusta in “Rust, Sword and the Sun” (2×)

mention.title: By Sun's Burning Hand
mention.text: It's rare to see Iuno hold back like that. You must be someone... different to her.
mention.source: Augusta brings up Iuno in “By Sun's Burning Hand” (7×)

mention.title: Rust, Sword and the Sun
mention.text: The Senate should be reminded now and then that the Tetragon's kindness is not a reason to take Priestess Iuno lightly.
mention.source: Augusta brings up Iuno in “Rust, Sword and the Sun” (6×)

mention.title: By Moon's Fated Light
mention.text: Existence always leaves a trace. Beyond feeling, memory, and perception, is there anything that can prove this "Iuno" isn't an illusion?
mention.source: Augusta brings up Iuno in “By Moon's Fated Light” (2×)

mention.title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
mention.text: Iuno. We know each other.
mention.source: Augusta brings up Iuno in “Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides” (2×)

sample.speaker: Avidius
sample.text: Such carnage...

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: These tricks do not surprise me.

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: Avidius, take a response team and get that Anchor Obelisk functioning.

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: Rover and I will provide cover.

sample.speaker: Avidius
sample.text: As you command, Your Excellency.

scene.desc: With the Sovereign slain, you attend the victory ceremony by invitation of Ceremonial Officer Bruno. The celebration honors the new Hero of Heroes and those who stood by their side amidst the crackling bonfire and joyous cheers of the crowd... Now that the countless petals are to be thrown into the sky to become the rain of glory and triumph, you might finally reunite with the girl you have never forgotten in a way even beyond fate's grasp.

voiceline.title: About Avidius
voiceline.text: A formidable opponent. His words and actions have indeed earned the Senate's favor. I'm well aware the Senate is far from clean, but I trust Avidius has no intention of sinking into its filth. What I do wonder, though, is how fiercely his ambition will burn… or whether the confusion I now see in his eyes will one day consume him, leaving only cold embers in the wake of a fire gone out.

mention.title: By Sun's Burning Hand
mention.text: I assure you, Priestess, I will not act from the shadows. If Augusta seeks a fair challenge, I shall honor her with the respect she deserves.
mention.source: Avidius brings up Augusta in “By Sun's Burning Hand” (3×)

mention.title: By Moon's Fated Light
mention.text: I always thought I was the hero who conquered Manes Deep. The one more worthy of ruling than even Augusta.
mention.source: Avidius brings up Augusta in “By Moon's Fated Light”

mention.title: By Sun's Burning Hand
mention.text: Avidius, descendant of the Hero of Heroes, Atilius. Decorated for the four crossings of Manes Deep.
mention.source: Augusta brings up Avidius in “By Sun's Burning Hand” (7×)

dialogue.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

sample.speaker: Lupa
sample.text: Feels like just yesterday we were fighting side by side in the Colosseum. And now look at you, "Hero of Heroes" and all. Didn't see that coming!

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: Rover, your arrival is appreciated.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Oh, let me introduce you. Augusta, this is...

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: Iuno. We know each other.

sample.speaker: Iuno
sample.text: Å lot happened while you were off adventuring. You missed some fun.

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: It is strange... From the moment we met, it felt like we were cut from the same cloth. Like we'd known each other before. She might seem unmoored, but when the storm hits, she holds fast.

dialogue.desc: Cartethyia vanished in the Inverted Tower. To uncover the truth, you form a temporary alliance with Contender Lupa. Together, you set your sights on the championship...

sample.speaker: Lupa
sample.text: In this very match, the Silvas stooped to underhanded tactics!

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: Speak plainly, Gladiator.

sample.speaker: Lupa
sample.text: This spear… it was a gift from Domina Julia, head of House Silva, when I first joined the family.

sample.speaker: Lupa
sample.text: Back then, I trusted the Silvas completely, never once doubting their intentions. That is, until I chose to leave them not long ago.

sample.speaker: Lupa
sample.text: Now in today's arena, this spear spiraled out of control, nearly stabbing my own teammate!

dialogue.summary: Lupa announces to Ephor Augusta that her weapon was tampered with, but House Silva denies the accusation.

voiceline.title: About Lupa
voiceline.text: A genius made for the arena whose passion burns pure. Had we met in the early days of the Colosseum, perhaps we would have fought side by side, as you two do now. Just watching her reminds me that my efforts to reform the arena were not in vain. The Colosseum is always meant to be a stage for passion and glory, not a mire of corruption and decay.

voiceline.title: About Augusta
voiceline.text: Whenever I watch videos of the Ephor's past fights, I do wonder if she stepped into the arena for political reasons, or-or to prove herself. Whatever her reason, Augusta's rise to power was a good thing for Septimont. Change is always toughest at the beginning. And for that, I have respect for her.

mention.title: Shadow of Glory
mention.text: Ephor Augusta's are the most popular. Four years ago, she became the champion and a household name by crushing every single opponent. From there, she worked her way up into the Ephor's seat.
mention.source: Lupa brings up Augusta in “Shadow of Glory” (6×)

dialogue.desc: As the High Tide draws near, a lurking calamity stirs, with its gaze fixed upon the borders of Septimont. Ephor Augusta invites you to the Sanguis Plateaus for a fateful hunt, the one that may decide the realm's survival...

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: Of course. I'll leave it to you then.

sample.speaker: Buling
sample.text: Alright, I think I got the whole picture now... Oh Rover, how do you keep ending up in messes like this? This is one tough cookie, all right.

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: You mean...

sample.speaker: Buling
sample.text: Let me tell you, the latest data we got from the Resonance Nexus isn't so pretty. Something's really off with the Dark Tide in that Sanguis place. I don't remember it being this crazy before.

sample.speaker: Buling
sample.text: Normally, the Dark Tide getting all freaky during High Tide is whatever, right? But now, I don't know what happened, cuz it's... it's turning into a person.

sample.speaker: Buling
sample.text: So listen up, I'll give you Tethys's rundown. That humanoid thing, that "Sovereign," is gobbling up frequencies like a maniac!

voiceline.title: About Buling
voiceline.text: Buling... Heh, just from the name alone, I can tell she's from Huanglong. From the moment we met, this remarkable young lady made an impression. I'm grateful she kept her promise and gave Septimont a fighting chance. For me, and for everyone in this land, her kindness is a debt we will never forget.

mention.title: By Sun's Burning Hand
mention.text: Buling mentioned even something small could have a great influence. The smaller, the more unnoticed.
mention.source: Augusta brings up Buling in “By Sun's Burning Hand” (2×)

dialogue.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: We won't last much longer at this rate...

sample.speaker: Galbrena
sample.text: The entrance is open. Now's the time...

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: ...What are you doing?

sample.speaker: Galbrena
sample.text: What I always planned to do―hunt the Threnodian.

sample.speaker: Galbrena
sample.text: The moment I jump into the Dark Tide, the Tidespawn will retreat to defend. That's when you seal the Anti-Corrosion Ward. Trap them in one stroke.

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: Jump into the Dark Tide? Are you out of your mind ?!

scene.desc: As the High Tide draws near, a lurking calamity stirs, with its gaze fixed upon the borders of Septimont. Ephor Augusta invites you to the Sanguis Plateaus for a fateful hunt, the one that may decide the realm's survival...

voiceline.title: About Angel
voiceline.text: Angel... I've never forgotten Fabianum, nor the past we shared. When our homeland fell... I don't know what kind of nightmare she faced that day in the depths of Oak Hollow. But there is a voice in my heart that never fades... it tells me she's still alive. And I believe, one day, Angel will find her way home, back to our land.

voiceline.title: About Augusta
voiceline.text: Augusta... she was my childhood friend. Back then, I'd usually sit quietly under a tree, lost in my own thoughts. She'd be off swinging her sword, shouting about becoming the next Hero of Heroes. She loved dragging me into sparring matches... We'd often end up scuffling into the Fabianum rivers, and when we got tired, we'd lie on the riverbank letting the cool water soak us completely. Now... time has changed a lot. But thankfully, not all of it for the worse. Augusta became exactly the kind of ruler Septimont needed.

mention.title: Of a Childhood Long Gone
mention.text: The girl, Augusta, cared most for the stories behind each weapon, while Angel was captivated by the mysterious ritual of "quenching."
mention.source: Galbrena's character story “Of a Childhood Long Gone”

mention.title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
mention.text: Augusta, you buried the "Waystone" yourself. But it's been corrupted. Only the Sentinel's power can purifv it.
mention.source: Galbrena brings up Augusta in “Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides” (5×)

dialogue.desc: Amidst a ripple of Reverberations, you hear the call... As you unravel your past, a new path unfolds before you, beckoning from the unknown.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Could it be the side effect of fighting that Tacet Discord? Baizhi, can we take Rover to do a check-up at Huaxu Academy's Resonance Medical Department...

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Baizhi?

sample.speaker: Baizhi
sample.text: Absorbing Echoes with the human body is not entirely unprecedented.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: With the human body...?

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: I remember Comprehensive Mirror for Historians mentioned this in the Huanglong section's opening...

dialogue.desc: Amidst a ripple of Reverberations, you hear the call... As you unravel your past, a new path unfolds before you, beckoning from the unknown.

sample.speaker: Baizhi
sample.text: Myself included.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Baizhi, I think your last sentence could be worded better...

sample.speaker: Baizhi
sample.text: I see. I agree that my phrasing lacked the attention to detail. Please allow me to reorganize my words.

dialogue.desc: As the city lights twinkle, friendly faces beckon you to join them in the bustling border town. Immerse yourself in its prosperous yet tranquil ambiance.

sample.speaker: Baizhi
sample.text: This is not an ordinary leaf, but it doesn't seem to be a Tacet Discord, either. Based on the data we gathered, I believe it was sampled from an area struck with the Waveworn phenomena.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Yes. The anomalies that occurred after the Lament, including the formation of Tacet Fields, Etheric Sea, Retroact Rain, and gravity loss... These are collectively called the Waveworn phenomena.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: And the Lament was the start of it all.

sample.speaker: Baizhi
sample.text: As for the sugar pearl... It has been determined to be a type of oral vaccine.

sample.speaker: Baizhi
sample.text: This sugar pearl expired over 20 years ago. The low-temperature storage life for this vaccine is about 2 years.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: A 20-year-old vaccine...

dialogue.desc: The Land of Xuanfang is thrown into turmoil following an unexpected riot of out-of-control Autopuppets. As you investigate, you uncover the mastermind behind the scheme—a mysterious Artisan who covets the Sentinel's technology. In the culmination of the event, this figure commands the rogue Autopuppets to launch an assault on Xuanfang Hold.

sample.speaker: Baizhi
sample.text: Yangyang, Rover, what are your plans now?

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Hmm...

sample.speaker: Baizhi
sample.text: Don't let Jinzhou weigh on you. Just focus on the problem at hand.

sample.speaker: Baizhi
sample.text: As for that... new look of yours, the explanation can wait until you've caught your breath. Best to wait until Chixia has fully recovered. Otherwise, the shock might land her right back in that hospital bed.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: I understand. Thank you, Baizhi.

dialogue.desc: Days after the Autopuppet crisis was solved, Yangyang chooses to stay behind in the Land of Xuanfang to assist the soldiers and the civilians. As she's waiting on her Resonance Assessment report, a mysterious voice starts to whisper in her ears...

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Huh? Did I miss something...?

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Yangyang! Your avatar!!!

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: What's with the new style?!

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: You do look nice, I'll be honest. Hehe.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Oh, this... It's a long story...

dialogue.desc: As the Moon-Chasing Festival approaches, you become aware of the "Moontree Lodge" tales under the Wishing Tree. An encounter with a strange robot links you to the mysterious wish granter at the Lodge...

sample.speaker: Baizhi
sample.text: With the Threnodian defeated, our Sentinel and the Jinzhou Magistrate have resumed their duties. Jinzhou will have peace and prosperity once more.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Yes. Oh Rover, and the Sentinel did give you certain insights about your memory loss. While there's still much to uncover, at least we're on the right track.

scene.desc: The previous puzzle's answers has been revealed, but it only leads to another one. With a storm on the horizon, you follow the Magistrate's advice and search for clues about "the Black Shores".
As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

scene.quest: Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song
scene.desc: The frequencies building up within Patty have resonated with the environment and generated a Sonoro Sphere. The truth about the fourth wish may be hidden therein. The name Patty keeps mumbling about seems to be connected with Xiangli Yao. You must head it off at the pass before things get out of hands at the Moonlit Fair.

voiceline.title: About Yangyang
voiceline.text: Some people are good at listening, while some are good at counseling others. Yangyang is good at both. With her, you can just be yourself.

voiceline.title: About Baizhi
voiceline.text: Baizhi has a unique approach to comprehending and accomplishing tasks, but that doesn't make her a difficult person to talk to. When you ask her for help, you may notice a flicker of surprise on her face, but you will never receive a refusal.

mention.title: First Resonance
mention.text: He might be able to help us get in touch with Baizhi, but, erm... it seems we've caught him at a bad time.
mention.source: Yangyang brings up Baizhi in “First Resonance” (7×)

mention.title: Utterance of Marvels: I
mention.text: Baizhi is just concerned about your condition. She must think we shouldn't be letting you move around that much, since you've just regained consciousness...
mention.source: Yangyang brings up Baizhi in “Utterance of Marvels: I” (7×)

mention.title: A New Companion
mention.text: So, the excess energy this little thing had "consumed" somehow ended up in your body, available at your disposal. In other words, there's a deeper connection between the two of you. Or, according to Baizhi, it’s a Convergent Codependency.
mention.source: Yangyang brings up Baizhi in “A New Companion” (7×)

mention.title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
mention.text: My voicemail is... wait. Ninety-nine missed calls?! Baizhi, Zhezhi, Taoqi, Suisui, Jianxin... even Magistrate Jinhsi called!
mention.source: Yangyang brings up Baizhi in “Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled” (4×)

mention.title: Echoing Marche
mention.text: Baizhi said the leaf bears the frequencies of Tacet Discords, so it must be from a tree near a Tacet Field.
mention.source: Yangyang brings up Baizhi in “Echoing Marche”

mention.title: Utterance of Marvels: II
mention.text: Baizhi, I think your last sentence could be worded better...
mention.source: Yangyang brings up Baizhi in “Utterance of Marvels: II”

mention.title: The Chant of Unseen Ties
mention.text: Baizhi told me your numbers are up, and there's nothing to worry about.
mention.source: Yangyang brings up Baizhi in “The Chant of Unseen Ties”

mention.title: The Wind Before the Storm
mention.text: Chixia... the Midnight Rangers who brought her back said she was gravely injured, but she still made it across the Dreaming Cavern by herself. She stayed conscious long enough to tell them what happened to Yangyang before finally collapsing.
mention.source: Baizhi brings up Yangyang in “The Wind Before the Storm” (5×)

mention.title: First Resonance
mention.text: Apart from the ancient legend Yangyang mentioned earlier, I've never heard of anything like this...
mention.source: Baizhi brings up Yangyang in “First Resonance” (2×)

mention.title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
mention.text: Yangyang, Rover, I don't know what you've faced in Xuanfang Hold these past few days...
mention.source: Baizhi brings up Yangyang in “Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled” (2×)

mention.title: Utterance of Marvels: I
mention.text: Worry has clouded your judgement, Yangyang.
mention.source: Baizhi brings up Yangyang in “Utterance of Marvels: I”

mention.title: Moonlit Reunion
mention.text: Don't mind me, I tend not to make wishes. But if I did, it would probably be similar to Yangyang's.
mention.source: Baizhi brings up Yangyang in “Moonlit Reunion”

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Baizhi, you know, we... huh?

sample.speaker: Baizhi
sample.text: You are alright, it seems.

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: You know, was super energetic! Handled a super big TD! Way more spirited than me!

sample.speaker: Baizhi
sample.text: Given our lack of data on you and your unusual physical signs, I suggest absorbing another Reverberation with your Terminal when we find one. That being said, please be sure to proceed cautiously.

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Yeah, don't go too hard on yourself. You should get a check-up just to be safe. Besides, Yangyang's very worried about you.

dialogue.desc: The previous puzzle's answers has been revealed, but it only leads to another one. With a storm on the horizon, you follow the Magistrate's advice and search for clues about "the Black Shores".

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: There you are, Rover!

sample.speaker: Baizhi
sample.text: The Academy has noted a concerning rise of Tacet Field activities. Please use caution when exiting the city.

sample.speaker: Baizhi
sample.text: Remember to check your Terminal signals, and wear the Academy's protective suit correctly.

sample.speaker: Baizhi
sample.text: ...And don't forget to stay hydrated. Now, I have experiments to run. Take care.

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: It's just Baizhi being Baizhi. She's a little awkward with showing care, but I think it's cute!

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Anyway! Rover, quick, tell us what happened!

sample.speaker: Baizhi
sample.text: She's right here. Still undergoing treatment.

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Yang... Yang...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: ...Don't worry, Chixia. I'll bring Yangyang back.

sample.speaker: Baizhi
sample.text: We should step outside. She needs rest.

dialogue.desc: Days after the Autopuppet crisis was solved, Yangyang chooses to stay behind in the Land of Xuanfang to assist the soldiers and the civilians. As she's waiting on her Resonance Assessment report, a mysterious voice starts to whisper in her ears...

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Aw, man... I could really use some sunlight. Breathe in that fresh air, and stretch my legs a bit...

sample.speaker: Baizhi
sample.text: Chixia, adequate rest is a more appropriate approach to your current condition.

sample.speaker: Baizhi
sample.text: As I understand, profound moaning and groaning have no positive effect on your recovery, and such childish behavior will only result in your extended stay at Huaxu Academy for up to two weeks.

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Uh... There's Baizhi being tough again...

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Fine, I'll be a good girl and behave myself. Can't have everyone looking after me forever...

dialogue.quest: Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song
dialogue.desc: The frequencies building up within Patty have resonated with the environment and generated a Sonoro Sphere. The truth about the fourth wish may be hidden therein. The name Patty keeps mumbling about seems to be connected with Xiangli Yao. You must head it off at the pass before things get out of hands at the Moonlit Fair.

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: And you, Baizhi?

sample.speaker: Baizhi
sample.text: Please come early if possible.

sample.speaker: Baizhi
sample.text: People have been preparing for the Moonlit Fair for many weeks.

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Rover, I just sent the coordinates to your Terminal! See you there!

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Haha, get ready to be blown away!

dialogue.desc: As the Moon-Chasing Festival approaches, you become aware of the "Moontree Lodge" tales under the Wishing Tree. An encounter with a strange robot links you to the mysterious wish granter at the Lodge...

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: She, um... She's not really into wishes.

sample.speaker: Baizhi
sample.text: Don't mind me, I tend not to make wishes. But if I did, it would probably be similar to Yangyang's.

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: There, you're the last one left, Rover. Oh, and don't forget about Abby! I'm sure the little guy doesn't want to miss out.

scene.desc: As the city lights twinkle, friendly faces beckon you to join them in the bustling border town. Immerse yourself in its prosperous yet tranquil ambiance.
As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

The Land of Xuanfang is thrown into turmoil following an unexpected riot of out-of-control Autopuppets. As you investigate, you uncover the mastermind behind the scheme—a mysterious Artisan who covets the Sentinel's technology. In the culmination of the event, this figure commands the rogue Autopuppets to launch an assault on Xuanfang Hold.

voiceline.title: About Chixia
voiceline.text: When I first met Chixia, I was indeed a bit overwhelmed... She was always vibrant and lively, and her way of thinking was very different from mine. As our understanding of each other grew, we created a unique synergy. Our differences complemented each other perfectly.

voiceline.title: About Baizhi
voiceline.text: Speaking of Baizhi, she's not the talkative type. Don't get me wrong, she's not an Ice Queen! She just has her own ways of expressing emotions. You'll get it once you've spent enough time with her.

mention.title: Utterance of Marvels: I
mention.text: Ugh, I knew it. Our gourds are out of service because of the Etheric Sea's influence. We can't send or receive messages for help now. We better hurry over to meet up with Baizhi at our gathering spot and get outta here.
mention.source: Chixia brings up Baizhi in “Utterance of Marvels: I” (11×)

mention.title: First Resonance
mention.text: I'd love me some Chili Sauce Tofu, Jinzhou Maocai, Spicy Meat Slices... Ugh, I'm starving. Wait a sec, we still need to meet up with Baizhi first, right?
mention.source: Chixia brings up Baizhi in “First Resonance” (3×)

mention.title: A New Companion
mention.text: Knew it. Nothing about Rover's ever gonna be easy to figure out... Hmm. Maybe we should bring Baizhi, Mr. Xiangli Yao, and all the researchers in Jinzhou... No, in the entire Huanglong together. They'll do a nice and thorough examination on Abby, and then...
mention.source: Chixia brings up Baizhi in “A New Companion” (3×)

mention.title: Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song
mention.text: Seriously? What a pity... Okay then, I'll tell Yangyang and Baizhi you can't make it to the show...
mention.source: Chixia brings up Baizhi in “Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song” (3×)

mention.title: Echoing Marche
mention.text: And with just a few tugs of the rope, I bet every researcher will come running at you, with Baizhi leading the pack. Hook, line, and sinker!
mention.source: Chixia brings up Baizhi in “Echoing Marche” (2×)

mention.title: Rewinding Raindrops
mention.text: It's just Baizhi being Baizhi. She's a little awkward with showing care, but I think it's cute!
mention.source: Chixia brings up Baizhi in “Rewinding Raindrops” (2×)

mention.title: The Chant of Unseen Ties
mention.text: Uh... There's Baizhi being tough again...
mention.source: Chixia brings up Baizhi in “The Chant of Unseen Ties”

mention.title: A Taste of Everything
mention.text: You got it! Next time, we'll bring Yangyang and Baizhi along. Food's always better with more pals, right? But what should we get then?
mention.source: Chixia brings up Baizhi in “A Taste of Everything”

mention.title: The Wind Before the Storm
mention.text: Chixia... the Midnight Rangers who brought her back said she was gravely injured, but she still made it across the Dreaming Cavern by herself. She stayed conscious long enough to tell them what happened to Yangyang before finally collapsing.
mention.source: Baizhi brings up Chixia in “The Wind Before the Storm” (5×)

mention.title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
mention.text: As for that... new look of yours, the explanation can wait until you've caught your breath. Best to wait until Chixia has fully recovered. Otherwise, the shock might land her right back in that hospital bed.
mention.source: Baizhi brings up Chixia in “Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled” (2×)

mention.title: The Chant of Unseen Ties
mention.text: Chixia, adequate rest is a more appropriate approach to your current condition.
mention.source: Baizhi brings up Chixia in “The Chant of Unseen Ties”

timeline.quest: Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song

dialogue.desc: As the city lights twinkle, friendly faces beckon you to join them in the bustling border town. Immerse yourself in its prosperous yet tranquil ambiance.

sample.speaker: Mortefi
sample.text: So, sugar pearls like this were distributed at hospitals? Perhaps...

sample.speaker: Baizhi
sample.text: The sugar pearl might be a type of medicine. Its sweet taste would've made it more palatable to children.

sample.speaker: Mortefi
sample.text: Ms. Baizhi. As a Huanglong local working at the Academy, I suppose you already had an idea about what it is?

sample.speaker: Baizhi
sample.text: I do have my theory as to what it is, but it still needs verification. I wouldn't proclaim any solid answers before confirming the chemical composition of this item with reliable data.

sample.speaker: Mortefi
sample.text: Seconded. Let's find out through actual testing, then.

sample.speaker: Baizhi
sample.text: It will take some time before the results are ready. If you have other matters to take care of, you should go ahead. I'll let you know once we have the results.

dialogue.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

sample.speaker: Mortefi
sample.text: Lastly, we've got more bad news... Baizhi, please fill us in.

sample.speaker: Baizhi
sample.text: Yes.

sample.speaker: Baizhi
sample.text: Rover, I am currently monitoring the Tacet Discord attacks from the Academy to design a safer route for you.

sample.speaker: Baizhi
sample.text: We just received word from our soldiers at the emplacement. A large number of Tacet Discords are targeting the Disruptor, and our troops are doing their best to defend it.

sample.speaker: Baizhi
sample.text: The Disruptor has been surrounded by the Tacet Discords, with more of them slowly closing in.

sample.speaker: Baizhi
sample.text: After we recapture the nearby emplacement, it will take some more time for the Disruptor to recharge. You may need to hold out a little longer.

scene.quest: Depths of Illusive Realm · event story

voiceline.title: About Mortefi
voiceline.text: We didn't converse frequently, but our cooperation was always seamless. He may experience minor inflammation-related health issues because of his Resonance Ability, so I suggest bringing him Bittberry tea next time. A single cup can relieve his symptoms for a whole day.

voiceline.title: About Baizhi
voiceline.text: Baizhi and I are almost colleagues, though we don't work in the same department. I've only interacted with her briefly on a few occasions, but I had the chance to read some of her writings. Her paper was well-thought-out and carefully expressed, featuring an intriguing perspective. If I may comment, she is an excellent scholar of Remnant Creatures.

mention.title: First Resonance
mention.text: Ms. Baizhi. As a Huanglong local working at the Academy, I suppose you already had an idea about what it is?
mention.source: Mortefi brings up Baizhi in “First Resonance” (2×)

mention.title: Grand Warstorm
mention.text: Lastly, we've got more bad news... Baizhi, please fill us in.
mention.source: Mortefi brings up Baizhi in “Grand Warstorm”

mention.title: Pastures like old times
mention.text: It's someone you know. Baizhi. She specializes in Ecoacoustic research, and the Sonoro Sphere is her field of expertise.
mention.source: Mortefi brings up Baizhi in “Pastures like old times”

mention.title: Unsettled Aftermath (I)
mention.text: Baizhi mentioned you came into contact with a substantial amount of Autopuppets in Xuanfang Hold. I'd like to hear about them. The more detail, the better.
mention.source: Mortefi brings up Baizhi in “Unsettled Aftermath (I)”

mention.title: First Resonance
mention.text: Yes, Mortefi is the Branch of Tacetite Weaponry's head within the Department of Safety.
mention.source: Baizhi brings up Mortefi in “First Resonance”

dialogue.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

sample.speaker: Baizhi
sample.text: Forgive me, Rover. After I heard, I also wanted to search for Yangyang immediately. But with Chixia in this condition, I had no choice but to...

sample.speaker: Xiangli Yao
sample.text: That's right, Baizhi. Without you, Chixia's condition wouldn't have stabilized so quickly. And frankly, she might've been left with permanent damage.

sample.speaker: Xiangli Yao
sample.text: Rover, Sanhua told me about your situation. I take it you'll be heading to Xuanfang Hold soon?

sample.speaker: Baizhi
sample.text: Do be extra cautious, Rover. Xuanfang Hold isn't just any military stronghold. It's the pinnacle of what Automata Mechanics as a field can achieve today, and for the foreseeable future.

sample.speaker: Xiangli Yao
sample.text: It's the masterpiece of Mengzhou's Sentinel, Hsin. A mechanical city built for the sole purpose of trapping and eliminating Tacet Discords to keep wider Mengzhou safe.

sample.speaker: Xiangli Yao
sample.text: Xuanfang Hold has stood at the border between our two states for over two hundred years now. Not a single incident in all that time. It's a "living" city in its own way that doesn't rely on people to run things. Instead, it uses creations called "Autopuppets" to fight off TDs.

dialogue.desc: The Land of Xuanfang is thrown into turmoil following an unexpected riot of out-of-control Autopuppets. As you investigate, you uncover the mastermind behind the scheme—a mysterious Artisan who covets the Sentinel's technology. In the culmination of the event, this figure commands the rogue Autopuppets to launch an assault on Xuanfang Hold.

sample.speaker: Xiangli Yao
sample.text: I should be returning to my lab. I wish you a swift and successful conclusion to this case.

sample.speaker: Baizhi
sample.text: Yangyang, Rover, what are your plans now?

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Hmm...

sample.speaker: Baizhi
sample.text: Don't let Jinzhou weigh on you. Just focus on the problem at hand.

sample.speaker: Baizhi
sample.text: As for that... new look of yours, the explanation can wait until you've caught your breath. Best to wait until Chixia has fully recovered. Otherwise, the shock might land her right back in that hospital bed.

scene.desc: The frequencies building up within Patty have resonated with the environment and generated a Sonoro Sphere. The truth about the fourth wish may be hidden therein. As the Moon-Chasing Festival approaches, you become aware of the "Moontree Lodge" tales under the Wishing Tree. An encounter with a strange robot links you to the mysterious wish granter at the Lodge...

voiceline.title: About Xiangli Yao
voiceline.text: His good temper is almost as impressive as the exceptional talent he has. I've never seen him raise his voice in anger at anyone. No matter how impossible the task sounds, he always delivers.

voiceline.title: About Baizhi
voiceline.text: Baizhi is a great researcher. Our work doesn't often overlap, but I've read her reports and they're well-informed and persuasive. She often participates in field research, earning her a reputation among peers for bringing back valuable data.

mention.title: Wish Upon the Moon II: The Elder's Promise
mention.text: So that's what you're worried about. It seems what Baizhi said about you is true. You do have a gentle soul.
mention.source: Xiangli Yao brings up Baizhi in “Wish Upon the Moon II: The Elder's Promise”

mention.title: The Wind Before the Storm
mention.text: That's right, Baizhi. Without you, Chixia's condition wouldn't have stabilized so quickly. And frankly, she might've been left with permanent damage.
mention.source: Xiangli Yao brings up Baizhi in “The Wind Before the Storm”

timeline.quest: Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song

scene.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

scene.quest: Depths of Illusive Realm · event story

voiceline.title: About Yuanwu
voiceline.text: The tea Mr. Yuanwu brews always tastes sweeter than those served in teahouses, even if the same recipe and ingredients were used. He told me it was only because he put his sincerity into it. Sincerity... How does it affect the flavor of tea?

dialogue.desc: What would the Captain of the Fool's Troupe normally do? Stage an impromptu performance or set out on a great adventure? Instead of speculating, why not hear it straight from Brant himself? A captivating journey surely awaits!

sample.speaker: Brant
sample.text: Thank you! Thank you!

sample.speaker: Margherita
sample.text: That was a wonderful performance!

sample.speaker: Brant
sample.text: To be honest, I came dangerously close to it…

sample.speaker: Margherita
sample.text: Take care not to overindulge again. We don't offer home delivery for humans, I assure you.

sample.speaker: Brant
sample.text: Alright, seems like we've got ourselves a lucky gentleman.

sample.speaker: Brant
sample.text: How about an introduction first, and then you tell us where that coin is?

scene.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

scene.quest: What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing
scene.desc: Following Carlotta's guidance, you arrive at the Penitent's End and reunite with the Troupe. Here, another buried secret of the Order awaits discovery...

mention.title: Thoughts: V
mention.text: Over there, just around the corner—that's Trattoria Margherita.
mention.source: Brant's voice line “Thoughts: V”

mention.title: When the Carnevale Ends
mention.text: First, he bought a pizza from Margherita's, then made a bet with the pigeons in the square.
mention.source: Brant's character story “When the Carnevale Ends”

mention.title: Sail Day, Captain!
mention.text: Margherita, two glasses of Nectarwine please, and top off Bella's drink. On my tab.
mention.source: Brant brings up Margherita in “Sail Day, Captain!”

dialogue.desc: To open the Sentinel's Relic, you head back to Ragunna once more...

sample.speaker: Brant
sample.text: Even in Septimont, folks claim they've seen Tacet Discords not of this land in the wilds, or the ghosts of their ancestors.

sample.speaker: Roccia
sample.text: Thanks to all these oddities, the mood in Ragunna has gone sour.

sample.speaker: Roccia
sample.text: The Troupe performed today because Brant thought a new play to lighten the mood might give the people some hope.

sample.speaker: Brant
sample.text: But here's the odd part. Only Rinascitans seem to be having these dreams. Visitors are spared... the same should be true of you.

sample.speaker: Roccia
sample.text: Well... Not Brant or me. But someone in the Troupe has. They said they dreamed of sinking into an enormous, black ocean...

sample.speaker: Brant
sample.text: The Tacet Discords in the Stormy Sea have been more restless lately. And the "siren's" songs? Well, they've started sounding an awful lot like the Order's hymns...

dialogue.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

sample.speaker: Roccia
sample.text: Oh, it's Rover...

sample.speaker: Brant
sample.text: We did right by the trust they placed in us. We got all the folks from Riccioli Islands to safety.

sample.speaker: Roccia
sample.text: Compared to what you're about to face, that s torm was nothing.

sample.speaker: Brant
sample.text: Sailing into the unknown is never easy. Sailing through the Dark Tide? Even worse.

sample.speaker: Roccia
sample.text: Pero stocked up on gadgets. You can take whatever you like!

sample.speaker: Roccia
sample.text: This is all we can do for you right now... Please come back safe, Rover.

dialogue.quest: What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing
dialogue.desc: Following Carlotta's guidance, you arrive at the Penitent's End and reunite with the Troupe. Here, another buried secret of the Order awaits discovery...

sample.speaker: Brant
sample.text: In the face of danger and adversity, the stage is set for our grandest act!

sample.speaker: Roccia
sample.text: Brant, you handle the Tacet Discords. I've got the dragon.

sample.speaker: Brant
sample.text: Of course, but with all due respect... shouldn't the Captain be the one giving the orders?

sample.speaker: Roccia
sample.text: Just playing to our strengths. Take it, or I'll spill the beans about your wine stash.

sample.speaker: Brant
sample.text: Aye, aye, First Mate!

sample.speaker: Roccia
sample.text: It's time to pay for what you've done, Dragon of Dirge.

scene.desc: Shorekeeper might have some clues about Abby's weakening frequencies. Return to the Black Shores to find out.

You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

voiceline.title: About Roccia
voiceline.text: Don't be fooled by our First Mate's age—if you ever need performance advice, she's your go-to. Plus, she's also an excellent stage designer!

voiceline.title: About Brant
voiceline.text: Brant is the greatest captain in all of Solaris. At least, that's what he insists I say. But it's true, having him around really does bring out the best in us. His passion is infectious, and his belief in freedom is like the mast that keeps us all steady.

mention.title: Dusk, When Fools Sing
mention.text: Battier hauled in a bountiful catch of fish, Lavito returned with a bundle of hares from his hunt, and Roccia, with her loyal companion Pero, returned with a basket of meat they'd bought with one of the bounties earned in the name of Captain Brant. Battier and Lavito were deep in a heated debate, Hymer and Budd were playing rock-paper-scissors, and Tina was coaching Roccia on breathing techniques for singing.
mention.source: Brant's character story “Dusk, When Fools Sing”

mention.title: Peculiar Box
mention.text: Tina's bright voice rang out, Bardolino flew in the air with balloons and tossed petals, Brant swung down on a rope holding a massive welcome banner, and Pero fired the confetti pistol, inviting her to the stage.
mention.source: Roccia's character story “Peculiar Box”

mention.title: New Stage
mention.text: "Brant the Maverick Captain," and "Pero the Peculiar Box" became legends of their own. Childhood memories were hazy for Roccia, but as she followed Brant and the crew into Ragunna's streets, the familiar smell of Trattoria Margherita's fresh-baked pizza and the songs spilling from the Odyssey Opera House stirred something deep within her, just like it did everyone else.
mention.source: Roccia's character story “New Stage”

mention.title: Through the Sea Thou Break
mention.text: All good, Roccia? Some new friends have joined us.
mention.source: Brant brings up Roccia in “Through the Sea Thou Break”

mention.title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
mention.text: But you're a bit too young for this, Roccia. The crew and I will handle the taste test!
mention.source: Brant brings up Roccia in “Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides”

mention.title: All Out! Towards the Peaks of Prestige (Quest)
mention.text: Of course not! Came with the whole Troupe. But Roccia's busy with prepping a show with the others and said they didn't need me hanging around.
mention.source: Brant brings up Roccia in “All Out! Towards the Peaks of Prestige (Quest)”

mention.title: What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing
mention.text: Use it to protect yourself. Our troupe will bring you to our base soon and tell you the truth we've uncovered. I'll join you once I find Brant.
mention.source: Roccia brings up Brant in “What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing” (10×)

mention.title: Veils Off in Sun or Shadow
mention.text: Use it to protect yourself. Our troupe will bring you to our base soon and tell you the truth we've uncovered. I'll join you once I find Brant.
mention.source: Roccia brings up Brant in “Veils Off in Sun or Shadow” (4×)

mention.title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
mention.text: Well... Not Brant or me. But someone in the Troupe has. They said they dreamed of sinking into an enormous, black ocean...
mention.source: Roccia brings up Brant in “The Bygone Shall Always Return” (2×)

mention.title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
mention.text: Good work, Brant. And thank you, everyone.
mention.source: Roccia brings up Brant in “Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides”

mention.title: Sail Day, Captain!
mention.text: Leave the paperwork to Brant. Pero will keep an eye on him to make sure it's done by tomorrow.
mention.source: Roccia brings up Brant in “Sail Day, Captain!” (2×)

mention.title: The Stars Still Burn Bright
mention.text: Should it be "Battier and the Golden Harpoon," "Tina the Soprano Navigator," "Brant the Maverick Captain," or "Pero the Peculiar Box"?
mention.source: Roccia brings up Brant in “The Stars Still Burn Bright”

dialogue.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

sample.speaker: Brant
sample.text: The north flank's ours! Let's give 'em a grand show!

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: The Montellis greet you. We will secure this side.

dialogue.quest: What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing
dialogue.desc: Following Carlotta's guidance, you arrive at the Penitent's End and reunite with the Troupe. Here, another buried secret of the Order awaits discovery...

sample.speaker: Brant
sample.text: "Ghost" is just a dramatic name given by the Ragunnesi for Tacet Discords. They look nearly identical to Echoes, especially in the mist.

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: With your help, Grandfather has thwarted their plan. No corrupted Echoes will appear at this year's Carnevale.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Order has allied with the Fractsidus to control the dragon... From what I saw when I connected with its frequency, they might be planning to command it to attack Ragunna during the Carnevale.

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: After the Tacet Discords took over this isle, the Order used them as an excuse to forbid any entry. It might be their way of concealing the dragon's existence.

sample.speaker: Brant
sample.text: But without the Lycoris, the Dragon of Dirge is now off the table.

dialogue.desc: You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: We're also waiting for your guidance, Primus.

sample.speaker: Brant
sample.text: Inded. The show is still missing a key character! The ceremony can't kick off in grand style without our beloved, ever-devout Acolyte!

scene.desc: To open the Sentinel's Relic, you head back to Ragunna once more...

voiceline.title: About Carlotta
voiceline.text: She's got her course set and sticks to it, no matter what. Living as a Montelli is no easy path, but she's determined to make her own way. And mark my words, when her performances draw to a close, she'll be known not just as a Montelli, but Carlotta.

voiceline.title: About Brant
voiceline.text: He's the captain leading his crew through tempestuous seas, and I often wonder whether his gaze from the deck reveals ambition, or selflessness and passion. Our family once extended an invitation to him, but he declined, remarking, "A captain's ship is his alone, and he will never abandon it." Thus, we remain partners with aligned interests, and that suits us just fine.

mention.title: What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing
mention.text: If you're ready, let's begin! Everyone, a big round of applause to welcome the Rover and Ms. Carlotta on stage!
mention.source: Brant brings up Carlotta in “What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing” (3×)

mention.title: What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing
mention.text: I have sent the address to your Terminal. Brant and Roccia are also here. We are awaiting your arrival.
mention.source: Carlotta brings up Brant in “What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing”

dialogue.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

sample.speaker: Brant
sample.text: It's Cetus The Tidebreaker! Are you here to see our Rover off too? Haha, I remember the moment we met like it was yesterday.

sample.speaker: Cartethyia
sample.text: Maybe it's more than just a farewell. I think the Tidebreaker wants to escort you on your journey.

voiceline.title: About Cartethyia
voiceline.text: Some call her a saint; others, a sinner. But who is she really? No one cares how she treats her friends or faces her foes. The Order's tales never speak of her dreams, and the legends conceal her heart's desire. Everyone has heard of Cartethyia—but does anyone know the person behind that name?

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: Copy that!

sample.speaker: Brant
sample.text: Leave them to us!
