voiceline.title: About Zani
voiceline.text: Many wear masks to fit in, but not her. Whatever her past, whatever roles she's played, she's here now, true to herself.

voiceline.title: About Brant
voiceline.text: Brant is a skilled actor, a respected captain, and a fighter willing to sacrifice everything for truth and justice. But what I envy most is that he's never weighed down by stacks of paperwork. If I knew anything about acting, I'd quit this job, join the Troupe of Fools, and live the carefree life he does... Now, now. Just a pipe dream to keep me going.

voiceline.title: About Jianxin
voiceline.text: She's the same as me, super good at some stuff, bad at others. Last martial contest, Master Shiling said she punches too much, thinks too little. I wanted to challenge her—but whoosh—her palm wind came out of nowhere and blew right through my spell array and talisman! But it's okay. I'm not the fist-and-muscle type. Redirecting force to attack is the smarter move. Hehe, knowing Jianxin's style, next time I might not even need to lift a finger. Just a bit of smooth talk and walk away with the win...?

mention.title: Peers of Different Sects
mention.text: "Ah, I heard that the Fengyiquan Sect is full of talent, and Jianxin is undoubtedly unmatched. On the ring, Buling and Jianxin faced each other.
mention.source: Buling's character story “Peers of Different Sects”

mention.title: Shadow of Glory
mention.text: Heard about you from an old friend. You know Jianxin? Pretty sure you met her in Jinzhou. She trained with the same master before me.
mention.source: Buling brings up Jianxin in “Shadow of Glory”

voiceline.title: About Youhu
voiceline.text: Master Youhu helps lots of my clients check their treasures, telling them what's real, what's fake, clearing their doubts and worries. But she's never that serious with me. Last time she brought out a new eggshell porcelain cup. Told me it's an ancient treasure with thin glaze, clean color, things like that, and she said five hundred Shell Credits is a steal. I said the cup was cursed with evil Yin Qi, and better pay seven hundred for a talisman seal, or it's not safe. Guess what happened in the end?

voiceline.title: About Aalto
voiceline.text: We haven't met many times, but somehow, he feels like an old friend. Why? I thought I knew many people from traveling, but he knows even more! No matter where I go, someone always drops his name. What's that theory… any two people in the world are only like, six degrees apart? I bet we show up in the same friend circles all the time.

mention.title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
mention.text: So, all available Bloom Bearers have arrived in Rinascita. We're standing guard at Averardo Vault, and Buling is already en route to reinforce Septimont.
mention.source: Aalto brings up Buling in “Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides”

scene.desc: After you escaped from Honami City, Chisa, who had pushed herself to the brink of overclocking more than once, received treatment at the Black Shores. You've been apart ever since. Now, it's time to visit her again. For both of you, this will be a new beginning.

voiceline.title: About Camellya
voiceline.text: She's... an interesting one. Before I joined the Black Shores, she tried to fight me. Of course I was no match for her, so I ran for it, as fast as oil on shoes! But she chased me all the way... into the Tacet Discord nest I led her to. She got caught up fighting, looked up and smiled at me. I was sitting in a tree, smiling right back. It was interesting... real interesting.

mention.title: Earthly Immortal, Heavenly Sheep
mention.text: Back then, she had just passed Camellya's test and arrived at the Black Shores archipelago for the first time as a Consultant.
mention.source: Buling's character story “Earthly Immortal, Heavenly Sheep”

voiceline.title: About Encore
voiceline.text: Every time I go chasing ghost rumors, I always ask Encore to come along. She's not scared and she loves a new adventure! Sometimes she even livestreams it on the forum, makes up spooky stories to reel our audience in. Then when we drop the twist there's no ghost, we hide behind the screen and laugh till our bellies hurt. Then? Poof. Delete account. Hey, you want to know our forum nicknames? I'm "Earthly Immortal," and she's "Heavenly Sheep."

mention.title: Earthly Immortal, Heavenly Sheep
mention.text: Buling made friends with Encore on an unexpected occasion. Encore poked her head out from behind the plush toys, grinning.
mention.source: Buling's character story “Earthly Immortal, Heavenly Sheep”

scene.desc: A pair of constantly shifting spatial coordinates leading to an unknown location has caught your attention. Following the trail, you reach a metropolis... that had been erased long ago.

After you escaped from Honami City, Chisa, who had pushed herself to the brink of overclocking more than once, received treatment at the Black Shores. You've been apart ever since. Now, it's time to visit her again. For both of you, this will be a new beginning.

voiceline.title: About Shorekeeper
voiceline.text: She stands guard, outside all laws, all patterns... But total detatchment from the world isn't always a good thing. That isn't my divination, I can't read her. But I see it, loud and clear.

mention.title: Flowing Starlight in the Iris
mention.text: From the guest list you provided, only Encore, Buling, and myself were free to come. The others are either away or currently on assignment.
mention.source: Shorekeeper brings up Buling in “Flowing Starlight in the Iris”

mention.title: The Patroller and the Taoist
mention.text: Chixia, Jinzhou Patroller!" Chixia straightened with pride at being recognized, then quickly regained her serious tone.
mention.source: Buling's character story “The Patroller and the Taoist”

dialogue.desc: As the High Tide draws near, a lurking calamity stirs, with its gaze fixed upon the borders of Septimont. Ephor Augusta invites you to the Sanguis Plateaus for a fateful hunt, the one that may decide the realm's survival...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Hey Buling, can you help me track down the Sovereign?

sample.speaker: Buling
sample.text: You got it. Gimme a sec to scan things.

sample.speaker: Buling
sample.text: Emm... Sorry, Boss. The frequencies around you are all over the place... I can't get a clear reading.

sample.speaker: Buling
sample.text: This Sovereign's a slippery eel, eating up every little frequency like it's popcorn. Now the Tethys system's got nothing to work with!

sample.speaker: Buling
sample.text: Hmph... it's playing hide-and-seek with us on purpose. What trouble.

sample.speaker: Buling
sample.text: Hold on. What if you bring me some pure Dark Tide frequency samples?

dialogue.desc: A pair of constantly shifting spatial coordinates leading to an unknown location has caught your attention. Following the trail, you reach a metropolis... that had been erased long ago.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (Maybe I should try using the power of separation? I might be able to split the projection from the rift... )

sample.speaker: Buling
sample.text: Hey, Boss! You zoned out again. Still thinking about the creepy rift, huh?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: ... Something about this isn't normal.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: The frequency data sent to the Black Shores, the coordinates pointing to this rift, this Sonoro of a ruined city... It's hard to make sense of the info we have. If only we could enter it ourselves...

sample.speaker: Buling
sample.text: Would've been nice, huh? But this thing's got its doors shut tight to outsiders. But you Rover, you might be different! You're always full of surprises.

sample.speaker: Buling
sample.text: Still, are you sure you want to? I've "seen" it... That's a Death Gate, clear as day.

dialogue.desc: Cartethyia vanished in the Inverted Tower. Following the traces she left behind, you arrive at Septimont, one of Rinascita's city-states, steeped in glory and famed for its gladiatorial tradition. The city is hosting the Great Agon—a grand championship held once every four years. Yet beneath the grandeur, shadows stir. Multiple factions move in secret, each with their hidden agenda. To uncover the truth, you form a temporary alliance with Contender Lupa. Together, you set your sights on the championship...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: And you are...?

sample.speaker: Buling
sample.text: Me? I'm a traveling Taoist from Mengzhou. Just call me Buling.

sample.speaker: Buling
sample.text: Exorcism, talisman divination, fortune-telling... you name it, I "bling" it! So Rover, you want to try your luck fah?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: How did you know my name?

sample.speaker: Buling
sample.text: Heard about you from an old friend. You know Jianxin? Pretty sure you met her in Jinzhou. She trained with the same master before me.

sample.speaker: Buling
sample.text: We've got history. Last time I went up to the mountain to see her, she mentioned you.

dialogue.summary: As you consider the connection between Lupa and the strange happenings in Septimont, Buling appears once more.

scene.desc: After you escaped from Honami City, Chisa, who had pushed herself to the brink of overclocking more than once, received treatment at the Black Shores. You've been apart ever since. Now, it's time to visit her again. For both of you, this will be a new beginning.

You and Lupa follow the Lioness of Glory to the burial ground of the heroes and into a world of growing uncertainty. At the same time, you start to wonder if Lupa, your companion on this journey, is friend or foe. Cheers sound distorted. Fate has been woven. You have a choice to make, and your choice will determine how the story ends.

mention.title: Free Spirit in Travel
mention.text: That Rover was different—no carefree traveler, but someone forever running from one storm to the next.
mention.source: Buling's character story “Free Spirit in Travel”

mention.title: Shadow of Glory
mention.text: How much do you know about it? This is our second time meeting, Buling. That can't be a coincidence.
mention.source: Rover brings up Buling in “Shadow of Glory” (3×)

mention.title: By Sun's Burning Hand
mention.text: If anyone can sniff out the truth, it's Abby. But just to be sure, I'll send the data to Buling once we're out of here.
mention.source: Rover brings up Buling in “By Sun's Burning Hand” (2×)

mention.title: Flames of Heart
mention.text: (Before meeting Buling, when I touched the Echo in that village, I felt... a layered, indistinct frequency.)
mention.source: Rover brings up Buling in “Flames of Heart”

mention.title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
mention.text: Buling's bronze mirror isn't responding... Abby?
mention.source: Rover brings up Buling in “The Bygone Shall Always Return”

voiceline.title: About Jiyan
voiceline.text: He's a capable leader. He once recommended me an ancient tome on the art of war from Huanglong, one that I regret not acquiring sooner—it could have saved me some effort. As for the deal between us... *scoff* It was merely an exchange of interests. Nothing more.

mention.title: Domestication
mention.text: Because of reasons unspecified, Calcharo stumbled upon Jiyan's troops inside the borders of Huanglong. After careful consideration, Jiyan accepted this mutually beneficial deal.
mention.source: Calcharo's character story “Domestication”

voiceline.title: About Mortefi
voiceline.text: Pretentious, arrogant, and self-absorbed... That man epitomizes every trait associated with those snooty New Federation nobles. That said, I cannot deny his talent in crafting Tacetite Weapons. I can arrange a meeting with our trusted arms dealer, if he's interested.

voiceline.title: About Yinlin
voiceline.text: Yinlin? That undercover agent who infiltrated my group? *huff* Easy there. I didn't give her a hard time, provided she always stayed in her lane.

voiceline.title: About Verina
voiceline.text: I met her once. A prodigy in the field of botany at such a young age... Impressive.

voiceline.title: About Calcharo
voiceline.text: I remember meeting Mr. Calcharo when I was out collecting data in the wild. At first, he didn't seem very approachable... but then he gave me some flower seeds, all super rare species. He's so awesome.

sample.speaker: Encore
sample.text: Into Woolies' belly you go!

sample.speaker: Camellya
sample.text: Feed my blossoms, self-deceivers!

voiceline.title: About Encore
voiceline.text: Encore… Ah, that girl who loves stories! I hope she'll mature into a strong opponent one day, then we'll have so much fun together.

dialogue.desc: After you escaped from Honami City, Chisa, who had pushed herself to the brink of overclocking more than once, received treatment at the Black Shores. You've been apart ever since. Now, it's time to visit her again. For both of you, this will be a new beginning.

sample.speaker: Camellya
sample.text: Don't be silly. Seeing you is always my No. 1 priority.

sample.speaker: Shorekeeper
sample.text: Cammellya, shouldn't you be on a mission?

sample.speaker: Camellya
sample.text: Got it done early. And I wouldn't finished it even sooner if someone had told me a city popped up off the coast of the Black Shores.

sample.speaker: Camellya
sample.text: So... you must be Chisa?

sample.speaker: Chisa
sample.text: ...Hello.

sample.speaker: Camellya
sample.text: I saw the report on Honami. Oh, it's such a shame I wasn't there for the excitement.

dialogue.desc: You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

sample.speaker: Camellya
sample.text: If "the conflict is meaningless," why not have a little fun in the meaningless? Rover is having fun, see?

sample.speaker: Shorekeeper
sample.text: Fun int he meaningless...? It's true that I have never seen this side of Rover before...

sample.speaker: Shorekeeper
sample.text: I... I have never tried it myself either...

sample.speaker: Camellya
sample.text: Hehe... I can see you're starting to waver, Shorekeeper.

sample.speaker: Camellya
sample.text: Even with all your computing power, you'll still end up choosing to have fun with us. So just stop resisting!

sample.speaker: Shorekeeper
sample.text: It will be... my choice? Hmm... my own decision...

scene.desc: KU-Lolo has a new idea to turn your fondest memories into unique Cube souvernirs in the Second Coming of Solaris! Head on over to the Memory Travelogue event, collect memories with the Cubes, and turn them in to KU-Lolo!

voiceline.title: About Shorekeeper
voiceline.text: She's always so serious, following every rule despite being our de facto leader now. Well, she's taken care of me before on many occasions, so I gotta show some respect... Wait, I've been a Bloom Bearer for years? How time flies…

voiceline.title: About Camellya
voiceline.text: Though her words may not always align with her actions, she remains fiercely loyal to her desires. Her carefree lifestyle holds a certain charm, yes, but we were made differently, with distinct objectives to pursue. Following your example, I've allowed her to make her own choices, without limitations.

mention.title: About Jinhsi
mention.text: The Loong Maiden of Jinzhou reminds me of the Shorekeeper, the way they're oh-so-devoted to their duties, all the self-sacrifice!
mention.source: Camellya's voice line “About Jinhsi”

mention.title: The One that Impresses
mention.text: Abbowser... is the new leader of the New Black Shores? And Camellya joined Abbowser? Or... did Abbowser's minions join Camellya?
mention.source: Shorekeeper brings up Camellya in “The One that Impresses” (2×)

mention.title: The One that Impresses
mention.text: Giving up already? Even Shorekeeper hasn't had her fill yet.
mention.source: Camellya brings up Shorekeeper in “The One that Impresses” (2×)

dialogue.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

sample.speaker: Camellya
sample.text: Feed my blossoms, self-deceivers!

sample.speaker: Aalto
sample.text: So you don't have...

voiceline.title: About Aalto
voiceline.text: Aalto's a master at mind games. It's hard to get under his skin! He's not strong enough to pique my interest though. That guy relies on trickery too much for my liking.

mention.title: Rewinding Raindrops
mention.text: Camellya? Course we do!
mention.source: Aalto brings up Camellya in “Rewinding Raindrops”

mention.title: Through the Sea Thou Break
mention.text: Encore's off on a mission! Camellya's out too! Yelling's not gonna save you!
mention.source: Aalto brings up Camellya in “Through the Sea Thou Break”

voiceline.title: About Jianxin
voiceline.text: That girl, the Taoist? She's a fun one to watch. She may seem to follow human society's boring norms, but her untamed spirit still shines through every now and then.

sample.speaker: Camellya
sample.text: Try not to let me catch you so easily next time~!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: And she's gone... Huh, that was fast.

sample.speaker: Camellya
sample.text: Rising silently, cutting through the darkness… It's the only time it's glow is tender and soft.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: So, you come here for the sun?

sample.speaker: Camellya
sample.text: Flowers thirst for light and water. It's their instinct.

sample.speaker: Camellya
sample.text: I'm no different.

sample.speaker: Camellya
sample.text: But I can't always linger here. Being a Bloom Bearer means I have my own responsibilities.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Like what?

scene.quest: The Hidden Treasure of the Black Shores
scene.desc: After following the clues, you discover the room said to conceal hidden treasures. Yet, it appears to be just an ordinary room...
You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

mention.title: To the Days Ahead
mention.text: She knew Rover was to remain in the Black Shores, preparing for journey to Rinascita. She gave Rover a gift, a bracelet designed to monitor frequencies, just like the one they had given her before.
mention.source: Camellya's character story “To the Days Ahead”

mention.title: A Fleeting Moment
mention.text: Most of the time, she opted to accompany Rover on various errands, leaving her footprints across the tapestry of Solaris, from bustling towns to unknown alcoves, safe havens to treacherous lands. Lady Flora relished this existence, brimming with the thrill of the unknown, and Rover had an uncanny talent for transforming the ordinary into something extraordinary.
mention.source: Camellya's character story “A Fleeting Moment”

mention.title: Eve
mention.text: A void of chaos swirled within her, yet there was one thing that stood out in sharp relief: Rover. Who she was, who Rover is, the reason for her being, Solaris, and the Lament…
mention.source: Camellya's character story “Eve”

mention.title: Once Upon a Time
mention.text: It was a song she had learned from Rover. Of course, she hadn't heard it directly from Rover , she had picked it up secretly.
mention.source: Camellya's character story “Once Upon a Time”

mention.title: Dreamscape Odyssey: Blooming Reverie
mention.text: Is that... Camellya? She needs help.
mention.source: Rover brings up Camellya in “Dreamscape Odyssey: Blooming Reverie”

dialogue.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

sample.speaker: Cantarella
sample.text: Quite right. That was once the family's shipyard, though long idle due to certain historical circumstances. If needed, we can grant the Montellis access.

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: Well then, Lady Cantatrella. What are your terms...?

sample.speaker: Cantarella
sample.text: As expected, your insight is as sharp as ever, Miss Carlotta. Terms... naturally, there are some.

sample.speaker: Cantarella
sample.text: The family has an ancient blueprint for a ship. I wish to see it brought to life with your expertise.

sample.speaker: Cantarella
sample.text: Once completed, it may serve your transport needs. It was once the "ark" carrying our ancestors from disasters. Now, I hope... it will carry the future.

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: That's truly... an offer one can hardly refuse. In that case, we will cover the funding and materials needed for construction.

scene.quest: A Stranger in a Strange Land
scene.desc: In this battle that sealed the fate of Rinascita, its people rose in defiance. And among them stood another, a swordsman of Huanglong, guided across the seas by Huanglong Mingting to lend you his strength. He fought as one among the countless souls drawn to this hour, but the story of his own journey, and the shadows of his past, remain known to few...

scene.quest: The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier
scene.desc: After the Carnevale, a voice in your head leads you to the supposed Martyred Maiden—Cartethyia. The encounter creates more questions than it answers. Who are your enemies? Who are your friends? Where is the Inverted Tower located? The helper Carlotta has found and the invitation from Fisalia may help you answer all these questions. The moment of truth seems inevitable...

voiceline.title: About Carlotta
voiceline.text: Even in shackles, she dances elegantly—a true Montelli, yet more than that. Where will her choices lead her family? How delightful to imagine how she might present herself when next we meet.

mention.title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
mention.text: Members of Fisalia will relocate to Averardo Vault. When I meet with Carlotta and the others, I'll relay what we've learned about Leviathan.
mention.source: Cantarella brings up Carlotta in “Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides” (2×)

mention.title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
mention.text: We've lost contact with Cantarella. The Beacon on her end appears to have been destroyed.
mention.source: Carlotta brings up Cantarella in “The Bygone Shall Always Return”

timeline.quest: A Stranger in a Strange Land

dialogue.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

sample.speaker: Cantarella
sample.text: And should you ever return to Rinascita, know this. You will always be our most honored guest and dearest friend.

sample.speaker: Roccia
sample.text: Not just us, but these little Echoes too. We'll hold this bond close, always.

voiceline.title: About Roccia
voiceline.text: The little girl with a giant box who plays with fireworks? A fascinating child. I wonder if bringing her into this castle would liven it up a little. Oh relax, I'm only teasing.

sample.speaker: Cartethyia
sample.text: Wait, I'm not ready yet!

sample.speaker: Cantarella
sample.text: Ever the early riser. Did you call to say good morning?

sample.speaker: Cartethyia
sample.text: Good morning...

sample.speaker: Cantarella
sample.text: Is something the matter, Cartethyia?

sample.speaker: Cartethyia
sample.text: I just wanted to know how you're doing.

sample.speaker: Cantarella
sample.text: ... Ah, so you do care. Good to know my efforts weren't wasted.

dialogue.summary: And now, with Tyrvine restored and fate uncertain, Cantarella poses a question to the distraught Cartethyia: "The real Blessed Maiden is dead.

dialogue.desc: You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

sample.speaker: Cantarella
sample.text: So, I decided a little nap was in order.

sample.speaker: Cartethyia
sample.text: Sorry, I've ruined the anniversary...

sample.speaker: Cantarella
sample.text: Cartethyia, do kindly cast your gaze upon me, Rover, and MR. "Most Powerful Resonator" over there. Have you noticed our smiles?

sample.speaker: Cantarella
sample.text: Despite the somewhat tumultuous proceedings and the rather crude stage, I'm certain that your good wishes, along with Abbowser's, have been felt by all.

sample.speaker: Cartethyia
sample.text: Really?!

sample.speaker: Cartethyia
sample.text: That's good to hear!

voiceline.title: About Cartethyia
voiceline.text: She accomplished the impossible, reclaiming her humanity from the cage of a Divinity's vessel. When the Carnevale petals fall upon Ragunna's streets again, the Holy Maiden will at last be herself.

voiceline.title: About Cantarella
voiceline.text: I… took away the brilliant future she was meant to have. The future of being the Sentinel's true Blessed Maiden. All the goodwill and hopes placed upon me, and the power I now possess… all of it should have belonged to Cantarella. Yet, she never seemed bothered by it. Someone as mature as her must have already found her own path within the Fisalia family. But still, I'll always remember that I owe her so much… so much.

mention.title: The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier
mention.text: Precisely. It could very well have been Cartethyia's doing. But, as with the first time, there's also the chance it was the Sentinel who turned the tide.
mention.source: Cantarella brings up Cartethyia in “The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier” (5×)

mention.title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
mention.text: Cartethyia remains secure in the Fisalia estate. But the Divinity's statue began whispering in our minds... Then came the Tidespawn soon after.
mention.source: Cantarella brings up Cartethyia in “The Bygone Shall Always Return” (4×)

mention.title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
mention.text: Galbrena and Cartethyia hesitated to reveal their full plan... and perhaps this is why. As she said, only an unshakable will can stand against Leviathan.
mention.source: Cantarella brings up Cartethyia in “Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides” (2×)

mention.title: Shadow of Glory
mention.text: Cartethyia is missing… I see.
mention.source: Cantarella brings up Cartethyia in “Shadow of Glory”

mention.title: The One that Impresses
mention.text: Cartethyia, do kindly cast your gaze upon me, Rover, and MR. "Most Powerful Resonator" over there. Have you noticed our smiles?
mention.source: Cantarella brings up Cartethyia in “The One that Impresses”

mention.title: The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier
mention.text: One last thing, you should speak with Cantarella. I can sense she made it out of Sonoro Sphere, safely.
mention.source: Cartethyia brings up Cantarella in “The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier” (8×)

dialogue.desc: To open the Sentinel's Relic, you head back to Ragunna once more...

sample.speaker: Cantarella
sample.text: Rover? What brings you back to the Inverted Tower so suddenly?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Something's come up. I need Cartethyia's help to deal with it.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Did something unusual happen here?

sample.speaker: Cantarella
sample.text: I've only just arrived. For now, everything appears to be in order. I didn't come because of any disturbance.

sample.speaker: Cantarella
sample.text: There are matters I, too, need to discuss with Cartethyia...

dialogue.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I know how to resist the Dark Tide's corruption.

sample.speaker: Cantarella
sample.text: The Fisalia family potion grants resistance. And I've endured Its whispersfor long enough. I know Its tactics. Let me face this...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: We don't even know where this Anchor Stone is. Finding it may take time, and your potion might wear off before you reach it.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: But I still carry the Sentinel's power. I can hold out longer than anyone. I have to be the one.

dialogue.quest: The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier
dialogue.desc: After the Carnevale, a voice in your head leads you to the supposed Martyred Maiden—Cartethyia. The encounter creates more questions than it answers. Who are your enemies? Who are your friends? Where is the Inverted Tower located? The helper Carlotta has found and the invitation from Fisalia may help you answer all these questions. The moment of truth seems inevitable...

sample.speaker: Cantarella
sample.text: So, you'd do well to visit often.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Before I forget, Imperator left a message.

sample.speaker: Cantarella
sample.text: ...Tell me, I'm ready.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: "From this day forth. You are free."

sample.speaker: Cantarella
sample.text: ...I'll remember that.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Will you tell the others?

dialogue.summary:
With that in mind, Rover bids farewell to Ciaccona and sets off toward the Fisalia estate.

=== Cantarella and the Sentinel ===
The current head of the Fisalia family introduces herself as Cantarella. Drawing on prior information provided by Gilberto, Rover questions Cantarella regarding the Fisalia family's rumoured allegiance to the Threnodian.

dialogue.desc: Cartethyia vanished in the Inverted Tower. Following the traces she left behind, you arrive at Septimont, one of Rinascita's city-states, steeped in glory and famed for its gladiatorial tradition. The city is hosting the Great Agon—a grand championship held once every four years. Yet beneath the grandeur, shadows stir. Multiple factions move in secret, each with their hidden agenda. To uncover the truth, you form a temporary alliance with Contender Lupa. Together, you set your sights on the championship...

sample.speaker: Cantarella
sample.text: Go on, what is it you wish to ask of me?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I want to learn more about the archipelago before I set off to find her.

sample.speaker: Cantarella
sample.text: Ah, caution is indeed a virtue. Since you're in a hurry, I'll spare you the lengthy details.

sample.speaker: Cantarella
sample.text: That archipelago is called Septimont.

sample.speaker: Cantarella
sample.text: It's another city-state within Rinascita. Like us Ragunnesi, its people were guided by the Sentinel across vast seas to settle there.

sample.speaker: Cantarella
sample.text: But over time, Septimont and Ragunna's differences led to a rift. Each one forged its own path.

dialogue.desc: A mysterious letter gently lifts a corner of the veil that shrouds the nights gone by. A faint whisper from the depths of the abyss waits for your reply.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: That person does seem a bit extra...

sample.speaker: Cantarella
sample.text: It's understandable. Hearing a Laureate perform is an honor, a blessing for everyone in Rinascita.

sample.speaker: Cantarella
sample.text: Even this music box should be humming along in admiration…

sample.speaker: Cantarella
sample.text: Oh, so that's why this little thing isn't behaving… Someone must have silenced it, leaving it unable to sing.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: If you look at this music box from above, doesn't it resemble a big apple?

sample.speaker: Cantarella
sample.text: Hmm, now that you mention it… Indeed, it does.

dialogue.summary: In the bustling event, you spot Cantarella in the crowd. After reading the strange message you received, Cantarella explains that the Night of Remembrance is centered around ghost-related themes.

mention.title: Lucid Dream

mention.source: Cantarella's character story “Lucid Dream”

mention.title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
mention.text: ...Cantarella, you never did get to say what brought you here.

mention.title: The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier
mention.text: (Cantarella said that only those who resonate with Tyrvine are granted glimpses of its knowledge...)

mention.title: Shadow of Glory

mention.source: Rover brings up Cantarella in “Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides”

mention.text: Cantarella, since you were part of the trials yourself, why not just tell me the secret?

mention.title: Dreamcatchers in the Secret Gardens
mention.text: (This feels a lot like what Cantarella described before.)

dialogue.desc: Following Carlotta's guidance, you arrive at the Penitent's End and reunite with the Troupe. Here, another buried secret of the Order awaits discovery...

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: The current Primus claims to be the Enlightened One, the Sentinel's Resonator. However, based on the prophecy we found in the ruins, this role is meant for the young maiden who is destined to heed the divine oracles during the Carnevale.

sample.speaker: Roccia
sample.text: The Carnevale is the only time humans can directly communicate with the Sentinel. Normally, it's the Primus who conveys the Sentinel's words.

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: A successful Carnevale offers a chance for citizens to meet the Sentinel in person. But for the Primus, and possibly the Order, it poses a threat if they've been fabricating the oracles.

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: To sabotage it while still maintaining their authority... they partnered with the Fractsidus.

sample.speaker: Roccia
sample.text: The Fractsidus will cause chaos during the Carnevale, and the Order will swoop in as the saviors, restoring public trust just as they did before.

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: So far, you've helped us crush three of their schemes, but one remains...

voiceline.title: About Roccia
voiceline.text: I've always been curious about something. Just how much can her box, Pero, actually hold? New designs, costumes, the fine wines the troupe keeps hidden, shimmering sea gems and shells... And Roccia's thoughts and feelings, too. Though Roccia herself rarely speaks her mind, Pero seems to reveal them all.

voiceline.title: About Carlotta
voiceline.text: Leading a large family is like steering a massive ship. It requires immense effort to keep it on course. I have firsthand experience in managing a vessel, and I admire her energy and bravery in navigating this journey.

mention.title: What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing
mention.text: We don't know what challenges we'll face, so your help will be needed, Ms. Carlotta. Plus, it's a chance for you to get to know our methods.
mention.source: Roccia brings up Carlotta in “What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing” (4×)

mention.title: Veils Off in Sun or Shadow

mention.source: Roccia brings up Carlotta in “Veils Off in Sun or Shadow” (2×)

mention.title: What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing

voiceline.title: About Phoebe
voiceline.text: Phoebe is as pure and innocent as a budding lily. Her kindness and devotion are beyond question. Yet, without sufficient strength, such virtues might lead one into the trap of blind faith. I mean no disrespect, but this is a dilemma every believer faces at some point—whether they are following a mere illusion shaped by others' agendas or upholding principles and beliefs that truly have meaning.

mention.title: What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing
mention.text: We contacted the Acolyte, Phoebe. After some digging in the Order's records, she confirmed that before taking on her holy title, the Blessed Fleurdelys was called... Cartethyia.
mention.source: Carlotta brings up Phoebe in “What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing”

mention.text: Rover? And Lady Carlotta? W-why are you here?! P-please don't misunderstand me, I'm not...

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: Zani, status of the evacuation?

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: Eighty percent of Ragunna's residents have been relocated.

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: But... the Troupe of Fools hit a storm while ferrying people from the Riccioli Islands. Rough seas out there.

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: Trust them to see it through.

sample.speaker: Montelli Member
sample.text: Miss Carlotta! We've cleared the depositories as ordered. Ready to receive incoming supplies.

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: Good. Rinascita's greatest treasure has always been the people who built it. The next Cloudpuffer Express is due at any moment. Be ready to offload.

dialogue.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: But really, such "technology" is our family's prodest "asset." Naturally, we brought what we could with us.

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: Septimont's Common Echoes use a different configuration than Ragunna's, but the underlying logic is compatible. Our tuning technique will still serve us well here.

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: ...If working a little longer means you'll carry a little less, then I'll stay up as long as it takes.

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: I don't care about overtime in this case... If working a little longer means you'll carry a little less, then I'll stay up as long as it takes.

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: Besides, Ms. Carlotta hasn't rested properly in days.

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: In times like these, we cannot afford even a sliver of carelessness. We must do everything within our power... so that you can focus on what lies ahead in the Dark Tide without distractions.

dialogue.quest: Veils Off in Sun or Shadow
dialogue.desc: To understand Gilberto's part in the Echo incident, you trace his steps to the outskirts of the city. But the deep you delve, the more elusive the truth becomes...

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: Allow me to properly introduce myself. My name is Carlotta, Carlotta Montelli.

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: Montelli... You are the...

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: The second daughter of the Montelli Family, yes. Please feel free to call me Carlotta.

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: Also, I trust the renumeration meets your satisfaction, Ms. Zani?

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: It was you who tasked me with receiving Rover?

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: Surely a distinguished guest such as Rover deserves the attention of our most trusted employee.

dialogue.desc: You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: You can go ahead now. I'll catch up after my shift.

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: If I were to help you clear your debts and find a way to make Abbowser forgive you, would you consider working for the family again, Zani?

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: Rest assured, the Montellis never settle for a bad bargain. I believe Abbowser has yet to realize Zani's true value.

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: More importantly, Zani has been an indispensable companion for both you and me. No price is too high for a friend.

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: Lady Carlotta, this is... much too flattering. Wait, this isn't part of your plan is it?

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: If it helps put you at ease, feel free to see this as purely a business matter.

dialogue.summary: Zani politely declines Carlotta's offer to help pay off her debt and promises to assist you after work every day.

voiceline.title: About Zani
voiceline.text: Zani is wary of unnecessary, inefficient tasks because she excels at completing her work with haste, precision, and quality. Although it may seem that these aspects contradict each other, they actually complement one another. The family imposes few restrictions on private commissions, so if you have a challenging request, feel free to approach her. Oh, but do ensure the compensation is appropriate.

voiceline.title: About Carlotta
voiceline.text: Lady Carlotta? Her vision has never been limited to Ragunna, or even Rinascita. Hers was about the world beyond the sea horizon. I don't know what kind of future she sees, but I'll stand by her until the day her vision becomes reality.

mention.title: Veils Off in Sun or Shadow
mention.text: We're done here. Let the guards take care of the rest. So, Ms. Zani mentioned you heard the Sentinel's oracle when you met the Vitreum Dancer?
mention.source: Carlotta brings up Zani in “Veils Off in Sun or Shadow” (8×)

mention.title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
mention.text: ...Very well. We'll hold the line. Zani, call in the family's transport Echoes. We'll assist Rover where we can.
mention.source: Carlotta brings up Zani in “The Bygone Shall Always Return” (2×)

mention.title: What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing
mention.text: We are lucky that you and Zani, along with that Acolyte, awakened Lorelei in time. You prevented the mist from spreading and averted the Waveworn. The Fractsidus must still be licking their wounds.
mention.source: Carlotta brings up Zani in “What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing”

mention.title: The One that Impresses
mention.text: If I were to help you clear your debts and find a way to make Abbowser forgive you, would you consider working for the family again, Zani?
mention.source: Carlotta brings up Zani in “The One that Impresses” (3×)

mention.title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
mention.text: Lady Carlotta, we still face a significant shortage of supplies. The Black Shores have met some urgent demands, but moving forward...
mention.source: Zani brings up Carlotta in “Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides” (3×)

mention.title: Veils Off in Sun or Shadow
mention.text: Oh, you're back. I've done everything you asked, Lady Carlotta. All the thugs trying to storm the room were handled.
mention.source: Zani brings up Carlotta in “Veils Off in Sun or Shadow” (2×)

mention.title: What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing
mention.text: Lady Carlotta has already briefed me on your plan. Along with the other family members, you can count on my full support.
mention.source: Zani brings up Carlotta in “What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing”

mention.title: A Stranger in a Strange Land
mention.text: The Vault is all right. As Lady Carlotta instructed, we just had to throw a few collections away.

sample.text: But if the images on the stained glass windows were fabricated, why would the Order deface them and declare this tower forbidden?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: There's only one explanation. These are not fabrications but buried truth.

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: If this is indeed the Order's doing... we must leave here immediately.

sample.text: North of this tower is an island.

dialogue.desc: Following Carlotta's guidance, you arrive at the Penitent's End and reunite with the Troupe. Here, another buried secret of the Order awaits discovery...

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: At that time, the entire city was shrouded in mist. Ghosts roamed the streets, a dragon roared from the sky and a sea behemoth raged, summoning towering waves... Do any clues come to mind?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: The mist might be coming from the Remnant Clouds in the Nimbus Sanctum. Lorelei has the power to purify and control them, but the Fractsidus interfered…

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: Remnant Clouds corrupted by evil will disrupt Echoes' frequencies. If the mist had spread to the city, it would have stirred the Echoes into chaos.

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: We are lucky that you and Zani, along with that Acolyte, awakened Lorelei in time. You prevented the mist from spreading and averted the Waveworn. The Fractsidus must still be licking their wounds.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: The Montelli traitors used Lycoris in experiments to turn Echoes back into Tacet Discords... If they were successful, the "ghosts" seen ten years ago may have also been created this way.

dialogue.quest: The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier
dialogue.desc: After the Carnevale, a voice in your head leads you to the supposed Martyred Maiden—Cartethyia. The encounter creates more questions than it answers. Who are your enemies? Who are your friends? Where is the Inverted Tower located? The helper Carlotta has found and the invitation from Fisalia may help you answer all these questions. The moment of truth seems inevitable...

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: I'll call you as soon as I find anything.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Got it.

dialogue.summary: Along the way, Rover encounters Ciaccona, a wandering bard dispatched by Carlotta to assist in the journey.

dialogue.quest: If On a Rainy Night a Family
dialogue.desc: The bitter night lingers for the restless. An invitation from the Montelli family pulls you into its past, where new and old, balance and change collide. In the freest place of Ragunna, the host of the invitation awaits your arrival.

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: Now, Cat's Eye, will you stand with me to catch the traitor within our family and avert this looming threat?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I understand decorum is important to the Montellis. But among friends, can't we be a bit more... informal?

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: What made you say that?

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: Hmm, you're curious who I am beyond my role, is that it?

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: Hmm, I just might entertain that thought.

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: But for now, my agents just sent me the address of Benett's residence. While his body has been found, what he left behind is still out there.

dialogue.desc: A rumor about Daemons is spreading through the streets of Ragunna, with an article pointing to the former Poets Society—Golden Anthem. As you dig deeper, you uncover a tragic story deliberately concealed by the Order.

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: We should also share these findings with Ciaccona. As a poet, her insights would be much appreciated.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: That's strange, she was just there a moment ago.

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: ...Just like when we were children. Gone without a trace.

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: When she and her family disappeared without even a goodbye.

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: Ms. Margherita, have you seen Ciaccona?

dialogue.summary: At the Margherita's Restaurant, you meet Carlotta. Carlotta then leads you to Ciaccona, who seems hesitant to involve you in the mystery.

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: That scene was delightful. You've presented another precious opportunity to me.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Opportunity?

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: Yes. an opportunity to explore something yet to be assessed with you. Speaking of which, how do you feel about a future collaboration?

dialogue.desc: You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?
dialogue.summary: Zani politely declines Carlotta's offer to help pay off her debt and promises to assist you after work every day.

scene.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

scene.quest: A Stranger in a Strange Land
scene.desc: In this battle that sealed the fate of Rinascita, its people rose in defiance. And among them stood another, a swordsman of Huanglong, guided across the seas by Huanglong Mingting to lend you his strength. He fought as one among the countless souls drawn to this hour, but the story of his own journey, and the shadows of his past, remain known to few...

scene.quest: The Sacred Breeze So Often Breathes
scene.desc: After a minor twist in the journey, Ragunna, the Land of Echoes, unfolds its grandeur, extending a grand welcome to the traveler from distant shores.

KU-Lolo has a new idea to turn your fondest memories into unique Cube souvernirs in the Second Coming of Solaris! Head on over to the Memory Travelogue event, collect memories with the Cubes, and turn them in to KU-Lolo!

mention.title: In the Name of Carlotta
mention.text: After celebrating the Carnevale with the distinguished guest, and exposing Capollo's betrayal with their (Rover) help, Carlotta finally understood what Grandfather had been unable to fully express on that rainy night. But perhaps Rover would be the exception.
mention.source: Carlotta's character story “In the Name of Carlotta”

mention.title: Veils Off in Sun or Shadow
mention.text: Carlotta, hello?!
mention.source: Rover brings up Carlotta in “Veils Off in Sun or Shadow” (2×)

mention.title: The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier
mention.text: Carlotta once helped me interpret some stained glass images. The story it told was very similar to what you've described.
mention.source: Rover brings up Carlotta in “The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier” (2×)

mention.title: What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing
mention.text: And the Fisalia family worships the Threnodian. We'll have to wait for Carlotta to arrange an audience with them.
mention.source: Rover brings up Carlotta in “What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing”

mention.title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
mention.text: But I saw Carlotta, Brant, everyone... and you. You were all just like in that illusion I had before...
mention.source: Rover brings up Carlotta in “Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides”

mention.title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
mention.text: Those voices... Zani and Carlotta?
mention.source: Rover brings up Carlotta in “The Bygone Shall Always Return”

mention.title: If On a Rainy Night a Family
mention.text: Carlotta told me Mr. Pierre always follows her grandfather around. My instincts weren't wrong when I saw you together.
mention.source: Rover brings up Carlotta in “If On a Rainy Night a Family” (3×)

mention.title: All Out! Towards the Peaks of Prestige (Quest)
mention.text: (I wonder if Carlotta would take an interest in this game? If the Montelli Family sponsored it, that would solve everything.)
mention.source: Rover brings up Carlotta in “All Out! Towards the Peaks of Prestige (Quest)”

mention.title: Your Summer Will Never Wither (Quest)
mention.text: I'm starting to understand why Carlotta calls you "Topaz".
mention.source: Rover brings up Carlotta in “Your Summer Will Never Wither (Quest)”

timeline.quest: A Stranger in a Strange Land

dialogue.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

sample.speaker: Cartethyia
sample.text: It's been a long time since Ilast sat down with the Order's doctrines... I didn't expect this many changes while I was "gone."

sample.speaker: Phoebe
sample.text: The Codex has been revised serveral times over the past decade...

sample.speaker: Cartethyia
sample.text: Wait, "Flying Ragunnesi" was banned? That play is a masterpiece! And civilians aren't allowed to perform at the Carnevale anymore?

sample.speaker: Cartethyia
sample.text: ...Such harsh decrees should all be struck down!

sample.speaker: Phoebe
sample.text: O-okay, I've noted it down. Actually, I think this one should go too...

sample.speaker: Cartethyia
sample.text: And this—"Acolytes must avoid close contact with Common Echoes"? That's beyond absurd!

dialogue.desc: You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

sample.speaker: Phoebe
sample.text: Understood. I will help as much as I can.

sample.speaker: Cartethyia
sample.text: No need to worry about all that! I've already taken care of everything.

sample.speaker: Cartethyia
sample.text: Lollo Logistics has already packed it all up! Mission accomplished!

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: But we haven't counted everything yet...

sample.speaker: Phoebe
sample.text: You two really have... very different personalities.

scene.desc: To open the Sentinel's Relic, you head back to Ragunna once more...

scene.quest: What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing
scene.desc: Following Carlotta's guidance, you arrive at the Penitent's End and reunite with the Troupe. Here, another buried secret of the Order awaits discovery...

KU-Lolo has a new idea to turn your fondest memories into unique Cube souvernirs in the Second Coming of Solaris! Head on over to the Memory Travelogue event, collect memories with the Cubes, and turn them in to KU-Lolo!

voiceline.title: About Phoebe
voiceline.text: That girl has a kind and gentle heart. Duties aside, she always does her best to be there for others. Honestly, when it comes to knowledge of the Order's doctrines, I'm nowhere near as good as Phoebe. It's because of so many true and faithful believers like her, I find it difficult to reveal the truth to the people of Ragunna. People turn to faith for many reasons, not just out of devotion to the Sentinel. To unveil such unsettling truths would bring forth countless difficult choices and challenges...

voiceline.title: About Cartethyia
voiceline.text: ...I once dreamt of a black sea, with swells growing larger and more violent. Amidst the spray, the Blessed Maiden appeared—or at least I think it was her. Something in that swaying silhouette resembled her, yet it also felt so unlike her...

mention.title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
mention.text: Phoebe, your faith in the Sentinel has never wavered, nor has it been blind. It stems not from obedience, but from a deep belief in Their deeds and ideals.
mention.source: Cartethyia brings up Phoebe in “Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides”

mention.title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
mention.text: Are you considering running, Cartethyia?
mention.source: Phoebe brings up Cartethyia in “Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides”

dialogue.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

sample.speaker: Cartethyia
sample.text: Oh, I'm back to myself now. Let's meet in Ragunna City, (Righteous One).

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: Defeating Leviathan was just the start of Rinascita's "new era." There is plenty of cleanup work ahead for everyone.

dialogue.quest: What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing
dialogue.desc: Following Carlotta's guidance, you arrive at the Penitent's End and reunite with the Troupe. Here, another buried secret of the Order awaits discovery...

sample.speaker: Cartethyia
sample.text: Farewell, Laureate! I hope that someday, I might stand on stage with your troupe.

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: Are you alright, Rover? Some family members mentioned you were speaking to a wall... I'm worried you might still be under Phrolova's spell.

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: See who? Are you truly alright?

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: Cartethyia... I'll make a note of it.

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: If she was indeed here, she is likely still in Ragunna. I will have my family start searching.

You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

voiceline.title: About Carlotta
voiceline.text: As the daughter of Montelli, she has really brought fresh ideas to the city. If this island were to stay isolated, the air would grow stifling. The people of Ragunna need new ships, new horizons, and new discoveries. I'm not very skilled in business matters, though. My nanny in the Order always said I didn't even know how to haggle... If I ever get the chance, I'd love to learn a few tricks from Miss Carlotta!

mention.title: What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing
mention.text: We contacted the Acolyte, Phoebe. After some digging in the Order's records, she confirmed that before taking on her holy title, the Blessed Fleurdelys was called... Cartethyia.
mention.source: Carlotta brings up Cartethyia in “What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing” (4×)

mention.title: The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier
mention.text: In the meantime, I'll keep looking for more information and the person Cartethyia mentioned to you.
mention.source: Carlotta brings up Cartethyia in “The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier”

scene.desc: To open the Sentinel's Relic, you head back to Ragunna once more...

The moment of truth seems inevitable...
scene.summary: Possessing the Resonance Ability to recreate past experiences, Ciaccona enables Rover to relive the encounter with Cartethyia, the Blessed Maiden who was supposedly martyred during the Second Dark Tide.

voiceline.title: About Ciaccona
voiceline.text: When I was a child, I used to beg the bards passing through town to sing me stories of knights. After I was freed from the tower, I wandered through a field one day, and the wind carried a piece of beautiful music to me. I stood beneath a tree in the distance, listening as Ciaccona sang a new poem, one with the melody of Egla Town's folk songs… In the blink of an eye, noon had already given way to dusk.

voiceline.title: About Cartethyia
voiceline.text: The Blessed Maiden? Or a villain? There are still many unanswered questions in Cartethyia's story. I would never sing an incomplete story. A tale must have a proper ending for a bard to make it truly resonate through history.

mention.title: The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier
mention.text: Well, it's a little tricky to explain in words... Think of it like being in an immersive portrait. Can you tell me about your meeting with Cartethyia?
mention.source: Ciaccona brings up Cartethyia in “The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier” (3×)

mention.title: A Stranger in a Strange Land
mention.text: It's similar to what happened when I helped you see Cartethyia.
mention.source: Ciaccona brings up Cartethyia in “A Stranger in a Strange Land”

dialogue.desc: You and Lupa follow the Lioness of Glory to the burial ground of the heroes and into a world of growing uncertainty. At the same time, you start to wonder if Lupa, your companion on this journey, is friend or foe. Cheers sound distorted. Fate has been woven. You have a choice to make, and your choice will determine how the story ends.

sample.speaker: Cartethyia
sample.text: I once believed the Threnodian sought to use the Fractsidus to regain power, but Its true goal is the Central Hub. I believe it's due to this secret the Sentinel has hidden.

sample.speaker: Lupa
sample.text: That direction... It leads to the hunting grounds.

sample.speaker: Lupa
sample.text: The Blightcloud still lingers there. When the High Tide comes, Septimontians hunt and cull the spawning Tacet Discords.

sample.speaker: Cartethyia
sample.text: The Dark Tide... connects everything.

sample.speaker: Cartethyia
sample.text: I cannot pinpoint where the Sentinel's message lies. I'm afraid you must go there yourself, Rover.

sample.speaker: Cartethyia
sample.text: But the worst of the storm has passed. Let's take a moment to rest.

dialogue.summary: You begin to piece together everything you've learned about Septimont, Lupa, Cartethyia, Mya, the Dark Tide, and Arsinosa. Lupa arrives at the flooded Old District, the waters stirring memories of when she once walked these streets with Cartethyia.

dialogue.desc: Cartethyia vanished in the Inverted Tower. Following the traces she left behind, you arrive at Septimont, one of Rinascita's city-states, steeped in glory and famed for its gladiatorial tradition. The city is hosting the Great Agon—a grand championship held once every four years. Yet beneath the grandeur, shadows stir. Multiple factions move in secret, each with their hidden agenda. To uncover the truth, you form a temporary alliance with Contender Lupa. Together, you set your sights on the championship...

sample.speaker: Cartethyia
sample.text: Come forth, and face my blade.

sample.speaker: Lupa
sample.text: Welcome to my city, Gryphon's Fortress of Capitoline Hill!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Who are they...?

sample.speaker: Lupa
sample.text: Oh, some minor noble houses that didn't make it into the Agon.

sample.speaker: Lupa
sample.text: But in Septimont, strength and power go hand in hand. Nobles get more, but they better prove they're worth it and pull their weight for the city.

sample.speaker: Lupa
sample.text: The Agon isn't just about fortune. It's a way to find the capable. For nobles, the ability to command and control Echoes is a basic responsibility.

dialogue.summary: You sense a faint trace of Cartethyia's frequency on Lupa, but she denies ever meeting her. Meanwhile, Lupa's departure from House Silva sparks retaliatory rumors, but she appears unaffected, focusing on helping your search for Cartethyia.

scene.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

scene.quest: Where Stars Cascade Down · event story

voiceline.title: About Lupa
voiceline.text: The nature of the Threnodian's power to converge often makes me appear dangerous and unsettling after battle, but Lupa has never once recoiled. She never treats me as more or less than I am, and she has never distanced herself. She is honest, tenacious, and unwavering in her care of her friends. Even though I'm shorter than her when not in my Fleurdelys form, I still feel that I should take on the role of the "older sister" in our friendship.

voiceline.title: About Cartethyia
voiceline.text: In that empty city, Cartethyia was there for me during my most delirious and painful moments. At first, our conversations were a bit stiff. Guess she hadn't spoken to anyone in who knows how long. But as we spent more time together, I realized that she was actually easygoing and carefree. For someone like her, being trapped in one place for so long must've been unbearable... Now that our long journey is over, I hope my friend can fully enjoy this moment of peace.

mention.title: Thoughts: IV
mention.text: Cartethyia had passed the hope to you, and you entrusted it to me.
mention.source: Lupa's voice line “Thoughts: IV”

mention.title: The Nameless
mention.text: Sometimes, when Cartethyia spoke to her, she had to pause for a long while before she could muster a reply. Cartethyia didn't think so, but the Nameless could no longer hold on.
mention.source: Lupa's character story “The Nameless”

mention.title: Big Little Things
mention.text: She whisked Rover and Cartethyia on a carefree whirlwind tour through Septimont.
mention.source: Lupa's character story “Big Little Things”

mention.title: Flames of Heart
mention.text: In those three days of the story where Cartethyia didn't rescue me, I would always die on the first day, helplessly watching as my home slowly crumbled to dust.
mention.source: Lupa brings up Cartethyia in “Flames of Heart” (17×)

mention.title: Shadow of Glory
mention.text: I don't know if this Cartethyia of yours is strong enough to take on Arsinosa. If she did, it would be the talk of Septimont.
mention.source: Lupa brings up Cartethyia in “Shadow of Glory” (4×)

mention.title: Flames of Heart
mention.text: Sadly, the playwright did eventually erase Lupa's existence. As for me, I descended into the submerged aqueducts where I found the Threnodian. It had inhabited Mya's remains and was hiding within an experimental unit.
mention.source: Cartethyia brings up Lupa in “Flames of Heart” (10×)

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: The safest option is for me to go in person.

sample.speaker: Changli
sample.text: ...Very well.

sample.speaker: Changli
sample.text: Since we are already mid-game, I will let you decide our next move.

sample.speaker: Changli
sample.text: This time, I shall be a pawn in your hand.

sample.speaker: Changli
sample.text: Remember I will always stand by your side, in this crisis or any other.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: ...Am I a player or a mere pawn? I suppose there is no difference at this point.

dialogue.desc: According to Xinyi, Hongzhen's Mayor, Jinhsi has gone off to Truthseeker's Pass, or the Court of Savantae Ruins. The Cipher Key stored in the heart of Truthseeker's Pass is a precondition to opening Mianloong Chamber and the audience with Jué, the Sentinel.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: You...

sample.speaker: Changli
sample.text: Don't worry. Rover is special. The Temporal Dusruption can't hurt .

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: I... *cough*... but Changli, your...

sample.speaker: Changli
sample.text: Shh...

sample.speaker: Changli
sample.text: I gave my word to be your pawn and I intend to keep it. As your teacher and courtier, it is only right for me to do so.

sample.speaker: Changli
sample.text: And let's not forget, without me playing the Wayfinder for Rover, we wouldn't even have here.

dialogue.desc: You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: Abbowser just vanished into thin air!

sample.speaker: Changli
sample.text: It probably moved deeper into the labyrinth.

sample.speaker: Changli
sample.text: We'll explain later, Rover.

scene.desc: Jinhsi has gone missing, and you just had an enigmatic dream.... That Wayfinder at the ferry may hold answers to these mysteries.
scene.summary: Changli tells you that she has successfully fulfilled her mission to bring you to Jinhsi and chooses to stay behind to handle the troublesome Fractsidus.

scene.desc: Jinhsi has gone missing, and you just had an enigmatic dream.... That Wayfinder at the ferry may hold answers to these mysteries.
scene.summary: Changli finds her Terminal is not working and suggests hurrying to Hongzhen, a town that Jinhsi must pass through in her search for the Sentinel.

voiceline.title: About Jinhsi
voiceline.text: Jinhsi is a bright and diligent soul. With time, she will undoubtedly blossom into a capable Magistrate. She has always been dedicated to her work, perhaps too much so. She simply needs some time to find balance and fully embrace who she truly is. I am entrusting her care to you, Rover.

voiceline.title: About Changli
voiceline.text: Over the years, my esteemed teacher Changli has taught me much… Yet her smiling eyes still hold mysteries that I cannot yet comprehend.

mention.title: Changli's Trouble
mention.text: Jinhsi's iced pastries and Sanhua's delicate snow birds always melt faster than I'd prefer in my hands...
mention.source: Changli's voice line “Changli's Trouble”

mention.title: About Sanhua
mention.text: But both Jinhsi and I have always wished for her to take a well-deserved rest and let others help shoulder the burden.
mention.source: Changli's voice line “About Sanhua”

mention.title: Beneath the Whispers
mention.text: It is said that Counselor Changli did not become a Counselor after the Sentinel chose the Jinzhou Magistrate, but she had long volunteered to come to Jinzhou, to teach the young Jinhsi, and to help her take over the power that was too heavy for a child. After the ceremony, Changli gave up power to Jinhsi and became her Counselor.
mention.source: Changli's character story “Beneath the Whispers”

mention.title: Master and Minister
mention.text: Before becoming Jinhsi's tutor, Changli had only met her once when she was a young girl. As Jinhsi works tirelessly at City Hall, Changli remains by her side, answering questions and offering advice whenever needed.
mention.source: Changli's character story “Master and Minister”

mention.title: Mianloong Chamber (Quest)
mention.text: My teacher Changli told me it's up to both of us to solve the crisis at Mt. Firmament. As I know you have a special connection with our Sentinel, I need your support in this decision.
mention.source: Jinhsi brings up Changli in “Mianloong Chamber (Quest)” (2×)

mention.title: Truthseeker's Pass (Quest)
mention.text: I... *cough*... but Changli, your...
mention.source: Jinhsi brings up Changli in “Truthseeker's Pass (Quest)” (2×)

mention.title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
mention.text: Please don't sell yourself short, Yangyang. The power you now carry... Well, as my teacher Changli would say, "You are certainly a pivotal piece on the board."
mention.source: Jinhsi brings up Changli in “Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled” (2×)

mention.title: Clashing Blades
mention.text: No need. Both Changli and I will be away, and there'll be more paperwork for you to handle.
mention.source: Jinhsi brings up Changli in “Clashing Blades”

mention.title: Road of Pilgrimage
mention.text: Those Artificers are nothing to worry about. Rover, don't worry. Changli has her plans.
mention.source: Jinhsi brings up Changli in “Road of Pilgrimage”

mention.title: Where Stars Cascade Down · event story
mention.text: Changli once said, in moments like this...
mention.source: Jinhsi brings up Changli in “Where Stars Cascade Down · event story”

mention.title: To Mt. Firmament
mention.text: She grew up with immense responsibilities, forced to suppress her true nature from a young age. Thinking back, Jinhsi was only a teenage girl when she became the Magistrate...
mention.source: Changli brings up Jinhsi in “To Mt. Firmament” (12×)

mention.title: Truthseeker's Pass (Quest)
mention.text: ...Yes. That fight has to happen to trigger a Second Resonance Awakening for Jinhsi, so she may exert even stronger Resonance Abilities... One that allows her to restore the flow of time.
mention.source: Changli brings up Jinhsi in “Truthseeker's Pass (Quest)” (12×)

mention.title: Road of Pilgrimage
mention.text: Please don't forget: I am your Wayfinder. I journeyed with you into the mountains to ensure you meet up with Jinhsi.
mention.source: Changli brings up Jinhsi in “Road of Pilgrimage” (2×)

mention.title: Immortal Blaze
mention.text: Mt. Firmament used to have Temporal Disruptions caused by its tumultuous history. However, thanks to Magistrate Jinhsi and Rover, these disruptions have been dealt with. Or so we had hoped.
mention.source: Changli brings up Jinhsi in “Immortal Blaze” (2×)

voiceline.title: About Sanhua
voiceline.text: Sanhua is always composed and silent. As a bodyguard, she remains vigilant and alert at all times. But both Jinhsi and I have always wished for her to take a well-deserved rest and let others help shoulder the burden.

mention.title: Changli's Trouble
mention.text: Jinhsi's iced pastries and Sanhua's delicate snow birds always melt faster than I'd prefer in my hands...
mention.source: Changli's voice line “Changli's Trouble”

mention.title: Clashing Blades
mention.text: Is Lady Changli leaving for the capital?
mention.source: Sanhua brings up Changli in “Clashing Blades”

mention.title: To Mt. Firmament
mention.text: You're here because I invited you. Sanhua was instructed to disclose my whereabouts if you ever went to City Hall and asked about Jinhsi.
mention.source: Changli brings up Sanhua in “To Mt. Firmament”

voiceline.title: About Jiyan
voiceline.text: Upon my initial arrival in Jinzhou, I was tasked with handling paperwork at the City Hall for a temporary period. Despite sifting through countless documents and files, never once did I come across any issues regarding our border defenses. During the time when Jinzhou was lacking a Magistrate, General Jiyan's unwavering efforts were essential in protecting the welfare of our people.

voiceline.title: About Jianxin
voiceline.text: Although we followed different sects of Taoist teachings, I found commonalities with her. Her pure and open mind is quite rare nowadays. I believe her perception of the world must be as clear as her eyes. I first met her at the tea house; back then, she seemed to have sensed something about my condition, and served me a bowl of Lotus Seed Soup. That was a delightful surprise.

voiceline.title: About Chixia
voiceline.text: Chixia is a vibrant girl, radiating warmth and enthusiasm like a shining flame. She graciously showed me around Jinzhou, introducing me to all the local gems and delectable delicacies. Ah, yes, now I remember... The Spicy Pulled Chicken may seem intimidating to many, but it's just the right amount of spice for me.

mention.title: The Myth-Laden Savior
mention.text: "...Steadfastly by the side of Sentinel Jué, in a bond of intimate camaraderie." From then on, everything unfolded precisely as Sentinel Jué predicted.
mention.source: Changli's character story “The Myth-Laden Savior”

mention.title: Truthseeker's Pass (Quest)
mention.text: Rover, Jué, and Mt. Firmament... There must be some kind of crucial connection between the three. Rover has own reasons for being here.
mention.source: Changli brings up Jué in “Truthseeker's Pass (Quest)” (2×)

mention.title: Immortal Blaze
mention.text: Yes. Information on the actual powers of Jué... This isn't the kind of information an ordinary explorer can obtain.
mention.source: Changli brings up Jué in “Immortal Blaze”

dialogue.desc: A pair of constantly shifting spatial coordinates leading to an unknown location has caught your attention. Following the trail, you reach a metropolis... that had been erased long ago.

sample.speaker: Namipon
sample.text: Ah, Passengers! You're back!

sample.speaker: Chisa
sample.text: ...What... How are you—?!

sample.speaker: Namipon
sample.text: Hm? I'm brewing tea for you.

sample.speaker: Chisa
sample.text: But you said... "this is as far as I go"?

sample.speaker: Namipon
sample.text: Uh... yes. It was as far as I could go because I had to go back to the cafe first...

dialogue.desc: After you escaped from Honami City, Chisa, who had pushed herself to the brink of overclocking more than once, received treatment at the Black Shores. You've been apart ever since. Now, it's time to visit her again. For both of you, this will be a new beginning.

sample.speaker: Namipon
sample.text: Something's probably broken inside. I'll take a look.

sample.speaker: Chisa
sample.text: Namipon, was that a live signal from Lahai-Roi?

sample.speaker: Namipon
sample.text: Yes, it was. That cassette we put inside lets it receive radio signals from the rift.

sample.speaker: Namipon
sample.text: With the right tweak, maybe I can track it. Like I did with Neon Tower's—

sample.speaker: Chisa
sample.text: It sounded like the Academy's radio talk show... But why did I hear my mother?

sample.speaker: Chisa
sample.text: Does that mean she's at Startorch? Why is she there? Is she... looking for me?

dialogue.desc: The gateway to Lahai-Roi is now open! What burns beneath the frostlands is waiting for your return!

sample.speaker: Chisa
sample.text: Namipon, Shorekeeper... thank you. For looking after me during this time.

sample.speaker: Namipon
sample.text: Oh, don't get all serious! You can visit during your holidays.

sample.speaker: Chisa
sample.text: ...Alright. I promise I'll visit often.

sample.speaker: Chisa
sample.text: Well then, Rover, I'll see you at the Academy.

dialogue.desc: After the end of Honami's looping crisis, Chisa heads to the Black Shores to recover. Namipon from Shashou Cafe contacts you to request your help in investigating a series of strange occurrences throughout Honami City. Assist Namipon with the investigation while also gathering supplies to help rebuild the Shashou Cafe.

sample.speaker: Namipon
sample.text: Lives that were never meant to meet all found a connection in the cafe. And slowly, this place became the central station for it all.

sample.speaker: Chisa
sample.text: Maybe… that is why you, the symbol of Honami, appeared here in the first place.

sample.speaker: Namipon
sample.text: Beats me. At the very least, this cafe is proof that the Honami of the past existed.

sample.speaker: Chisa
sample.text: Then, as the Shashou, you have to take good care of it, Namipon.

sample.speaker: Namipon
sample.text: Don't you worry. The story of Shashou Cafe is just getting started.

sample.speaker: Namipon
sample.text: Next time you get the chance, remember to bring more of your friends over to visit, Rover, Chisa.

voiceline.title: About Namipon
voiceline.text: Born of love. Always kind and dependable... That's the Guardian of Honami City. Or at least, that's how it likes to introduce itself. Being around Namipon feels peaceful. Hard to explain. Sometimes it follows me, quietly. I won't notice until it brushes up against me, soft fur against my arm, asking if I want coffee. But there's something more beneath that face. Something vast. Maybe it's just... trying to return the love people once gave it.

mention.title: Stagnant Dawn on Wastelands
mention.text: But here's what we do know: After the Lament, Namipon gained a physical form and a will of its own. And as Honami's mascot, it knows the city like the back of its paw. The layout, the pathways. I believe that makes it a pretty reliable partner.
mention.source: Chisa brings up Namipon in “Stagnant Dawn on Wastelands” (12×)

mention.title: Flowing Starlight in the Iris
mention.text: I just remembered... Namipon always said the cafe needed more life. Maybe now is the time to try?
mention.source: Chisa brings up Namipon in “Flowing Starlight in the Iris” (5×)

mention.title: The Wind Before the Storm
mention.text: Last break, I made time to go back to Honami. Brought Namipon some Roya snacks. And Namipon said.. it really hopes you'll go back to visit.
mention.source: Chisa brings up Namipon in “The Wind Before the Storm” (2×)

mention.title: When the Unknown Thrums
mention.text: Namipon, Shorekeeper... thank you. For looking after me during this time.
mention.source: Chisa brings up Namipon in “When the Unknown Thrums”

mention.title: Stranger Things in Honami/Story
mention.text: It's too soon to jump to conclusions. But the Meishin Passageway she mentioned is highly suspect… Has anyone reported strange happenings there, Namipon?
mention.source: Chisa brings up Namipon in “Stranger Things in Honami/Story” (2×)

mention.title: Star Bouncing · event story
mention.text: I just... started to talk like Namipon.
mention.source: Chisa brings up Namipon in “Star Bouncing · event story”

mention.title: Flowing Starlight in the Iris
mention.text: Then you curled up here in the cafe and took a nice, long nap. Chisa woke up first and watched you sleeping for a while.
mention.source: Namipon brings up Chisa in “Flowing Starlight in the Iris” (11×)

mention.title: Stagnant Dawn on Wastelands
mention.text: During the Lament, my "existence" was torn apart once, so I lost that ability. The Honami you see now looks whole, but inside it's been cut into countless tangled paths like Chisa's The Japanese art of folding and cutting paper.
mention.source: Namipon brings up Chisa in “Stagnant Dawn on Wastelands” (11×)

mention.title: Stranger Things in Honami/Story
mention.text: Oh, that... Well, after you and Chisa stopped the looping Lament in the city, the Waveworn Phenomena affecting the Left Behind was weakened.
mention.source: Namipon brings up Chisa in “Stranger Things in Honami/Story” (2×)

dialogue.desc: After you escaped from Honami City, Chisa, who had pushed herself to the brink of overclocking more than once, received treatment at the Black Shores. You've been apart ever since. Now, it's time to visit her again. For both of you, this will be a new beginning.

sample.speaker: Buling
sample.text: Very good lah! My reading for you said visitors from all around, wealthy coming in thick and fast. Super lucky day for an opening!

sample.speaker: Chisa
sample.text: You must be Buling?

sample.speaker: Chisa
sample.text: I've heard about you from Rover. You're the one who helped pinpoint Honami's rift. Thank you.

sample.speaker: Buling
sample.text: It's no biggie. Me and Boss, we go way back. Just treat me to good meal and we're even.

sample.speaker: Buling
sample.text: Good to meet you, Chisa. And this floating one here... Hmm...

scene.desc: A pair of constantly shifting spatial coordinates leading to an unknown location has caught your attention. Following the trail, you reach a metropolis... that had been erased long ago.

voiceline.title: About Buling
voiceline.text: She's a very fascinating Taoist. If I remember correctly, she's from Mengzhou, in Huanglong? She's always saying odd metaphors and local sayings, and showing off the rare antiques she carries around. Once even offered me a "Buy two, get 20% off" deal. Maybe... I'll take her up on it. Just to see.

mention.title: Flowing Starlight in the Iris
mention.text: You must be Buling?
