mention.source: Chisa brings up Buling in “Flowing Starlight in the Iris”

mention.title: Flowing Starlight in the Iris
mention.text: Good to meet you, Chisa. And this floating one here... Hmm...
mention.source: Buling brings up Chisa in “Flowing Starlight in the Iris”

dialogue.desc: After you escaped from Honami City, Chisa, who had pushed herself to the brink of overclocking more than once, received treatment at the Black Shores. You've been apart ever since. Now, it's time to visit her again. For both of you, this will be a new beginning.

sample.speaker: Shorekeeper
sample.text: I see you're all waiting here. Could I be mistaken about the time?

sample.speaker: Chisa
sample.text: No, not at all. We're glad you made it, Shorekeeper. Shasho Cafe welcomes you aboard!

sample.speaker: Shorekeeper
sample.text: I see.

sample.speaker: Chisa
sample.text: Mmm...

dialogue.desc: The gateway to Lahai-Roi is now open! What burns beneath the frostlands is waiting for your return!

sample.speaker: Shorekeeper
sample.text: Hmm...? If only that were true.

sample.speaker: Chisa
sample.text: My apologies. I'm late.

sample.speaker: Shorekeeper
sample.text: It's time to set out.

scene.desc: A pair of constantly shifting spatial coordinates leading to an unknown location has caught your attention. Following the trail, you reach a metropolis... that had been erased long ago.
Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.

voiceline.title: About Shorekeeper
voiceline.text: Shorekeeper helped me a lot while I've been recovering at the Black Shores. It took me a while to settle in, but in time, I started to feel the kindness there. Shorekeeper once took me to the beach at the Haven of Sprouts to see the stars. They were infinite. And I found myself thinking... Sumika must've stood beneath that same sky many times, imagining the future she hoped to reach.

mention.title: Flowing Starlight in the Iris
mention.text: Chisa remained on the verge of Overclocking for a prolonged period within a distorted temporal flow. Her case required a full evaluation by the Tethys System.
mention.source: Shorekeeper brings up Chisa in “Flowing Starlight in the Iris” (3×)

mention.title: When the Unknown Thrums
mention.text: This? Chisa taught me how to make this beverage. I find it tastes better with more milk and sugar...
mention.source: Shorekeeper brings up Chisa in “When the Unknown Thrums”

mention.title: Flowing Starlight in the Iris
mention.text: Yes. Shorekeeper personally oversaw all of the routine checkups during my recovery. She was very helpful.
mention.source: Chisa brings up Shorekeeper in “Flowing Starlight in the Iris” (2×)

mention.title: When the Unknown Thrums
mention.text: Namipon, Shorekeeper... thank you. For looking after me during this time.
mention.source: Chisa brings up Shorekeeper in “When the Unknown Thrums”

dialogue.desc: Amidst a ripple of Reverberations, you hear the call... As you unravel your past, a new path unfolds before you, beckoning from the unknown.

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: You made a couple kicks and that thing vanished into thin air!

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: That's strange. This place isn't known to be so dangerous...

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Anyway, come check this out!

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Oh, this is... an Echo.

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Wow! An Echo of the Elite Class... Someone got lucky today!

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: My apologies. We got a little carried away. Does "Reverberation" or "Echo" ring a bell to you, Rover?

dialogue.desc: Amidst a ripple of Reverberations, you hear the call... As you unravel your past, a new path unfolds before you, beckoning from the unknown.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: It may take some time, but there won't be too much paperwork.

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Then I guess I'll take Rover over to the Nexus Tower for registration first, and we'll just hang out for a while.

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Being new to Jinzhou and all, can't be left standing outside the City Hall with nothing to do.

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Hospitality is our local speciality, you know!

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Then I'll leave you in Chixia's care, Rover. Is that alright with you? I'll give you a call once the paperwork is done.

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Leave it to me!

dialogue.desc: As the city lights twinkle, friendly faces beckon you to join them in the bustling border town. Immerse yourself in its prosperous yet tranquil ambiance.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: The few that made it inside said it only took "one freezing look from Lady Sanhua", and they were compelled to leave.

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: What kind of description is that? sounds like they've met some snake-haired lady, and got turned into stone.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: She's the Magistrate's personal bodyguard.

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Oh, I've heard of her before. She's the "All-round Death Glare slash Terminator Ice Beauty."

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: ...That's what the rumors say, at least.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: There is a small chance she's not in the City Hall, but it is very unlikely for her not to be in Jinzhou.

dialogue.desc: As the tides of danger retreat, Jinzhou appears tranquil and vibrant. But beyond its borders lies a fierce and desperate battleground.

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: So it only took us one trip to the Academy to solve half of our problems. Either Rover's really smart, or Madam Magistrate was gonna make it easy for us to begin with.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: What's our next plan of action, Rover?

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: As for the mangosteen, we've got people selling these at the market nearby. Might find some clues there.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Mangosteens are not from Jinzhou. These fruits are usually brought in by boat. Should we start from the harbor?

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Do you think the token is guiding us outside the city?

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Baizhi said the leaf bears the frequencies of Tacet Discords, so it must be from a tree near a Tacet Field.

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Those wackos are hellbent on making their own Resonators. Said there's no right or wrong when it comes to Resonance powers and everyone should have the right to them.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: They use mechanical manipulation to integrate parts of Tacet Discords into human bodies.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Seeking power with such gruesome acts... I cannot bring myself to understand them.

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: That Scar guy you mentioned sounds like he's on a whole other level. How did the fight go?

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: He... It seems he didn't intend to kill us. I would say he was even pulling his punches.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: I don't know what he wants from us. But Madam Magistrate may have intended to hint something by letting us run into him.

dialogue.desc: The previous puzzle's answers has been revealed, but it only leads to another one. With a storm on the horizon, you follow the Magistrate's advice and search for clues about "the Black Shores".

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Uhhh... Maybe the Sentinel had its own special ways of picking candidates?

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Or maybe it is their incomprehensible ways that set these divine beings apart from us? Their thinking tends to be elusive to the average person.

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Yeah, true. Wouldn't be surprised if Jué decided to make me the Magistrate one day, not gonna lie!

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: I understand your concern, Rover.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Madam Jinhsi was only a teenager, and she was suddenly selected to be the Magistrate. It must have been so difficult for her...

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: I remember people were skeptical when she first took office.

dialogue.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: You're injured... Please go get yourself patched up first!

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Chixia is right. Please leave it to us. We'll help deliver these supplies.

sample.speaker: Weary Patroller
sample.text: Huff... Okay... Thank you!

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Rover, Yangyang and I need to get these stuff delivered.

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Director Taoqi should be at the northern pass. We'll go meet you there as soon as we're done!

dialogue.desc: After the battle of Norfall Barren, everything came to an end. Your friends are calling you for a meet-up with snacks at Panhua's Restaurant. It seems they like to know more about that "little one" from within your body...

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Seems like you're trying to boost your ego a bit!

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Oh, actually... While those aren't Baizhi's exact words, that is what she meant.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: She mentioned highly intelligent Echoes that can act on their own in other countries. Said they are involved in every aspect of human life, with unique abilities beyond our imagination.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Those Echoes are rare though. Neither I nor Baizhi, an Ecoacoustics expert, have ever seen one in person. But this little thing here... It could be one of those foreign Echoes.

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Yeah, makes sense! Now we just gotta figure out where it came from. Who knows, we may find other cool Echoes in that place!

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Well, both General Jiyan and Baizhi have confirmed it. No way they're lying.

dialogue.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Ugh! Why, you little—!

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Chixia—! Are you all right?

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: I'm okay. Just a scratch—I can still—

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: ...Chixia—

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Yangyang?

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: One of us has to make it back—

dialogue.desc: Days after the Autopuppet crisis was solved, Yangyang chooses to stay behind in the Land of Xuanfang to assist the soldiers and the civilians. As she's waiting on her Resonance Assessment report, a mysterious voice starts to whisper in her ears...

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: You do look nice, I'll be honest. Hehe.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Oh, this... It's a long story...

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: How about I tell you the full story after I'm back in Jinzhou?

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Ohhh... Now you've really piqued my curiosity! I'm gonna hold you to that.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Enough about me. How have you been?

dialogue.quest: Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song
dialogue.desc: The frequencies building up within Patty have resonated with the environment and generated a Sonoro Sphere. The truth about the fourth wish may be hidden therein. The name Patty keeps mumbling about seems to be connected with Xiangli Yao. You must head it off at the pass before things get out of hands at the Moonlit Fair.

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Before we hang up, anything you wanna say to Rover, Yangyang?

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Me? But I'm not ready...

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Okay, erm... How're you doing today, Rover?

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: I'm looking forward to enjoying the Moonlit Fair with you tonight.

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: And you, Baizhi?

dialogue.desc: A blue figure guides you through the mist-it's the Shorekeeper. The bad news you've brought from the Port City to Guixu has unveiled a looming threat now casting its shadow over the Black Shores. An imminent danger awaits both you and the Black Shores.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: ...Rover! Finally got through...

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Hey, you scared us to death!!!

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Glad to know you're all right.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: ...Rover! Finally got through...

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Yeah! Just so you know, we got the Black Shores' warning, so we cranked up the defenses in Jinzhou.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: The Midnight Rangers are preparing to secure the Port City of Guixu, and...

dialogue.desc: As the Moon-Chasing Festival approaches, you become aware of the "Moontree Lodge" tales under the Wishing Tree. An encounter with a strange robot links you to the mysterious wish granter at the Lodge...

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: That's right. Remember what I told you about wishes made under the Wishing Tree coming true?

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: There are stories of it flying around... Especially in recent years, the wishes people make on the eve of the Moon-Chasing Festival seem to come true in one form or another.

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: A few years ago, Jinzhou had endless rain. Yangyang wished for clear skies for the Festival and a perfect Moonlit Fair.

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: And guess what? The rain stopped, and the moon was full and bright.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Exactly. I thought I'd try my luck, but it actually happened.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Perhaps just a pleasant coincidence? The Moon-Chasing Festival does have a history of such coincidences. Maybe there's something to the Wishing Tree's magic after all.

scene.desc: The Land of Xuanfang is thrown into turmoil following an unexpected riot of out-of-control Autopuppets. As you investigate, you uncover the mastermind behind the scheme—a mysterious Artisan who covets the Sentinel's technology. In the culmination of the event, this figure commands the rogue Autopuppets to launch an assault on Xuanfang Hold.

voiceline.title: About Yangyang
voiceline.text: Yangyang's such a darling, even her words sound pretty! Sometimes I can't quite get what she says though. Whatcha call those again? Ah, poems, I think!

voiceline.title: About Chixia
voiceline.text: "When in trouble, ask Chixia, the Ally of Justice!" This statement, while playful, rings very true. With her surging passion, seasoned prowess, and abundant vigor, Chixia already meets every quality a hero should have, helping the people in need.

mention.title: The Secret to Listening
mention.text: That's why Chixia was shocked at Yangyang's ability to accurately hum a melody she had only heard. Soon enough, Chixia told everyone else about Yangyang's amazing talent, sparking playful requests for a song.
mention.source: Yangyang's character story “The Secret to Listening”

mention.title: Utterance of Marvels: I
mention.text: Also, we have Resonators who can detect the formation of Tacet Fields nearby, like what Yangyang just did. She can tell all kinds of information by reading the Streams in the wind—that's her Resonance Ability.
mention.source: Chixia brings up Yangyang in “Utterance of Marvels: I” (10×)

mention.title: The Wind Before the Storm
mention.text: Ain't the same. Anybody with eyes can tell ya, a smile ain't just a smile. There's the smile you put on 'cause you're s'posed to, and the smile that comes from the heart. So what's got my Yangyang smilin' like that, I wonder...
mention.source: Chixia brings up Yangyang in “The Wind Before the Storm” (10×)

mention.title: Echoing Marche
mention.text: It's a no-go for me if you're leaving the city, my shift's coming up. Protect Rover well and shoot me a message if you need anything, alright Yangyang?
mention.source: Chixia brings up Yangyang in “Echoing Marche” (3×)

mention.title: First Resonance
mention.text: Aren't you forgetting something, Yangyang? Rover told us this morning that he/she has been offered a stay at the City Hall...
mention.source: Chixia brings up Yangyang in “First Resonance” (3×)

mention.title: Grand Warstorm
mention.text: Rover, Yangyang, I'll be keepin' the city safe as a Patroller. Do come back in one piece, okay?
mention.source: Chixia brings up Yangyang in “Grand Warstorm” (3×)

mention.title: Clashing Blades
mention.text: C'mon, Yangyang. It's just an one-on-one meeting with Madam Magistrate. What's the worst that could happen?
mention.source: Chixia brings up Yangyang in “Clashing Blades” (2×)

mention.title: Rewinding Raindrops
mention.text: Hi, Verina! I'm Chixa, this is Yangyang, and he/she's Rover! Grandma Lin told us we should come find you!
mention.source: Chixia brings up Yangyang in “Rewinding Raindrops” (2×)

mention.title: Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song
mention.text: Seriously? What a pity... Okay then, I'll tell Yangyang and Baizhi you can't make it to the show...
mention.source: Chixia brings up Yangyang in “Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song” (2×)

mention.title: The Wind Before the Storm
mention.text: You're exaggerating, Chixia... According to the Patrollers' investigation reports, the victims all had reasons to travel to Mengzhou, and Xuanfang lies right along the only route there.
mention.source: Yangyang brings up Chixia in “The Wind Before the Storm” (8×)

mention.title: First Resonance
mention.text: Chixia told me he's quite popular with the kids. Children have been pestering him for all kinds of fancy toys, and he's always open to their requests.
mention.source: Yangyang brings up Chixia in “First Resonance” (6×)

mention.title: Rewinding Raindrops
mention.text: ...Okay. Chixia and I will wear these black flowers and go look for members of the Black Shores in the city.
mention.source: Yangyang brings up Chixia in “Rewinding Raindrops” (4×)

mention.title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
mention.text: Oh! Did you see Chixia in Jinzhou? Is she okay? Those wounds she suffered from the Tacet Discords were—
mention.source: Yangyang brings up Chixia in “Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled” (3×)

mention.title: Utterance of Marvels: I
mention.text: Chixia might be in danger. Rover, please..!
mention.source: Yangyang brings up Chixia in “Utterance of Marvels: I” (2×)

mention.title: Clashing Blades
mention.text: Chixia has a point.
mention.source: Yangyang brings up Chixia in “Clashing Blades”

mention.title: Echoing Marche
mention.text: That should be the Midnight Rangers training camp... Let's not worry about it, Chixia.
mention.source: Yangyang brings up Chixia in “Echoing Marche”

mention.title: Grand Warstorm
mention.text: Chixia is right. Please leave it to us. We'll help deliver these supplies.
mention.source: Yangyang brings up Chixia in “Grand Warstorm”

timeline.quest: Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song

sample.speaker: Yinlin
sample.text: Don't worry. I'm not going anywhere. I've got a hostage, you see?

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Whoa! You-you... Don't move!

sample.speaker: Yinlin
sample.text: I wouldn't try anything stupid if I were you. Can't risk the VIP of Jinzhou getting hurt, now can we?

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Ugh, fine... Lower your weapons guys!

sample.speaker: Yinlin
sample.text: "Trust me... Come this way."

voiceline.title: About Yinlin
voiceline.text: She was once the thunder that lit up my path ahead. I've always wanted to be like her, until I realized not everyone had that power. Now, I am happy with being a small flicker of flame, doing what I can to help people around me.

voiceline.title: About Chixia
voiceline.text: I guess you can say Chixia is a younger colleague of mine. She is a natural fit for the Patroller position. With time and experience, she will surely excel in her role.

scene.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

voiceline.title: About Lingyang
voiceline.text: Sometimes they'd perform liondance between hero plays. That leading dancer, Lingyang, can put on quite a show for a small guy like him! The way he moves and swings around really makes for an awesome lion!

voiceline.title: About Chixia
voiceline.text: Chixia? Aha, you mean my top rival! I won't let her outshine me again... And why is that, you ask? Well, we're battling to see who can help more people!

dialogue.desc: The previous puzzle's answers has been revealed, but it only leads to another one. With a storm on the horizon, you follow the Magistrate's advice and search for clues about "the Black Shores".

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: The Fractsidus again? Ugh, those jerks!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Jiyan the General, Jinhsi the Magistrate, and Jué, Jinzhou's Sentinel... Is there any kind of connection between them?

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Connection? ...No idea, but I did hear General Jiyan used to be a military doctor...

dialogue.desc: After the battle of Norfall Barren, everything came to an end. Your friends are calling you for a meet-up with snacks at Panhua's Restaurant. It seems they like to know more about that "little one" from within your body...

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: I thought Yangyang said you had a super cool lil' buddy to show us. Where is it?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Uh, I don't know...

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Did it just... pop out of your Tacet Mark...?

sample.speaker: Little One
sample.text: Mmm... smells good!

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: So... Is this how it first showed up when you guys were in the Norfall Barrens?

dialogue.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Yang... Yang...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: ...Don't worry, Chixia. I'll bring Yangyang back.

dialogue.desc: Days after the Autopuppet crisis was solved, Yangyang chooses to stay behind in the Land of Xuanfang to assist the soldiers and the civilians. As she's waiting on her Resonance Assessment report, a mysterious voice starts to whisper in her ears...

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Fine, I'll be a good girl and behave myself. Can't have everyone looking after me forever...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: You can worry about that later, Chixia. Just focus on recovering for now.

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Yes,

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Think of it as taking some time off. It's not every day you get to let loose a little bit.

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Good point...

dialogue.quest: Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song
dialogue.desc: The frequencies building up within Patty have resonated with the environment and generated a Sonoro Sphere. The truth about the fourth wish may be hidden therein. The name Patty keeps mumbling about seems to be connected with Xiangli Yao. You must head it off at the pass before things get out of hands at the Moonlit Fair.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Hello? What's up, Chixia?

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Hey, Rover! You've been to the Wishing Tree, right? What did you wish for?

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Did it come tru— Oh wait, it can't be that fast...

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Gotcha!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Still busy with the preparations?

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Almost finished! It's crazy here with all these people bustling around!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (Chixia just called me. I wonder what's happening...)

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Huh? Is that your first reaction? Come on!

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Anyway! You know, we could really use your help with this ongoing case!

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Here's the thing, we could really use your help with this ongoing case...

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: We've been getting a lot of missing persons reports recently.

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Nobody ever saw those people assaulted or anything, they just vanished.

dialogue.summary: Chixia contacts you to say that several Jinzhou citizens have recently gone missing. You realize the place is connected to the Séance Society, so you use the communication panel you found earlier to send the coordinates and details of the situation to Chixia.

dialogue.quest: Disappearance Case: The Visitor from Jinzhou
dialogue.desc: Weining sent a strange message. According to her, you've been "kidnapped" by someone right now. What on earth is going on?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I can confirm this lady isn't Chixia. Aside from the red hair, they have nothing in common.

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: See? Told you! I'm not Chixia!

sample.speaker: Sen
sample.text: I-I see... But if you're the real Rover, then who's the missing one?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Can you give me more details on this case?

scene.desc: Amidst a ripple of Reverberations, you hear the call... As you unravel your past, a new path unfolds before you, beckoning from the unknown.
Amidst a ripple of Reverberations, you hear the call... As you unravel your past, a new path unfolds before you, beckoning from the unknown.
As the city lights twinkle, friendly faces beckon you to join them in the bustling border town. Immerse yourself in its prosperous yet tranquil ambiance.
As the tides of danger retreat, Jinzhou appears tranquil and vibrant. But beyond its borders lies a fierce and desperate battleground.
As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

The Land of Xuanfang is thrown into turmoil following an unexpected riot of out-of-control Autopuppets. As you investigate, you uncover the mastermind behind the scheme—a mysterious Artisan who covets the Sentinel's technology. In the culmination of the event, this figure commands the rogue Autopuppets to launch an assault on Xuanfang Hold.

A blue figure guides you through the mist-it's the Shorekeeper. The bad news you've brought from the Port City to Guixu has unveiled a looming threat now casting its shadow over the Black Shores. An imminent danger awaits both you and the Black Shores.
A challenge called "Moon Shooter" is known at the Moonlit Fair. Interesting challenges like this are meant for Chixia... and you! Unlock a new Companion after completing this quest.

As the Moon-Chasing Festival approaches, you become aware of the "Moontree Lodge" tales under the Wishing Tree. An encounter with a strange robot links you to the mysterious wish granter at the Lodge...

voiceline.title: About Rover
voiceline.text: You don't talk much, but you're so strong in battle. There's a good old Huanglong saying, "A cat that catches mice doesn't meow." Fits perfectly on you, doesn't it?

mention.title: The Wind Before the Storm
mention.text: There's Yangyang. She's kind, and very pleasant to be around. Chixia. Loyal, strong sense of justice. She goes by another name too.
mention.source: Rover brings up Chixia in “The Wind Before the Storm” (7×)

mention.title: Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song
mention.text: Hello? What's up, Chixia?
mention.source: Rover brings up Chixia in “Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song”

mention.title: The Chant of Unseen Ties
mention.text: You can worry about that later, Chixia. Just focus on recovering for now.
mention.source: Rover brings up Chixia in “The Chant of Unseen Ties”

mention.title: Solitary Path
mention.text: (I should use it to inform Chixia and the others of my situation, and my current coordinates.)
mention.source: Rover brings up Chixia in “Solitary Path” (2×)

mention.title: Disappearance Case: The Visitor from Jinzhou
mention.text: I can confirm this lady isn't Chixia. Aside from the red hair, they have nothing in common.
mention.source: Rover brings up Chixia in “Disappearance Case: The Visitor from Jinzhou”

mention.title: Moonlit Reunion
mention.text: (Wishes... and solutions...? Could this relate to what Chixia said about "someone" at Moontree Lodge making wishes come true? And Xiangli Yao... The name sounds familiar.)
mention.source: Rover brings up Chixia in “Moonlit Reunion”

timeline.quest: Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song

dialogue.desc: A rumor about Daemons is spreading through the streets of Ragunna, with an article pointing to the former Poets Society—Golden Anthem. As you dig deeper, you uncover a tragic story deliberately concealed by the Order.

sample.speaker: Ciaccona
sample.text: Rover, Carlotta, it's been too long!

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: You really must adore that song. I remember hearing you sing it when I was little.

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: When I was a child, whenever I passed by Ciaccona's house, I'd always hear music drifting from the courtyard. Lively, spirited and so full of emotion...

sample.speaker: Ciaccona
sample.text: Oh, I remember it well! Those two guards of yours were like giants from Septimont, easily two hundred pounds of pure muscle!

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: Back then Ciaccona's family conducted the Order's choir.

sample.speaker: Ciaccona
sample.text: How should I put it... Well, as they say, families are always rising and falling.

dialogue.summary: Carlotta then leads you to Ciaccona, who seems hesitant to involve you in the mystery. Carlotta sighs that Ciaccona has never changed since childhood, always vanishing without a word.

scene.desc: To open the Sentinel's Relic, you head back to Ragunna once more...
With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

scene.quest: A Stranger in a Strange Land
scene.desc: In this battle that sealed the fate of Rinascita, its people rose in defiance. And among them stood another, a swordsman of Huanglong, guided across the seas by Huanglong Mingting to lend you his strength. He fought as one among the countless souls drawn to this hour, but the story of his own journey, and the shadows of his past, remain known to few...

scene.quest: The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier
scene.desc: After the Carnevale, a voice in your head leads you to the supposed Martyred Maiden—Cartethyia. The encounter creates more questions than it answers. Who are your enemies? Who are your friends? Where is the Inverted Tower located? The helper Carlotta has found and the invitation from Fisalia may help you answer all these questions. The moment of truth seems inevitable...
scene.summary: Along the way, Rover encounters Ciaccona, a wandering bard dispatched by Carlotta to assist in the journey.

voiceline.title: About Carlotta
voiceline.text: She's a discerning buyer and a skilled seller. Whether modern or vintage, Carlotta always appraises art with a fair and thoughtful eye. She taught me that the beauty of art transcends time, and that every artist will eventually find an audience that appreciates their vision.

mention.title: For Herself, She Shall Sing
mention.text: As the girl with antlers watches you and Carlotta emerge from the wind, something tells her she too might soon be swept into a story.
mention.source: Ciaccona's character story “For Herself, She Shall Sing”

mention.title: The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier
mention.text: I was sent by Lady Carlotta to find you. As I passed that abandoned house, I suddenly felt this... well, you know, rush of inspiration that just can't be ignored! So, I stopped to compose a piece...
mention.source: Ciaccona brings up Carlotta in “The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier” (5×)

mention.title: A Stranger in a Strange Land
mention.text: Carlotta!
mention.source: Ciaccona brings up Carlotta in “A Stranger in a Strange Land”

mention.title: Your Summer Will Never Wither (Quest)
mention.text: But this time, I have you and my friends with me... I can't let you all repeat my fate. If we step onto that stage tomorrow, the Order will not stand idly by. They might even come after you and Carlotta...
mention.source: Ciaccona brings up Carlotta in “Your Summer Will Never Wither (Quest)” (3×)

mention.title: The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier
mention.text: Hello, Rover. I received Ciaccona's memo.
mention.source: Carlotta brings up Ciaccona in “The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier”

mention.title: Your Summer Will Never Wither (Quest)
mention.text: When I was a child, whenever I passed by Ciaccona's house, I'd always hear music drifting from the courtyard. Lively, spirited and so full of emotion...
mention.source: Carlotta brings up Ciaccona in “Your Summer Will Never Wither (Quest)” (5×)

timeline.quest: A Stranger in a Strange Land

dialogue.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

sample.speaker: Ciaccona
sample.text: Whew, made it this time! I've got this side covered!

sample.speaker: Phoebe
sample.text: By the name of Imperator! We'll protect the Obelisks here!

scene.desc: To open the Sentinel's Relic, you head back to Ragunna once more...

scene.quest: A Stranger in a Strange Land
scene.desc: In this battle that sealed the fate of Rinascita, its people rose in defiance. And among them stood another, a swordsman of Huanglong, guided across the seas by Huanglong Mingting to lend you his strength. He fought as one among the countless souls drawn to this hour, but the story of his own journey, and the shadows of his past, remain known to few...

voiceline.title: About Phoebe
voiceline.text: There was a time when I thought about telling her the truths about the Order, but after seeing her devotion as she stood in front of the Sentinel's statue, praying for the people of Ragunna, I abandoned the idea. For an Acolyte as kind as she is, perhaps the truth may do more harm than good, just as it did to me.

timeline.quest: A Stranger in a Strange Land

dialogue.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

sample.speaker: Ciaccona
sample.text: I have an idea! If Leviathan found Its Anchor of Reality to summon the Tidespawn into our world...

sample.speaker: Brant
sample.text: We follow suit and find an Anchor of Hope to find a way out of the world of the Dark Tide!

scene.desc: To open the Sentinel's Relic, you head back to Ragunna once more...

scene.quest: All Out! Towards the Peaks of Prestige (Quest)
scene.desc: A strange message draws your attention to a mysterious Echo dueling game called Peaks of Prestige. "Countless Echoes. Limiteless tactics. You could be the next Apex Duelist!"

voiceline.title: About Brant
voiceline.text: He's a captivating performer on stage. Sometimes I wonder about Brant's fate. Will he be written into the pages of history after countless adventures? Or will he spend his retirement years recounting his legendary tales on a ship somewhere, holding a bottle of Troupe Strength?

mention.title: All Out! Towards the Peaks of Prestige (Quest)
mention.text: Captain Brant of the Fool's Troupe? I doubt anyone could outdo his price. I hear the entire Troupe relies on his bounty to survive.
mention.source: Ciaccona brings up Brant in “All Out! Towards the Peaks of Prestige (Quest)”

mention.title: Your Summer Will Never Wither (Quest)
mention.text: As you've already seen, I was also banished. You‘ve probably heard a lot about the Pilgrim's Sail from Brant.
mention.source: Ciaccona brings up Brant in “Your Summer Will Never Wither (Quest)”

scene.quest: Depths of Illusive Realm · event story

voiceline.title: About Mortefi
voiceline.text: Mortefi may seem a bit intimidating, but he's actually quite nice. Once my blade got really worn out, and Mortefi repaired it for me. To repay his kindness, that week I wiped out several groups of bandits eyeing the Tacetite weapons he developed... He ended up having to repair it for me again.

voiceline.title: About Chixia
voiceline.text: You can never go wrong by taking lost children to Chixia. While some kids may find me scary, they would never be scared of her.

voiceline.title: About Yinlin
voiceline.text: The familiar sight of Yinlin's thunder always reassures me that the upcoming battle will be a breeze. Though, I must admit, it took me until at least our tenth collaboration to finally learn her name... Embarrassingly so.

voiceline.title: About Yangyang
voiceline.text: When I just met Yangyang, I had been curious how someone could always be such a sweetheart. Later, I finally learned how gentleness with boundary has a powerful strength of its own.

voiceline.title: About Danjin
voiceline.text: I met Danjin a few times on different occasions. I could tell how much she values justice. She is very clear about when to unsheath her blade, and for what she fights, despite being surprisingly young. Her actions reflect her belief in an ideal world—one that she is determined to create.

dialogue.quest: Faithful Heart Tested at Skyfall: Epilogue
dialogue.desc: The Crisis at the Skyworks has come to an end, and Danjin has found her path. It is a treacherous one, but with the light pulsating in her jade pendant and your words in her heart, she no longer fears what lies ahead.

sample.speaker: Danjin
sample.text: Rover? Are you planning on training here too?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Didn't you say you were looking for hobbies outside of combat? Why are you here?

sample.speaker: Danjin
sample.text: Hehe, one thing at a time. Training is different. Besides, here I can fight all kinds of powerful enemies I've never even heard of…

sample.speaker: Danjin
sample.text: It literally gets my blood flowing.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Normally, this isn't meant for solo training...

sample.speaker: Danjin
sample.text: Huh? Really? But I've already had a few rounds.

phoneSample.speaker: Danjin
phoneSample.text: Rover! The Battle Shade Shroud is something else!

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: Well, that came out of the blue. You're there already?

phoneSample.speaker: Danjin
phoneSample.text: It has all kinds of features, perfect for daily combat training!

phoneSample.speaker: Danjin
phoneSample.text: And the scenarios are all right up my alley. I'll be coming here every day until Suyu is back on her feet!

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: Don't forget to make Loong Whiskers Crisps...

dialogue.desc: You encounter Suyu, an injured Midnight Ranger, in Xuanfang. She tells you that she is here on a mission as an Oversight Officer, accompanying a unique Resonator. Seizing the chance, you join this Resonator in investigating a crisis unfolding in the Skyworks, and along the way, uncover the burdens she carries in her heart...

sample.speaker: Danjin
sample.text: My blood... it had turned into blades. It carved through the Exiles. The floor, the ceiling, the whole warehouse was covered in crimson slashes...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Did you Overclock?

sample.speaker: Danjin
sample.text: I've always been at risk, and I must've come very close that time. But luckily, the Patrollers found me when they did... And this jade pendant.

sample.speaker: Danjin
sample.text: It was the last thing my family left me.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Were they… by Exiles?

sample.speaker: Danjin
sample.text: They're all the same. Bandits. Murderers. No difference.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: Danjin performed well. Her mental state was stable, and she kept her Forte under good control during combat.

phoneSample.speaker: Danjin
phoneSample.text: It was still a bit risky, though. Good thing Rover and the big robot were there to help out.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: Danjin sliced the Myriad Snare clean in half at the entrance of the Skyworks. One strike, and our problem was solved.

phoneSample.speaker: Suyu
phoneSample.text: Huh? Of course Danjin... Whoops, I meant to say, of course, Danjin the Great crushed it out there!

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: Hehe. We took it a bit far, but you did great out there, Danjin.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: After we took down the Myriad Snare, the chaos in the Skyworks subsided.

dialogue.quest: Depths of Illusive Realm · event story

sample.speaker: Danjin
sample.text: You should leave here. You don't smell like "them." Take this as a token of my gratitude, and I wish you a safe journey.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Smell?

sample.speaker: Danjin
sample.text: Greed, wrath, envy...

voiceline.title: About Rover
voiceline.text: You always act first in the face of injustice, despite having lost all memories... You must always have been a righteous person, right? I'd be very troubled if it turned out otherwise.

mention.title: Faithful Heart Tested at Skyfall: Epilogue
mention.text: A "Danjin Special" Loong Whiskers Crisp. Now that's a one-of-a-kind gift.
mention.source: Rover brings up Danjin in “Faithful Heart Tested at Skyfall: Epilogue” (2×)

mention.title: Faithful Heart Tested at Skyfall
mention.text: But from what she just told me, it sounds like you're under supervision. Suyu, did Danjin do something to warrant this?
mention.source: Rover brings up Danjin in “Faithful Heart Tested at Skyfall” (18×)

dialogue.desc: The New Solar Celebration is just around the corner. Yet, President Lucilla detects a mysterious frequency appearing in the Academy's Dark Side—one that does not belong to the Academy. You suspect it may be the "reward" once mentioned by the Grand Architect of the Fractsidus. Determined to uncover the truth behind this anomaly, you venture into the Dark Side alongside Sigrika, a student you encountered there...

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: Okay then, we should find a quiet spot...

sample.speaker: Denia
sample.text: Go see the Divinator. I'll get you tickets.

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: Good idea! I can pick up the new riddle while we're there. You're the best, Nia!

sample.speaker: Denia
sample.text: It's Denia.

sample.speaker: Denia
sample.text: Now off you go. Bye-bye.

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: Alright, alright. Let's head to the Divinator's place. See you later, Lynae!

dialogue.desc: Not long after the Stridergate incident, the Spacetrek Collective informs you that Denia is awake and being kept in isolation. To learn the Fractsidus's next step and open new directions for future research, you head to the infirmary to negotiate with Denia. There, she offers you a "deal." In exchange, you'll need to stay with her for her birthday...

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: Sigh... Speaking of Nivora, I wonder how she's doing now.

sample.speaker: Denia
sample.text: ...Siggy.

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: Hmm?

sample.speaker: Denia
sample.text: Let's take another photo together.

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: Really? That's a first for you!

sample.speaker: Denia
sample.text: Come on, Rover, you too. And... can I borrow your camera?

scene.desc: Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.

voiceline.title: About Sigrika
voiceline.text: I find myself wondering... how nice would it be if Sigrika were just an ordinary girl? Without all that weight on her shoulders. They say you eventually have to pay for being innocent, but what did the kind and pure ever do to deserve that? The world can be so cruel. It punishes the kindest people and calls it "growth." Like that makes any sense. But through it all, Siggy has never been afraid... She really is amazing.

voiceline.title: About Denia
voiceline.text: Nia always says, "If you can't finish it, just drop it. Toss away whatever's hard or sad. Running away makes everything so much easier." But whenever I'm up late studying, she's always right there beside me. Sometimes I think… maybe she's actually the one who least wants to run away. She never talks about herself, so I can't quite see what's going on in her heart. Still... I hope we can stay friends for a very, very long time.

mention.title: A Bright Light
mention.text: Denia first met Sigrika during a group assignment. "But why me, Sigrika?"
mention.source: Denia's character story “A Bright Light”

mention.title: A Lie
mention.text: Sigrika, chasing birds through a sunset field.
mention.source: Denia's character story “A Lie”

mention.title: Beneath a Melting Night Sky
mention.text: I used to tell myself that was karma. But what does an ending like that mean for Sigrika? For Nastasha? For someone like you, who always tries to save everyone?
mention.source: Denia brings up Sigrika in “Beneath a Melting Night Sky” (11×)

mention.title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
mention.text: Made your decision? Well, no one's going to blame you. Not everyone's built like Sigrika.
mention.source: Denia brings up Sigrika in “Gold Suspended in Shadows” (3×)

mention.title: Beneath a Melting Night Sky
mention.text: Senior, do you remember Denia? You met her at the New Solar Celebration. She was the one who got us those tickets.
mention.source: Sigrika brings up Denia in “Beneath a Melting Night Sky” (12×)

mention.title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
mention.text: Denia was supposed to hand them out, but she's taken a few days off. Odd that Nivora's on leave, too. I wonder if they planned it...
mention.source: Sigrika brings up Denia in “Gold Suspended in Shadows” (8×)

mention.title: Sunny Season
mention.text: And also about what happened to Denia. She always did tell me that ignoring certain things was the key to staying happy.
mention.source: Sigrika brings up Denia in “Sunny Season” (3×)

dialogue.desc: Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.

sample.speaker: Denia
sample.text: No... don't—

sample.speaker: Hiyuki
sample.text: Is she stopping us of her own will?

scene.desc: Not long after the Stridergate incident, the Spacetrek Collective informs you that Denia is awake and being kept in isolation. To learn the Fractsidus's next step and open new directions for future research, you head to the infirmary to negotiate with Denia. There, she offers you a "deal." In exchange, you'll need to stay with her for her birthday...

voiceline.title: About Hiyuki
voiceline.text: That miko from Ashinohara is so powerful. Like she's cheating, you know? Yeah, I'd heard the stories before. But facing that power myself was a whole different story. She wasn't exactly what I pictured, though. Beyond all that strength and the gentleness you can tell right from her face, there's something else, almost... clinging to her. Something that won't wash away. Loneliness... or maybe regret? If growing stronger really comes with a price, I wonder… what has she given up to get this power?

voiceline.title: About Denia
voiceline.text: I... believe I failed her, in a way. Had I been quicker to see through the Fractsidus's plot, she might not have suffered as she did. I borrowed your strength when I delivered that strike. Only then was I able to restore a whisper of her true self back to her. I pray it caused no lasting harm. I am told that she is recovering. If we meet again, I will offer my apologies in person.

mention.title: Beneath a Melting Night Sky
mention.text: It definitely would! Hiyuki is... well... kind of scary, isn't she? Always popping up out of nowhere with a blade...
mention.source: Denia brings up Hiyuki in “Beneath a Melting Night Sky” (2×)

mention.title: Starlights from Yesterdays
mention.text: If you wish, I can tell you about my history with the Fractsidus. But of course, Denia is the more pressing matter.
mention.source: Hiyuki brings up Denia in “Starlights from Yesterdays” (2×)

mention.title: So as the Melting Snow Desires
mention.text: Their plans for Denia and me may have failed, but it proves one thing. They have found a way to harness Threnodian power.
mention.source: Hiyuki brings up Denia in “So as the Melting Snow Desires”

voiceline.title: About Phrolova
voiceline.text: She was one of the few Overseers in the Fractsidus who would talk to me. When I was floating in the Voidmatter pod, she'd even play the violin for me. I really enjoyed her music. It's just... I never figured out how someone who could make such beautiful melodies... would ever want to help a maniac like the Grand Architect.

scene.desc: The New Solar Celebration is just around the corner. Yet, President Lucilla detects a mysterious frequency appearing in the Academy's Dark Side—one that does not belong to the Academy. You suspect it may be the "reward" once mentioned by the Grand Architect of the Fractsidus. Determined to uncover the truth behind this anomaly, you venture into the Dark Side alongside Sigrika, a student you encountered there...
Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.
In the Voidmatter-contaminated area of the Twilight Woodlands, you discover Helios's prototype, a machine thought lost long ago in a Void Storm.

voiceline.title: About Mornye
voiceline.text: Professor Mornye fits every idea I've ever had of a perfect teacher: She has a soft voice, a sweet heart, she knows her stuff inside and out, and her classes are seriously intense. And the best part? She never, ever calls on me to answer questions when I'm napping in her class! Although... it might also be that no one has ever dared to sleep in her class before.

voiceline.title: About Denia
voiceline.text: You'll see her at every public lecture, nodding along as if she understands every word. Until she inevitably dozes off, jolts awake after bumping her head on the seat, and then drifts off again... I only later discovered that students receive credit solely for attendance.

mention.title: A Bright Light
mention.text: At night, they gazed at the star charts, watching the dreams Professor Mornye painted across the sky.
mention.source: Denia's character story “A Bright Light”

mention.title: Beneath a Melting Night Sky
mention.text: It's alright, Siggy. I'm sure you've got something really important to do with Professor Mornye.
mention.source: Denia brings up Mornye in “Beneath a Melting Night Sky”

sample.speaker: Aemeath
sample.text: Pfft! Hahahahaha!

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: ...That last part? Who said that?

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: What I'm trying to say is I really don't know what happened! (But I do know who's responsible for this!)

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: Let me make this clear. (I'll keep telling the truth anyway.) This candy's effect is very serious... (And I know you're not going to go easy on me.)

sample.speaker: Denia
sample.text: Rover, anything else fun to show?

scene.desc: Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.

voiceline.title: About Aemeath
voiceline.text: She's the legendary Fleet Snowfluff, right? I totally recognized her back in Voidspace. The Academy's former beloved star—even the toughest professors still talk about her after all these years. Plus, she still holds the top score on every single machine at the Mind Dive Arcade! Honestly, if you want your classmates to trust you, all you have to do is try to act like her... Her charm is seriously next level. Speaking of which... you must be really proud of her, huh? Make sure you protect her well this time. Don't ever lose her again.

dialogue.desc: The previous puzzle's answers has been revealed, but it only leads to another one. With a storm on the horizon, you follow the Magistrate's advice and search for clues about "the Black Shores".

sample.speaker: Encore
sample.text: Cosmos! Cloudy! You saw anything fun?

sample.speaker: Cosmos
sample.text: Reporting in! Cosmos saw nothing!

sample.speaker: Cloudy
sample.text: Cloudy saw nothing either, Baa.

sample.speaker: Encore
sample.text: What?! Go! Go look again!

sample.speaker: Encore
sample.text: With his brave heart, Cosmos decided to fight the Big Bad Demon and save the Magical Kingdom with Encore.

sample.speaker: Cosmos
sample.text: Baa!

dialogue.desc: While in Jinzhou, you run into Encore on vacation. She extends a special invitation to you— The adventure is about to begin! As Encore's closest friend, will you join the Wooly Warrior on this exciting journey?

sample.speaker: Encore
sample.text: And among these people, there's a small adventurer that goes by the name of "Wooly Warrior." When asked about her desires, she replies:

sample.speaker: Cosmos
sample.text: "I do not seek wealth or honor. Baa."

sample.speaker: Encore
sample.text: Fairy Cloudy, greatly puzzled by this reply, goes on to ask:

sample.speaker: Cloudy
sample.text: "If you desire neither wealth nor honor, why do you choose to venture to the Gateway of Wishes?"

sample.speaker: Cosmos
sample.text: "I have but one wish, to be reunited with my family."

sample.speaker: Encore
sample.text: Fairy Cloudy nods in approval and offers her guidance to the little warrior.

scene.desc: You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

mention.title: Thoughts: III
mention.text: Cosmos said you smell full of stories, and Cloudly told me you've been to many, many places.
mention.source: Encore's voice line “Thoughts: III”

mention.title: Thoughts: V
mention.text: Mommy's not with me anymore, and they say Cosmos and Cloudy are just my imaginary friends…
mention.source: Encore's voice line “Thoughts: V”

mention.title: Chat: I
mention.text: Cosmos and Cloudy are presents from mommy.
mention.source: Encore's voice line “Chat: I”

mention.title: Let's be Friends!
mention.text: Apologies if Cosmos accidentally bumps into you, it just tends to get a little too... excited.
mention.source: Encore's character story “Let's be Friends!”

mention.title: A Kid from the Theater
mention.text: Encore can't quite remember how long Cosmos and Cloudy have been part of her life. As a child, Encore secretly favored the cute Cloudy, a detail she never shared with Cosmos.
mention.source: Encore's character story “A Kid from the Theater”

mention.title: A Heroine's Return
mention.text: The first time Cosmos and Cloudy spoke to Encore was at her mother's funeral. Cosmos bluntly complained.
mention.source: Encore's character story “A Heroine's Return”

mention.title: Orphanage and Candy House
mention.text: That's when Cloudy raises its little fluffy hand, promptly followed by the dark, fluffy hand of Cosmos. Cosmos eagerly pushed Cloudy aside, standing beside Encore's bed, proudly taking over the storytelling.
mention.source: Encore's character story “Orphanage and Candy House”

mention.title: A New Story, A New Adventure
mention.text: Rather than answering Aalto's question, she picked up Cosmos and Cloudy, bringing them close to her ears. "Since Cosmos and Cloudy said you're a good guy, Encore will go with you," she said, trying to make her tone sound formal, "but Cosmos and Cloudy are coming too.
mention.source: Encore's character story “A New Story, A New Adventure”

mention.title: Dreamscape Odyssey: Little Warrior's Stage
mention.text: But they were not afraid! Ha, ha! Princess Cloudy and Adventure Cosmos used all their skills to support Warrior Encore.
mention.source: Encore brings up Cosmos in “Dreamscape Odyssey: Little Warrior's Stage” (6×)

mention.title: Rewinding Raindrops
mention.text: Cosmos! Cloudy! You saw anything fun?
mention.source: Encore brings up Cosmos in “Rewinding Raindrops” (2×)

mention.title: When the Night Knocks
mention.text: Then she met you, Traveler Cosmos, Prince Cloudy, and many more new friends.
mention.source: Encore brings up Cosmos in “When the Night Knocks” (2×)

mention.title: Small Wooly, Big Adventures
mention.text: "Hmph. Give us some extra time, and we can make one bigger than that giant gate of Jinzhou. Baa!" Says Cosmos.
mention.source: Encore brings up Cosmos in “Small Wooly, Big Adventures” (8×)

mention.title: Do Echoids Dream of Electric Sheep? (Quest)
mention.text: Ms. Encore has been preoccupied with numerous other matters recently. Therefore, I, the Black Wooly, will temporarily serve as your business representative in her stead.
mention.source: Cosmos brings up Encore in “Do Echoids Dream of Electric Sheep? (Quest)”

mention.title: Fantasies of the Thousand Gateways (Quest)
mention.text: I'm afraid Ms. Encore has no involvement in this. This entity is a replica of memory fragments from the Somnoire. I am merely borrowing its appearance for the time being.
mention.source: Cosmos brings up Encore in “Fantasies of the Thousand Gateways (Quest)”

mention.title: The One that Impresses
mention.text: Encore saw all the fun you were having and wants to join! So Encore sent Cosmos to take a look.
mention.source: Cosmos brings up Encore in “The One that Impresses” (5×)

dialogue.desc: The previous puzzle's answers has been revealed, but it only leads to another one. With a storm on the horizon, you follow the Magistrate's advice and search for clues about "the Black Shores".

sample.speaker: Verina
sample.text: Oh, please watch out... It's dangerous to run like that...

sample.speaker: Encore
sample.text: Here you are! Hurray!

dialogue.desc: While in Jinzhou, you run into Encore on vacation. She extends a special invitation to you— The adventure is about to begin! As Encore's closest friend, will you join the Wooly Warrior on this exciting journey?

sample.speaker: Verina
sample.text: The flower typically blooms in pairs, representing companionship and support. Perfect for conveying friendship.

sample.speaker: Encore
sample.text: And these. These are Encore's picks!

sample.speaker: Verina
sample.text: That's quite the selection, Encore. What do they all represent?

sample.speaker: Encore
sample.text: Have a look at this one. It's gold and shiny, and it matches the color of your eyes, Rover!

sample.speaker: Encore
sample.text: Encore picked flowers that resemble everyone. If we put them together, they can represent our whole team.

sample.speaker: Verina
sample.text: That's pretty special! I'm sure it'll look really nice once they're all together.

dialogue.summary: With Verina's guidance, you and Encore set out to find the perfect flowers that represent your feelings, weaving them together into a beautiful wreath.

scene.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

voiceline.title: About Verina
voiceline.text: Verina's flowers are grown with love! Nothing like the ones they sell in the New Federation! But some of them looked a bit wacky, like the one that gobbled down on Aalto's head and gave him a new haircut… Gotta ask her what it's called next time!

voiceline.title: About Encore
voiceline.text: Little Encore is full of intriguing ideas, and she always has a lot of curious questions to ask. Hmm... I've got to keep looking for all the answers she wants. Oh, you're wondering why I call her "little"? Hehe, we're just playing big sister and little baby.

mention.title: Small Wooly, Big Adventures
mention.text: Hi Verina, er, not exactly. we're here to ask you how we can make the Wreath of Hope.
mention.source: Encore brings up Verina in “Small Wooly, Big Adventures” (6×)

mention.title: Small Wooly, Big Adventures
mention.text: That's quite the selection, Encore. What do they all represent?
mention.source: Verina brings up Encore in “Small Wooly, Big Adventures” (2×)

scene.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

voiceline.title: About Mortefi
voiceline.text: Friends in Jinzhou told me Mortefi makes lots of fun gadgets and gizmos! That's so cool! Hmm, should I ask him for a bouncy sheep next time…

scene.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...
You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

voiceline.title: About Calcharo
voiceline.text: Psst. Wanna hear a secret? That strange big guy Aalto's been working with is actually... a doggy person! That's why he's a big doggy in Encore's stories!

scene.desc: The previous puzzle's answers has been revealed, but it only leads to another one. With a storm on the horizon, you follow the Magistrate's advice and search for clues about "the Black Shores".
As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

voiceline.title: About Jiyan
voiceline.text: Grown-ups like him have to wear a long face all the time, you know. See? Being a grown-up is really tough!

voiceline.title: About Encore
voiceline.text: Are you referring to the little girl who is always seen by Aalto's side? I have met her once. She and Aalto complement each other perfectly, personality wise.

dialogue.desc: The previous puzzle's answers has been revealed, but it only leads to another one. With a storm on the horizon, you follow the Magistrate's advice and search for clues about "the Black Shores".

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Hello, little one. Is your name Encore? Do you know this person?

sample.speaker: Encore
sample.text: Yes! Encore knows him!

sample.speaker: Encore
sample.text: Uncle Aalto sells stuff without a license, he listens in on people for commercial secrets, and he loves pulling pranks on us kids... But he's not a bad guy, really!

scene.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

scene.quest: Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song
scene.desc: The frequencies building up within Patty have resonated with the environment and generated a Sonoro Sphere. The truth about the fourth wish may be hidden therein. The name Patty keeps mumbling about seems to be connected with Xiangli Yao. You must head it off at the pass before things get out of hands at the Moonlit Fair.

voiceline.title: About Chixia
voiceline.text: Miss Chixia is another one of Encore's besties! She can get a bit strict sometimes, but in a good way! You can call her when you're lost in town, she doesn't mind the extra work.

mention.title: Rewinding Raindrops
mention.text: Hello, little one. Is your name Encore? Do you know this person?
mention.source: Chixia brings up Encore in “Rewinding Raindrops”

timeline.quest: Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song

dialogue.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

sample.speaker: Cartethyia
sample.text: You bear the Dark Tide's power, but you are no Harbinger.

sample.speaker: Galbrena
sample.text: Good, we can avoid the lengthy explanation. If you're looking for the Harbinger too, you must've seen it. The apocalypse Leviathan will bring forth.

sample.speaker: Galbrena
sample.text: It was meant to remain restrained by the Sentinel. But I feel It stirring again. I followed Its frequency... and found you.

sample.speaker: Cartethyia
sample.text: Most of Leviathan's power resides in me. But a fragment escaped. I've been tracking the one who carriesthat power.

sample.speaker: Galbrena
sample.text: That Gem was cast into the Dark Tide. If this is where things are at, that leads to only one conclusion...

scene.desc: To open the Sentinel's Relic, you head back to Ragunna once more...

scene.quest: Where Stars Cascade Down · event story

voiceline.title: About Cartethyia
voiceline.text: It was through the Dark Tide's memory that I first learned of her. I never saw her as anyone's Resonator, and in return, she gave me a reply that was... wild, reckless, but resolute. A knight of justice shouldn't be sealed away in a tower. The nightmare Leviathan cast upon her lasted far too long… But now that Rinascita has emerged from the darkness, she too should be free to embrace her own dawn.

mention.title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
mention.text: Perhaps longer than we can imagine. Even your clash with Cartethyia may have been scripted. A setup to give Leviathan a shot at slipping the Sentinel.
mention.source: Galbrena brings up Cartethyia in “The Bygone Shall Always Return” (4×)

mention.title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
mention.text: That power you used... Was it the Sentinel's power of separation? And that incredible little one... No wonder Cartethyia had the nerve to propose such a mad plan.
mention.source: Galbrena brings up Cartethyia in “Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides” (3×)

mention.title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
mention.text: This might be the first real conversation we've had since everything ended. Thank you very much, Galbrena.
mention.source: Cartethyia brings up Galbrena in “Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides” (2×)

dialogue.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

sample.speaker: Aalto
sample.text: But that's all theorizing best kept to caffeinated hours. For now, we'll need to wait until Tethys completes its analysis before drawing any conclusions.

sample.speaker: Galbrena
sample.text: Well, I'm glad it helped. I'll be on my way then.

sample.speaker: Aalto
sample.text: Hey, Rover... She's got real skill. Moves like she's already part of our rhythm. This kind of synergy doesn't come knocking twice. What do you say...?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Everyone in the Black Shores has made it their mission to stand against the Lament. Our goals are the same, and we've been walking the same path from the start.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I know you're not the type who likes being tied down by titles. But just remember this... You're not fighting it alone. So...

voiceline.title: About Aalto
voiceline.text: The Black Shores' database needs constant updates, and I send captured Tacet Discord data back like clockwork. I don't visit the base much, so Aalto is the one who always helps handle my performance check-ins. Of course, he never signs off on anything that doesn't benefit him. That's why half the data I send ends up counted as his work.

scene.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

voiceline.title: About Calcharo
voiceline.text: While hunting in the New Federation, we had our eyes on the same Tacet Discord. His goal was to eliminate it. Mine was to absorb it. There were some misunderstandings along the way, but overall, it was a smooth collaboration. He actually invited me to join his mercenary group. Pack hunting is indeed important to survival, but... I'm just used to working alone.

scene.desc: Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.

Though the Threnodian Aleph-1 was banished, Lucilla finds herself in yet another predicament. In the absence of the Exostrider, funders are questioning whether the Synchronist program—and even the Rabelle College itself—should continue to exist. As both a professor and the head of the Academy, Lucilla must now choose between harsh reality and her ideals.

After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

voiceline.title: About Lynae
voiceline.text: She is a bright spirit. I am aware of certain secrets she carries. In a sense, we are both bound by our pasts. But she has a future she is galloping toward, one filled with light and hope she wholly deserves. That said, I still believe she should refrain from using her Forte to slip into class when she is late.

voiceline.title: About Chisa
voiceline.text: Chisa is also from Ashinohara. I have made a point to avoid meeting her. After all, in our homeland, Mikos only appeared in the darkest of times. We were never omens of good fortune—perhaps a parallel can be drawn to those detective comics popular nowadays. Besides, it may be unsettling to see a name from history standing before you in the flesh. Also, please do not speak to her of what transpired in Ashinohara. That burden is not hers to bear.

scene.desc: You receive word from Lucilla requesting your presence at the Academic Affairs office to discuss plans. In place of the busy President, Hiyuki will be meeting with you.

voiceline.title: About Aemeath
voiceline.text: A resilient child. She surely endured unimaginable hardship to return here. When she vanished within the simulator cockpit, I was out on a field assignment. The investigation team later briefed me on her case. The detail that made me pause was her writing "saving the world" as her career aspiration... Hm, I find myself wondering... what in her upbringing instilled this level of conviction?

mention.title: Starlights from Yesterdays
mention.text: Rover, I've read the Spacetrek Collective's report on Aemeath.
mention.source: Hiyuki brings up Aemeath in “Starlights from Yesterdays”

To learn the Fractsidus's next step and open new directions for future research, you head to the infirmary to negotiate with Denia. There, she offers you a "deal." In exchange, you'll need to stay with her for her birthday...

voiceline.title: About Sigrika
voiceline.text: She bears an awful load for a child of her age. She seeks to shoulder the expectations placed upon a Solsworn far ahead her own time. I have noticed her watching the Shiratori I send forth. Perhaps I should fold one for her before I depart?

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: You're here.

sample.speaker: Hiyuki
sample.text: Go after it. I'll handle the rest.

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: Come on. We've still got work to do.

dialogue.desc: After the Dark Side incident comes to an end, Lucilla meets with Hiyuki at the auditorium. Lucilla suspects that the Fractsidus may be plotting something far more dangerous behind the scenes...

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: Have you swallowed it?

sample.speaker: Hiyuki
sample.text: Umm-hmm. A bit sour… and my tongue's tingling. Not my favorite.

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: Huh? No reaction at all? That's odd. When Sigrika and the others ate theirs, they…

sample.speaker: Hiyuki
sample.text: What?

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: You're no fun.

sample.speaker: Hiyuki
sample.text: saw me. Does that affect your plan?

sample.speaker: Hiyuki
sample.text: What are you looking at?

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: Ah, there you are. Nothing really. I've just been wondering... if I wanted to land another astronomical investment to study all the Exoswarm coming off this giant mech...

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: What kind of pitch would it take to make every major player in Solaris nod along and funnel Credits into my pocket, year after year?

sample.speaker: Hiyuki
sample.text: Have you figured it out?

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: Not yet. My conscience won't let me think that far. Luckily, the man who can figure it out is back.

sample.speaker: Hiyuki
sample.text: ...The old man who promised me the blade? The head of the Spacetrek Collective?

dialogue.desc: Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.

sample.speaker: Hiyuki
sample.text: Should you lose yourself in the Voidmatter, it will also guide you back.

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: Hiyuki is part of Startorch Academy's Special Response Force. She works from the shadows, she's been an incredible help to us all.

sample.speaker: Hiyuki
sample.text: If, in your fight with the Threnodian, you require aid...

sample.speaker: Hiyuki
sample.text: ...You may make a wish to me.

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: How about I go first? I wish for peace and safety across the Dimmr Plains.

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: Hehe, Hiyuki is the strong and silent type. Spend enough time with her, though, and you'll find she's rather fascinating.
