scene.desc: You receive word from Lucilla requesting your presence at the Academic Affairs office to discuss plans. In place of the busy President, Hiyuki will be meeting with you.

voiceline.title: About Lucilla
voiceline.text: Though Lucilla insists our partnership is only contractual, I am well aware that without her discreet arrangements, I would have no place in the Spacetrek Collective, much less have obtained that blade. She carries herself lightly, yet the weight on her shoulders is plain to see. She often visits me, half in jest, declaring that she intends to "call it quits"—it is her way of venting. Before returning to Ashinohara, I should at least see her through the troubles presently at hand.

voiceline.title: About Hiyuki
voiceline.text: You, me, and Hiyuki. If I may, I'd like to presume we're "cut from the same cloth." Each of us had our reasons for starting down the path we're on now. Difference is, I journey to stay, whereas you and Hiyuki...

mention.title: Even Should the Path Have No End
mention.text: "Lucilla." Lucilla casually pulled a bottle of fine liquor from beneath the desk, a specialty from Ashinohara.
mention.source: Hiyuki's character story “Even Should the Path Have No End”

mention.title: Starlights from Yesterdays
mention.text: This is Hiyuki, I told you about her before. The only reason we could set up the monitoring equipment so quickly is because she cleared the way for us.
mention.source: Lucilla brings up Hiyuki in “Starlights from Yesterdays” (6×)

mention.title: The Flaming Red from Tomorrow
mention.text: Her name is Hiyuki. She's been helping the Collective survey the active Voidmatter zone. Simply put, she's in charge of protecting researchers and students who aren't equipped for a fight.
mention.source: Lucilla brings up Hiyuki in “The Flaming Red from Tomorrow” (3×)

mention.title: Wishes in the Bell
mention.text: Her name is Hiyuki. She's been helping the Collective survey the active Voidmatter zone. Simply put, she's in charge of protecting researchers and students who aren't equipped for a fight.
mention.source: Lucilla brings up Hiyuki in “Wishes in the Bell” (2×)

mention.title: So as the Melting Snow Desires
mention.text: Hiyuki will meet you there instead.}}
mention.source: Lucilla brings up Hiyuki in “So as the Melting Snow Desires”

mention.title: Platya's Gift
mention.text: Hah... You two might actually get along. Which is saying something. Hiyuki doesn't exactly do small talk.
mention.source: Lucilla brings up Hiyuki in “Platya's Gift” (2×)

mention.title: Starlights from Yesterdays
mention.text: Yes. Lucilla spoke of what that child did. She is a good one. Strong... But her strength does not change the fact that she is a student.
mention.source: Hiyuki brings up Lucilla in “Starlights from Yesterdays” (6×)

mention.title: The Wind Before the Storm
mention.text: All eyes are watching Ashinohara now. In Lucilla's words, it is a "complicated and troublesome adult world." And the appearance of the Miko of Flaming Sakura would only complicate things further.
mention.source: Hiyuki brings up Lucilla in “The Wind Before the Storm” (3×)

mention.title: So as the Melting Snow Desires
mention.text: She is still undergoing treatment and remains unstable. The Collective seem to have special arrangements for her. I wished to visit, but Lucilla said I am the one person who cannot...
mention.source: Hiyuki brings up Lucilla in “So as the Melting Snow Desires” (4×)

dialogue.desc: The Waking Moon Festival is drawing near in the Land of Xuanfang, yet rumors that "the Hold is doomed to fall" have begun to spread throughout the city. To find the Sentinel who has long been absent, you decide to head to where Hsin's presence was last felt—the Manifold Sanctum.

sample.speaker: Hsin
sample.text: It was your obsession with the Ten Seals that carried you this far? If one day, you release them all—

sample.speaker: Suoming
sample.text: I would welcome that day, Hsin the Moon Fox.

sample.speaker: Hsin
sample.text: Suoming...

sample.speaker: Suoming
sample.text: Enough about me. Have you chosen who will accompany us to Mengzhou?

sample.speaker: Hsin
sample.text: The Zhaoming Commerce Guild will provide us with cover along the way. Besides that, three more skilled individuals are joining us.

sample.speaker: Suoming
sample.text: A fugitive framed by the Fractsidus, formerly known as the "Blind Watcher."

scene.desc: Entrusted by Hsin, Suoming invites you to revisit the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou. Although you still have many questions about Hsin's intentions, you embark on the journey once more...

voiceline.title: About Suoming
voiceline.text: When I was wholly consumed by remolding the Civilization Capsule and building Xuanfang Hold, Mengzhou weathered its trials alone. It was Intendant Suoming who bore the weight of the region's affairs on my behalf. I know she clings to obsessions she has no intention of releasing, using them as fuel to walk through storm and calm alike... Every time I think of it, I am flooded with guilt. I long for the day she finds what she seeks—the peace that only home can bring. For that to happen, I must be the Sentinel she deserves.

voiceline.title: About Hsin the Moon Fox
voiceline.text: After our bitter victory over the Evil Miasma, I resented the Sentinel for failing to appear while the black rain fell upon Huating. But when I finally stood before It, seeing Mengzhou as it was and finding It gravely wounded yet still straining to hold the enemies at bay... How could I hold onto my hatred? In the end, I accepted the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs' mandate and dedicated everything I have to It and to Mengzhou.

voiceline.title: About Hsin
voiceline.text: If we speak of age, Hsin is actually a bit younger than me. Having assisted the Sentinel for so long, watching Her grow into who She is today naturally carries a certain fondness. Whether it was Her solitary effort to remold the Civilization Capsule in the past, or Her finally stepping into Her role as the Sentinel now... Hsin has never once let the Sentinel down.

mention.title: Thoughts: I
mention.text: For a century, the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs has spoken on behalf of Hsin the Moon Fox to every Magistrate.
mention.source: Suoming's voice line “Thoughts: I”

mention.title: Thoughts: III
mention.text: At Sentinel Hsin's behest, I joined the Ministry to purge Balanophora's remnants, restore order, and find a path forward.
mention.source: Suoming's voice line “Thoughts: III”

mention.title: Suoming's Trouble
mention.text: I cannot say if it's just my imagination, but ever since Sentinel Hsin returned, Mengzhou seems to have more sunny days.
mention.source: Suoming's voice line “Suoming's Trouble”

mention.title: Ideals
mention.text: For now, Hsin and Mengzhou's future must come first.
mention.source: Suoming's voice line “Ideals”

mention.title: Birthday Wishes
mention.text: May all be well in Hsin's keeping, and may your journey ahead be safe.
mention.source: Suoming's voice line “Birthday Wishes”

mention.title: Join Team: I
mention.text: May all be well in Hsin's keeping.
mention.source: Suoming's voice line “Join Team: I”

mention.title: Simulacrum of the Heart
mention.text: Our Grand Library records that Sentinel Hsin and the Court of Savantae agreed that once the Hold was complete, the Artisans would surrender their lives and become conscious frequencies woven into the mechanisms. Part of the Sanctum's computational power.
mention.source: Suoming brings up Hsin in “Simulacrum of the Heart” (29×)

mention.title: Past Dreams, Traced Seals
mention.text: I can't. Neither Hsin nor the late Sentinel ever met them in person. They only heard fragments of their past from me, so these memory projections are incomplete.
mention.source: Suoming brings up Hsin in “Past Dreams, Traced Seals” (9×)

mention.title: Simulacrum of the Heart
mention.text: Hmph, it seems my grand plans for a "welcome party" for little Suoming were quite unnecessary. Seems I needn't worry about you getting along.
mention.source: Hsin brings up Suoming in “Simulacrum of the Heart” (8×)

dialogue.desc: With the great battle over, the Land of Xuanfang is slowly returning to how it once was, though plenty of aftershocks have yet to settle. Then one day, a WavesLine message from Yangyang arrives out of the blue: Suisui is about to head back to Mengzhou City...

sample.speaker: Hsin
sample.text: Should the tide become irreversible, then you may exercise my authority in my stead.

sample.speaker: Qingxiao
sample.text: You... What has happened?

sample.speaker: Qingxiao
sample.text: Qingxiao accepts your charge.

sample.speaker: Hsin
sample.text: With you here, I am at ease. Perhaps soon... you will find the answer to that which you have asked the heavens.

sample.speaker: Qingxiao
sample.text: ...Where will you go now?

sample.speaker: Hsin
sample.text: Shh. That is still a secret.

scene.desc: The Land of Xuanfang is thrown into turmoil following an unexpected riot of out-of-control Autopuppets. As you investigate, you uncover the mastermind behind the scheme—a mysterious Artisan who covets the Sentinel's technology. In the culmination of the event, this figure commands the rogue Autopuppets to launch an assault on Xuanfang Hold.

The Waking Moon Festival is drawing near in the Land of Xuanfang, yet rumors that "the Hold is doomed to fall" have begun to spread throughout the city. To find the Sentinel who has long been absent, you decide to head to where Hsin's presence was last felt—the Manifold Sanctum.

voiceline.title: About Qingxiao
voiceline.text: The Xuan Paragon appears cold and distant, but she is softer than she lets on. If you need something from her, all it takes is a little persistence, and she will fold. "I will not go," she says of the Waking Moon Festival, yet she never misses a single one. I have always seen that she carried the answer within her heart. She simply needed someone to give her a gentle push. Seeing her finally lay that burden down... it brings me immense joy. Come to think of it, if we were to count by age, I might even call her "Sister Qingxiao"... Oh my, but she must never hear me say that. She would tell me to stop foxing around.

voiceline.title: About Hsin
voiceline.text: Hsin is one to follow Her whims, and carries a wealth of emotions unlike any other Sentinel of Huanglong. It was She who first invited me to hold the honorary title of Xuan Paragon in Xuanfang Hold. In those days, She would often come up the mountain, regaling me with anecdotes and trivia, and once She started, She could go on for hours. Only when I played the qin would She fall quiet. Sometimes, as She listened, a flicker of loneliness would cross Her face… She always believed She hid it well from me.

mention.title: Disliked Food
mention.text: Hsin learned of this one day and secretly added Chongzhou chili sauce to some pastries she had me try.
mention.source: Qingxiao's voice line “Disliked Food”

mention.title: Song of the Heart Sword
mention.text: At this point in time, I hadn't yet accepted Hsin's request to serve as the Xuan Paragon. The "Sword Transcendent" title only came from an embellished tale.
mention.source: Qingxiao brings up Hsin in “Song of the Heart Sword” (15×)

mention.title: Simulacrum of the Heart
mention.text: Hsin keeps no set path, so a flickering presence is nothing new... She vanishes for a time, then reappears as if nothing happened, chattering of trifles.
mention.source: Qingxiao brings up Hsin in “Simulacrum of the Heart” (13×)

mention.title: Song of the Heart Sword/Extra
mention.text: My disciple, you accepted Hsin's power before, and your body still needs time to adapt to it. You have been running ragged across Xuanfang lately without a moment's rest.
mention.source: Qingxiao brings up Hsin in “Song of the Heart Sword/Extra”

mention.title: Together, Into the Worldly Splendor
mention.text: My disciple, you accepted Hsin's power before, and your body still needs time to adapt to it. You have been running ragged across Xuanfang lately without a moment's rest.
mention.source: Qingxiao brings up Hsin in “Together, Into the Worldly Splendor”

mention.title: Song of the Heart Sword
mention.text: Paragon Qingxiao, should disaster one day befall Xuanfang Hold, I hope you will raise your sword for its people.
mention.source: Hsin brings up Qingxiao in “Song of the Heart Sword” (4×)

scene.desc: The Land of Xuanfang is thrown into turmoil following an unexpected riot of out-of-control Autopuppets. As you investigate, you uncover the mastermind behind the scheme—a mysterious Artisan who covets the Sentinel's technology. In the culmination of the event, this figure commands the rogue Autopuppets to launch an assault on Xuanfang Hold.

With the great battle over, the Land of Xuanfang is slowly returning to how it once was, though plenty of aftershocks have yet to settle. Then one day, a WavesLine message from Yangyang arrives out of the blue: Suisui is about to head back to Mengzhou City...

The Waking Moon Festival is drawing near in the Land of Xuanfang, yet rumors that "the Hold is doomed to fall" have begun to spread throughout the city. To find the Sentinel who has long been absent, you decide to head to where Hsin's presence was last felt—the Manifold Sanctum.

voiceline.title: About Suisui
voiceline.text: Now there is a remarkably clever young woman. I have seen so many lose their way in the world of commerce, but she navigates it with purpose, her heart set on something larger than profit, pursuing it with the same innate force as the wind rising over water. She even dared to try and outmaneuver me, a Sentinel, heedless of the consequences! And yet, I knew at a glance—her wish is the same as mine. Besides, she has long since seen through me. So I let her be. And as it turns out... I chose well.

voiceline.title: About Hsin
voiceline.text: Unlike the other Sentinels of Huanglong, Hsin doesn't feel like a divinity looking down from on high. Somehow, I see a part of her that's unmistakably "human." Maybe it's because I know how much she loves this mortal world that I dared to stand before her.

mention.title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
mention.text: I'm sorry, Rover, for keeping this from you. My deal with Hsin was meant to stay between us. Until I stood before Her, I wasn't sure if revealing the truth would help or just make things worse.
mention.source: Suisui brings up Hsin in “Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled” (8×)

dialogue.desc: A mysterious girl approaches you on WavesLine, asking for your help to collect the scattered Feeling Capsule Shards. As you go deeper into this matter, a story surfaces about Hsin the Moon Fox, the Sentinel of the past.

sample.speaker: Xuanqing
sample.text: "But the Arbiter already acknowledged me as the Sentinel. So no matter what, I won't doubt myself again!"

sample.speaker: Xuanqing
sample.text: Hahaha, you and the Moon Fox are so alike, it's adorable!

sample.speaker: Xuanqing
sample.text: But here's what I want you to know. The choice you made… it fulfilled the Moon Fox's wish.

sample.speaker: Hsin
sample.text: The Moon Fox's wish?

sample.speaker: Xuanqing
sample.text: Just as Hsin the Moon Fox defied the laws of the Sentinels to build Xuanfang Hold and shelter all beings...

voiceline.title: About Xuanqing
voiceline.text: Though I never truly met her, she remains vividly undimmed, unfaded, as real as breath and bone within the Moon Fox's memories. I sometimes wonder, had she never existed, would the Sentinel have ever thought to create me? Emotion... is the hardest thing to put into words.

mention.title: Moonlike Heart, Mortal Longing
mention.text: But a newborn consciousness can't handle too much feeling all at once. She needed time to learn. "Joy," "sorrow," "anger," "fear"... She sealed these emotions away, and as "Hsin" lived among mortals, She gradually received them.
mention.source: Xuanqing brings up Hsin in “Moonlike Heart, Mortal Longing” (19×)

mention.title: Moonlike Heart, Mortal Longing
mention.text: Resonator of Sentinel Hsin the Moon Fox... Xuanqing.
mention.source: Hsin brings up Xuanqing in “Moonlike Heart, Mortal Longing” (3×)

voiceline.title: About "Jué"
voiceline.text: Jué... It is the youngest of all the Huanglong Sentinels, and yet no one is more rigid in following the ordained path. Perhaps it is because of Its Temporal Mandate that It values the weight of each "choice" so dearly. When It came to consult with the Moon Fox on the raising of a city, It had exhausted every ounce of Its computational power in seeking a future for the people... Had I not acted in the Fortress and Gorges War, its fires would have reached the very heart of the Jinmen Pass. Jué had cultivated the seeds of Jinzhou with such care, I could not bear to watch them wither. And now, Jinzhou flourishes with lanterns and laughter, year after year. Jué's gambit... was not made in vain.

dialogue.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

sample.speaker: Lupa
sample.text: What is that in the center? An opening? Something inside is sending them frequencies to recover!

sample.speaker: Iuno
sample.text: The Tidespawn are still hiding in there, ready to strike again... Damn it. There's no end to this...

dialogue.desc: Cartethyia vanished in the Inverted Tower. Following the traces she left behind, you arrive at Septimont, one of Rinascita's city-states, steeped in glory and famed for its gladiatorial tradition. The city is hosting the Great Agon—a grand championship held once every four years. Yet beneath the grandeur, shadows stir. Multiple factions move in secret, each with their hidden agenda. To uncover the truth, you form a temporary alliance with Contender Lupa. Together, you set your sights on the championship...

sample.speaker: Lupa
sample.text: That's Iuno, the Priestess of Septimont. She rarely leaves the Temple and only shows up accompanying Ephor Augusta.

sample.speaker: Iuno
sample.text: The heroic spirits of the moon and stars have long seen through it. These hollow lies taint Septimont's sacred arena.

sample.speaker: Iuno
sample.text: Guilty.

sample.speaker: Iuno
sample.text: Augusta, banish the Silvas from Septimont!

sample.speaker: Lupa
sample.text: The Priestess can foretell fate and has the power to make final calls here. Most people trust her judgment.

sample.speaker: Lupa
sample.text: But... Iuno is a bit extreme in our line of Priestesses. Not everyone agrees with her behavior, despite her capabilities.

voiceline.title: About Lupa
voiceline.text: Anyone who's seen her matches probably feels the urge to challenge her as well, wouldn't you agree? Her passion for competition is really something... Pure, simple, and completely genuine. For her, victory and glory are just icing on the cake compared to the joy of the fight. She's not afraid to lose, but her passion always drives her to give her all and never back down, no matter the odds.

voiceline.title: About Iuno
voiceline.text: I rarely visit the Temple to pray for revelations, so I can't say I know the Priestesses well. But I do like Iuno. Many of the nobles can't stand her unconventional ways, but I find her boldness entertaining. Don't you?

voiceline.title: About Iuno
voiceline.text: A spirited, nimble girl... That's my impression of her. Once, I saw her sprint along the narrow bricks at the top of the high wall and leap onto a statue like a cat. No clue who was chasing her, but I cheered loudly along with everyone else at the foot of the wall!

mention.title: Shadow of Glory
mention.text: The Priestess of Septimont has the authority to make final judgments. Iuno, in particular, is one of Ephor Augusta's staunchest allies.
mention.source: Lupa brings up Iuno in “Shadow of Glory” (4×)

dialogue.desc: As the High Tide draws near, a lurking calamity stirs, with its gaze fixed upon the borders of Septimont. Ephor Augusta invites you to the Sanguis Plateaus for a fateful hunt, the one that may decide the realm's survival...

sample.speaker: Avidius
sample.text: Whether the Priestesses can't foresee the fate that awaits, or whether the true prophecy is meant to remain hidden... Is indeed a question worth pondering.

sample.speaker: Iuno
sample.text: Our would-be Hero of Heroes, lost in daydreams again? What is it this time? Staring at an empty wall, hoping one day it'll bear your name?

sample.speaker: Avidius
sample.text: I happened to wander by, passing the time as one does. No need to trouble yourself with someone as inconsequential as I, Priestess.

sample.speaker: Iuno
sample.text: Inconsequential? Come now. Everyone knows you're the Senate's golden child. Those old loons wouldn't spare me a glance, but they hang on your every word.

sample.speaker: Iuno
sample.text: Have you been waiting long? Ugh, I can't believe he got to you first.

sample.speaker: Avidius
sample.text: Isn't paying respects to the Heroes fairly commonplace? Surely, we needn't allow rivalry to come between us, Priestess.

scene.desc: With the Sovereign slain, you attend the victory ceremony by invitation of Ceremonial Officer Bruno. The celebration honors the new Hero of Heroes and those who stood by their side amidst the crackling bonfire and joyous cheers of the crowd... Now that the countless petals are to be thrown into the sky to become the rain of glory and triumph, you might finally reunite with the girl you have never forgotten in a way even beyond fate's grasp.

voiceline.title: About Avidius
voiceline.text: He roared at fate with everything he had. Sure, that roar was swiftly reduced to whimpers, then silence, but we all heard it. It left its mark... I think he's more like the Hero of Heroes when he stops worrying about what that even means or what others expect from him.

mention.title: By Sun's Burning Hand
mention.text: Though... Avidius makes me rather uncomfortable. It's got nothing to do with his stance, it's... more of a hunch. Something about him feels... unnatural.
mention.source: Iuno brings up Avidius in “By Sun's Burning Hand” (4×)

mention.title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
mention.text: I see, Ragunna too... And Avidius... He never bent the knee, never played by the rules. Why is it that fate always strikes hardest at those who dare to defy it?
mention.source: Iuno brings up Avidius in “Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides”

dialogue.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: Meanwhile, we'll hold the line at the Three Heroes' Crest. The Tidespawn aren't the only threat. The Fractsidus might still have their hand to play.

sample.speaker: Iuno
sample.text: Rinascita will not falter just because a few of its leaders are gone. Its people will rise.

sample.speaker: Iuno
sample.text: We'll meet again in the Paradise and end this together... Leviathan will fall

voiceline.title: About Carlotta
voiceline.text: She and her family always manage to bring something fresh to Septimont and Ragunna, even to themselves. And before you know it, those little novelties spark whole new trend.... Me? Yep, I usually end up buying whatever it is. It's just hard to resist. She always gets what I like. Those Montellis, cunning as ever!

scene.desc: As the tides of danger retreat, Jinzhou appears tranquil and vibrant. But beyond its borders lies a fierce and desperate battleground.
As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

voiceline.title: About Chixia
voiceline.text: Chixia always invites me to spar. She's really good with her guns, and I've learned so much from those fights. I admire her dedication and genuineness. It's great to have made a friend while honing my fighting skills.

scene.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

voiceline.title: About Yuanwu
voiceline.text: Occasionally I'd leave my sect to go on what we call self-cultivating trips. During one of those trips, I visited Mr. Yuanwu's boxing gym and challenged him to fight, and I won. I told Master Shiling about it when I returned, and it turns out Mr. Yuanwu's ancestors used to practice martial arts at our sect. According to the rules, I guess I should call him my "martial senior". I heard that Mr. Yuanwu went through a lot when he was younger, but it seems he doesn't want me to talk too much about it, so let's just drop it there.

voiceline.title: About Jianxin
voiceline.text: I am more than happy to get an outstanding training partner like Jianxin by merely offering her a simple meal... Of course, I'm always pleased to spend time with her over a meal, whether she's here to train with me or not.

voiceline.title: About Suisui
voiceline.text: The famous Madam Chongming Pruner... efficient, sharp-minded, and knows her way around all sorts. The Zhaoming Commerce Guild keeps growing with her at the helm. Rare goods from cities in and even outside of Huanglong keep flowing through her hands. Hm, color me impressed—I've seen my fare share of relics and curios. But if she's got the touch to gather all these lost treasures and put them back on the market... hah, that takes real skill.

voiceline.title: About Jingran
voiceline.text: The Cat of the Nether Lamp… the rumors make him sound like a ghost story. A figure in black, drifting through shadows with a Nether Lamp and the chill of the netherworld clinging to him. I've only met him a few times. Despite his youth, his eyes have the look of someone who has weathered storms that would break lesser men. He is utterly uninhibited, and it makes me curious: is there anything in this world that could actually hold him back?

dialogue.desc: With the great battle over, the Land of Xuanfang is slowly returning to how it once was, though plenty of aftershocks have yet to settle. Then one day, a WavesLine message from Yangyang arrives out of the blue: Suisui is about to head back to Mengzhou City...

sample.speaker: Jingran
sample.text: While he was running his mouth at you, I gave him a little love tap in the back. Shame he slipped away behind a wall of Autopuppets.

sample.speaker: Qingxiao
sample.text: I see... that's why Muyu's phantom vanished so suddenly.

sample.speaker: Jingran
sample.text: Right, let's skip the chit‑chat. We're all hunting the same soulless fart, so why not team up?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: You've helped a great deal, and I've no reason to refuse. I need your intel. But you... what do you need from me?

sample.speaker: Jingran
sample.text: You get right to it, huh? Love it. I want to stick with you because it's better odds for making sure Muyu doesn't get away again.

sample.speaker: Jingran
sample.text: I don't have any of your "noble" motives, just an old score to settle with that bastard.

scene.desc: The Land of Xuanfang is thrown into turmoil following an unexpected riot of out-of-control Autopuppets. As you investigate, you uncover the mastermind behind the scheme—a mysterious Artisan who covets the Sentinel's technology. In the culmination of the event, this figure commands the rogue Autopuppets to launch an assault on Xuanfang Hold.

With the crisis behind you, Liangyu seems to have something to discuss. Go find out what it is when you have a moment. You may soon be seeing that Nethermancer who worked alongside you at the Manifold Sanctum.

The Waking Moon Festival is drawing near in the Land of Xuanfang, yet rumors that "the Hold is doomed to fall" have begun to spread throughout the city. To find the Sentinel who has long been absent, you decide to head to where Hsin's presence was last felt—the Manifold Sanctum.

voiceline.title: About Qingxiao
voiceline.text: There's an old story. A girl went looking for a Transcendent in the mountains, panicked when she ran into Tacet Discords, and fell off a cliff. At the last second, she was saved by a flying sword. That girl? That was my Shifu's old lady. I heard that story a thousand times as a kid. Honestly? Never believed a word of it. Until I saw someone flying across the sky on a blade... There aren't any divinities in Xuanfang, but there is the Xuan Paragon.

voiceline.title: About Jingran
voiceline.text: Years ago, his master crossed paths with me and casually asked for a divination before venturing into a Mirage Realm. I know only a little of the art, but I obliged regardless... It was an ill omen. Yet he simply grinned and went on. Later, this young man took up his master's mantle, the smile on his face even more defiant. Even if the road ahead is treacherous and life is fleeting, to live unburdened and unbound... I suppose that, too, is a life well lived.

mention.title: Song of the Heart Sword
mention.text: Rover, Paragon Qingxiao...
mention.source: Jingran brings up Qingxiao in “Song of the Heart Sword”

mention.title: Song of the Heart Sword
mention.text: The wound was fatal. It must have been the strike Jingran landed earlier.
mention.source: Qingxiao brings up Jingran in “Song of the Heart Sword”

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: Sanhua.

sample.speaker: Sanhua
sample.text: Yes, Madam Magistrate.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: I will be going on a temporary leave. During my absence, please help me handle my responsibilities in Jinzhou.

sample.speaker: Sanhua
sample.text: Understood. Should I continue protecting that Rover?

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: No need. Both Changli and I will be away, and there'll be more paperwork for you to handle.

sample.speaker: Sanhua
sample.text: Is Lady Changli leaving for the capital?

scene.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

voiceline.title: About Sanhua
voiceline.text: Amidst my busy days, meals can easily slip my mind. Before I knew it, it would be well past the time for another meal. But like a blessing, Sanhua would always appear with a plate of delicious Loong Buns, filled with exactly what I was craving. I am in awe… How does she know every time?

voiceline.title: About Jinhsi
voiceline.text: Lately, my lady prefers to wake up earlier, so I've been waking her up on time every day… Huh? She sometimes prefer to stay in bed a bit longer?! Is that what she told you? What else did she say? Please, do tell me in detail.

mention.title: Thoughts: I
mention.text: Other than my lady Jinhsi, you are the only person who looks so clear and true.
mention.source: Sanhua's voice line “Thoughts: I”

mention.title: Sanhua's Hobby
mention.text: Occasionally I would recite it for my lady Jinhsi, but she always started to grow sleepy after a while...
mention.source: Sanhua's voice line “Sanhua's Hobby”

mention.title: Self-Introduction
mention.text: I am Sanhua, the bodyguard of Magistrate Jinhsi.
mention.source: Sanhua's voice line “Self-Introduction”

mention.title: The Magistrate's Bodyguard
mention.text: Sanhua is always seen standing silently behind Jinhsi, maintaining an adequate distance. Although the majority of voices opposing Jinhsi have already subsided, there are still a handful of individuals who would attempt to challenge her authority.
mention.source: Sanhua's character story “The Magistrate's Bodyguard”

mention.title: Lingering Coldness
mention.text: So when she was jostled awake from another nightmare and noticed the presence of light, she immediately realized that it must be Jinhsi still working on her documents. Jinhsi pondered for a moment, then offered a mischievous smile, "If you want to help, just stay and chat with me for a while.
mention.source: Sanhua's character story “Lingering Coldness”

mention.title: Thawing Frost
mention.text: Jinhsi has shown Sanhua the power of rebirth in destruction. Jinhsi...
mention.source: Sanhua's character story “Thawing Frost”

mention.title: Clashing Blades
mention.text: Sanhua, you can place more trust in Rover and me.
mention.source: Jinhsi brings up Sanhua in “Clashing Blades” (2×)

mention.title: The Wind Before the Storm
mention.text: Please forgive Sanhua. I truly did not share my whereabouts with her.
mention.source: Jinhsi brings up Sanhua in “The Wind Before the Storm”

mention.title: The One that Impresses
mention.text: Rover, do you know the whereabouts of Sanhua, Ms. Taoqi, and General Jiyan?
mention.source: Jinhsi brings up Sanhua in “The One that Impresses”

mention.title: First Resonance
mention.text: Our Magistrate's birth name was Hsi. She took on the name Jinhsi when she became the Magistrate of Jinzhou.
mention.source: Sanhua brings up Jinhsi in “First Resonance”

mention.title: A Brief Respite
mention.text: I don't have a plan yet. I will probably continue enjoying the Moonlit Fair, just as Madam Jinhsi hoped. Perhaps the tasks on my to-do list aren't as urgent as they seem.
mention.source: Sanhua brings up Jinhsi in “A Brief Respite” (7×)

dialogue.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

sample.speaker: Taoqi
sample.text: I'm afraid... We're already running out of time.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: Report the situation, please.

sample.speaker: Taoqi
sample.text: Madam Magistrate, the barrier has been fully repaired and we have evacuated all residents. We've successfully minimized the damage.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: Well done, Director Taoqi.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: Indeed, it's been a while, Rover.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: It's been going according to plan, if I may say so. I was made aware of this in advance, and planned out our defense beforehand.

voiceline.title: About Taoqi
voiceline.text: Taoqi is able to breeze through mountains of workload with ease, despite her frequent yawns. Her efficiency is truly remarkable.

voiceline.title: About Jinhsi
voiceline.text: People think Lady Jinhsi is too young to lead, but I don't see the problem. Her young age may be seen as a disadvantage, but it's also her greatest strength. As we work on moving Jinzhou forward, she will go further and accomplish more than any of us can imagine.

mention.title: Her Wish-granting Magic
mention.text: "Dear Magistrate, I'm worried about Tacet Discords infiltrating our city."—Taoqi, director of the Defense Division, was then tasked with fortifying the city defense walls.
mention.source: Jinhsi's character story “Her Wish-granting Magic”

mention.title: About Sanhua
mention.text: Where on earth did Lady Jinhsi find herself such an incredible bodyguard?
mention.source: Taoqi's voice line “About Sanhua”

mention.title: Grand Warstorm
mention.text: Well done, Director Taoqi.
mention.source: Jinhsi brings up Taoqi in “Grand Warstorm”

mention.title: The One that Impresses
mention.text: Rover, do you know the whereabouts of Sanhua, Ms. Taoqi, and General Jiyan?
mention.source: Jinhsi brings up Taoqi in “The One that Impresses”

dialogue.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: May victory prevail the lasting night. I pray for your safe return.

sample.speaker: Jiyan
sample.text: ...Thank you for your trust, Madam Magistrate.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: No need for that, General. We've always shared the same goal, you and I.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: Attention, all units. Do everything you can to assist. You are authorized to use the Disruptor.

sample.speaker: Jiyan
sample.text: Target, the Norfall Barrens.

sample.speaker: Jiyan
sample.text: We... ate it.

sample.speaker: Jiyan
sample.text: All of us.

sample.speaker: Jiyan
sample.text: Sorry, I have to hold this to speak.

scene.desc: The previous puzzle's answers has been revealed, but it only leads to another one. With a storm on the horizon, you follow the Magistrate's advice and search for clues about "the Black Shores".

scene.quest: Where Stars Cascade Down · event story

voiceline.title: About Jiyan
voiceline.text: "Qingloong rise, monsters gone"... Every child in Jinzhou knows this nursery rhyme by heart. My faith rests with Jiyan, for with his protection the Tacet Discords will never breach our borders.

voiceline.title: About Jinhsi
voiceline.text: The "battle" Magistrate Jinhsi has been taking on may prove more complicated than our situation in the borderlands: stipulating rules, overseeing trade, ensuring the well-being of the people, and managing the city's functioning all demand her coordination and judgement. Every time I return to Jinzhou, I can feel the city's vibrancy and enthusiasm, all thanks to her meticulous governance.

mention.title: Clashing Blades
mention.text: I suppose so. General Jiyan is currently battling another TD Outbreak in the Norfall Barrens, which will also serve as our frontline against the Threnodian.
mention.source: Jinhsi brings up Jiyan in “Clashing Blades” (2×)

mention.title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
mention.text: Then it is settled. I will speak with General Jiyan and arrange for your temporary transfer to the Xuanfang Ministry of War.
mention.source: Jinhsi brings up Jiyan in “Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled”

mention.title: The One that Impresses
mention.text: Rover, do you know the whereabouts of Sanhua, Ms. Taoqi, and General Jiyan?
mention.source: Jinhsi brings up Jiyan in “The One that Impresses”

dialogue.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Wait... Are you...?

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: Please forgive Sanhua. I truly did not share my whereabouts with her.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: It's nothing. Just some scratches. Compared to what I've gained from this trip, this is merely a small jest from That One.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: My deepest apologies for not welcoming you properly, Miss Suisui. And apologies that your first visit to Jinzhou is under such circumstances.

sample.speaker: Suisui
sample.text: ...Well. Since Ms. Sanhua was telling the truth, I suppose I should apologize for my earlier rudeness. I came all the way to Jinzhou to see my sister, only to be told she's gone missing. I hope you can understand how that feels.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: I do. And I understand the urgency of the matter. Now that Rover is here, I'll brief you both directly.

dialogue.desc: The Land of Xuanfang is thrown into turmoil following an unexpected riot of out-of-control Autopuppets. As you investigate, you uncover the mastermind behind the scheme—a mysterious Artisan who covets the Sentinel's technology. In the culmination of the event, this figure commands the rogue Autopuppets to launch an assault on Xuanfang Hold.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: Rover, Yangyang. Glad to see you both safe...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I had a feeling it was you.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: Hehe. I had planned to wait until Changli returned from Mingting, but I found myself growing a bit restless.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: I've already spoken with Commander Qiuhong regarding the current situation in Xuanfang Hold. Rover, I assume you intend to stay in the region to search for Sentinel Hsin?

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: And you, Yangyang? What is your plan?

dialogue.desc: According to the Sentinel's hints, three Flare Stones must be activated, and the Flare Crests be put out to remove the chains on them that are made of special Flare Crests.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: The Sentinel is telling us... We need to find the three Flare Stones corresponding to the Flare Crest, then we will be able to lift the confinement set by the Fractsidus.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: But I'm not seeing any Flare Stones. Or any kind of entrance to another chamber.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: There seems to be something underwater. Let's start with the Chronosorter here.

dialogue.desc: Jinhsi has gone missing, and you just had an enigmatic dream.... That Wayfinder at the ferry may hold answers to these mysteries.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Changli...

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: Those Artificers are nothing to worry about. Rover, don't worry. Changli has her plans.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: I don't believe we will run into more ambushes on the way.

dialogue.summary: Changli tells you that she has successfully fulfilled her mission to bring you to Jinhsi and chooses to stay behind to handle the troublesome Fractsidus.

dialogue.desc: KU-Lolo has a new idea to turn your fondest memories into unique Cube souvernirs in the Second Coming of Solaris! Head on over to the Memory Travelogue event, collect memories with the Cubes, and turn them in to KU-Lolo!

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: Allow me to formally introduce myself. I am Jinhsi. It brings me great joy to see you, Rover.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Hello.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I hope I'm not talking to another projection.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: To show up as a projection again would be ill-mannered of me. Please rest assured, it is a real human in the flesh you're speaking to. Despite Huanglong's advanced technology, such a realistic projection is still impossible.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: Or perhaps you would like to verify it?

dialogue.desc: At Lumi's invitation, you come to an unending party...

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: But in one of the rounds, I confess I may have gotten a little reckless...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Don't worry, Jinhsi. A game at a party is meant to be fun.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: You're right. I do have a habit of overthinking.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Don't forget to breathe, Magistrate. Oh and, I'm looking forward to seeing you back in Jinzhou someday.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: Very well, I'll be waiting.

dialogue.desc: You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: Jinzhou is in the midst of a bustling festival, and if all the key leaders are trapped within this Sonoro Sphere, I must consider whether our emergency plan remains operaitonal.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Don't worry, those outside won't be affected.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: If that's the case... No, while Jinzhou may be safe for now, the cake crisis we face still demands our attention.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: No need for such formality. You are both the distinguished guest and savior of Jinzhou, Rover. I will always do my utmost to aid you.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: Once the crisis is over, perhaps we can take a stroll together?

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: Winter shall come to pass, and the spring thaw will bring all things back to life. Perhaps that is the moral of the play.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Your goddess cameo in the final scene was spectacular.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: Because you helped me rehearse. Would you like to have a stroll with me later?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Keep your guard up. I have something to tell you.

sample.speaker: Jiyan
sample.text: We... ate it.

sample.speaker: Jiyan
sample.text: All of us.

sample.speaker: Jiyan
sample.text: Sorry, I have to hold this to speak.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: What about Changli...

scene.desc: Amidst a ripple of Reverberations, you hear the call... As you unravel your past, a new path unfolds before you, beckoning from the unknown.
Amidst a ripple of Reverberations, you hear the call... As you unravel your past, a new path unfolds before you, beckoning from the unknown.

As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.
Time resumes and the snow clears. Mt. Firmament emerges from its long seclusion, ready to embrace its revival.
It is the deity that commands time. It is the deity that bestows blessings. Now is your time to confront Sentinel Jué.
Jinhsi has gone missing, and you just had an enigmatic dream.... That Wayfinder at the ferry may hold answers to these mysteries.

According to Xinyi, Hongzhen's Mayor, Jinhsi has gone off to Truthseeker's Pass, or the Court of Savantae Ruins. The Cipher Key stored in the heart of Truthseeker's Pass is a precondition to opening Mianloong Chamber and the audience with Jué, the Sentinel.

As the preparation for the Moonlit Fair is nearly complete, the whole venue exudes a vibe of joy. At this point, Jinhsi, the much anticipated Magistrate of Jinzhou shows up... Unlock a new Companion after completing this quest.

scene.quest: Where Stars Cascade Down · event story

voiceline.title: About Rover
voiceline.text: I can feel it in my heart that we both have something we'll fiercely defend, a cause worth fighting for... And we won't back down, no matter what it takes.

mention.title: Her Long-awaited Guest
mention.text: It brings me great joy to see you, Rover."
mention.source: Jinhsi's character story “Her Long-awaited Guest”

mention.title: The Wind Before the Storm
mention.text: (Yangyang hasn't written back yet. Yangyang, Chixia, Baizhi... and even Jinhsi. I wonder how everyone's doing?)
mention.source: Rover brings up Jinhsi in “The Wind Before the Storm” (5×)

mention.title: Rewinding Raindrops
mention.text: Jiyan the General, Jinhsi the Magistrate, and Jué, Jinzhou's Sentinel... Is there any kind of connection between them?
mention.source: Rover brings up Jinhsi in “Rewinding Raindrops”

mention.title: Dreamweaver's Ascent
mention.text: Jinhsi said she'll go search for the Sentinel and update me on its whereabouts.
mention.source: Rover brings up Jinhsi in “Dreamweaver's Ascent”

mention.title: Road of Pilgrimage
mention.text: Jinhsi, so far, everything we know about the Sentinel is still just speculation.
mention.source: Rover brings up Jinhsi in “Road of Pilgrimage”

mention.title: The Commander of Time
mention.text: ...If I open it, Jinhsi is bound to face you in the ultimate battle.
mention.source: Rover brings up Jinhsi in “The Commander of Time”

mention.title: To Mt. Firmament
mention.text: Did Xinyi and Jinhsi know each other?
mention.source: Rover brings up Jinhsi in “To Mt. Firmament”

mention.title: What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing
mention.text: (He said she "once again resonated with the Sentinel," was that really a Second Resonance Awakening? Sentinel Jué had a trial with Jinhsi, but my permission was needed to transfer the Sentinel's power...)
mention.source: Rover brings up Jinhsi in “What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing”

mention.title: The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier
mention.text: (That's exactly what happened with Jinhsi. Could Imperator be trying to restore Their power through a Second Awakening?)
mention.source: Rover brings up Jinhsi in “The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier”

dialogue.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

sample.speaker: Jiyan
sample.text: I'll leave it to the professional to explain in details.

sample.speaker: Mortefi
sample.text: Greetings, General Jiyan, Rover.

sample.speaker: Jiyan
sample.text: How's the preparation going on your side?

sample.speaker: Mortefi
sample.text: We've got good news and bad news. Good news is, we've established connection to the Disruptor and we're ready to go.

sample.speaker: Mortefi
sample.text: Bad news is, the Disruptor's electric capacitor is damaged.

sample.speaker: Mortefi
sample.text: Simply put, it's out of power.

sample.speaker: Mortefi
sample.text: It's someone you know. Baizhi. She specializes in Ecoacoustic research, and the Sonoro Sphere is her field of expertise.

sample.speaker: Jiyan
sample.text: Yes... Whatever you do, please keep it safe.

sample.speaker: Mortefi
sample.text: What now, you don't trust me?

sample.speaker: Jiyan
sample.text: I trust you as always, Mortefi. But this sample... It means a lot to me.

sample.speaker: Mortefi
sample.text: Rest assured. You should know how careful we are with our samples... Especially such a valuable one.

sample.speaker: Jiyan
sample.text: This should be our wake-up call. The Waveworn Phenomena is more complicated than we thought.

sample.speaker: Mortefi
sample.text: I don't want to spoil your fun, but I'm afraid we need to suspend the race for now.

sample.speaker: Jiyan
sample.text: Can you fill us in on the data?

sample.speaker: Mortefi
sample.text: I checked the monitoring data as you asked, and I found unusual fluctuations near the upper waters to the north.

sample.speaker: Jiyan
sample.text: Why didn't the nearest Beacon pick up on this anomaly?

sample.speaker: Mortefi
sample.text: The Resonance Beacon is functioning properly, but we still don't know why it didn't issue a warning this time. I will investigate this further at a later time.

sample.speaker: Mortefi
sample.text: Animals are often the first to detect signs of danger.

voiceline.title: About Mortefi
voiceline.text: Others often perceive Mortefi as arrogant and unapproachable, but, in fact, he is not that hard to talk to. Remember to be direct with him, as trying to be overly polite and subtle may only lead to misunderstandings.

voiceline.title: About Jiyan
voiceline.text: It was Jiyan who rescued me from the wilderness and referred me to the Academy, and I've been thankful for that... I have solved a lot of problems for him in return, of course. For example, all the Midnight Rangers currently use a one-piece medical kit of my design.

mention.title: Grand Warstorm
mention.text: Greetings, General Jiyan, Rover.
mention.source: Mortefi brings up Jiyan in “Grand Warstorm”

mention.title: Riverside Games (Quest)
mention.text: The lack of perceivable warning signs typically suggests unknown risks. Jiyan, Rover, stay safe.
mention.source: Mortefi brings up Jiyan in “Riverside Games (Quest)” (2×)

mention.title: Pastures like old times
mention.text: By the way, the Riverside Games people were looking for you, Jiyan. Probably wanted to discuss holding the event again at a later date.
mention.source: Mortefi brings up Jiyan in “Pastures like old times”

mention.title: Grand Warstorm
mention.text: Mortefi, it's time!
mention.source: Jiyan brings up Mortefi in “Grand Warstorm”

mention.title: Pastures like old times
mention.text: I trust you as always, Mortefi. But this sample... It means a lot to me.
mention.source: Jiyan brings up Mortefi in “Pastures like old times” (2×)

mention.title: Replica of Past Days
mention.text: According to Mortefi's speculation, this Sonoro Sphere was resonating with the Riverside Games' frequencies, and it led to the abnormal fluctuations we detected earlier.
mention.source: Jiyan brings up Mortefi in “Replica of Past Days”

dialogue.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

sample.speaker: Jiyan
sample.text: Please update me on the situation in Jinzhou city.

sample.speaker: Taoqi
sample.text: Under Madam Magistrate's command, the barrier has been activated and citizens are being evacuated to the safe zone.

sample.speaker: Taoqi
sample.text: Huaxu Academy and Ministry of Development are on standby for further instructions. Bazhi is overseeing operations at the Academy while Mortefi has arrived at the Ministry. Rest assured, we are all safe in the city.

sample.speaker: Taoqi
sample.text: And that Rover... He/She is heading over to meet you. Yangyang is coming with him/her.

sample.speaker: Jiyan
sample.text: I see. We have successfully contained the Outbreak here at the base.

sample.speaker: Jiyan
sample.text: I will go pick them up as soon as possible.

voiceline.title: About Taoqi
voiceline.text: Taoqi... Though our views on loose management don't always align, I am able to focus on the front lines without any worries, thanks to her effective leadership in maintaining Jinzhou's fortifications.

voiceline.title: About Jiyan
voiceline.text: General Jiyan's schedule is always so impossibly tight... He seems to keep finding more issues to take care of, like a devoted parent who never allows himself any rest. Maybe it's his doctor instincts, always putting others first. I really hope he can take some time off for his own well-being.

mention.title: Grand Warstorm
mention.text: I've informed General Jiyan that you're heading to his place. He will be meeting up with you soon.
mention.source: Taoqi brings up Jiyan in “Grand Warstorm”

mention.title: Grand Warstorm
mention.text: Madam Magistrate and Taoqi have informed me of your willingness to assist us. Thank you for lending u a hand.
mention.source: Jiyan brings up Taoqi in “Grand Warstorm”

dialogue.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

sample.speaker: Jiyan
sample.text: ...Begone!

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: We did it!

sample.speaker: Jiyan
sample.text: The Thundering Mephis is a blend of countless fallen soldiers' Reverberations.

sample.speaker: Jiyan
sample.text: As long as more soldiers are still dying here, it will always return. Not to mention...

sample.speaker: Jiyan
sample.text: Countless souls of our brave soldiers remain trapped in this rain, to this day.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: ...General.

scene.desc: As the tides of danger retreat, Jinzhou appears tranquil and vibrant. But beyond its borders lies a fierce and desperate battleground.
The previous puzzle's answers has been revealed, but it only leads to another one. With a storm on the horizon, you follow the Magistrate's advice and search for clues about "the Black Shores".

voiceline.title: About Yangyang
voiceline.text: She can perceive minute changes in the surroundings from the Streams, but there is a limit to the amount of information a single person can take in. Excessive use of this ability might add to her burden, and I hope she won't strain herself.

voiceline.title: About Jiyan
voiceline.text: On the dangerous frontiers where we suffered immense losses, it was General Jiyan who stepped up to protect everyone, making all the tough decisions to ensure our safety. As the backbone of the Midnight Rangers, he has led us to countless victories as our Qingloong. The weight on his shoulders is beyond our imagination.

mention.title: Echoing Marche
mention.text: An imposing warrior wielding the power of a Qingloong... The Qingloong is the Midnight Rangers' emblem. It's also the symbol of General Jiyan, the leader of all Midnight Rangers.
mention.source: Yangyang brings up Jiyan in “Echoing Marche” (4×)

mention.title: Grand Warstorm
mention.text: The Tacet Field Director Taoqi mentioned should be right up ahead. We must pass through it to reach our base and find General Jiyan.
mention.source: Yangyang brings up Jiyan in “Grand Warstorm” (3×)

mention.title: A New Companion
mention.text: General Jiyan and Rover later told me it was this little thing coming out of Rover's body. It was blocking, or even "consuming" the overflow of Threnodian power.
mention.source: Yangyang brings up Jiyan in “A New Companion”

mention.title: Grand Warstorm
mention.text: And I'll join Rover, Yangyang, and Jianxin to create an opening for our main forces to take down the Threnodian.
mention.source: Jiyan brings up Yangyang in “Grand Warstorm” (7×)

dialogue.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

sample.speaker: Baizhi
sample.text: I'll send you the coordinates of the Disruptor and its backup energy port. We wish you the best of luck.

sample.speaker: Jiyan
sample.text: I trust we all understand the situation now.

sample.speaker: Jiyan
sample.text: Rover, Yangyang, please go secure the Disruptor and fix its backup energy outlet.

sample.speaker: Jiyan
sample.text: Jianxin, please stay and guard the base. I'll draw those Tacet Discords away.

sample.speaker: Jiyan
sample.text: Let's get moving.

scene.desc: The previous puzzle's answers has been revealed, but it only leads to another one. With a storm on the horizon, you follow the Magistrate's advice and search for clues about "the Black Shores".

voiceline.title: About Baizhi
voiceline.text: Many stumble through life directionless, without ever finding a purpose. Baizhi is among the rare few who have found their calling, and she is willing to give up anything for the truth she pursues.

scene.desc: As the tides of danger retreat, Jinzhou appears tranquil and vibrant. But beyond its borders lies a fierce and desperate battleground.
The previous puzzle's answers has been revealed, but it only leads to another one. With a storm on the horizon, you follow the Magistrate's advice and search for clues about "the Black Shores".
As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

voiceline.title: About Chixia
voiceline.text: That energetic and passionate Patroller? Yes, I have heard of her. She has been devoting her time to protecting the dreams of children in Jinzhou.

mention.title: First Resonance
mention.text: There's been TD outbreaks every year, but we can always trust General Jiyan, Madam Magistrate, and our Sentinel to have our backs! We're not ones to mess with!
mention.source: Chixia brings up Jiyan in “First Resonance” (2×)

mention.title: Grand Warstorm
mention.text: It's a pre-recorded broadcast message. Our Magistrate saw this coming, and she had General Jiyan devise an emergency plan a long time ago.
mention.source: Chixia brings up Jiyan in “Grand Warstorm”

mention.title: Rewinding Raindrops
mention.text: Connection? ...No idea, but I did hear General Jiyan used to be a military doctor...
mention.source: Chixia brings up Jiyan in “Rewinding Raindrops”

mention.title: A New Companion
mention.text: Well, both General Jiyan and Baizhi have confirmed it. No way they're lying.
mention.source: Chixia brings up Jiyan in “A New Companion”

scene.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

voiceline.title: About Jiyan
voiceline.text: In Jinzhou, the liondance tradition started as a way to celebrate victories in battle. And nowadays, we always perform before our soldiers go into battle—it's like a good luck charm and morale booster. Our Liondance Troupe has been traveling between military camps in various regions to deliver performances. I'll never forget my first time leading a pre-battle show. I was nervous and messed up here and there, but General Jiyan didn't get mad at me. He actually encouraged me a lot. He isn't as strict as he seems in public, is he? No wonder the soldiers admire him so much... He's really a strong and kind person.

scene.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

voiceline.title: About Jianxin
voiceline.text: Liondance is a fusion of martial arts and dance. It originated from traditional boxing and martial arts in Huanglong, emphasizing swift footwork and powerful postures. Miss Jianxin practices Fengyiquan, a contrasting style to liondance, but just as impressive. I once saw her effortlessly take down seven men with a single punch! The Fengyiquan truly lives up to its reputation: conquering the unyielding with the yielding.

scene.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

voiceline.title: About Taoqi
voiceline.text: The Qixing Drum's sound echoes far and wide, and people say it scares evil spirits and beasts away. I never thought anyone could sleep through that loud banging, but then I met this pink-haired lady called Taoqi... Turns out she's the Chief Officer of border defense at the Ministry of Development. With all the defenses in Jinzhou, I'd be tired too... Maybe she is just too exhausted from work? I hope she can catch some good rest.

scene.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

voiceline.title: About Yuanwu
voiceline.text: Uncle Yuanwu keeps lots of street cats at his boxing gym. I often bring them fish I've caught as thank-yous for, let's say, helping me practice. I wonder if those cats are picking up on his moves? Maybe I can draw some inspiration from that. By the way, Uncle Yuanwu's dried fish is super delicious!

voiceline.title: About Lingyang
voiceline.text: Lingyang often visits my gym to play with Mimi just outside the front doors, always carrying a couple of fresh tetras as treats. I guess it might be his thank-you to Mimi for all the agility training they had done together. He sure is a thoughtful young man.

scene.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

voiceline.title: About Mortefi
voiceline.text: Don't let Mr. Mortefi's permanent 'Do-Not-Disturb' face fool you, he's actually a big kid at heart. He's the genius behind all those fun toys for Jinzhou's children, and he even created some sick merch for our Liondance Troupe! So when you need his help, don't hesitate to tell him—just do it politely and he'll surely lend you a hand!

scene.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

voiceline.title: About Yangyang
voiceline.text: I love Yangyang's singing! I've been trying to convince her to sing at our theater, but she keeps turning me down.... Says she's embarrassed to sing in front of a crowd. I don't get it! It's just like liondancing—once you take that first step, the rest falls into place!

scene.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

voiceline.title: About Baizhi
voiceline.text: The Remnant Creature that hangs around Baizhi... It's called You'tan, right? I once thought it was my kind. Aw. I wish it really was…

sample.speaker: Aemeath
sample.text: Gotta run, Professor!

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: Rover, let's try to channel that enthusiasm into listening. Do come see me in my office after class, okay?

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: Assistant Nivora, if you would? Pick up from the Twilight Epoch's Unending Winter, please.

voiceline.title: About Luuk Herssen
voiceline.text: He's got just a few too many mysteries for a doctor... But as a colleague, his skills speak for themselves. And that's what I trust.

voiceline.title: About Lucilla
voiceline.text: The President of the Academy and a... savvy adult. Lucilla knows what she wants, and what others want from her. Unlike those pedantic academics, she understands when to put her foot down and when to give ground for the sake of Startorch. She's like the undercurrents flowing beneath the Academy's ice cap—calm, quiet, and always keeping things afloat.

mention.title: All That Sunlight Touches
mention.text: You were a Synchronist in the Academy once before. I'll speak with Lucilla about getting you piloting access.
mention.source: Luuk Herssen brings up Lucilla in “All That Sunlight Touches” (4×)

mention.title: Starlights from Yesterdays
mention.text: My conversation with Lucilla went well. She's on your side. Your showing during the Dark Side incident also helped speed up the Academy's internal review.
mention.source: Luuk Herssen brings up Lucilla in “Starlights from Yesterdays” (4×)

mention.title: The Star That Voyages Far
mention.text: All good on your end, golden ? Lucilla mentioned the Exostrider in the frostlands just moved. Please tell me that was you?
mention.source: Luuk Herssen brings up Lucilla in “The Star That Voyages Far” (2×)

mention.title: Ode to the Second Sunrise
mention.text: (Chuckles) You can relax. Professor Lucilla has already given you the clear. You're not a suspect.
mention.source: Luuk Herssen brings up Lucilla in “Ode to the Second Sunrise”

mention.title: The Wind Before the Storm
mention.text: Haha. Well, that depends on whether the Academy is willing to let me go. Somehow I doubt President Lucilla would say yes. She's already filled our schedules.
mention.source: Luuk Herssen brings up Lucilla in “The Wind Before the Storm”

mention.title: The Heartbeat of Life
mention.text: Let me guess, did Lucilla ask you to handle the cleanup? Or were you given some kind of unavoidable assignment?
mention.source: Luuk Herssen brings up Lucilla in “The Heartbeat of Life”

voiceline.title: About Sigrika
voiceline.text: She's just the cutest, isn't she? Pure, honest, trying so hard to carry the weight of the world on those tiny shoulders. Breaks my heart. But given my position, even a gentle pat on the cheek would likely only make her more anxious.

voiceline.title: About Lucilla
voiceline.text: President Lucilla's classes are so much fun. When she taught the history of Royan clothing, she even turned it into an impromptu styling workshop! But getting into her classes is almost impossible. Every time the course listings go up, I have to glue myself to the screen and click as fast as I can, or they'll be gone in seconds! And on the professor review forum, her page is just full of students complaining, "How can someone who teaches everything have classes that fill up in seconds?!"

mention.title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
mention.text: Precisely. It told Sigrika she would always return. To make that happen, it will have to issue a new riddle.
mention.source: Lucilla brings up Sigrika in “Gold Suspended in Shadows” (9×)

mention.title: Rabbit Reflected in Shades
mention.text: I have a general picture now. At the end of the Celebration, you and Sigrika entered the Dark Side to solve the final riddle, and encountered another "Sigrika."
mention.source: Lucilla brings up Sigrika in “Rabbit Reflected in Shades” (6×)

mention.title: Starlights from Yesterdays
mention.text: Ah. That's what's on your mind. Well, I have an update. Remember Sigrika's friend? The… somewhat lackadaisical one?
mention.source: Lucilla brings up Sigrika in “Starlights from Yesterdays”

mention.title: The Flaming Red from Tomorrow
mention.text: Huh? No reaction at all? That's odd. When Sigrika and the others ate theirs, they…
mention.source: Lucilla brings up Sigrika in “The Flaming Red from Tomorrow”

mention.title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
mention.text: Professor Lucilla said that no matter what happens, she believes I can face it. I'm not alone in this. With you, with her, with Dr. Luuk… none of us will let the Dark Side ruin the Academy.
mention.source: Sigrika brings up Lucilla in “Gold Suspended in Shadows” (3×)

mention.title: The Wind Before the Storm
mention.text: You'll get your chance! Besides, I heard President Lucilla say she wants to invite you back as a teaching assistant.
mention.source: Sigrika brings up Lucilla in “The Wind Before the Storm” (2×)

mention.title: At Dream's Edge
mention.text: President Lucilla, ever heard what they say about Night City?
mention.source: Sigrika brings up Lucilla in “At Dream's Edge”

mention.title: Sunny Season
mention.text: Before the New Solar Celebration, I also asked President Lucilla and Dr. Herssen. Neither of them gave me a straight answer.
mention.source: Sigrika brings up Lucilla in “Sunny Season”

voiceline.title: About Denia
voiceline.text: She's kept it hidden so well, for so long. That just makes me blame myself and my heart ache for her more.

mention.title: Starlights from Yesterdays
mention.text: She also asked me to tell you that she's run into the Fractsidus there, including the missing girl, Denia.
mention.source: Lucilla brings up Denia in “Starlights from Yesterdays”

sample.text: I'm sorry.

sample.speaker: Rebecca
sample.text: I get it.

sample.speaker: Lucy
sample.text: ...I'm sorry.

sample.speaker: Rebecca
sample.text: Lucy...

voiceline.title: About Rebecca
voiceline.text: She always saw me as a choom, as part of the crew. But in all our time together, I never once opened up to her. It wasn't until she was gone that I realized... just how much I left unsaid.

voiceline.title: About Lucy
voiceline.text: Lucy... Dunno where to even start. Known her a while now, but can't say I really get her, y'know? Far as her netrunnin' skills go, she's a freakin' code wizard, can't deny that. I guess... no matter what, Lucy's crew. That answer your question?

mention.title: Birthday Wishes
mention.text: Rebecca's been on my case for weeks 'bout a party.
mention.source: Lucy's voice line “Birthday Wishes”

mention.title: When the Sandevistan Hits
mention.text: Hot-headed members like Rebecca threw themselves at the killer, while Lucy took cover to strike with caution.
mention.source: Lucy's character story “When the Sandevistan Hits”

mention.title: My Moon My Man
mention.text: Rebecca switched to stronger cyber-arms and swore she'd never lose anyone else. Rebecca and Falco—the remains of a loyal crew—threw themselves into the line of fire just to keep him moving.
mention.source: Lucy's character story “My Moon My Man”

mention.title: So, Get Away
mention.text: Rebecca and David were gone.
mention.source: Lucy's character story “So, Get Away”

mention.title: Rebecca's Hobby
mention.text: Even Lucy the loner would stick around...
mention.source: Rebecca's voice line “Rebecca's Hobby”

mention.title: Self-Introduction
mention.text: Edgerunner from Night City, just like Lucy.
mention.source: Rebecca's voice line “Self-Introduction”

mention.text: Listen, those Nightmare TDs are targeting me. If this op goes critical, make sure you get Rebecca out... At least some of us should survive.
mention.source: Lucy brings up Rebecca in “At Dream's Edge” (8×)

mention.title: At Dream's Edge
mention.text: That's 'cause Lucy called. Warned me not to touch the door directly. Somethin' about contamination... You get the idea.
mention.source: Rebecca brings up Lucy in “At Dream's Edge” (14×)

sample.text: I'm fine... Just need a sec.

sample.text: The students you protected have been sent for treatment. They asked me to send their gratitude.

sample.speaker: Lucy
sample.text: ...Didn't do much.

voiceline.title: About Mornye
voiceline.text: "Tragedy did not extinguish her ideals. She works tirelessly to reach the stars with her own two hands." I mean, sh*t, you can feel the weight of these records just by reading them. If I hadn't met 'er myself, I'd call it a fairy tale. No one holds onto hope that tight... I respect her for it.

mention.title: At Dream's Edge
mention.text: ...But I can't crack the encryption solo. I'll wait to see if your Professor Mornye has any leads.
mention.source: Lucy brings up Mornye in “At Dream's Edge” (5×)

mention.title: At Dream's Edge
mention.text: While we can't fully decode your power, we can study and replicate the frequency signatures of Lucy and Rebecca's weapons, applying it to our own armaments.
mention.source: Mornye brings up Lucy in “At Dream's Edge” (5×)
