sample.text: I'm Lynae. Nice to meet you, Rebecca!

sample.speaker: Lucy
sample.text: Lucy. We're tyin' up some loose ends here. Try to stay outta your hair.

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: Sure, make yourselves at home!

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: By the way, I haven't seen you around before... New students?

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: Ahaha, look at you, all conflicted. Fine, I won't pry.

sample.speaker: Lucy
sample.text: Prolly a good call.

voiceline.title: About Lynae
voiceline.text: When my Resonance Ability awakened, I hacked Lynae. Not on purpose, but I did see the memories she'd locked away. Hard to reconcile the weight of her past with that big, bright smile. Can't say we're all that different, her and I. I'm just glad she's finally free.

mention.title: At Dream's Edge
mention.text: Lynae... right? She's an interesting variable.
mention.source: Lucy brings up Lynae in “At Dream's Edge”

scene.desc: A Somnoire door has suddenly appeared in the Academy. Mornye has asked for your help investigating it.

voiceline.title: About Lucilla
voiceline.text: We've never crossed paths, but her rep's solid. Hear she did a lot of heavy lifting with the Somnoire situation. The approachable Madam President, former editor for the Pioneer Association... Official file reads like a press release though. Bet the real story's a helluva lot more interesting. Wouldn't mind a face-to-face, see the woman behind the curtain.

mention.title: At Dream's Edge
mention.text: ...A parting gift from Lucilla. I can't take it with me. It's yours now.
mention.source: Lucy brings up Lucilla in “At Dream's Edge”

scene.desc: A Somnoire door has suddenly appeared in the Academy. Mornye has asked for your help investigating it.

voiceline.title: About Sigrika
voiceline.text: Sigrika is an interesting girl. Has a way of puttin' people at ease. But what gets me are the runes she uses. What are they? They seem to follow a unique operational logic... some kind of unparsed assembly language? What's the transmission method...?

dialogue.desc: A Somnoire door has suddenly appeared in the Academy. Mornye has asked for your help investigating it.

sample.speaker: Lucy
sample.text: ...A train? What's a Night City train doing behind a door?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Night City?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: You don't have to explain if you don't want to.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: The Somnoire is where dreams gather. It's a place where anything can happen.

sample.speaker: Lucy
sample.text: Anything? Sure, makes sense...

mention.title: So, Get Away
mention.text: On the day she left the Somnoire, Lucy stopped at the threshold of the gateway and turned to Rover.
mention.source: Lucy's character story “So, Get Away”

mention.title: At Dream's Edge
mention.text: Lucy is linked to that Nightmare Tacet Discord somehow. Figuring it out might be our ticket to stopping the spread.
mention.source: Rover brings up Lucy in “At Dream's Edge” (7×)

voiceline.title: About Jianxin
voiceline.text: When I am out delivering packages, I can't always find a place to stay, so sometimes I rest outdoors. Once, I woke up to see Miss Jianxin napping on a boulder on the cliff edge! She seemed... so light, like a feather...

voiceline.title: About Chixia
voiceline.text: Ma Xiao...oops, I mean Chixia, hehe! Ahem, Patroller Chixia's packages are mostly snacks and hero play merchs. She was so stoked last time she got one, she practically bounced out of the room!

voiceline.title: About Youhu
voiceline.text: Youhu's packages always come with insurance, full of pricey antiques. I don't know much about these stuff, but the way she handles them, you can tell they're her treasures.

voiceline.title: About Baizhi
voiceline.text: Researcher Baizhi's packages weigh a ton! Mostly stacks of books, thick ones, and a bunch of other weird stuff. Said those are for research purposes...

scene.desc: A mysterious request, a lost delivery, an opening gateway... In a realm where dreams and nightmares intertwine, a massive shadow looms around you. It casts a darkness over reality, opening the gateways to dreams across Jinzhou. It asks you, if beauty is fleeting and salvation is futile, why not remain in a dream...

voiceline.title: About Zhezhi
voiceline.text: Actually, I rarely get to meet Miss Zhezhi in person… She's a night owl, barely out during the day. So I've been dropping her paints and paper at her door.

scene.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

scene.quest: All Out! Towards the Peaks of Prestige (Quest)
scene.desc: A strange message draws your attention to a mysterious Echo dueling game called Peaks of Prestige. "Countless Echoes. Limiteless tactics. You could be the next Apex Duelist!"

voiceline.title: About Brant
voiceline.text: Many Gladiators of the Blue Furies come from the Troupe of Fools. I remember once, at Cliffside Harbor, I saw their captain leap off the deck just to hug his crew. They chattered on for a while, and then suddenly broke into song...!

dialogue.desc: Cartethyia vanished in the Inverted Tower. Following the traces she left behind, you arrive at Septimont, one of Rinascita's city-states, steeped in glory and famed for its gladiatorial tradition. The city is hosting the Great Agon—a grand championship held once every four years. Yet beneath the grandeur, shadows stir. Multiple factions move in secret, each with their hidden agenda. To uncover the truth, you form a temporary alliance with Contender Lupa. Together, you set your sights on the championship...

sample.speaker: Lupa
sample.text: We team up and fight together in the finals?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (That's Cartethyia's frequency... but how?)

sample.speaker: Lupa
sample.text: Huh? Rover, is that your way of saying yes?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I'm sorry. Lupa, have you ever met a Ragunnesi girl by the name of Cartethyia?

sample.speaker: Lupa
sample.text: Cartethyia... No, never heard of her. What's going on with her?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: She's missing. I'm looking for her.

dialogue.summary: To avoid lingering too long, Lupa laughs and takes your hand, pulling you away from the arena. After coming to Septimont, you learn from Lupa just how important the arena is to the city.

dialogue.desc: You and Lupa follow the Lioness of Glory to the burial ground of the heroes and into a world of growing uncertainty. At the same time, you start to wonder if Lupa, your companion on this journey, is friend or foe. Cheers sound distorted. Fate has been woven. You have a choice to make, and your choice will determine how the story ends.

sample.speaker: Lupa
sample.text: But... she is still an Echo and can't talk.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (These sounds...)

sample.speaker: Lupa
sample.text: What is it? Did you feel something just now?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I only heard strange sounds. Tell me, what direction did the Lioness just look toward?

sample.speaker: Lupa
sample.text: The Vale of Glory.

sample.speaker: Lupa
sample.text: It's where all heroes, blessed by the glory forged in iron and fire, find their rest.

dialogue.summary: The Lioness of Glory Arsinosa gives you and Lupa her blessing. You begin to piece together everything you've learned about Septimont, Lupa, Cartethyia, Mya, the Dark Tide, and Arsinosa.

dialogue.desc: Return to Forever Fest to see which companions have shown up today, and see if Lumi has uncovered something new.

sample.speaker: Lupa
sample.text: You're finally here, Warrior!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Come on! You're the one who was a no-show yesterday.

sample.speaker: Lupa
sample.text: Haha! I wanted to come sooner, but I had a match I couldn't back out of.

sample.speaker: Lupa
sample.text: A total knockout, of course!

sample.speaker: Lupa
sample.text: As long as you're rooting for me, losing isn't even an option.

sample.speaker: Lupa
sample.text: The world's full of fights waiting for us! And with a partner like you, we're unstoppable!

sample.speaker: Lupa
sample.text: I know! But it's so funny that I just had to share!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Where is Chimera?

sample.speaker: Galbrena
sample.text: It's right here.

sample.speaker: Galbrena
sample.text: Lupa gave me a piece of that candy. I just shoved it into Chimera's mouth.

sample.speaker: Galbrena
sample.text: The effect is lingering, so it'll be stuck in this shape for a while.

sample.speaker: Lupa
sample.text: So, Warrior! Where are you heading next?

dialogue.quest: Where Stars Cascade Down · event story

sample.speaker: Lupa
sample.text: …The incomplete form of the Threnodian of War? So you stopped it from hatching, but its vanguards still gave you and that Jinzhou general a right proper fight, hmm...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Yeah. But without Abby's help, we wouldn't have been able to hold the line and defeat it.

sample.speaker: Lupa
sample.text: Huh, if I'd been there, I'd have fought alongside you. Threnodian or anything else.

sample.speaker: Lupa
sample.text: The Carnevale in Ragunna…? I heard you claimed the title of Laureate there, but I never knew the full story.

sample.speaker: Lupa
sample.text: What the Fractsidus did to Rinascita is unforgivable. One day, they'll pay for that. I'll make sure of it.

sample.speaker: Lupa
sample.text: What incredible stories! Each of these battles shines with its own glory...

scene.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

scene.quest: All Out! Towards the Peaks of Prestige (Quest)
scene.desc: A strange message draws your attention to a mysterious Echo dueling game called Peaks of Prestige. "Countless Echoes. Limiteless tactics. You could be the next Apex Duelist!"

mention.title: Big Little Things
mention.text: She whisked Rover and Cartethyia on a carefree whirlwind tour through Septimont. But as everything was settled and the tension finally eased, a faint, nagging worry began to stir again in Lupa's heart, a worry for Rover, her best teammate ever.
mention.source: Lupa's character story “Big Little Things”

mention.title: Shadow of Glory
mention.text: (That fleeting frequency... It was similar to the Threnodian's. Could it really be linked to the Dark Tide Lupa will bring forth in Septimont, as Phrolova said?)
mention.source: Rover brings up Lupa in “Shadow of Glory” (16×)

mention.title: Flames of Heart
mention.text: (In this Great Agon, Lupa is the protagonist. Years ago, it was Mya. Now, I'm seeing Mya's image flicker in and out throughout this journey.)
mention.source: Rover brings up Lupa in “Flames of Heart” (11×)

mention.title: Star Bouncing · event story
mention.text: Galbrena... and Lupa?
mention.source: Rover brings up Lupa in “Star Bouncing · event story”

sample.speaker: Aemeath
sample.text: The snow... It's so beautiful.

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: What a coincidence to run into you here, {PlayerName}. This is a pleasant surprise.

sample.speaker: Aemeath
sample.text: Oh… it's Dr. Luuk. When he's around, just pretend I'm not here. Otherwise, you look like a weirdo talking to thin air.

sample.speaker: Aemeath
sample.text: You should hide too, okay? This is our secret journey.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: You know him?

sample.speaker: Aemeath
sample.text: He's the school doctor. All the students know him. I didn't super well, but I do know that he's been in Lahai-Roi for a long time, and… you can trust him.

sample.speaker: Aemeath
sample.text: Pfft! Hahahahaha!

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: ...That last part? Who said that?

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: What I'm trying to say is I really don't know what happened! (But I do know who's responsible for this!)

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: Let me make this clear. (I'll keep telling the truth anyway.) This candy's effect is very serious... (And I know you're not going to go easy on me.)

scene.desc: Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.

After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

voiceline.title: About Aemeath
voiceline.text: That child who means so much to you... I do see you in her. So bullheaded up against fate itself. So decisive and brave it leaves one speechless. At moments when that upbeatness flickers, I can tell that bright smile is just a mask she puts on, but if that's what she wants others to see, I'll respect it.

mention.title: All That Sunlight Touches
mention.text: With the Reactor Core returned, all you need now is a little patience. Wait for the Exostrider to awaken. Then we can focus on how to use it to find Aemeath.
mention.source: Luuk Herssen brings up Aemeath in “All That Sunlight Touches” (7×)

mention.title: The Star That Voyages Far
mention.text: This "Aemeath" isn't exactly human, nor is she a Reverberation. She's closer to an Exoswarm, with only a trace of her original frequency remaining.
mention.source: Luuk Herssen brings up Aemeath in “The Star That Voyages Far” (2×)

mention.title: Starlights from Yesterdays
mention.text: Based on your intel, the Reactor Core has been returned. Ideally, we'd wait for the Exostrider to awaken before trying to help Aemeath or confront the Threnodian.
mention.source: Luuk Herssen brings up Aemeath in “Starlights from Yesterdays”

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: How to put this... I think you can have more faith in yourself, Sigrika.

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: Faith in myself...

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: You see, people can be more perceptive than you might realize, including those you care about. So try not to take everything to heart. Go a little easier on yourself.

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: Good or bad, true or false, these things have a way of coming to light. And as your friend Denia said, sometimes a little distraction is good for your health.

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: Yeah… I'll give it a try! Thank you, Dr. Herssen.

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: You're welcome. Again, don't push yourself too hard.

dialogue.desc: The New Solar Celebration is just around the corner. Yet, President Lucilla detects a mysterious frequency appearing in the Academy's Dark Side—one that does not belong to the Academy. You suspect it may be the "reward" once mentioned by the Grand Architect of the Fractsidus. Determined to uncover the truth behind this anomaly, you venture into the Dark Side alongside Sigrika, a student you encountered there...

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: I think that's the answer to the final riddle.

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: I'd say this calls for the special candy.

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: Are these... Rainbow Bean Pop Rocks?

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: With an improved formula. Not on the market yet.

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: So the one who makes these is—?

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: Shhh... Our little secret.

After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.
A Somnoire door has suddenly appeared in the Academy. Mornye has asked for your help investigating it.

voiceline.title: About Sigrika
voiceline.text: Sigrika... She shoulders a weight far too heavy for someone her age. Thankfully, there's candy to sweeten the gloom. She never hesitates to sample my newest candies. Her fearlessness has me impressed. Perhaps that curiosity of hers... is what finally lets her act her age.

voiceline.title: About Luuk Herssen
voiceline.text: After the New Solar Celebration incident, some students said we should make a banner for Dr. Luuk. It seems that whenever someone's feeling down, he's always there, checking on them, talking with them for as long as they need. They suggested things like "Startorch's Best Counselor" or "Best Doctor and Best Advisor." But if you ask me… I think I'd just write, "The One Who Always Has Candy."

mention.title: All That Sunlight Touches
mention.text: How to put this... I think you can have more faith in yourself, Sigrika.
mention.source: Luuk Herssen brings up Sigrika in “All That Sunlight Touches” (2×)

mention.title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
mention.text: Do you still remember what I told you last time, Sigrika?
mention.source: Luuk Herssen brings up Sigrika in “Gold Suspended in Shadows”

mention.title: Starlights from Yesterdays
mention.text: Candy? It's a new flavor. Sigrika and Lynae suggested it. Great for lifting spirits.
mention.source: Luuk Herssen brings up Sigrika in “Starlights from Yesterdays”

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: Upperclassman Lynae! You're back! I'm so glad! And this is… huh?

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: You're the upperclassman now, Sigrika. Rover and I are just lowly freshmen.

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: M-Me? But I...

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: By the way, this is Rover, the one I told you about.

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: Wait—you're the Rover?! I can't believe you're still a freshman…

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: It's so great to finally meet you! I'm Sigrika. Lynae's told me all about you. I can't believe you're the one who took down the Voidworm!

dialogue.desc: Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: Don't worry. I have my runes. They'll help me drive back any contaminated Exoswarm! The Soliskin will guide me too.

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: I'm coming with you. Finding people is one thing, hauling them back is another. It'll be faster if we take my motorbike.

dialogue.desc: Though the Threnodian Aleph-1 was banished, Lucilla finds herself in yet another predicament. In the absence of the Exostrider, funders are questioning whether the Synchronist program—and even the Rabelle College itself—should continue to exist. As both a professor and the head of the Academy, Lucilla must now choose between harsh reality and her ideals.

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: You didn't know, Rover? Everyone's saying the board is looking to shut down Rabelle College.

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: No, not the college. Just the Synchronists. A professor covering our Royan History class told us the Spacetrek Collective wants them out of the Academy!

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: Yeah, well, the rumor mill says Rabelle eats up two-thirds of the Academy's budget, and the Collective's investors have strong opinions 'bout that.

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: I say investors, but it's mostly New Federation money. Can't say I'm surprised they're pulling this kinda stunt.

dialogue.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: You weren't gonna just shoot us a WavesLine and dip, were ya? That'd be cold!

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: Oh, Senior! Come back and visit us when you get the chance, okay?

dialogue.desc: A Somnoire door has suddenly appeared in the Academy. Mornye has asked for your help investigating it.

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: We'll make sure this special gift is kept safe.

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: ...Yeah. Oh, Rover, just between us. On the corner of the tag, Sigrika totally...

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: Hey! We swore we'd keep that a secret, Lynae!

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: Oops. Sorry. Slipped my mind.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: A secret?

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: You'll just have to figure that one out youself, Rover.

voiceline.title: About Sigrika
voiceline.text: When I first got here, Sigrika helped me get a handle on student life... She's super serious, the kind who never lets up on herself, you know? She never complains though, just bottles it all up inside. She's gonna hit a wall one day if she keeps that up... So, how about you and I... pull a little "intervention"? You know, take her out to have some real fun.

voiceline.title: About Lynae
voiceline.text: Lynae always comes and goes like the wind. Wherever she passes, she leaves behind these dazzling colors. Those colors are her riddles, and the smile on her face? That's always the answer.

mention.title: Thoughts: II
mention.text: New spray cans, odd parts for my seniors, candy from Sigrika...
mention.source: Lynae's voice line “Thoughts: II”

mention.title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
mention.text: Sigrika? Sure, I know her. We were in the same year. She saved my butt in Royan Cultural History. I never would've passed that exam without her.
mention.source: Lynae brings up Sigrika in “Gold Suspended in Shadows” (11×)

mention.title: At Dream's Edge
mention.text: ...Yeah. Oh, Rover, just between us. On the corner of the tag, Sigrika totally...
mention.source: Lynae brings up Sigrika in “At Dream's Edge” (2×)

mention.title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
mention.text: It's so great to finally meet you! I'm Sigrika. Lynae's told me all about you. I can't believe you're the one who took down the Voidworm!
mention.source: Sigrika brings up Lynae in “Gold Suspended in Shadows” (10×)

mention.title: At Dream's Edge
mention.text: Hey! We swore we'd keep that a secret, Lynae!
mention.source: Sigrika brings up Lynae in “At Dream's Edge”

dialogue.desc: With the Voldworm threat gone for now, and the commencement of the New Solar Ceremony, Mornye, a Research Institute project lead, invites you to witness the rise of the new sun. However, a distress signal tells you that not everyone is looking forward to this ceremony. To uncover the truth, you and Mornye set off for the Bjartr Woods...

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: You want me to testify against Professor Warren? That's practically perjury… Sure, I could work some verbal magic, but honestly, I don't even know who I'm dealing with on the other side...

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: It is a dirty tactic, but it's effective. I'm confident in my analysis of those devices, but we'll need the university's verification to use them as evidence.

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: In the limited time we have, the quickest way to detain Warren is your testimony.

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: Professor Mornye...

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: You can keep this recording. If I'm wrong, it'll be your guarantee later.

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: Or... you can refuse.

dialogue.desc: The New Solar Celebration is just around the corner. Yet, President Lucilla detects a mysterious frequency appearing in the Academy's Dark Side—one that does not belong to the Academy. You suspect it may be the "reward" once mentioned by the Grand Architect of the Fractsidus. Determined to uncover the truth behind this anomaly, you venture into the Dark Side alongside Sigrika, a student you encountered there...

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: Gotta earn back all those Credits I just blew... Catch you later!

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: Facility readings are stable and within safety parameters. No abnormalities detected. Very good...

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: I did assist in designing several attractions. Monitoring their operational integrity is a logical extension of my responsibility for student safety.

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: Once you understand the mechanics, getting a high score is a breeze. But when it comes to games that test your rhythm or reflexes... I'm not so good at those...

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: Could that be a bit unfair to the students? Maybe I should delete my high scores from the server...

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: I always used to watch the students celebrate from my lab in the Research Institute. Being here with you, Mentor, actually participating... I think... I like it.

dialogue.desc: Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: The whole server bank's going nuts! Every screen is flickering!

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: The data volume is far beyond the Cassette's capacity. It's as if thousands of people left their records in it...

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: The storage system has destabilized. It's now flooding data into every archived Cassette in the room.

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: But this isn't memory data.

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: Aside from the corrupted junk, the compressed mass consists of coordinates.

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: Coordinates? From beyond the Gate? Are they... locations inside the Threnodian's black hole?

dialogue.desc: A Somnoire door has suddenly appeared in the Academy. Mornye has asked for your help investigating it.

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: We just finished the weapon's analysis. I've arranged for remote configuration. Lynae and Sigrika, your attacks should be effective now.

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: Oh yeah, it's working! Great, now it's showtime!

scene.quest: Where Stars Cascade Down · event story

voiceline.title: About Mornye
voiceline.text: What do Professor Mornye and I have in common? Easy. We both hate sitting through class! So I took her for a drive one time. Total stone face the whole time, but I could tell she was loving it. The best part was the welcome committee when we got back. A whole pack of her researchers, swarming the gates like I'd just pulled a full-blown professor-napping. I mean, hello?! I kinda like my life here. And let's be real... if I were actually trying to sneak her out, nobody would've had a clue.

voiceline.title: About Lynae
voiceline.text: I wish to be like her, having the freedom to do what she wants. To act without constraint. Especially the constraint of a class schedule. It's a pity that professors are forbidden to skip their own lectures…

mention.title: Ode to the Second Sunrise
mention.text: Lynae, Rover, can you walk me through exactly how you managed to contain it?
mention.source: Mornye brings up Lynae in “Ode to the Second Sunrise” (3×)

mention.title: At Dream's Edge
mention.text: Lynae also reported seeing a graffiti-like image at the anomaly's center. But we still don't fully understand what happened. The investigation isn't over yet.
mention.source: Mornye brings up Lynae in “At Dream's Edge” (3×)

mention.title: Ode to the Second Sunrise
mention.text: Oh, but hey, you got Mornye's email about the Hyvatia Detector, right? It's almost go-time. How about we hang by the entrance, and then we—
mention.source: Lynae brings up Mornye in “Ode to the Second Sunrise” (7×)

mention.title: What Burns Beneath Frostlands
mention.text: The Fractsidus investigation is still dragging on. And since I'm technically not enrolled yet, no classes for me. Ugh... They even confiscated my ride, too. Professor Mornye dumped a ton of homework on me to keep me busy.
mention.source: Lynae brings up Mornye in “What Burns Beneath Frostlands” (3×)

mention.title: Starlights from Yesterdays
mention.text: I kinda cornered Professor Mornye. Bugged her until she cracked.
mention.source: Lynae brings up Mornye in “Starlights from Yesterdays” (2×)

mention.title: At Dream's Edge
mention.text: So... this is one of the Dream Band shards Professor Mornye mentioned?
mention.source: Lynae brings up Mornye in “At Dream's Edge” (3×)

voiceline.text: The first time I met Dr. Herssen at the infirmary, I got this weird feeling he could see right through me. Now I think I might've just imagined it. Anyway, the man can write a very generous doctor's note slip. I'll give him that.

sample.text: Easy-peasy! If anything comes up, just gimme a shout.

sample.speaker: Chisa
sample.text: And me.

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: Rover! Perfect timing! Here, take this.

sample.speaker: Chisa
sample.text: It's a souvenir ticket for the New Solar Celebration.

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: My hand feels so warm. Incredible, it's like magic...

sample.speaker: Chisa
sample.text: Huh... so this is a Royan rune...

sample.text: Happy graduation, Rover!

sample.speaker: Chisa
sample.text: Congratulations on your graduation. I'll do my best to catch up to you as soon as I can.

voiceline.title: About Chisa
voiceline.text: First time I saw Chisa, I thought that quiet, intense vibe meant "keep your distance." Man, was I wrong. We clicked instantly. She took one look at my bike and knew exactly what part was malfunctioning. Way faster than any manual diagnostic I could've run! Now that's impressive...

mention.title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
mention.text: Sigrika! Over here! Chisa's getting a new top record!
mention.source: Lynae brings up Chisa in “Gold Suspended in Shadows” (2×)

mention.title: What Burns Beneath Frostlands
mention.text: Unconventional methods, huh? That reminds me, just a few days ago, a student named Chisa appeared out of thin air in the middle of a class. Freaked everyone out.
mention.source: Lynae brings up Chisa in “What Burns Beneath Frostlands”

mention.title: Starlights from Yesterdays
mention.text: Rover, I've been asking everyone. Even Lynae was being vague about it, but I figured it out…
mention.source: Chisa brings up Lynae in “Starlights from Yesterdays” (2×)

dialogue.desc: The gateway to Lahai-Roi is now open! What burns beneath the frostlands is waiting for your return!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: It's... far beyond what I had imagined.

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: Didn't get to introduce myself. I'm Lynae, by the way.

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: I saw your acceptance letter, so... freshman? What's your name?

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: Oh okay, Rover... I got it.

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: It's not totally safe yet. Let's keep moving while we talk.

dialogue.desc: To reach Lahal-Roi in the midst of a Void Storm, you dive into the spatial tunnel, which pulls you into a strange dimension... Upon arriving in Lahai-Roi, you chance upon Lynae, a student who leads you to Startorch Academy. As you begin enrollment, everything about this "academic metropolis" unfolds before your eyes. Meanwhile, shadows stir beneath the Vold Storm...

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: Thanks… for speaking up for me.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: What was that device you had when Hyvatia went berserk?

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: Straight to the point, huh? I thought you'd let it slide, like they did.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Highly unlikely.

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: Good... you're still you.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: What's your real purpose?

phoneSample.speaker: Lynae
phoneSample.text: Is everything going alright?

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: Just got inside the Institue.

phoneSample.speaker: Lynae
phoneSample.text: That's good

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: I'm lost...

phoneSample.speaker: Lynae
phoneSample.text: O_O?

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: It's so quiet here...

dialogue.summary: Lynae, still concerned, mentions that where you fell was right in the middle of an active Voidworm zone. Not far away, Lynae quietly shuts off a machine that seems to be monitoring you.

dialogue.desc: With the Voldworm threat gone for now, and the commencement of the New Solar Ceremony, Mornye, a Research Institute project lead, invites you to witness the rise of the new sun. However, a distress signal tells you that not everyone is looking forward to this ceremony. To uncover the truth, you and Mornye set off for the Bjartr Woods...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (Figuring out who she is and what happened to her will be the next big task.)

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: Rover? Rover—Hey, stop spacing out!

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: To celebrate Professor Mornye waking up and the crisis being averted, don't you think we should...

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: Go for a ride!

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: Nothing beats the wind on your face, especially when—

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: The three of us still don't have a group picture!

dialogue.desc: The New Solar Celebration is just around the corner. Yet, President Lucilla detects a mysterious frequency appearing in the Academy's Dark Side—one that does not belong to the Academy. You suspect it may be the "reward" once mentioned by the Grand Architect of the Fractsidus. Determined to uncover the truth behind this anomaly, you venture into the Dark Side alongside Sigrika, a student you encountered there...

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: Why are you hiccuping, Sigrika?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: We just had some Rainbow Bean Pop Rocks. Want to try?

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: No way! Your voice is totally different! Gimme one, I gotta try this!

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: Oh, that's "awful"!

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: Wait, that "is" what I meant...? Everything is "the same as" what I want to say... Huh?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: It's making you say the opposite of what you're trying to say...

dialogue.desc: Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: Everything's felt so heavy at the Academy lately. Teachers are stretched thin. Even the nearby Exoswarm seem restless...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Lynae, are you nervous?

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: ...Eh?! Okay, fine. Is it that obvious?

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: Look, after I aced the entrance exam, I thought, "Sweet. Life's gonna be packed again. Non-stop." Like it used to be.

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: But just when I was ready to finally be a student... my bubble popped. My brilliant student life, "Poof" and done.

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: The Threnodian, Voidmatter, the Fractsidus... They're breathing down our necks, and I can't do anything to help you fight them.

phoneSample.speaker: Lynae
phoneSample.text: What's your status? I saw you dash straight into the most contaminated area when I passed Bjartr Woods.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: So far, so good. How's it looking on your end?

phoneSample.speaker: Lynae
phoneSample.text: My section is pretty far out. On the bright side, they gave me a permit to ignore all speed limits!

phoneSample.speaker: Lynae
phoneSample.text: Catch you on the other side!}}

dialogue.desc: Though the Threnodian Aleph-1 was banished, Lucilla finds herself in yet another predicament. In the absence of the Exostrider, funders are questioning whether the Synchronist program—and even the Rabelle College itself—should continue to exist. As both a professor and the head of the Academy, Lucilla must now choose between harsh reality and her ideals.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Someone want to tell me what's happening?

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: You didn't know, Rover? Everyone's saying the board is looking to shut down Rabelle College.

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: No, not the college. Just the Synchronists. A professor covering our Royan History class told us the Spacetrek Collective wants them out of the Academy!

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: Yeah, well, the rumor mill says Rabelle eats up two-thirds of the Academy's budget, and the Collective's investors have strong opinions 'bout that.

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: I say investors, but it's mostly New Federation money. Can't say I'm surprised they're pulling this kinda stunt.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: What about you, Chisa? What have you heard?

dialogue.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: So, Rover! You have a good time here at the Academy with us, yeah?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: It was short, but yeah. I'm glad.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: If there's one thing I'll take away from my time here, it's all of you.

phoneSample.speaker: Lynae
phoneSample.text: But I'm sure I'll find the answer here. I'll let you know once I get there!

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: Looking forward to it.

phoneSample.speaker: Lynae
phoneSample.text: By the way, since you've already been to so many places...

phoneSample.speaker: Lynae
phoneSample.text: That means... you'll end up in the New Federation sooner or later, right?

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: Yeah, probably.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: If I need to.

dialogue.desc: A Somnoire door has suddenly appeared in the Academy. Mornye has asked for your help investigating it.

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: I mean, I have been slacking on training to chase credits... but that's not it, is it?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: It happened to me, too. There's a unique Tacet Discord on the other side of that door. It resisted all standard attacks.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: These aren't normal Tacet Discords. Lynae, can you report this directly to President Lucilla? We need her insight.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: After that, I'll go with you to see Mornye. When you deliver the data, I'll brief her on our guests.

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: Copy that. I'll grab the data samples first, plus an extra copy for the President!

dialogue.desc: Amid the lively bustle of the New Solar Celebration, students are busy pairing up for the festivities. Lynae—the very first schoolmate you met here—reaches out with an invitation of her own! Don't miss the chance to share a festive lunch and celebrate the once-in-a-lifetime event together.

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: Phew...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: So the volunteering job is pretty tough, huh?

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: Hmm... It's all right, I guess? Mostly it's just helping people with lost belongings. So far we've received over a hundred requests. Ugh, still got no idea where to start for thirty of those...

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: ...Plus those twelve equipment malfunctions I fixed for the Department of Engineering. And you know what? Over a dozen glitches on the same little projector. That was a real eye-opener!

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: And counting supplies, painting stage props, hauling people who passed out from overworking to the infirmary, patching up the accidental injuries, yada, yada, yada...

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: Well, it's my first Celebration after being "officially accepted" to the Academy. Of course I have to make it worthwhile!

phoneSample.speaker: Lynae
phoneSample.text: How's it goin'? Enjoying campus life so far?

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: Not too bad.

phoneSample.speaker: Lynae
phoneSample.text: Great to hear! Ever give the New Solar Celebration another go?

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: It's been very productive.

phoneSample.speaker: Lynae
phoneSample.text: Well... Wanna make it more exciting?

phoneSample.speaker: Lynae
phoneSample.text: Come hang out at the New Solar Celebration when ur free!

dialogue.desc: Lynae finally pins down the mech's signal. It has already left the Academy. Why did the student install unauthorized modifications? Where is the patrol mech heading? And what truth awaits at the end of this pursuit? Head to the Academy's main entrance and meet Lynae.

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: That was the first time I realized the danger of the Void Storm, and it really stuck with me. So she was his... his mother.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Did he modify the mech because of his lost mother?

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: Well... maybe he wanted revenge, or maybe... he was just trying to prevent another tragedy like the one that took his mom.

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: Its core programming prioritizes "protecting human escorts" above everything else, even over securing the survey data.

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: Now that we've found it, we should…

phoneSample.speaker: Lynae
phoneSample.text: Managed to track its signal, but the coordinates are way off from the Academy.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: How did you do that?

phoneSample.speaker: Lynae
phoneSample.text: Just tweaked the tracker's frequency range a little.

phoneSample.speaker: Lynae
phoneSample.text: It's running around in a circle now. We gotta get to it before a Void Storm hits.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: You can leave campus grounds now?

phoneSample.speaker: Lynae
phoneSample.text: Did 30 mins of forms for 30 mins of investigation time. The volunteer's green channel!

dialogue.desc: An unmistakably "unordinary" emergency request arrives! An unstable prototype patrol mech has vanished without a trace! Concerned for campus safety, Lynae asks you to help track it down. Once again, the merry duo of the Voidworm Knight sets out on a new adventure! Head to the square with Lynae and speak with the student who lost the patrol mech.

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: So we gotta find it ASAP!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Roger that. What's the rally point?

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: The fountain by the square. I'm with the student who needs help.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Be there in a minute.

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: Perfect! Joint ops with you are always fun!

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: I'll get some more details from the person first. See you soon.}}

dialogue.quest: If You Catch Up to It...
dialogue.desc: A new lead emerges. To recover the missing patrol mech, Lynae invites you to investigate the lab together. One unusual trace after another points toward something far from ordinary. Is a real threat waiting ahead? Or just a false alarm? Work with Lynae to uncover the truth.

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: Hmm... it seems this student secretly modified the patrol mech under the teachers' noses...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: ...and then it went out of control by accident.

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: If the Academy finds out, he's gonna face disciplinary action for sure. Or worse yet, he could get kicked out.

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: If he wanted to do this kind of research, he'd definitely get the chance after making it to the Department of Engineering. Why's he in such a hurry...

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: I thought the same at first. But after digging into his research logs, I found a lot of clever optimizations and impressive designs. He just needs more experience to pull them off...

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: If he had some shady motives, why would he even bother with all this...

dialogue.desc: The emergency has been resolved. After the Celebration, life at the Academy has settled back into its familiar rhythm. As your days find their balance between calm and chaos, Lynae's message pops up on your Terminal as usual. She wants to catch up and fill you in on what happened after the incident. Meet Lynae by the fountain in the square.

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: Got a moment? The incident's resolved without a hitch.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: How's everything?

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: Hmm... Can we meet?

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: Maybe a walk? Need some time to talk about it.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Okay.

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: (ゝ∀･) Meet me at the square fountain!}}

dialogue.quest: Where Stars Cascade Down · event story

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: —Hey, Rover! Over here!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Lynae? Don't tell me you're skipping class again…

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: Don't stereotype me! I'm not playing hooky this time. I've actually got business here.

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: See this display? The Academy teamed up with Lollo Logistics to share some vehicle tech for hauling cargo over rough terrain.

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: Ahem, that's not the point! Anyway, the demo vehicle started acting up during testing, and some of the custom parts weren't ready in time.

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: If this keeps up, the Academy's reputation could take a real hit. So, to keep things on track and make sure the partnership goes smoothly…

mention.title: Where the Story Begins
mention.text: Back then, Lynae had no idea whether Rover, who had literally fallen straight from the sky, had witnessed the exact moment she carried out her plan. So she reached out immediately, hauling Rover upright and dragging onto the back seat of her motorbike.
mention.source: Lynae's character story “Where the Story Begins”

mention.title: What Burns Beneath Frostlands
mention.text: (Lynae's behavior is suspicious… but judging by what I just saw, she didn't seem like she was trying to damage the Detector.)
mention.source: Rover brings up Lynae in “What Burns Beneath Frostlands” (12×)

mention.title: Starlights from Yesterdays
mention.text: Lynae, are you nervous?
mention.source: Rover brings up Lynae in “Starlights from Yesterdays” (2×)

mention.title: The Wind Before the Storm
mention.text: I appreciate it, Lynae.
mention.source: Rover brings up Lynae in “The Wind Before the Storm”

mention.title: At Dream's Edge
mention.text: These aren't normal Tacet Discords. Lynae, can you report this directly to President Lucilla? We need her insight.
mention.source: Rover brings up Lynae in “At Dream's Edge”

mention.title: Where Stars Cascade Down · event story
mention.text: Lynae? Don't tell me you're skipping class again…
mention.source: Rover brings up Lynae in “Where Stars Cascade Down · event story”

voiceline.title: About Sigrika
voiceline.text: She's a remarkably conscientious student, but her persistence can sometimes be wasteful. For instance, she will fill the exam questions with unrelated formulas when she doesn't know the answers. It won't get her points.

mention.title: Beneath a Melting Night Sky
mention.text: Tonight might not work for me... I... I promised Professor Mornye I'd help out at the Reactor Drive today...
mention.source: Sigrika brings up Mornye in “Beneath a Melting Night Sky” (2×)

mention.title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
mention.text: Senior, Professor Mornye is calling.
mention.source: Sigrika brings up Mornye in “Gold Suspended in Shadows”

mention.title: Sunny Season
mention.text: I've been helping Professor Mornye with the Reactor Drive for the past couple of days ... Feels like it's been ages since we met, Senior!
mention.source: Sigrika brings up Mornye in “Sunny Season”

mention.title: At Dream's Edge
mention.text: We just finished the weapon's analysis. I've arranged for remote configuration. Lynae and Sigrika, your attacks should be effective now.
mention.source: Mornye brings up Sigrika in “At Dream's Edge” (2×)

sample.text: Returning to work with this "emotional parameter" boost should correlate to higher efficiency. Thank you, Mentor.

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: We've had campus-wide events before, but this New Solar Celebration energy is on another level...

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: Is it because it's the inaugural event? The students poured everything into this. Their passion is great to see, but a little more caution wouldn't hurt.

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: Patched up a handful of scrapes and bruises just getting here. Ah, the passionate, painful privilege of youth.

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: Heh, not at all. Time flies when you're having fun, and this was... memorable.

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: I should head back to the infirmary. Enjoy the rest of the celebration, and watch your step.

voiceline.title: About Luuk Herssen
voiceline.text: When I was a student, I frequented the infirmary. Dr. Herssen had me take a medicine imported from the New Federation that would only take effect if I went to bed before 10 P.M. A month passed, and my health improved. It wasn't until later that I found those medicines were just ordinary Lahai-Roi plant-based milk...

mention.title: Ode to the Second Sunrise
mention.text: We're still unsure what triggered the surge. But after comparing the waveforms with the device Professor Mornye brought back, we suspect it was an artificially induced Void Storm.
mention.source: Luuk Herssen brings up Mornye in “Ode to the Second Sunrise”

mention.title: Starlights from Yesterdays
mention.text: President Lucilla, Professor Mornye, and I have all put in a good word. You'll be meeting him at the Research Institute.
mention.source: Luuk Herssen brings up Mornye in “Starlights from Yesterdays”

voiceline.title: About Chisa
voiceline.text: The freshman girl who vanished in the Void Storm... I remember the incident clearly. It happened during my first year as a teaching assistant at the Academy. I even graded a paper she submitted. It was exceptionally well-written, with a logical structure, rigorous analysis, and precise formatting. Now, she's become the student who writes the best papers in my class.

mention.title: Starlights from Yesterdays
mention.text: Rover, I'm at the Research Institute. Professor Mornye is here, too.
mention.source: Chisa brings up Mornye in “Starlights from Yesterdays”

dialogue.desc: As the city lights twinkle, friendly faces beckon you to join them in the bustling border town. Immerse yourself in its prosperous yet tranquil ambiance.

sample.speaker: Mortefi
sample.text: ...My apologies. Did I startle you?

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Mr. Mortefi, please pardon our intrusion. We are friends of Baizhi, and we're here to look for her.

sample.speaker: Mortefi
sample.text: I see. I hope I didn't cause any offense earlier.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Not at all, it was us who bothered you...

sample.speaker: Mortefi
sample.text: Baizhi should be in the Data Analysis Room. I'll go tell her you're here.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Thank you, sir.

scene.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

voiceline.title: About Yangyang
voiceline.text: That girl, I think the name is Yangyang. I hear her humming from time to time. Surprisingly, her melodies always bring my mind to peace.

mention.title: First Resonance
mention.text: This is Mortefi, a renowned figure in the Department of Safety. He was born in the New Federation, and he joined the Huaxu Academy a few years ago. I heard his talent is truly impressive.
mention.source: Yangyang brings up Mortefi in “First Resonance” (11×)

mention.title: Clashing Blades
mention.text: Mr. Mortefi said it's an intricate puzzle box. Madam Magistrate might have hid her real message inside.
mention.source: Yangyang brings up Mortefi in “Clashing Blades”

voiceline.title: About Chixia
voiceline.text: Speaking of Chixia, she's a regular visitor at my lab, often bringing children along. She's a straightforward person, which I like. Besides, those who get along with kids are never bad people. Kids are incredibly perceptive of a person's true character.

voiceline.title: About Xiangli Yao
voiceline.text: That Xiangli Yao... One day I'll outdo him, and create even better inventions!

voiceline.title: About Mortefi
voiceline.text: Mortefi is an interesting person. He's devoted to his work with unwavering determination. It's that kind of intense drive that pushes scientists towards brilliant discoveries. I know he considers me a "genius"—but in a workplace with only "geniuses", many ideas will never be realized. My dear friend has yet to grasp his true potential.

mention.title: First Resonance
mention.text: Crack that thing another five degrees, and not even Xiangli Yao will be able to save it.
mention.source: Mortefi brings up Xiangli Yao in “First Resonance”

dialogue.desc: A long-dead captain, a ship that cannot sail. Yet now, that captain has set upon an inevitable course, and the ship must sail once again...

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: That's why it didn't want to fight her earlier. After teaching her a lesson, maybe she'll know better.

sample.speaker: Phoebe
sample.text: Tidebreaker. I... I have something to ask you!

sample.speaker: Phoebe
sample.text: Have you fully recovered?

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Of course it is! Look at it live and kicking. It's never been better.

sample.speaker: Phoebe
sample.text: You were tricked and deceived during the Carnevale... I know that an Acolyte like me is in no position to represent the Order...

dialogue.quest: The Sacred Breeze So Often Breathes
dialogue.desc: After a minor twist in the journey, Ragunna, the Land of Echoes, unfolds its grandeur, extending a grand welcome to the traveler from distant shores.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Wow... are they all Echoes?

sample.speaker: Phoebe
sample.text: Yes. Most newcomers to the city are amazed by the spectacle.

But Miss Zani is brave and dependable, which just might be enough to overcome existing prejudices. After all, she's such a reliable and respectable person.

sample.text: ...Perhaps.

sample.text: I am certain that, even without any direction, will walk the path that destiny has laid before .

sample.speaker: Cristoforo
sample.text: All things ascend towards a singular point of convergence, and what awaits at the end is... immortality.

sample.speaker: Cristoforo
sample.text: Before the tides of fate, we are all but...

dialogue.desc: The Dreamer seals her heart and surrenders to a world of dreams beyond mortal sight. In this hidden realm built upon melancholy melodies, she walks a path of fragile hope and delusions without looking back. But the dreams she longs to realize have long been tangled up in shadow and deceit. Beneath the lofty facade of the Orchestrator, who seems to have everything, is but a wretched, pitiful soul, drowning in her own illusions. In the end, will this dream of blooming and withering be a sweet reverie or a haunting nightmare?

sample.speaker: Phrolova
sample.text: Manipulating reality behind her back, reviving the Threnodian's lingering power within her through the progression of a tale... That's now nearly impossible.

sample.speaker: Cristoforo
sample.text: Ah, but at the very least, we have affirmed her resilience and stability after the merging. That alone offers invaluable insight into our research sample.

sample.speaker: Cristoforo
sample.text: If we allow the story to unfold, we may have the chance to further destabilize Cartethyia and mold her into the Threnodian.

sample.speaker: Phrolova
sample.text: Do you not hear Rover on our heels? And you're willing to gamble everything on a mere "chance" to deliver what the Grand Architect desires?

sample.speaker: Cristoforo
sample.text: Heh, so eager to witness the Beyond's completion at the seabed.

sample.speaker: Phrolova
sample.text: Why not nudge Septimont's plot just a little? Use your original plan to mask our true purpose.

scene.desc: The Waking Moon Festival is drawing near in the Land of Xuanfang, yet rumors that "the Hold is doomed to fall" have begun to spread throughout the city. To find the Sentinel who has long been absent, you decide to head to where Hsin's presence was last felt—the Manifold Sanctum.

Cartethyia vanished in the Inverted Tower. Following the traces she left behind, you arrive at Septimont, one of Rinascita's city-states, steeped in glory and famed for its gladiatorial tradition. The city is hosting the Great Agon—a grand championship held once every four years. Yet beneath the grandeur, shadows stir. Multiple factions move in secret, each with their hidden agenda. To uncover the truth, you form a temporary alliance with Contender Lupa. Together, you set your sights on the championship...

voiceline.title: About Cristoforo
voiceline.text: Attempting to awaken true free will in mankind, one that dares to confront the very truths of this world is an intriguing pursuit. Pity that blind will, without the anchor of survival, becomes naught but a flash in the pan. Are not the uncontrollable turns and imperfect endings caught within the cracks of the script the very tolling of a warning bell?

scene.desc: With the great battle over, the Land of Xuanfang is slowly returning to how it once was, though plenty of aftershocks have yet to settle. Then one day, a WavesLine message from Yangyang arrives out of the blue: Suisui is about to head back to Mengzhou City...

voiceline.title: About Changli
voiceline.text: The flame she manipulates is indeed a rare and perilous force. My Quietude Art could only ease the burning pain it caused her. To avoid being consumed by it, she had to temper her mind and master the flow of her Forte. The life she had already burned away cannot be restored. But now that she can wield it freely, she should be fine, so long as she respects her limits. That, too, is thanks to you.

sample.text: I will complete the Sanctum investigation quickly. Once the situation is clear, I shall return at once.

The Waking Moon Festival is drawing near in the Land of Xuanfang, yet rumors that "the Hold is doomed to fall" have begun to spread throughout the city. To find the Sentinel who has long been absent, you decide to head to where Hsin's presence was last felt—the Manifold Sanctum.

voiceline.title: About Yangyang
voiceline.text: When I first met her, I thought the Xuanling Bird had returned. She sees right through the ways of the world and hears the unspoken voices of others. Her Sword Intent seems gentle, yet it carries a resilience second to none. Something seems to be pressing behind her, urging her ever onward, toward some distant journey. Perhaps it is not that she resembles the Xuanling Bird... but that the Xuanling Bird resembled her.

mention.title: Song of the Heart Sword
mention.text: Suisui, I really am fine... Rover and Paragon Qingxiao are the ones who went into the Sanctum. They faced all the real danger.
mention.source: Yangyang brings up Qingxiao in “Song of the Heart Sword” (6×)

mention.title: Song of the Heart Sword
mention.text: Then I will rely on you, Yangyang.
mention.source: Qingxiao brings up Yangyang in “Song of the Heart Sword” (2×)

voiceline.title: About Buling
voiceline.text: That child is remarkably gifted and sharp. She has already mastered the basics of her Thunder Spells, though she rarely shows them off. At first, I tested her rigorously to see the true depths of her potential. Had she dedicated herself to her cultivation, she might well have reached her master's level within a few years. But that path is clearly not for her. The other day, she sent me a glowing knight's sword, calling it a travel souvenir from Rinascita. Well... at least she was thinking of me.

voiceline.title: About Sanhua
voiceline.text: My master once told me some of my ancestors moved from Chongzhou to the borderlands. Sanhua comes from that branch of lineage. Like me, her only interest used to be swordplay. But now, it seems she's found a purpose for her blade in Jinzhou's Magistrate. I'm glad for her.

voiceline.title: About Changli
voiceline.text: In Mingting, people like me rarely got the chance to meet the high-ups—and understandably so. We only show up where there's trouble. As for her, all I know is that ever since she stepped down as Secretary-General, no one's been able to truly fill her place.

voiceline.title: About Jiyan
voiceline.text: Across the troops under Huanglong's Ministry of War, you'd find no one other than him competent enough to earn the title of General at such a young age. I heard he used to be a medic before joining the Midnight Rangers... He's saving lives, one way or another.

mention.title: A Stranger in a Strange Land
mention.text: You know Jiyan. You fought in Norfall Barrens. You must also know what really happened in Jinzhou three years ago.
mention.source: Qiuyuan brings up Jiyan in “A Stranger in a Strange Land”

dialogue.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

sample.speaker: Scar
sample.text: Hahaha! Yes! Now this is a scene fit for the final act!

sample.speaker: Qiuyuan
sample.text: Blades do not discriminate. Leave. This one's mine.

sample.speaker: Scar
sample.text: Oh? Has Huanglong fallen so low, they now send a blind man to die?

sample.speaker: Qiuyuan
sample.text: Prisoner Scar of Jinzhou. Surrender now. One strike is all it would take to end you. Surrender, and you may be spared pain.

sample.speaker: Scar
sample.text: In an epic play such as this, I refuse an early exit.

sample.speaker: Qiuyuan
sample.text: My orders were to bring you back. Dead or alive.

voiceline.title: About Scar
voiceline.text: My knowledge of him only comes from the files. If we ever crossed blades, he wouldn't last three rounds without backup. Though Mingting brushed him aside like any other Fractsidus criminal, people in Jinzhou would scour the earth for him. Given the gravity of his crime, he's only asking to meet his end.

mention.title: Reforged
mention.text: "Scar, the Fractsidus Overseer, escaped from Jinzhou's prison not long ago. Find out how Scar escaped, then head east to Rinascita."
mention.source: Qiuyuan's character story “Reforged”

mention.title: A Stranger in a Strange Land
mention.text: She asked me to execute a Fractsidus Overseer named Scar in Rinascita, and help Rover in the process.
mention.source: Qiuyuan brings up Scar in “A Stranger in a Strange Land”

mention.title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
mention.text: Prisoner Scar of Jinzhou. Surrender now. One strike is all it would take to end you. Surrender, and you may be spared pain.
mention.source: Qiuyuan brings up Scar in “Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides”

dialogue.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

sample.speaker: Qiuyuan
sample.text: ...Death.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I accepted this long ago.

sample.speaker: Qiuyuan
sample.text: You've already been touched by the Dark Tide. Even the Sentinel's power cannot reverse it.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: That's why we're not arguing over who goes in first. Anyone else would just suffer longer.

sample.speaker: Qiuyuan
sample.text: You've been resisting the Threnodian's corruption this whole time, suppressing your Resonance Ability so Tidespawn wouldn't surface. Everything you said was just to hide the truth. Deliberately.

sample.speaker: Qiuyuan
sample.text: You're prepared to walk into death alone.

dialogue.quest: A Stranger in a Strange Land
dialogue.desc: In this battle that sealed the fate of Rinascita, its people rose in defiance. And among them stood another, a swordsman of Huanglong, guided across the seas by Huanglong Mingting to lend you his strength. He fought as one among the countless souls drawn to this hour, but the story of his own journey, and the shadows of his past, remain known to few...

sample.speaker: Qiuyuan
sample.text: You have come.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Leaving so soon?

sample.speaker: Qiuyuan
sample.text: I've lingered long enough. My work isn't done.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Scar and the other Fractsidus operatives got away...

sample.speaker: Qiuyuan
sample.text: Our Grand Marshal likely expected as much. They always have a way out.

sample.speaker: Qiuyuan
sample.text: Pity. Would have liked to see if I could sever that goat head in one strike.

scene.desc: With the crisis behind you, Liangyu seems to have something to discuss. Go find out what it is when you have a moment. You may soon be seeing that Nethermancer who worked alongside you at the Manifold Sanctum.

The Waking Moon Festival is drawing near in the Land of Xuanfang, yet rumors that "the Hold is doomed to fall" have begun to spread throughout the city. To find the Sentinel who has long been absent, you decide to head to where Hsin's presence was last felt—the Manifold Sanctum.

mention.title: Reforged
mention.text: Rover is in Rinascita." "…That Rover?"
mention.source: Qiuyuan's character story “Reforged”

timeline.quest: A Stranger in a Strange Land

dialogue.desc: A Somnoire door has suddenly appeared in the Academy. Mornye has asked for your help investigating it.

sample.speaker: Rebecca
sample.text: Picked the color scheme myself. Preem, right? Totally screams my style.

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: For sure, it's got your vibe all over it!

sample.speaker: Rebecca
sample.text: Hehe, keep the compliments rollin'!

sample.speaker: Rebecca
sample.text: Speaking of, your piece is killer, too... Lemme see?

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: Sure! Here you go.

sample.speaker: Rebecca
sample.text: Whoa, sick... Adorable AND tuned to perfection...?

voiceline.title: About Lynae
voiceline.text: Lynae and I just click. Got a lot in common—graffiti, motorbikes, badass vibes... Even went racin'. I ate her dust, but whatevs. Not many students 'round here are as nova as she is. Rare breed for sure. Be cool as hell if I got to be her classmate.

mention.title: At Dream's Edge
mention.text: C'mon, I'm sure Rebecca's already got a plan, right?
mention.source: Lynae brings up Rebecca in “At Dream's Edge” (3×)

mention.title: At Dream's Edge
mention.text: Y'know, honestly...? Kinda like it here at the Academy. Could drag Sigrika and Lynae 'round to some classes, see what that's like.
mention.source: Rebecca brings up Lynae in “At Dream's Edge” (3×)

dialogue.desc: A Somnoire door has suddenly appeared in the Academy. Mornye has asked for your help investigating it.

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: It will take a while to study your weapon, Ms. Rebecca. Do you have something to do in the meantime?

sample.speaker: Rebecca
sample.text: You can stop callin' me "Ms. Rebecca." Ain't my vibe, like, at all. Just Rebecca's fine.

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: ...I see. Then what do you plan to do now, Rebecca?

sample.speaker: Rebecca
sample.text: I'll be bored outta my gourd just sittin' here. Think I'll take a stroll 'round the Academy.

sample.speaker: Rebecca
sample.text: Yeah, I can run this spray can back to Lynae. And hey, shootin' the sh*t with Sigrika over some video games sounds pretty chill.

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: Ah... I didn't realize you were already acquainted with Sigrika.

voiceline.title: About Mornye
voiceline.text: Mornye's chrome legs and what I've got installed are toootally different. Hers are see-through! Can look right through 'em 'thout seein' a single wire or chip! Like, how's that even work? Uses 'em like she was born with 'em, like the kid's had 'em since forever—Wait, what...? She's OLDER than me?! The hell?!

mention.title: At Dream's Edge
mention.text: While we can't fully decode your power, we can study and replicate the frequency signatures of Lucy and Rebecca's weapons, applying it to our own armaments.
mention.source: Mornye brings up Rebecca in “At Dream's Edge” (6×)

mention.title: At Dream's Edge
mention.text: Right, now that that's wrapped up, gotta go grab my iron from Mornye and meet up with Luce.
mention.source: Rebecca brings up Mornye in “At Dream's Edge” (2×)

dialogue.desc: A Somnoire door has suddenly appeared in the Academy. Mornye has asked for your help investigating it.

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: We were able to reach a compromise. I agreed to give her access to the Academy's database while she receives care.

sample.speaker: Rebecca
sample.text: Tch. That gonk ain't the patient type. Her and David, both.

sample.speaker: Rebecca
sample.text: Whatever. So long as she's in one piece. Gonna go suck some fresh air, holler if ya need me.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Something else on your mind?

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: During the examination, I noted Lucy's psychological state isn't stable.

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: She's vulnerable to external frequency interference. That unique Tacet Discord you mentioned seems to be targeting that weakness. Pouring salt in the wound.

voiceline.title: About Luuk Herssen
voiceline.text: At first, he gave me creepy scavenger vibes. Boy, was I wrong. Hear he's good at patchin' peeps up, even their minds. Might let him scan my skull sponge when the dust settles. See if my grayware needs tuning, or if I'm just a certified whackjob.

mention.title: At Dream's Edge
mention.text: Of course. While you're at it, could you give Rebecca this Terminal?
mention.source: Luuk Herssen brings up Rebecca in “At Dream's Edge”

dialogue.desc: A Somnoire door has suddenly appeared in the Academy. Mornye has asked for your help investigating it.

sample.speaker: Rebecca
sample.text: Runes? Sounds like a fantasy sim to me... 'Sides, they all look the friggin' same. Can't tell 'em apart!

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: Hmm... What if you tried imagining them as stars?

sample.speaker: Rebecca
sample.text: Pass. Don't wanna fry my circuits with that stuff.

sample.speaker: Rebecca
sample.text: Mercwork suits me better than classwork!

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: That's a special-looking gun... Is it yours?

sample.speaker: Rebecca
sample.text: Yep, custom job. Don't feel right walkin' around 'thout iron in my pocket.

voiceline.title: About Sigrika
voiceline.text: Sigrika's a good kid. Too good. Bein' that responsible, with everyone expectin' so much...? Gotta be exhaustin'. She oughta cut loose more. Go wild sometimes, y'know? ...Speakin' of, think she'd be down to hit the arcade with me next weekend?

mention.title: At Dream's Edge
mention.text: I'm actually not very good at gaming. I lost every round until Rebecca showed up and gave me a hand.
mention.source: Sigrika brings up Rebecca in “At Dream's Edge” (3×)

mention.title: At Dream's Edge
mention.text: Y'know, honestly...? Kinda like it here at the Academy. Could drag Sigrika and Lynae 'round to some classes, see what that's like.
mention.source: Rebecca brings up Sigrika in “At Dream's Edge” (2×)

dialogue.desc: A Somnoire door has suddenly appeared in the Academy. Mornye has asked for your help investigating it.

sample.speaker: Rebecca
sample.text: Lemme be clear. If you're here to drag me back for an exam, I'll delta so fast you'll get whiplash.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Relax. I'm here to give you this.

sample.speaker: Rebecca
sample.text: What's this weird doodad?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Dr. Herssen helped you apply for a Terminal. Now I can ping your location and contact you whenever.

sample.speaker: Rebecca
sample.text: Oh, nice. Thanks, choom.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I just got a message from Lucy. She needs more time digging through the archives. Says to wait.

mention.title: Life in Limbo
mention.text: |mention5 = Abby, David, Lucy, Rover
mention.source: Rebecca's character story “Life in Limbo”

mention.title: At Dream's Edge
mention.text: I'll check with Rebecca first... Hm? Where'd she run off to?
mention.source: Rover brings up Rebecca in “At Dream's Edge” (4×)

dialogue.desc: A Somnoire door has suddenly appeared in the Academy. Mornye has asked for your help investigating it.

sample.speaker: Rebecca
sample.text: Not bad, you little turd. You're growin' on me!

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Hehe, just helping out Rover. Someone's gotta.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: But you've never heard of an Echo? What about a Tacet Discord? Do you know what those are?

sample.speaker: Rebecca
sample.text: Nope... Ring any bells, Lucy?

sample.speaker: Lucy
sample.text: If I had access to the Net, might be able to dig up something...

sample.speaker: Rebecca
sample.text: Yeah, no Net access is weird, I'll give ya that. But another world? C'mon. Am I right, Rover?

mention.title: Life in Limbo
mention.text: |mention5 = Abby, David, Lucy, Rover
mention.source: Rebecca's character story “Life in Limbo”

mention.title: At Dream's Edge
mention.text: Hm, guess I'm curious about your world, too, though. 'Specially the Echoes. Man, I'd kill to have an Echo buddy like Abby!
mention.source: Rebecca brings up Abby in “At Dream's Edge”

mention.title: At Dream's Edge
mention.text: Got a feeling that even when we find Rebecca, she's not going for that check-up.
mention.source: Abby brings up Rebecca in “At Dream's Edge”

dialogue.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

sample.speaker: Roccia
sample.text: The Echoes of Rinascita can sense human frequencies. When we reach out in hope, they answer us with hope.

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: But even with their help and the potion, we're still far from our goal... We fought through the illusions, but we still need an Anchor to open a path to the Journeying Paradise.

dialogue.quest: What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing
dialogue.desc: Following Carlotta's guidance, you arrive at the Penitent's End and reunite with the Troupe. Here, another buried secret of the Order awaits discovery...

sample.speaker: Roccia
sample.text: She intends to use those Lycorises to summon and control the Tacet Discords. If we destroy the Lycorises, we can neutralize them.

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: Everyone is in position. We'll manage the west plaza.

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: Phoebe is stationed at the east plaza, keeping an eye on things.

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: The main stage is all yours for the grand performance.

sample.speaker: Roccia
sample.text: I'll take care of the lighting and create the mood to make the performance stand out.

scene.desc: To open the Sentinel's Relic, you head back to Ragunna once more...

scene.quest: Veils Off in Sun or Shadow
scene.desc: To understand Gilberto's part in the Echo incident, you trace his steps to the outskirts of the city. But the deep you delve, the more elusive the truth becomes...

KU-Lolo has a new idea to turn your fondest memories into unique Cube souvernirs in the Second Coming of Solaris! Head on over to the Memory Travelogue event, collect memories with the Cubes, and turn them in to KU-Lolo!
You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

voiceline.title: About Zani
voiceline.text: Zani is the definition of a proper adult. Working with her is so easy, so comfortable, and I never have to worry about anything going wrong...

scene.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

scene.quest: What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing
scene.desc: Following Carlotta's guidance, you arrive at the Penitent's End and reunite with the Troupe. Here, another buried secret of the Order awaits discovery...

What would the Captain of the Fool's Troupe normally do? Stage an impromptu performance or set out on a great adventure? Instead of speculating, why not hear it straight from Brant himself? A captivating journey surely awaits!

mention.title: New Stage
mention.text: Childhood memories were hazy for Roccia, but as she followed Brant and the crew into Ragunna's streets, the familiar smell of Trattoria Margherita's fresh-baked pizza and the songs spilling from the Odyssey Opera House stirred something deep within her, just like it did everyone else.
mention.source: Roccia's character story “New Stage”

mention.title: The Stars Still Burn Bright
mention.text: When night falls, the curtain will rise at Margherita's Restauraunt.
mention.source: Roccia brings up Margherita in “The Stars Still Burn Bright”

voiceline.title: About Jianxin
voiceline.text: Jianxin... her soul has a beautiful golden hue, and she is a person of respectable character.

voiceline.title: About Lingyang
voiceline.text: That young liondancer? His soul appears in a unique shape, similar to that of an animal... I'm a little ashamed to admit that I once mistook him for a beast from the wild... Ahem. Don't worry, I have since made a formal apology to him, and we've cleared up the misunderstanding.

scene.desc: As the city lights twinkle, friendly faces beckon you to join them in the bustling border town. Immerse yourself in its prosperous yet tranquil ambiance.
