scene.quest: Depths of Illusive Realm · event story

voiceline.title: About Baizhi
voiceline.text: Baizhi is a brilliant scholar. I once worked with her on a collaborative project, assigned by Madam Magistrate. She will no doubt become a prominent scholar at the Huaxu Academy, and eventually a significant contributor to the study of Remnant Ecoacoustics in Huanglong.

scene.desc: A blue figure guides you through the mist-it's the Shorekeeper. The bad news you've brought from the Port City to Guixu has unveiled a looming threat now casting its shadow over the Black Shores. An imminent danger awaits both you and the Black Shores.

Beneath what was once a brilliant and harmonious starry sky, chaos and tragedy now prevail. As the boundary between the virtual and the real begins to blur, where will the remnants of civilization find their path?
Shorekeeper might have some clues about Abby's weakening frequencies. Return to the Black Shores to find out.

voiceline.title: About Aalto
voiceline.text: A mature organization requires a personable and skilled negotiator, adept at forging connections with all they encounter. In the case of the Black Shores, that person is Aalto. His keen insight ensures he obtains crucial information precisely when needed. Beneath his playful smile lies a resolute determination to end the Lament. Despite other offers, he was destined for the Black Shores' path from the start.

mention.title: Hidden Between the Waves
mention.text: In times of great adversity, the Shorekeeper will reveal herself and support our true leader, who, at the destined moment, will rise to save and guide the Black Shores. Fantastical or not, that's all we've got to go on.
mention.source: Aalto brings up Shorekeeper in “Hidden Between the Waves” (5×)

mention.title: We Choose the Sky
mention.text: But... the Bloombearers who graduated from Startorch heard about this and stepped up to endorse Lucilla. That's what changed Shorekeeper's mind.
mention.source: Aalto brings up Shorekeeper in “We Choose the Sky” (2×)

mention.title: Through the Sea Thou Break
mention.text: I'll have Aalto arrange your transportation to Rinascita then.
mention.source: Shorekeeper brings up Aalto in “Through the Sea Thou Break”

scene.desc: You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

voiceline.title: About Encore
voiceline.text: Encore sees the world as a canvas for her boundless imagination. A warrior, a knight, or a little adventurer... In her tales, she can become anyone she wants to triumph over evil and reach a happy ending. Wherever she ventures, her radiant energy dispels dismay. Perhaps this is what Tethys saw in her when she was chosen.

mention.title: The One that Impresses
mention.text: Because I turned you into one! Miss Shorekeeper could only grant me a tiny bit of Tethys' computing power, so this Cube is the best I could manage for you.
mention.source: Encore brings up Shorekeeper in “The One that Impresses” (3×)

mention.title: Flowing Starlight in the Iris
mention.text: From the guest list you provided, only Encore, Buling, and myself were free to come. The others are either away or currently on assignment.
mention.source: Shorekeeper brings up Encore in “Flowing Starlight in the Iris” (3×)

scene.desc: Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.

Though the Threnodian Aleph-1 was banished, Lucilla finds herself in yet another predicament. In the absence of the Exostrider, funders are questioning whether the Synchronist program—and even the Rabelle College itself—should continue to exist. As both a professor and the head of the Academy, Lucilla must now choose between harsh reality and her ideals.

After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

voiceline.title: About Aemeath
voiceline.text: I really, really love Fleet Snowfluff's songs! But the last time she held a fan meeting, I was out on a frostlands field study... I-I hope I'll get another chance to attend! I would love to see her!

dialogue.desc: The Land of Xuanfang is thrown into turmoil following an unexpected riot of out-of-control Autopuppets. As you investigate, you uncover the mastermind behind the scheme—a mysterious Artisan who covets the Sentinel's technology. In the culmination of the event, this figure commands the rogue Autopuppets to launch an assault on Xuanfang Hold.

sample.speaker: Suisui
sample.text: This will not do. This will not do at all. You need to eat more, darling. How else am I supposed to enjoy hugging you?

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Sister, please! I'm not a child anymore. And I've been eating perfectly fine...

sample.speaker: Suisui
sample.text: Oh? Since when has my little Yangyang been so shy?

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Sui—sui—

sample.speaker: Suisui
sample.text: Mm... All these years, and you don't hang on to me anymore. I find that rather crushing...

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: That is not how it was! You were the one who dragged me everywhere. I missed so many of my vocal lessons...

dialogue.desc: Days after the Autopuppet crisis was solved, Yangyang chooses to stay behind in the Land of Xuanfang to assist the soldiers and the civilians. As she's waiting on her Resonance Assessment report, a mysterious voice starts to whisper in her ears...

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Sister?

sample.speaker: Suisui
sample.text: I ran into Rover back in the city. told me I could find you here, so here I am!

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: I see. I'm waiting for my Spectrum Test results.

sample.speaker: Suisui
sample.text: You know, when you came back with Rover, you looked so different it actually gave me a bit of a fright...

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Haha... I'm not quite sure how it happened either. By the time I came to, the change had already happened.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: But I'm still me. You don't need to worry.

dialogue.desc: With the great battle over, the Land of Xuanfang is slowly returning to how it once was, though plenty of aftershocks have yet to settle. Then one day, a WavesLine message from Yangyang arrives out of the blue: Suisui is about to head back to Mengzhou City...

sample.speaker: Suisui
sample.text: Take care of Yangyang. If you let her get lost... you'll have to answer to me.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Sister... I can hear you, you know...

sample.speaker: Suisui
sample.text: Well then, let's say goodbye now. One of these days, I'll give you both a proper tour of Mengzhou!

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: That qin music... I think I've heard it before.

scene.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

The Waking Moon Festival is drawing near in the Land of Xuanfang, yet rumors that "the Hold is doomed to fall" have begun to spread throughout the city. To find the Sentinel who has long been absent, you decide to head to where Hsin's presence was last felt—the Manifold Sanctum.

voiceline.title: About Yangyang
voiceline.text: Since we were children, people have said that Yangyang and I share only a face, that our spirits couldn't be more different. I was the one who needed to see everything the world had to offer, while she was the quiet, gentle center who kept her thoughts close. Over time, people even joked, asking if we were truly sisters at all. Neither of us ever took offense. We knew that in all this wide world, you could never find two souls more alike. My sister may look soft and unassuming, but there is a resilience in her that runs deeper than anyone realizes. When you need the wind, she brings it to you. When you face the gale, she stands as your shield. This, I've always known.

voiceline.title: About Mother
voiceline.text: People know her as a master composer, but to me, she remains that gentle presence on the porch, pulling my sister and me into her arms on rainy days to tell us stories of the world beyond. I was always pressing her for what came next, while Yangyang would just watch her in quiet, wide-eyed wonder. Hehe, I suppose that was the rhythm of our childhood.

mention.title: Thoughts: II
mention.text: I often dragged Yangyang out to fly kites.
mention.source: Suisui's voice line “Thoughts: II”

mention.title: Thoughts: III
mention.text: Yangyang, though, was my opposite.
mention.source: Suisui's voice line “Thoughts: III”

mention.title: The Wind Before the Storm
mention.text: I was thinking about the day Yangyang told Mother and me she was leaving for Jinzhou. I told her that if she'd found her path, then she needn't worry about anything else. Just take that step and go.
mention.source: Suisui brings up Yangyang in “The Wind Before the Storm” (6×)

mention.title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
mention.text: Oh, my poor Yangyang! You've gotten so thin! Is no one in Jinzhou looking after you? Do you not eat properly?
mention.source: Suisui brings up Yangyang in “Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled” (6×)

mention.title: Song of the Heart Sword
mention.text: Relax, darling. I am esteemed Chairwoman of the Zhaoming Commerce Guild. The eldest daughter in a family of musicians. And... Yangyang's big sister!
mention.source: Suisui brings up Yangyang in “Song of the Heart Sword” (5×)

mention.title: The Chant of Unseen Ties
mention.text: But in all seriousness, Yangyang, you might not be able to see it yourself...
mention.source: Suisui brings up Yangyang in “The Chant of Unseen Ties” (4×)

mention.title: A Chill Day Out
mention.text: Great! So I was just telling you how Yangyang used to be my little shopping shadow, trailing behind me and going "Sister..." whenever something caught her eye, right?
mention.source: Suisui brings up Yangyang in “A Chill Day Out” (2×)

mention.title: The Chant of Unseen Ties
mention.text: Suisui, no matter what, I'll always be your little sister. That's the one thing that will never change.
mention.source: Yangyang brings up Suisui in “The Chant of Unseen Ties” (3×)

mention.title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
mention.text: My voicemail is... wait. Ninety-nine missed calls?! Baizhi, Zhezhi, Taoqi, Suisui, Jianxin... even Magistrate Jinhsi called!
mention.source: Yangyang brings up Suisui in “Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled” (3×)

mention.title: Song of the Heart Sword
mention.text: Suisui, I really am fine... Rover and Paragon Qingxiao are the ones who went into the Sanctum. They faced all the real danger.
mention.source: Yangyang brings up Suisui in “Song of the Heart Sword” (2×)

scene.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

The Land of Xuanfang is thrown into turmoil following an unexpected riot of out-of-control Autopuppets. As you investigate, you uncover the mastermind behind the scheme—a mysterious Artisan who covets the Sentinel's technology. In the culmination of the event, this figure commands the rogue Autopuppets to launch an assault on Xuanfang Hold.

With the great battle over, the Land of Xuanfang is slowly returning to how it once was, though plenty of aftershocks have yet to settle. Then one day, a WavesLine message from Yangyang arrives out of the blue: Suisui is about to head back to Mengzhou City...

The Waking Moon Festival is drawing near in the Land of Xuanfang, yet rumors that "the Hold is doomed to fall" have begun to spread throughout the city. To find the Sentinel who has long been absent, you decide to head to where Hsin's presence was last felt—the Manifold Sanctum.

voiceline.title: About Qingxiao
voiceline.text: One of my merchant caravans once spoke of a Transcendent who killed the Tacet Discords blocking their path through Xuanfang. That was Paragon Qingxiao. Between that debt and the support she provided during the Hold's defense, I felt it only right to thank her in person. With proper gifts, of course. But she wouldn't accept a thing. She only sat for a few cups of the tea I brewed. Wait, a tea favored by the famed Transcendent... Now that could be quite the selling point, no?

voiceline.title: About Sanhua
voiceline.text: Oh, I wish I had someone like Sanhua. Imagine how much easier my work would be with her help. Where on earth did Lady Jinhsi find herself such an incredible bodyguard? I'll have to ask her about it next time we meet.

voiceline.title: About Xiangli Yao
voiceline.text: Mr. Xiangli? Yes, he is a great collaborator of ours at the Ministry of Development. Our work partially overlaps with the Academy's research projects, and I consult him daily. Despite his genius intellect and quick thinking, I have no issue keeping up with his ideas.

dialogue.desc: The previous puzzle's answers has been revealed, but it only leads to another one. With a storm on the horizon, you follow the Magistrate's advice and search for clues about "the Black Shores".

sample.speaker: Verina
sample.text: What seems to be the trouble? If there's anything I can help you with...

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: We're looking for a special flower...

sample.speaker: Verina
sample.text: Hmm... It's an unusual flower indeed. Pure black flowers are rarely found in nature. We can't rule out the possibility that it's been dyed.

sample.speaker: Verina
sample.text: When looking at the structure, there are a few types of flowers that seem similar.

sample.speaker: Verina
sample.text: Take Iris, for example. Its petals are similarly oval-shaped, but it has double petals.

sample.speaker: Verina
sample.text: It's not Viola, either, since Viola has notched petals.

scene.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

voiceline.title: About Yangyang
voiceline.text: Miss Yangyang was curious about my plant growing skills, and she asked me many questions earlier. Then, she patiently listened to me explaining details for a long, long time. Hanging out with her feels like basking in a gentle breeze.

mention.title: A little Time Off
mention.text: And then she saw her friends waving to her: Chixia and Yangyang were walking towards her with freshly purchased Salted Milk Tea in their hands.
mention.source: Verina's character story “A little Time Off”

mention.title: Rewinding Raindrops
mention.text: We've been seeing these black petals for a while now... They're scattered all over the place, I'm sure they're not made by Miss Verina.
mention.source: Yangyang brings up Verina in “Rewinding Raindrops” (2×)

dialogue.desc: The previous puzzle's answers has been revealed, but it only leads to another one. With a storm on the horizon, you follow the Magistrate's advice and search for clues about "the Black Shores".

sample.speaker: Verina
sample.text: Come on, Verina, you can do it...

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: No way? That's amazing, seriously! It looks exactly like the flower in that picture!

sample.speaker: Verina
sample.text: T-thank you, it's nothing... I'm glad I could help.

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: It's friggin amazing! Could you do that again? Please! I love it!

scene.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

voiceline.title: About Chixia
voiceline.text: Miss Chixia once fed me a spoonful of her Victor Savor... I-I couldn't believe how spicy it was! What kind of pepper was that? Ow, my mouth still burns just thinking about it.

mention.title: A little Time Off
mention.text: And then she saw her friends waving to her: Chixia and Yangyang were walking towards her with freshly purchased Salted Milk Tea in their hands.
mention.source: Verina's character story “A little Time Off”

mention.title: Rewinding Raindrops
mention.text: Hi, Verina! I'm Chixa, this is Yangyang, and he/she's Rover! Grandma Lin told us we should come find you!
mention.source: Chixia brings up Verina in “Rewinding Raindrops” (3×)

scene.quest: Depths of Illusive Realm · event story

voiceline.title: About Baizhi
voiceline.text: Did you know? "Baizhi" is actually an old name for Angelica, a plant that can bloom beautiful flowers in freezing temperatures. It kinda makes me think of Miss Baizhi herself—some might say she seems a bit chilly, but I have a feeling she's got a warm and gentle heart underneath.

scene.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

scene.quest: Depths of Illusive Realm · event story

voiceline.title: About Mortefi
voiceline.text: Mr. Mortefi's dedication to his work is remarkable, but I do worry about his well-being... I mean, we all know how important the research project is, but a good night's sleep is just as crucial! Whenever I go and check on the nocturnal plants at night, I can see the lights on in his lab from a distance.

scene.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

The Land of Xuanfang is thrown into turmoil following an unexpected riot of out-of-control Autopuppets. As you investigate, you uncover the mastermind behind the scheme—a mysterious Artisan who covets the Sentinel's technology. In the culmination of the event, this figure commands the rogue Autopuppets to launch an assault on Xuanfang Hold.

voiceline.title: About Jinhsi
voiceline.text: Magistrate Jinhsi has been paying close attention to the battles against Tacet Discords. She often visits the Academy to learn about our latest progress in weapons development. During those visits, she always seems tense. I understand the pressure and weight she carries, with all the promises and expectations placed on her shoulders...

voiceline.title: About Jiyan
voiceline.text: The Midnight Rangers bring valuable insights on Tacet Discords from their years of combat experience. General Jiyan has shared his extensive knowledge and new ideas with us. He possesses a gentle and just nature, but what truly sets him apart is his composure. This is essential for someone in his position.

mention.title: Wish Upon the Moon III: Dreaming of Heroism
mention.text: A fine suggestion. I have always admired General Jiyan.
mention.source: Xiangli Yao brings up Jiyan in “Wish Upon the Moon III: Dreaming of Heroism”

voiceline.title: About Aalto
voiceline.text: Aalto once approached me with an offer from the Black Shores, but I declined. Life at the Academy suits me well. Though his manner may seem unserious, Aalto has a sharp eye for valuable information and connections for rare materials. I've frequently relied on his services.

dialogue.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Rover, did you see that?

sample.speaker: Taoqi
sample.text: Now it's almost identical to what we saw three years ago, during the "Battle Beneath the Crescent".

sample.speaker: Taoqi
sample.text: I'm afraid... We're already running out of time.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: Report the situation, please.

sample.speaker: Taoqi
sample.text: Madam Magistrate, the barrier has been fully repaired and we have evacuated all residents. We've successfully minimized the damage.

voiceline.title: About Taoqi
voiceline.text: Ms. Taoqi is always gracefully poised. She is the kind of person to quickly produce multiple solutions with ease in the most urgent situations, with a smile on her face: "Don't worry. I've got it sorted." Her seemingly unhurried demeanor must have been earned through hard work that we don't know about.

mention.title: Grand Warstorm
mention.text: Yangyang, you're one of our Outriders. I hope you can go with Rover and provide assistance.
mention.source: Taoqi brings up Yangyang in “Grand Warstorm” (2×)

mention.title: Grand Warstorm
mention.text: The Tacet Field Director Taoqi mentioned should be right up ahead. We must pass through it to reach our base and find General Jiyan.
mention.source: Yangyang brings up Taoqi in “Grand Warstorm”

mention.title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
mention.text: My voicemail is... wait. Ninety-nine missed calls?! Baizhi, Zhezhi, Taoqi, Suisui, Jianxin... even Magistrate Jinhsi called!
mention.source: Yangyang brings up Taoqi in “Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled”

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Yinlin!

sample.speaker: Yinlin
sample.text: Rover, you came because you were worried about me?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Let's take them down together.

sample.speaker: Yinlin
sample.text: Hehe, no rush. They'll be leaving soon.

sample.speaker: Yinlin
sample.text: Acknowledged... Is that our only option...?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (Yinlin seems to be on a call with someone.)

sample.speaker: Yinlin
sample.text: But... I believe it's unnecessary...

sample.speaker: Yinlin
sample.text: Yes... Understood... I'll have it taken care of.

sample.speaker: Yinlin
sample.text: Yes... It's my contact from the PSB.

sample.speaker: Yinlin
sample.text: They'll be sending people over soon. We can leave Lirong and Yuanyuan in their care.

dialogue.summary: During the conversation, you discover that the woman is actually a Patroller named Yinlin. Yinlin is on the trail of those responsible and invites you to meet her outside the city if you want to learn more about the case.

dialogue.desc: Enforce justice and cleanse the crimes lurking in the shadow before the Moon-Chasing Festival is around, now! Unlock a new Companion after completing this quest.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: The person you're after... Is he an Exile?

sample.speaker: Yinlin
sample.text: Exactly. Exiles aren't allowed in Jinzhou. To sneak in, he disguised himself and didn't wear the Exiles' uniform.

sample.speaker: Yinlin
sample.text: His name is Lei. He used to involve in petty crimes and just got out of prison a few days ago.

sample.speaker: Yinlin
sample.text: Used to be my informant before I became an undercover agent myself, but he fled at a critical moment.

sample.speaker: Yinlin
sample.text: Something feels off about him being here... It seems he's talking to someone. Let's find out what he's up to.

dialogue.quest: Where Stars Cascade Down · event story

sample.speaker: Yinlin
sample.text: It's been a long time, Rover.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: ...Are you in the middle of some urgent mission?

sample.speaker: Yinlin
sample.text: Mission? Not at all. But sure, proper code words and disguises are essential for an undercover agent. Especially at a party with such a mixed crowd.

sample.speaker: Yinlin
sample.text: Heh, relax. I've already scoped the area. No one's listening in on us.

sample.speaker: Yinlin
sample.text: Besides, like I said, I'm not here on assignment. I'm simply "Yinlin," on vacation.

sample.speaker: Yinlin
sample.text: It's a long story. Remember Yangyang, the Outrider? She told me about what you went through after Rinascita.

sample.speaker: Yinlin
sample.text: Rover. We really have to stop "running into" each other like this.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I've got about a hundred questions. But first... It's been a minute, Yinlin.

sample.speaker: Yinlin
sample.text: Sure has. Gotta say, after everything that went down at Xuanfang Hold, I can guess your questions well enough.

sample.speaker: Yinlin
sample.text: I'll give you a straight answer. Just one, though.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Hmm...

sample.speaker: Yinlin
sample.text: Heh. That's a sly one. All right, then.

scene.desc: A mysterious request, a lost delivery, an opening gateway... In a realm where dreams and nightmares intertwine, a massive shadow looms around you. It casts a darkness over reality, opening the gateways to dreams across Jinzhou. It asks you, if beauty is fleeting and salvation is futile, why not remain in a dream...

With the crisis behind you, Liangyu seems to have something to discuss. Go find out what it is when you have a moment. You may soon be seeing that Nethermancer who worked alongside you at the Manifold Sanctum.

The Waking Moon Festival is drawing near in the Land of Xuanfang, yet rumors that "the Hold is doomed to fall" have begun to spread throughout the city. To find the Sentinel who has long been absent, you decide to head to where Hsin's presence was last felt—the Manifold Sanctum.

voiceline.title: About Rover
voiceline.text: Being skilled as a Patroller doesn't necessarily make one suited for undercover work, but curiously enough I see potential in you. Have you considered applying to the Bureau? Just kidding, unless you're interested.

mention.title: Dreamscape Odyssey: Neverending Inferno
mention.text: Yinlin, calm down!
mention.source: Rover brings up Yinlin in “Dreamscape Odyssey: Neverending Inferno” (2×)

mention.title: Solitary Path
mention.text: (I should check this place out while Yinlin's gone. Might find something about that Dollmaker.)
mention.source: Rover brings up Yinlin in “Solitary Path” (6×)

mention.title: Simulacrum of the Heart/Extra
mention.text: Yinlin, I know you only gave me one question, but... was this really a coincidence?
mention.source: Rover brings up Yinlin in “Simulacrum of the Heart/Extra” (2×)

voiceline.title: About Lingyang
voiceline.text: That liondancer... Lingyang, I think? He surely knows how to come up with those Lucky Greetings. They sound cool. Almost as cool as my poems, I'll give him that!

voiceline.title: About Mortefi
voiceline.text: Even though I haven't chatted with him much, I can tell that Mortefi dude is a man of culture. Fingers crossed he becomes my client one day!

scene.desc: A blue figure guides you through the mist-it's the Shorekeeper. The bad news you've brought from the Port City to Guixu has unveiled a looming threat now casting its shadow over the Black Shores. An imminent danger awaits both you and the Black Shores.

voiceline.title: About Chixia
voiceline.text: A Jinzhou Patroller... Uhh, gotta stay away from her... Hey, I've done nothing bad! Just used a few... tricks, to get back what belongs to the right people. Surely that's not a crime... right?

voiceline.title: About Danjin
voiceline.text: We're about the same age, but Danjin's much taller than me... The jade she wears is so pretty! *sigh*... It's a shame I can't feel a single joyful frequency from it...

voiceline.title: About Jianxin
voiceline.text: What's up with that mirror she carries, you ask? Oh my, oh my! That's a big, BIG secret. Not for your ears!

scene.quest: Depths of Illusive Realm · event story

voiceline.title: About Danjin
voiceline.text: I can sense a dangerous aura from Danjin's way of fighting... I'm worried that she may have far too much burden on her shoulders at such a young age.

scene.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

voiceline.title: About Chixia
voiceline.text: Every morning, when I opened the gym, Chixia was already patrolling the street with exuberant energy. *chuckle*... I must keep up with my exercises too. Can't be outdone by the younger generations.

scene.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

scene.quest: Depths of Illusive Realm · event story

voiceline.title: About Rover
voiceline.text: Your poise and comfidence are impressive. Such remarkable character can't possibly be built overnight. I can tell you've experienced far more than I have.

dialogue.quest: The Sacred Breeze So Often Breathes
dialogue.desc: After a minor twist in the journey, Ragunna, the Land of Echoes, unfolds its grandeur, extending a grand welcome to the traveler from distant shores.

sample.speaker: Margherita
sample.text: Ciao, Zani! Knocking off early today, huh?

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: Not really... still on duty.

sample.speaker: Margherita
sample.text: Is that so? You seem alright, considering. So, what will it be today? The "Adios, Workdays" or the "Thank Goodness It's the Holiday" platter?

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: ...The last one. Thanks.

sample.speaker: Margherita
sample.text: And this here... A visitor from afar? It's a pleasure.

sample.speaker: Margherita
sample.text: I see. You certainly have the air of someone who matters.

scene.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

scene.quest: A Stranger in a Strange Land
scene.desc: In this battle that sealed the fate of Rinascita, its people rose in defiance. And among them stood another, a swordsman of Huanglong, guided across the seas by Huanglong Mingting to lend you his strength. He fought as one among the countless souls drawn to this hour, but the story of his own journey, and the shadows of his past, remain known to few...

scene.quest: What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing
scene.desc: Following Carlotta's guidance, you arrive at the Penitent's End and reunite with the Troupe. Here, another buried secret of the Order awaits discovery...
It's time for the Vault to assess Bakethoven's capabilities. Can its dream finally come true?

mention.title: Favorite Food
mention.text: My go-to restaurant is Trattoria Margherita.
mention.source: Zani's voice line “Favorite Food”

mention.title: Ideals
mention.text: The sea breeze that greets you, the bustling plaza filled with familiar faces, the shiny new products in shop windows, the aroma of food from Trattoria Margherita.
mention.source: Zani's voice line “Ideals”

mention.title: "A Regular"
mention.text: Margherita yawned. "Ciao, Margherita.
mention.source: Zani's character story “"A Regular"”

mention.title: Eve of the Carnevale
mention.text: "If she arrives at lunch time, I can suggest dinning at Trattoria Margherita for Ragunna's specialities.
mention.source: Zani's character story “Eve of the Carnevale”

mention.title: The Sacred Breeze So Often Breathes
mention.text: Yes. The nearest one is Trattoria Margherita. I personally recommend Pizza Tropicale. Would you like to dine there?
mention.source: Zani brings up Margherita in “The Sacred Breeze So Often Breathes” (2×)

mention.title: The Sacred Breeze So Often Breathes
mention.text: Oh, good choice! Zani's taste will never let you down.
mention.source: Margherita brings up Zani in “The Sacred Breeze So Often Breathes” (2×)

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: The Echo ships are still undergoing repairs. The family's shipyard is also operating beyond capacity and cannot free up berths for new ships anytime soon...

sample.speaker: Cantarella
sample.text: Perhaps the lower decks of Porto-Veno Castle could alleviate this issue.

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: I have heard the Fisalias first secured their standing through deep-sea fishing...

sample.speaker: Cantarella
sample.text: Quite right. That was once the family's shipyard, though long idle due to certain historical circumstances. If needed, we can grant the Montellis access.

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: Well then, Lady Cantatrella. What are your terms...?

sample.speaker: Cantarella
sample.text: As expected, your insight is as sharp as ever, Miss Carlotta. Terms... naturally, there are some.

voiceline.title: About Cantarella
voiceline.text: The Fisalia family has always clung to Ragunna's traditions, stubbornly resisting change. But Signorina Cantarella, the current head, isn't as traditional as people imagine. As an employee, I do not get to influence how the Montellis handle their relationship with the Fisalias... but personally, I wouldn't mind working with her.

timeline.quest: A Stranger in a Strange Land

dialogue.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: But even with their help and the potion, we're still far from our goal... We fought through the illusions, but we still need an Anchor to open a path to the Journeying Paradise.

sample.speaker: Ciaccona
sample.text: I have an idea! If Leviathan found Its Anchor of Reality to summon the Tidespawn into our world...

voiceline.title: About Ciaccona
voiceline.text: I've seen Ciaccona perform a few times outside the city. She often sings about Rinascita's old folklore. I once asked her if she thought the age of heroes described in her poems had ended, whether heroes had already exited the stage of history. She answered that as long as there is suffering, someone will rise up to be the new hero.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (Strange... I clearly sensed the Dark Tide's presence around here. So why does everything seem normal?)

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: Gunfire. We've got intruders.

dialogue.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (But at the same time...)

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: Lady Carlotta, we've finished tallying all our losses. Here's the full report for your review.

dialogue.quest: Veils Off in Sun or Shadow
dialogue.desc: To understand Gilberto's part in the Echo incident, you trace his steps to the outskirts of the city. But the deep you delve, the more elusive the truth becomes...

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: They are all mad... So this is what they've been planning all along.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: We have to do something.

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: You two go ahead. I'll stay here and watch him until the family arrives, just in case he gets any bright ideas.

sample.speaker: Phoebe
sample.text: I'll stay with you. After all, this could provoke outcry from the Fisalia family. If I testify about Gilberto's misdeeds on behalf of the Order, they can't deny the facts or exploit the situation.

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: I agree. But what about you, Rover...

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: All right. There's a port nearby where you can catch a Gondola. It can take you close to the Atrium of Reflections.

dialogue.quest: The Sacred Breeze So Often Breathes
dialogue.desc: After a minor twist in the journey, Ragunna, the Land of Echoes, unfolds its grandeur, extending a grand welcome to the traveler from distant shores.

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: Ahem. Sorry, too much. I'll do my best to meet your needs during your stay here.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Don't worry about me, I can handle myself without involving the Montellis. I'm not one for formalities, so let's keep it relaxed.

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: ...If that's what you want.

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: Thank you, Rover. All that formality was starting to feel like exercise.

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: Let's go get something to eat, shall we?

dialogue.desc: KU-Lolo has a new idea to turn your fondest memories into unique Cube souvernirs in the Second Coming of Solaris! Head on over to the Memory Travelogue event, collect memories with the Cubes, and turn them in to KU-Lolo!

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: Now, try the Nectarwine from Egla Town. It's aged in oak barrels from the Fagaceae Peninsula, known as the "Harvest Spirit" or "Gocce di Divino" for its exceptional flavor.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: So this is the Gocce di Divino.

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: To you, guests from afar...

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: ...and my vacation that never seems to come.

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: So here I am, working part-time… on my vacation. Tch. Guess that's how it goes when you're too damn good at what you do.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: So, I take it things in the Black Alley are wrapped up?

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: Yeah. The Chamber of Discipline and the Family took down Talos and everyone colluding with her.

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: Turns out, the folks in the Black Alley were just stuck in the mess. Those who weren't too deep in it, like Colleen, were pardoned.

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: I helped them apply for the Family's support fund and set some stalls up here. Should give them a shot at starting fresh.

dialogue.quest: Where Stars Cascade Down · event story

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: Ahem. Don't worry. If I can find a decent sofa and sit for a while, I'll be fine.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Rough day at work?

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: Not really. Technically, I'm on vacation.

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: Ragunna's been quiet, so Lady Carlotta's promise of paid leave finally came through. I'm just here to breathe a little.

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: It's true, I swear by this year's bonus. No work piling up, no sudden comms dragging me back to the Vault.

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: Haha, it's hard to believe, I know. How should I put it…

dialogue.desc: You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: Hello.

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: ...Could you leave a good review in the survey, please?

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: Working.

scene.quest: A Stranger in a Strange Land
scene.desc: In this battle that sealed the fate of Rinascita, its people rose in defiance. And among them stood another, a swordsman of Huanglong, guided across the seas by Huanglong Mingting to lend you his strength. He fought as one among the countless souls drawn to this hour, but the story of his own journey, and the shadows of his past, remain known to few...

scene.quest: What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing
scene.desc: Following Carlotta's guidance, you arrive at the Penitent's End and reunite with the Troupe. Here, another buried secret of the Order awaits discovery...

voiceline.title: About Jianxin
voiceline.text: Before I came to Jinzhou, I once met her training in the mountains. She had journeyed far and wide, sharing tales of the incredible places she'd been. Her views on nature completely changed how I paint. That deep focus she had while training... I aim for that same focus in my own art.

voiceline.title: About Verina
voiceline.text: I often run into her when I'm out painting. I'm curious about the habits of plants, and she's really into what they mean in Huanglong culture. So we end up spending a lot of time just squatting by some plant, chatting.

voiceline.title: About Youhu
voiceline.text: She's got a real knack for appraising antiques, and knows all about where the rare old paintings are kept. If she hadn't told me where to find those friendly collectors, I'd never have gotten to see the originals with my own eyes. Though she's never told me how she gets her info, I can tell it's not easy. So now and then, I slip some money into her pocket when she's not looking!

dialogue.quest: Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song
dialogue.desc: The frequencies building up within Patty have resonated with the environment and generated a Sonoro Sphere. The truth about the fourth wish may be hidden therein. The name Patty keeps mumbling about seems to be connected with Xiangli Yao. You must head it off at the pass before things get out of hands at the Moonlit Fair.

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Let's go check it out!

sample.speaker: Zhezhi
sample.text: P-please, I'm not photogenic...

scene.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

The Land of Xuanfang is thrown into turmoil following an unexpected riot of out-of-control Autopuppets. As you investigate, you uncover the mastermind behind the scheme—a mysterious Artisan who covets the Sentinel's technology. In the culmination of the event, this figure commands the rogue Autopuppets to launch an assault on Xuanfang Hold.

voiceline.title: About Chixia
voiceline.text: Oh! She once invited me to dinner, and I said yes. However, when I arrived at the restaurant, it turned out to be a large gathering with dozens of people… I was quite nervous, but she was super nice, always making sure I was okay. Thanks to that, I actually met a lot of new people... and some of them even became my clients later on.

mention.title: The Wind Before the Storm
mention.text: Chixia and Yangyang were the ones on this case, but two days after they left the city, Chixia was brought back by the Midnight Rangers due to serious injuries. And Yangyang... she wasn't with her.
mention.source: Zhezhi brings up Chixia in “The Wind Before the Storm” (4×)

timeline.quest: Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song

voiceline.title: About Lingyang
voiceline.text: His lion dancing... it's really something. So precise and yet so full of life. I once walked by a lion dance performance and tried to sketch it quickly, but the movements kept changing... My pencil couldn't keep up. So, I ended up going to the theater a few more times just to watch. Before I knew it, I actually started enjoying the liondances quite a bit.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: Scar, you are now under arrest for committing multiple felonies in Huanglong. Do you have anything to say?

sample.speaker: Scar
sample.text: What do I want to say, huh? While I'd love to tell you another story... I guess that's not what you want to hear.

sample.speaker: Scar
sample.text: Let's cut to the chase, "Madam Magistrate". I'm getting bored already.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: Very well. You will answer only our questions from now on.

sample.speaker: Scar
sample.text: Sure, why not. What do you want to know?

sample.speaker: Scar
sample.text: A Sentinel such as Jué can predict and "correct" future events. It gets in our way of achieving our sublime vision.

mention.title: Clashing Blades
mention.text: I have a plan to apprehend Scar. Once we capture him, the Fractsidus won't be that much of a threat to you for the time being.
mention.source: Jinhsi brings up Scar in “Clashing Blades” (4×)

sample.speaker: Scar
sample.text: What is the truth you've uncovered?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: The shepherd was granting wishes by sacrificing the lives of lambs. The flock found out the truth but chose to be his accomplices, and they willingly offered the black lamb as another sacrifice.

sample.speaker: Scar
sample.text: Hahaha, that's right!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: The shepherd was granting wishes by sacrificing the lives of lambs. The flock never found out about it. They were deceived into believing the black lamb was the culprit.

sample.speaker: Scar
sample.text: Almost there, Rover.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: The shepherd was granting wishes by sacrificing the lives of lambs. The flock never found out about it. Someone came to their rescue, and they all made it out alive.

sample.speaker: Scar
sample.text: Til we meet again, dear friends.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: You're not going anywhere!

scene.desc: As the city lights twinkle, friendly faces beckon you to join them in the bustling border town. Immerse yourself in its prosperous yet tranquil ambiance.
With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

You and Lupa follow the Lioness of Glory to the burial ground of the heroes and into a world of growing uncertainty. At the same time, you start to wonder if Lupa, your companion on this journey, is friend or foe. Cheers sound distorted. Fate has been woven. You have a choice to make, and your choice will determine how the story ends.

The Dreamer seals her heart and surrenders to a world of dreams beyond mortal sight. In this hidden realm built upon melancholy melodies, she walks a path of fragile hope and delusions without looking back. But the dreams she longs to realize have long been tangled up in shadow and deceit. Beneath the lofty facade of the Orchestrator, who seems to have everything, is but a wretched, pitiful soul, drowning in her own illusions. In the end, will this dream of blooming and withering be a sweet reverie or a haunting nightmare?

mention.source: Rover brings up Scar in “Flames of Heart” (2×)

mention.text: The order to hunt down Scar in Rinascita came straight from Mingting. Even Jinhsi was left in the dark.
mention.source: Rover brings up Scar in “A Stranger in a Strange Land” (2×)

mention.title: Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song
mention.text: Or maybe... he holds the key? Is it similar to what Scar did to me... No, I can't tell for sure yet.
mention.source: Rover brings up Scar in “Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song”

mention.title: Shadow of Glory
mention.text: Scar, your nameless ally, and you... The Fractsidus seems to revel in the company of those with twisted obsessions.
mention.source: Rover brings up Scar in “Shadow of Glory”

mention.title: All That Sunlight Touches
mention.text: Three: Cristoforo, Phrolova, and Scar. Plus the Grand Architect you mentioned.
mention.source: Rover brings up Scar in “All That Sunlight Touches”

mention.title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
mention.text: (Phrolova and Scar... Their appearance was too well-timed, like they knew our strategy all along. Meanwhile, Cristoforo's just biding his time in the shadows. This must be just the beginning.)
mention.source: Rover brings up Scar in “Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides”

sample.speaker: Sanhua
sample.text: Watch out!

sample.speaker: Scar
sample.text: You are one of us, the "black lambs", and you have been chosen to join us ushering in the new world...

sample.speaker: Scar
sample.text: Once you discover what you really are, you will come to us with no hesitation.

sample.speaker: Scar
sample.text: The Fractsidus awaits your arrival with open arms.

sample.speaker: Scar
sample.text: And I look forward to that day in sincere anticipation...

mention.text: When we captured Scar, he claimed that the Fractsidus had imprisoned our Sentinel.

dialogue.desc: As the city lights twinkle, friendly faces beckon you to join them in the bustling border town. Immerse yourself in its prosperous yet tranquil ambiance.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (It seems there may be hidden dangers lurking in Jinzhou...)

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: If it were you, Yangyang, what would you do to make sure the recipient gets what you mean?

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: ...I would emphasize my true message by repeating it, again and again.

dialogue.desc: As the tides of danger retreat, Jinzhou appears tranquil and vibrant. But beyond its borders lies a fierce and desperate battleground.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: I was worried... You just stood there and gazed into the distance. You were unresponsive when I tried talking to you. What did you see?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: It felt as if I was seeing through the eyes of a Tacet Discord. I think... I saw what was happening in the Norfall Barrens.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: An imposing warrior wielding the power of a Qingloong... The Qingloong is the Midnight Rangers' emblem. It's also the symbol of General Jiyan, the leader of all Midnight Rangers.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: The front lines are not far from here. General Jiyan must be there, fighting alongside our soldiers to keep the Tacet Discords away.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: It doesn't seem like a coincidence. We arrived near the battlefield right when General Jiyan was leading an attack against the Tacet Discords...

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: A woman in red who can control the Tacet Discord...

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: The Fractsidus is likely behind it all.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: The Fractsidus?

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Yes. I don't know much about the Fractsidus, but as an Outrider, I've worked on related cases.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: It's a group of extremists obsessed with fusing humans with Tacet Discords. They've caused terror attacks of various scales around the world.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Fusing humans and Tacet Discords...

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: We've seen signs of their presence in Jinzhou, left by lower-ranked members called "Artificers".

dialogue.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (But that also means...)

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: But that also means...

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: In countless tomorrows lie countless possibilities...

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Where our paths intertwine.

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Hello—! Yangyang! You comin' or what?

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Yes, I'm coming.

dialogue.desc: The Land of Xuanfang is thrown into turmoil following an unexpected riot of out-of-control Autopuppets. As you investigate, you uncover the mastermind behind the scheme—a mysterious Artisan who covets the Sentinel's technology. In the culmination of the event, this figure commands the rogue Autopuppets to launch an assault on Xuanfang Hold.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: If it is, it's far too...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Hey, relax. Feel that? I'm right here.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Yes... You're just much earlier than I expected.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: And yet, much later than I'd hoped.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: I'm sorry. I couldn't stop him.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: No, we couldn't stop him.

dialogue.desc: Days after the Autopuppet crisis was solved, Yangyang chooses to stay behind in the Land of Xuanfang to assist the soldiers and the civilians. As she's waiting on her Resonance Assessment report, a mysterious voice starts to whisper in her ears...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Yangyang, Huaxu Institute is asking for you.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Yes, I know. I received their message as well...

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Rover, I should go. It's only a routine Spectrum Test. Shouldn't take long.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: ...How have you been feeling the last few days?

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Well, nothing out of the ordinary... I'm still trying to get the hang of this new Forte.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: I can undo altered frequencies and restore them... But which frequencies it works on, and how much I can actually undo... that, I still don't know.

dialogue.desc: With the great battle over, the Land of Xuanfang is slowly returning to how it once was, though plenty of aftershocks have yet to settle. Then one day, a WavesLine message from Yangyang arrives out of the blue: Suisui is about to head back to Mengzhou City...

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: That's good. We don't know what awaits in the Sanctum, so conserve your strength.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Is everything all right here?

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: The surrounding defenses are complete. Many civilians volunteered to help. And another wave of reinforcements from Jinzhou just arrived.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Jinzhou answered at once, but recent activity from the Threnodian in the Norfall Barrens has tied down their main force.

sample.speaker: Qingxiao
sample.text: Ovathrax...

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Only a small group could come, but they're elite Rangers. They will make a difference.

phoneSample.speaker: Yangyang
phoneSample.text: Rover, are you free right now?

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: What's going on? Did something happen?

phoneSample.speaker: Yangyang
phoneSample.text: My sister...

phoneSample.speaker: Yangyang
phoneSample.text: She's about to go back to Mengzhou City!

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: Where is Suisui now? She hasn't left yet, has she?

phoneSample.speaker: Yangyang
phoneSample.text: She's with me... We're almost at the checkpoint to leave the Land of Xuanfang.

dialogue.desc: The Waking Moon Festival is drawing near in the Land of Xuanfang, yet rumors that "the Hold is doomed to fall" have begun to spread throughout the city. To find the Sentinel who has long been absent, you decide to head to where Hsin's presence was last felt—the Manifold Sanctum.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: If my messages get through, send something back. A line or two is enough.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Yangyang, your messages came through.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Things inside the Sanctum are complicated. There's a lot going on below the surface. But don't worry, I'm doing fine.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Once I've handled things in here, I'll be back.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Mm...

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: I see.

dialogue.desc: Riddle Twiddle is offering a limited special prize! Join Yangyang and try to win it! Unlock a new Companion after completing this quest.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Done! The answer is... 5 rabbits and 9 chickens!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (First, suppose that all of them are chickens, then calculate the difference in the number of legs, getting the amount of rabbits... I see.)

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: There are 5 rabbits and 9 chickens.

sample.speaker: Xieyang
sample.text: Correct! You figured it out even faster than Mr. Bosong. I'm impressed.

sample.speaker: Xieyang
sample.text: For the last riddle, how about we change things up a bit? You two can pick one from any of the lanterns.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Umm... I don't really see any riddles...

dialogue.desc: Amidst a ripple of Reverberations, you hear the call... As you unravel your past, a new path unfolds before you, beckoning from the unknown.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: This is... a holographic message to all of Jinzhou from the City Hall.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: My fellow soldiers and citizens, I apologize for any inconvenience caused. I am Jinhsi, the Magistrate of Jinzhou.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: As the Moon-chasing Festival approaches, our city welcomes visitors from around the world. The festivities are highly anticipated by our people, and I, too, share in this joyful sentiment.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: Jinzhou has always been a crucial defense against the Tacet Discord Outbreaks, safeguarding Huanglong. We have a heavy responsibility on our shoulders with no room for retreat or failure.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: It is the dedication of our warriors, along with the diligence of our citizens, that has allowed us to thrive in peace and prosperity.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: Despite the challenges of Tacet Discord, we remain steadfast and hospitable to visitors, upholding our enduring traditions.

dialogue.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: And the Retroact Rain falling... Rover, maybe this is "the right time" Madam Magistrate was talking about?

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: ...Citizens of Jinzhou, please remain calm and evacuate in an orderly manner as we practiced during previous drills...

dialogue.desc: The Land of Xuanfang is thrown into turmoil following an unexpected riot of out-of-control Autopuppets. As you investigate, you uncover the mastermind behind the scheme—a mysterious Artisan who covets the Sentinel's technology. sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: ...If it means I can help everyone, then yes.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: Then it is settled. I will speak with General Jiyan and arrange for your temporary transfer to the Xuanfang Ministry of War.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: Rover, I trust you to look after Yangyang on behalf of us here in Jinzhou.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Yes. And when that time comes, we'll bring everyone together for a celebration.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: A wonderful idea. We'll be waiting for you to come home.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: ...Citizens of Jinzhou, please remain calm and evacuate in an orderly manner as we practiced during previous drills...

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: It's a pre-recorded broadcast message. Our Magistrate saw this coming, and she had General Jiyan devise an emergency plan a long time ago.

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: This wave of TD attacks should be over now.

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: We knew this was coming and we were ready, but oh boy, the amount of TDs is insane.

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Thanks for coming in time, Rover. It would've taken us much longer to handle this.

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Oh, Director Taoqi is here too. For a better run down of the situation, you can find her near the city gate!

dialogue.desc: Jinhsi has gone missing, and you just had an enigmatic dream.... That Wayfinder at the ferry may hold answers to these mysteries.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Weren't they concerned about losing lifespan?

sample.speaker: Changli
sample.text: For those fanatics, nothing mattered more than the truth.

sample.speaker: Changli
sample.text: To live every moment with overwhelming passion... How many can claim such a tenacious drive and unshakable determination?

dialogue.summary: In the pouring rain, you encounter Changli, the Wayfinder, at the ferry. Changli speculates that your dreams might be a glimpse into your past and a light guiding you into the future.

dialogue.desc: According to Xinyi, Hongzhen's Mayor, Jinhsi has gone off to Truthseeker's Pass, or the Court of Savantae Ruins. The Cipher Key stored in the heart of Truthseeker's Pass is a precondition to opening Mianloong Chamber and the audience with Jué, the Sentinel.

sample.speaker: Changli
sample.text: "With one of the Temporal Programs lost"... It no longer had the power to restore time, instead it could only stop and rewind it.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: So the Sentinel protected Hongzhen with its power, but it couldn't return things back to normal?

sample.speaker: Changli
sample.text: It would seem so...

sample.speaker: Changli
sample.text: According to their theories, the Sentinel's injury would worsen over time. And if the Sentinel perishes... the Temporal Disruptions will spiral out of control, engulfing all of Jinzhou.

sample.speaker: Changli
sample.text: So the Fractsidus just added a pinch of salt to the already gaping wounds on Mt. Firmament...

sample.speaker: Changli
sample.text: There is nothing we can do. At least that's what it says on these records.

dialogue.quest: Dreamscape Odyssey: A Study in Snow

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: How did you know they killed Jing?

sample.speaker: Changli
sample.text: No child would go in thin pajamas in such freezing conditions.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: So you realized it was orchestrated by the Fractsidus...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: You know this is a dream, right?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Then why didn't you try to escape?

sample.speaker: Changli
sample.text: To win a game, you must first play it.

dialogue.desc: You meet an old storyteller when you roam about in Hongzhen. While you listen to the the immortality tales about Mt. Firmament, you notice another interested listener...

sample.speaker: Changli
sample.text: Oh? And what makes you think so?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Those tokens from Jinhsi... It was your idea, was it not?

sample.speaker: Changli
sample.text: *chuckle *...So you've guessed it.

sample.speaker: Changli
sample.text: Sorry, Rover. Jinzhou faced multiple threats back then, and we had to be cautious. We did not intend to inconvenience you. I regret our lack of hospitality.

sample.speaker: Changli
sample.text: Still, I owe you an apology in person.

sample.speaker: Changli
sample.text: This time... *chuckle* I just wanted to see you. The brilliant mind that always understood my unspoken words.

dialogue.desc: KU-Lolo has a new idea to turn your fondest memories into unique Cube souvernirs in the Second Coming of Solaris! Head on over to the Memory Travelogue event, collect memories with the Cubes, and turn them in to KU-Lolo!

sample.speaker: Changli
sample.text: A moment of companionship and protection meant everything to me.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: But I wasn't really there for you. Not in the real past. If there isn't a Secret to Immortality, what about you...

sample.speaker: Changli
sample.text: I can sense your unspoken question. Did I sacrifice my life when I burned down the Sonoro Sphere, like when I was a child?

sample.speaker: Changli
sample.text: What I told you there was true. But I've grown and gained control over my powers. Using my Forte now won't harm me in any way. Of that you can rest assured.

sample.speaker: Changli
sample.text: Also... If you really are the legendary person who changed the course of history, then you are perhaps the closest to immortality aside from our Sentinel.

sample.speaker: Changli
sample.text: We mortals come and go, our lives are full of meetings and goodbyes. Our time on this earth is fleeting compared to yours. So don't let it bother you.

sample.speaker: Changli
sample.text: The incorporation of so many nostalgic elements makes me wonder who the director is.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Well, you have a good eye for detail.

sample.speaker: Changli
sample.text: It doesn't really matter anyway. What matters is the joy of people he wished to see with this play. Don't you agree?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: What about Changli...

sample.speaker: Changli
sample.text: Worry not. It doesn't affect my moves. I just need to maintain a safe distance from you.

sample.speaker: Changli
sample.text: At least... for now.

sample.speaker: Changli
sample.text: Should you call for our strength, we'll be there for you at any time.

scene.desc: A mysterious request, a lost delivery, an opening gateway... In a realm where dreams and nightmares intertwine, a massive shadow looms around you. It casts a darkness over reality, opening the gateways to dreams across Jinzhou. It asks you, if beauty is fleeting and salvation is futile, why not remain in a dream...

With the great battle over, the Land of Xuanfang is slowly returning to how it once was, though plenty of aftershocks have yet to settle. Then one day, a WavesLine message from Yangyang arrives out of the blue: Suisui is about to head back to Mengzhou City...
Jinhsi has gone missing, and you just had an enigmatic dream.... That Wayfinder at the ferry may hold answers to these mysteries.

The Pioneer Association is offering generous prizes for "Hsin's Fortuity", among them is the surprise jackpot, and Changli manages to draw it. To make things more dramatic, the prize is a treasure map about a Court of Savantae legacy... Unlock a new Companion after completing this quest.
You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

mention.text: What about Changli...
mention.source: Rover brings up Changli in “Star Bouncing · event story”

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (In the south....)

sample.speaker: Sanhua
sample.text: They are unharmed. Please rest assured.

sample.speaker: Sanhua
sample.text: As you anticipated, Scar did not try to kill them... Yes, I stayed out of it like you asked.

sample.speaker: Sanhua
sample.text: Is everything alright on your end?

sample.speaker: Sanhua
sample.text: ...Please be sure to stay safe, My Lady.

sample.speaker: Sanhua
sample.text: I'm afraid... I cannot grant your request.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: It's been a while, Sanhua.

sample.speaker: Sanhua
sample.text: Rover!? You... you've returned?
(And who might you be?)

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Can you take me to Jinhsi?

dialogue.desc: Jinhsi entrusts you with a letter to Sanhua. What could it possibly be about? Unlock a new Companion after completing thing quest.

sample.speaker: Sanhua
sample.text: Oh, here you are, Rover.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Hi, Sanhua. Are you here for the Moonlit Fair?

sample.speaker: Sanhua
sample.text: No, I'm here for work today. Madam Jinhsi entrusted me with this letter for you.

sample.speaker: Sanhua
sample.text: As you're involved with the Moonlit Fair, she may have something important to discuss with you.

sample.speaker: Sanhua
sample.text: Have you finished reading it, Rover? Do you have any messages you would like me to convey?

sample.speaker: Sanhua
sample.text: Indeed, I have many affairs to attend to, but I think Madam Magistrate was exaggerating.

sample.speaker: Sanhua
sample.text: It was you who made this gathering possible, Rover.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I'm also surprised to see you acting as Asura in the play.

sample.speaker: Sanhua
sample.text: The lead actor had an unexpected issue, so I had to fill in with only a little time to rehearse. Fortunately, I managed to get most of the lines correct.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: That dance of blessings was impressive.

sample.speaker: Sanhua
sample.text: Glad you liked it. I wonder what our guests from Rinascita think about the play.

sample.speaker: Sanhua
sample.text: The play is over, but not the festivaL Why not enjoy the festive moments with others?

dialogue.desc: As the tides of danger retreat, Jinzhou appears tranquil and vibrant. But beyond its borders lies a fierce and desperate battleground.

sample.speaker: Jianxin
sample.text: It's so busy here... Looks like they don't even have the time to catch their breath.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Supplies, medical care, equipment maintenance, personnel management, and logistics ... They must carefully manage these matters to provide vital support for our fighters.

sample.speaker: Jianxin
sample.text: So this is what a real war looks like. I had no idea it could get this bad.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Most people would never have the chance to witness any of this. It's natural for you not to know.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: I think this is exactly what our military strives for—to ensure peace and safety for our citizens. It's a sacrifice made so others don't have to live in fear.

dialogue.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

sample.speaker: Jianxin
sample.text: Greetings, General.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Master Jianxin? Didn't know I'd be seeing you here...

sample.speaker: Jiyan
sample.text: Jianxin recently arrived at our base with one of the supply delivery teams. She has been a great help.

sample.speaker: Jianxin
sample.text: General, you flatter me.

sample.speaker: Jianxin
sample.text: I've heard people comparing the Norfall Barrens to a massive graveyard. Whenever it rains, cries and moans can be heard, as if many ghosts are weeping.

sample.speaker: Jianxin
sample.text: Master once told me life and death should follow a natural course. The heavens and earth form a vast chamber, where spirits freely depart and return.

mention.title: Echoing Marche
mention.text: Us running into Master Jianxin was a one-off incident. If the mangosteen indicates something about war, what is Madam Magistrate trying to convey?
mention.source: Yangyang brings up Jianxin in “Echoing Marche” (5×)

mention.title: Grand Warstorm

mention.source: Yangyang brings up Jianxin in “Grand Warstorm” (3×)

sample.speaker: Jianxin
sample.text: It was nothing. Master once told me, "The sage takes care of all men,and abandons none."

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Watch out!

sample.text: Hold on, Jianxin. Since it says "in the stall", we can probably cross out large stores from our list.

sample.speaker: Jianxin
sample.text: Good point. We should focus on the small vendor stalls, right?

sample.text: Please follow me.

mention.source: Jiyan brings up Jianxin in “Grand Warstorm” (4×)

mention.title: Grand Warstorm
mention.text: Rover, I'll defend our base. General Jiyan has set off with his team to distract those Tacet Discords.
mention.source: Jianxin brings up Jiyan in “Grand Warstorm”

dialogue.desc: As the promised raindrops fall upstream, you embark on a journey north to the battlefield in search for answers.

sample.speaker: Jiyan
sample.text: Where should we deploy the ranged units?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (Our main battlefield will be at the valley's bottom, where space and vision are limited.)

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (Placing ranged units behind infantry can slow their aim, making it counterproductive... This may not be the best strategy.)

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (Mixing ranged and infantry units may seem versatile, but it wastes the advantage of ranged units... This may not be the best strategy.)

sample.speaker: Jiyan
sample.text: Deploying our ranged units high above the valleys in advance...

sample.speaker: Jiyan
sample.text: This way, they'll provide cover for our close-combat forces while staying safe themselves. We'll use their range advantage to the fullest. It's a smart move.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: The fallen soldiers... They must have held on to those memories dearly. That's how they resisted merging with the Tacet Discords...

sample.speaker: Jiyan
sample.text: Yes... They have been silently fighting for us all these years, or we would've faced a TD Outbreak...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: During that past battle in Desorock Highland, did you...

sample.speaker: Jiyan
sample.text: Yes... We fought together.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: They probably didn't want it to happen again. All those deaths and losses...

sample.speaker: Jiyan
sample.text: ...And so they called out to us for help.

dialogue.quest: Where Stars Cascade Down · event story

sample.speaker: Jiyan
sample.text: Evaluating the Genesis Nexus for potential adoption is also part of my duty.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: So strictly speaking, this is a work trip?

sample.speaker: Jiyan
sample.text: Correct. Our itinerary included this place, in part to establish new ties with Lollo Logistics.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Come to think of it, as long as I've known you, you've barely left the border.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Oh, except that one time in Taoyuan Vale for the Riverside Games.

sample.speaker: Jiyan
sample.text: The situation back then was volatile with the Threnodian's resurgence. Remaining at the border to safeguard the city was my responsibility.

sample.speaker: Jiyan
sample.text: Sorry, I have to hold this to speak.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: What about Changli...

sample.speaker: Jiyan
sample.text: The Threnodian's current state looks to be more complicated than we assumed. Contact Huaxu Academy. Send them this round of data.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: General Jiyan speaks true.

sample.speaker: Jiyan
sample.text: Rover? ...That'll be all. Go on ahead, all of you.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Sounds like the Threnodian has retreated back into its corner?

sample.speaker: Jiyan
sample.text: It has. While this disturbance did not herald disaster, Overthrax stirring in response to Xuanfang's instability sits heavy with me.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: No amount of caution is too much where a Threnodian is concerned. If there's any sign of danger, send for me immediately.

dialogue.desc: Cartethyia vanished in the Inverted Tower. Following the traces she left behind, you arrive at Septimont, one of Rinascita's city-states, steeped in glory and famed for its gladiatorial tradition. The city is hosting the Great Agon—a grand championship held once every four years. Yet beneath the grandeur, shadows stir. Multiple factions move in secret, each with their hidden agenda. To uncover the truth, you form a temporary alliance with Contender Lupa. Together, you set your sights on the championship...

sample.speaker: Phrolova
sample.text: As of now, you and that Blessed Maiden from the tower are deeply interwoven in the fate he has spun.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: So you're not the only Overseer active in Rinascita.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Scar, your nameless ally, and you... The Fractsidus seems to revel in the company of those with twisted obsessions.

sample.speaker: Phrolova
sample.text: It's not as you imagine. You've already met my associate, you see. He trusts what he sees, not the words of others.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (I've already crossed paths with him since arriving in Rinascita…?)

sample.speaker: Phrolova
sample.text: As a creator, he always hopes his characters will craft twists and turns that he himself cannot foresee.

dialogue.summary: In your dreams, you see Phrolova floating in the air with pages swirling around her. Phrolova tells you that Lupa will be the one to trigger the Dark Tide's surge in Septimont, and it will happen within three days.

dialogue.desc: You and Lupa follow the Lioness of Glory to the burial ground of the heroes and into a world of growing uncertainty. At the same time, you start to wonder if Lupa, your companion on this journey, is friend or foe. Cheers sound distorted. Fate has been woven. You have a choice to make, and your choice will determine how the story ends.

sample.speaker: Phrolova
sample.text: Have you chosen?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Hesitate not, warrior.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: You are the protagonist I have chosen.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Only you can shatter the script.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: And jump to the next page.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Write.

dialogue.desc: The Dreamer seals her heart and surrenders to a world of dreams beyond mortal sight. In this hidden realm built upon melancholy melodies, she walks a path of fragile hope and delusions without looking back. But the dreams she longs to realize have long been tangled up in shadow and deceit. Beneath the lofty facade of the Orchestrator, who seems to have everything, is but a wretched, pitiful soul, drowning in her own illusions. In the end, will this dream of blooming and withering be a sweet reverie or a haunting nightmare?

sample.speaker: Phrolova
sample.text: Keep your eyes sharp. The mist is another trap they've set for us.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: So let's avoid it. Which way is faster?

sample.speaker: Phrolova
sample.text: The left one.

sample.speaker: Phrolova
sample.text: Still in doubt?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: The right one seems closer and safer.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I'd also like to know whether listening to past melodies allows me to hear realms that I once went through.

sample.speaker: Phrolova
sample.text: You wish to listen to past stories? Ah... It seems I have an audience for the songs I've collected throughout history.

sample.speaker: Phrolova
sample.text: Go ahead. Every song kept in this room is at your disposal. There's a seat by the window.

sample.speaker: Phrolova
sample.text: The people here are of no used to you. Don't try anything. I will protect this place.

sample.speaker: Phrolova

dialogue.desc: Mortefi has contacted you. He seems to be quite interested in Autopuppets and wants to speak in person with someone who has had direct contact with them...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Any idea of what might've happened, Mortefi? Should we check the last location first?

sample.speaker: Mortefi
sample.text: That won't be necessary, the Ministry of Development will prioritize their search in that area. Repeating the search will have little gain.

sample.speaker: Mortefi
sample.text: I have a theory...

sample.speaker: Mortefi
sample.text: Follow me. Let's pay a visit to the Hundred-Span Corridor.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: There!

sample.speaker: Mortefi
sample.text: Just as I suspected...

phoneSample.speaker: Mortefi
phoneSample.text: Baizhi mentioned you came into contact with a substantial amount of Autopuppets in Xuanfang Hold. I'd like to hear about them. The more detail, the better.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: This'll take a while...

phoneSample.speaker: Mortefi
phoneSample.text: It appears to be a significant amount of information. Going back and forth over WavesLine would only waste time... You'll be staying long at Xuanfang Hold, I presume?

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: Well, let me get everything sorted out first.

phoneSample.speaker: Mortefi
phoneSample.text: This will take too long. You'll be staying long at Xuanfang Hold, I presume?

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: Huh? Me? I mean, as far as principles go... I don't know much about them either.

dialogue.desc: Mortefi seems to have received clearance to handle actual Autopuppets. One wonders whether the research on Autopuppets has made any new progress...

sample.speaker: Mortefi
sample.text: I'm currently in Xuanfang Hold.

sample.speaker: Mortefi
sample.text: Zhuo Shanyue's application was approved.

sample.speaker: Mortefi
sample.text: I obtained some internal materials and was granted access to the Autopuppet specimens.

sample.speaker: Mortefi
sample.text: With the restriction being that the specimens must remain within Xuanfang Hold grounds. But this will suffice for the current stage of my research.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Mind if I join you?
