sample.text: How's everything going?

sample.speaker: Aalto
sample.text: Good news and bad.

sample.speaker: Aalto
sample.text: The Threnodian's Gem has been successfully contained. Tethys is already running a full-power analysis as we speak.

sample.speaker: Aalto
sample.text: However... the Gem we've recovered was incomplete.

sample.speaker: Aalto
sample.text: We're still investigating the cause. But look, successfully containing a Gem infused with the Threnodian's power? No small feat. It's already a huge step forward in our fight against the Threnodian and the Lament.

sample.speaker: Aalto
sample.text: If the Threnodian is truly bound to civilization, who's to say another one won't return to Rinascita in some new form...

dialogue.desc: Though the Threnodian Aleph-1 was banished, Lucilla finds herself in yet another predicament. In the absence of the Exostrider, funders are questioning whether the Synchronist program—and even the Rabelle College itself—should continue to exist. As both a professor and the head of the Academy, Lucilla must now choose between harsh reality and her ideals.

sample.speaker: Aalto
sample.text: Meanwhile, the Executive Committee moderates have promised to stay out of it, as long as their nation's Synchronists are covered. With either guaranteed support back home or a smooth transfer somewhere else.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Where does Lucilla stand?

sample.speaker: Aalto
sample.text: She wants to continue the Synchronist Program.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Continue?

sample.speaker: Aalto
sample.text: Yep. Confusing, isn't it? Speaking of which... how well do you know her, Rover?

sample.speaker: Aalto
sample.text: Hm. I see.

phoneSample.speaker: Aalto
phoneSample.text: Be at the square by 8. The one we passed earlier. Got some intel to share.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: OK.

phoneSample.speaker: Aalto
phoneSample.text: Any recs on what to order? Lucilla went back to her office to take care of something.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: Just order everything on the menu.

phoneSample.speaker: Aalto
phoneSample.text: Gotcha!

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: Get the cheap ones so you can toss them without feeling guilty.

Beneath what was once a brilliant and harmonious starry sky, chaos and tragedy now prevail. As the boundary between the virtual and the real begins to blur, where will the remnants of civilization find their path?
Shorekeeper might have some clues about Abby's weakening frequencies. Return to the Black Shores to find out.

dialogue.desc: After the battle of Norfall Barren, everything came to an end. Your friends are calling you for a meet-up with snacks at Panhua's Restaurant. It seems they like to know more about that "little one" from within your body...

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: W-what's going on? I... I'll try again! Just you see!

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Uh... What? Did something happen?

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: J-Just a little slip, that's all! I can do it! You gotta trust me!

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Back then, I just stood in front of , and that big bad Threnodian monster thing just... just... left.

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: So... you didn't really do anything?

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Huh? No, I... I definitely did something!

dialogue.desc: As the Moon-Chasing Festival approaches, you become aware of the "Moontree Lodge" tales under the Wishing Tree. An encounter with a strange robot links you to the mysterious wish granter at the Lodge...

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: There, you're the last one left, Rover. Oh, and don't forget about Abby! I'm sure the little guy doesn't want to miss out.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Yawn... Who's there...? What's going on...?

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Make... A wish...? I'm tired... Just make one for me...

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: I want... lots of goodies to eat... I don't ever want to be hungry again...

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Phew... Huff...

sample.speaker: Chixia
sample.text: Well, what did Abby say?

In the culmination of the event, this figure commands the rogue Autopuppets to launch an assault on Xuanfang Hold.

scene.quest: Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song
scene.desc: The frequencies building up within Patty have resonated with the environment and generated a Sonoro Sphere. The truth about the fourth wish may be hidden therein. The name Patty keeps mumbling about seems to be connected with Xiangli Yao. You must head it off at the pass before things get out of hands at the Moonlit Fair.

A blue figure guides you through the mist-it's the Shorekeeper. The bad news you've brought from the Port City to Guixu has unveiled a looming threat now casting its shadow over the Black Shores. An imminent danger awaits both you and the Black Shores.

mention.title: A New Companion
mention.text: Knew it. Nothing about Rover's ever gonna be easy to figure out... Hmm. Maybe we should bring Baizhi, Mr. Xiangli Yao, and all the researchers in Jinzhou... No, in the entire Huanglong together. They'll do a nice and thorough examination on Abby, and then...
mention.source: Chixia brings up Abby in “A New Companion” (5×)

mention.title: Moonlit Reunion
mention.text: There, you're the last one left, Rover. Oh, and don't forget about Abby! I'm sure the little guy doesn't want to miss out.
mention.source: Chixia brings up Abby in “Moonlit Reunion” (2×)

mention.title: Dreamweaver's Ascent
mention.text: How about we go to that place we went to last time with Yangyang and Chixia?
mention.source: Abby brings up Chixia in “Dreamweaver's Ascent”

mention.title: Dreaming Deep · event story
mention.text: "(Yawns)... How long was I asleep...? You say something, Chixia?"
mention.source: Abby brings up Chixia in “Dreaming Deep · event story”

timeline.quest: Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song

dialogue.desc: After the battle of Norfall Barren, everything came to an end. Your friends are calling you for a meet-up with snacks at Panhua's Restaurant. It seems they like to know more about that "little one" from within your body...

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: I'll make it clear. I am to stay with Rover.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: I agree. Abby cannot leave Rover's side, but we can't just trap here for research.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Where did you absorb Abby, what are Abby's powers, and what exactly happened between you two... There are so many questions we can't figure out yet.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Our Sentinel Jué can look into the future. Nothing ever deviates from its predictions. It has already sort of guided you to the Norfall Barrens through Madam Magistrate's messages, right?

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Now that the Threnodian crisis is over, perhaps you can consult our Magistrate and our Sentinel again. I’m sure they can offer you some more useful guidance.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Relax, relax! You have me now, remember? Meeting up with that Jinhsi person? Getting your memories back? I've got you!

dialogue.quest: Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song
dialogue.desc: The frequencies building up within Patty have resonated with the environment and generated a Sonoro Sphere. The truth about the fourth wish may be hidden therein. The name Patty keeps mumbling about seems to be connected with Xiangli Yao. You must head it off at the pass before things get out of hands at the Moonlit Fair.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Looky that!

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: This word puzzle... Is the answer "Friend", maybe?

With the great battle over, the Land of Xuanfang is slowly returning to how it once was, though plenty of aftershocks have yet to settle. Then one day, a WavesLine message from Yangyang arrives out of the blue: Suisui is about to head back to Mengzhou City...

The Waking Moon Festival is drawing near in the Land of Xuanfang, yet rumors that "the Hold is doomed to fall" have begun to spread throughout the city. To find the Sentinel who has long been absent, you decide to head to where Hsin's presence was last felt—the Manifold Sanctum.

A blue figure guides you through the mist-it's the Shorekeeper. The bad news you've brought from the Port City to Guixu has unveiled a looming threat now casting its shadow over the Black Shores. An imminent danger awaits both you and the Black Shores.

As the Moon-Chasing Festival approaches, you become aware of the "Moontree Lodge" tales under the Wishing Tree. An encounter with a strange robot links you to the mysterious wish granter at the Lodge...

mention.title: A New Companion
mention.text: Each special Echo has a unique ability. We can compare what Abby does with our records of other Echoes to see where they came from. Besides... It was Abby’s power that helped Rover defeat the Threnodian, I suppose?
mention.source: Yangyang brings up Abby in “A New Companion” (8×)

mention.title: The Wind Before the Storm
mention.text: What else am I supposed to do?! Blame Yangyang for sending us those tasty snacks. They brought back all my great memories of Jinzhou!
mention.source: Abby brings up Yangyang in “The Wind Before the Storm” (6×)

mention.title: Dreamweaver's Ascent
mention.text: How about we go to that place we went to last time with Yangyang and Chixia?
mention.source: Abby brings up Yangyang in “Dreamweaver's Ascent”

mention.title: Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song
mention.text: More trouble to solve eh? Wait... didn't you just promise Yangyang we'd hang out tonight?
mention.source: Abby brings up Yangyang in “Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song”

mention.title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
mention.text: It's all for Yangyang, okay? Even if I get a stomachache, I'll still do it—!
mention.source: Abby brings up Yangyang in “Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled”

mention.title: Song of the Heart Sword
mention.text: Hmph... Ugh... Pretty sure I just heard Yangyang. Did she leave already?
mention.source: Abby brings up Yangyang in “Song of the Heart Sword”

mention.title: Dreaming Deep · event story
mention.text: "Huh? Isn't this Yangyang? What's up with this Public Security officer thing?"
mention.source: Abby brings up Yangyang in “Dreaming Deep · event story”

timeline.quest: Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song

dialogue.desc: While waiting for contact from the Ephor's Palace, you and Abby arrive at Solis Tavern, where you run into a blind wandering bard—Nestor. Having learned of the Ephor's invitation to the hunt, Nestor shares with you Augusta's stories before she rose to power.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Huh... that reminds me, aren't we supposed to meet her today?!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: A messenger came this morning. Augusta is dealing with an emergency, so our meeting's postponed... looks like it'll be a while.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: An unexpected change. It's throwing everything off course... I don't like the feel of it.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: And why me for this hunt? If it's about the Great Agon... the messenger said none of the other Gladiators were invited.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Who knows? Maybe she just wants to test her strength against you. Typical Septimontian, right?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: You think so?

dialogue.desc: As the High Tide draws near, a lurking calamity stirs, with its gaze fixed upon the borders of Septimont. Ephor Augusta invites you to the Sanguis Plateaus for a fateful hunt, the one that may decide the realm's survival...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Abby? Abby? Wake up.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: ...Whaaat's going on...?

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: I'm sooo sleepy... Ugh, that dark spooky stuff I ate earlier is still gurgling in my belly...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Sorry to hear that. But if my clever, brave, stylish, and sweet Abby could help me out, that'd be amazing.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Aww, you're making me blush! Okay, okay, your best buddy Abby's on the job. Go on!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: So... that thing we tangled with before has gone into hiding around here.

dialogue.desc: With the Sovereign slain, you attend the victory ceremony by invitation of Ceremonial Officer Bruno. The celebration honors the new Hero of Heroes and those who stood by their side amidst the crackling bonfire and joyous cheers of the crowd... Now that the countless petals are to be thrown into the sky to become the rain of glory and triumph, you might finally reunite with the girl you have never forgotten in a way even beyond fate's grasp.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: She didn't even get to finish her sentence. What was she thinking? Why did she do it... If this is the end, maybe I'll never know.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Yeah, I know what you mean... Like, we didn't even get to have a proper goodbye!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I don't care if Iuno foresaw her fate and chose this path for herself.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: All I know is I won't let it end like this. Not with her fading into oblivion.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Why did Iuno choose this? Did she truly believe this was the better ending?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I'm the one she entrusted with her bracelet. The exception. So it's on me to find the answer.

dialogue.desc: To open the Sentinel's Relic, you head back to Ragunna once more...

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Mmm—mmm—! Can you smell that? Sweet o' Margherita's Restaurant. C'mon, c'mon, let's go stuff our faces already!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Let's take care of important matters first. You'll eat well soon, I promise.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Yeah, yeah, I know. We're here to find Cartethyia!

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: I still can't believe Tethys couldn't unlock the Sentinel's Relic we found in Septimont...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: At least now we know it's called the "Civilization Capsule." It probably holds key legacy data left behind by the Sentinel.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Like some ancient data recorder, right? But Tethys said to unlock it we'll need... the Leviathan's power.

dialogue.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Rover, did I... did I do something wrong?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: We made a call when it mattered. I asked you to absorb the Dark Tide. We couldn't have known what it would become. You didn't do anything wrong.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: I see... I-I can go hungry if I have to, but you, Rover, you better not get hurt...

sample.speaker: Galbrena
sample.text: The real threat is Leviathan. If we want to end this for good, we kill It and destroy Its Paradise.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: ...From what I know, Leviathan manifests Its kingdom by flooding Rinascita with the Dark Tide. That's how it turns the real world into the Journeying Paradise.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: But we've already secured Ragunna and Septimont. The Fabricatorium and the hunting grounds are both stabilized... So why is this Paradise still there?

dialogue.desc: A pair of constantly shifting spatial coordinates leading to an unknown location has caught your attention. Following the trail, you reach a metropolis... that had been erased long ago.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: ...Abby?

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Wahh! Wh-why didn't you answer me?! I waited outside forever! I had to force my way in to find you! Seriously, I thought you were—

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: This Sonoro was sealed off from the outside world. But it looks like it's reopened now.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Yup! All thanks to our pals at the Black Shores! They've been working nonstop to install all kinds of devices. And with the connection getting stronger, I finally managed to slip through when the rift popped back up and... Wait...

sample.speaker: Chisa
sample.text: Hello.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: A new face! Hiya! Is she coming with us?

dialogue.desc: After you escaped from Honami City, Chisa, who had pushed herself to the brink of overclocking more than once, received treatment at the Black Shores. You've been apart ever since. Now, it's time to visit her again. For both of you, this will be a new beginning.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Come to think of it, this is the first time I'm here at this cafe while wide awake.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: You sure it's not because you've been putting in more nap hours lately?

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Says who? I got locked out by the Sonoro Sphere right before the start, remember? I couldn't even get to you. And don't get me started on all the wacky frequencies that I got mixed in with...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: You did a great job. Welcome to Shashou Cafe, Abby.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: ...Whoa, why the formality all of a sudden? Ahem. So you asked Shorekeeper to invite the Black Shores gang over for a party. They should be here pretty soon, right?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Yep. Let's go check on Chisa and see how the decorating is going.

dialogue.desc: The gateway to Lahai-Roi is now open! What burns beneath the frostlands is waiting for your return!

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: (It stole your frequency! I'd know that stink anywhere!)

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (Now isn't a good time for a face-off. We'll settle the score later, Abby.)

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: (Fine, but it's not getting off easy!)

dialogue.desc: To reach Lahal-Roi in the midst of a Void Storm, you dive into the spatial tunnel, which pulls you into a strange dimension... Upon arriving in Lahai-Roi, you chance upon Lynae, a student who leads you to Startorch Academy. As you begin enrollment, everything about this "academic metropolis" unfolds before your eyes. Meanwhile, shadows stir beneath the Vold Storm...

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: That Voidworm must've snatched it! It smells like a Threnodian, just like that big eyeball!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: The Academy's been here a long time. They must have ways to deal with the Threnodian. We might even get some help.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: And that girl who appeared out of nowhere... Her voice was like the one I heard over the radio in Honami City. Maybe it was her.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Really? Maybe she's in Lahai-Roi now. Should we try to find her?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Let's focus on fixing my fading frequency first. We can keep an eye out for her in the meantime.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (As for Lynae, she's hiding something, but I've got bigger priorities right now.)

dialogue.desc: With the Voldworm threat gone for now, and the commencement of the New Solar Ceremony, Mornye, a Research Institute project lead, invites you to witness the rise of the new sun. However, a distress signal tells you that not everyone is looking forward to this ceremony. To uncover the truth, you and Mornye set off for the Bjartr Woods...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I... saw someone's memory.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Whoa, you scared me! And just now, a frequency jumped into your Tacet Mark! It felt like... some kinda connection?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Can you trace where it came from, Abby?

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Sniff, sniff, sniff...

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: I smell it coming from over there!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Good. Let's go check it out.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: It stopped... it stopped... for now. I gotta... I gotta rest...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: You did great, Abby. Go get some rest.

dialogue.desc: The New Solar Celebration is just around the corner. Yet, President Lucilla detects a mysterious frequency appearing in the Academy's Dark Side—one that does not belong to the Academy. You suspect it may be the "reward" once mentioned by the Grand Architect of the Fractsidus. Determined to uncover the truth behind this anomaly, you venture into the Dark Side alongside Sigrika, a student you encountered there...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Maybe that's what President Lucilla wants to discuss.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Makes sense! But what's with the "one from afar" bit?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Probably a riddle.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Let's go see the President and find out what she's planning.

dialogue.desc: Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: So, we're finally going to where that giant eye is hiding?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Yeah. And Abby, if you think it's stronger than you, don't try to be a hero, okay?

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: I've got this! But uh... We don't know how much strength it's hiding behind that Gate, huh...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Our priorities are the data and Aemeath. A direct fight with Aleph-1 can wait until the Drive Replica is ready.

dialogue.desc: Not long after the Stridergate incident, the Spacetrek Collective informs you that Denia is awake and being kept in isolation. To learn the Fractsidus's next step and open new directions for future research, you head to the infirmary to negotiate with Denia. There, she offers you a "deal." In exchange, you'll need to stay with her for her birthday...

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Rover... Will we ever see Denia again?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: We will.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Okay... But, what about the thing you didn't get to say, Rover?

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: "If you feel you don't belong here, then some day in the future, would you be willing to..." And? What about the rest?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Secret. For now.

dialogue.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Huh? A package from Huanglong? What is it, what is it? Someone sent you snacks?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: It's a letter from Yangyang.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Ohhh... from Yangyang, huh? Yeah, that time of year, I guess...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: There's a whole box of treats for you.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Whoa! Yangyang's the best!

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Ahem... I-I know that. Hello? You're looking at the maestro of sharing here! But hey, what'd Yangyang say in her letter?

dialogue.desc: The Land of Xuanfang is thrown into turmoil following an unexpected riot of out-of-control Autopuppets. As you investigate, you uncover the mastermind behind the scheme—a mysterious Artisan who covets the Sentinel's technology. In the culmination of the event, this figure commands the rogue Autopuppets to launch an assault on Xuanfang Hold.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Bleh... That tasted awful.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: What did you "taste"?

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Well, I'm not sure how to put it... The frequency was messy, like a billion math formulas all tangled together. Looking at it makes my head hurt.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: It's weird... On top of that string of numbers, there's a ton of... emotions.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Rage, regret, disappointment...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: A machine... isn't supposed to have emotions.

dialogue.desc: With the great battle over, the Land of Xuanfang is slowly returning to how it once was, though plenty of aftershocks have yet to settle. Then one day, a WavesLine message from Yangyang arrives out of the blue: Suisui is about to head back to Mengzhou City...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: The Prism of Fate isn't responding either...

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Oh, I found where that smell is coming from. This way!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: What's this...?

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Its frequency is a lot like that weird-smelling Autopuppet kernel from last time.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Hmm, Suisui did mention an informant who met her outside Fogveil Pagoda before—

dialogue.desc: With the crisis behind you, Liangyu seems to have something to discuss. Go find out what it is when you have a moment. You may soon be seeing that Nethermancer who worked alongside you at the Manifold Sanctum.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Hey, what's that ya got? Smells kinda scrumptious.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: This is for someone else. Don't you be getting any ideas.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: (Aww—what crummy luck!)

dialogue.desc: The Waking Moon Festival is drawing near in the Land of Xuanfang, yet rumors that "the Hold is doomed to fall" have begun to spread throughout the city. To find the Sentinel who has long been absent, you decide to head to where Hsin's presence was last felt—the Manifold Sanctum.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (What's wrong?)

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: (Got jolted awake by some huge frequency wave! It was kinda like... that Prism of Fate, but with all these extra nasty, funky smells. Ugh...)

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (Is it coming from that Fox Shadow on the horizon?)

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: (Uh-huh! Whatever's there has been giving me the willies since we got here. Like something's spying on me... Creepy. So I'm staying inside. If things get hairy, just holler!)

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (Okay. Got it.)

dialogue.quest: Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song
dialogue.desc: The frequencies building up within Patty have resonated with the environment and generated a Sonoro Sphere. The truth about the fourth wish may be hidden therein. The name Patty keeps mumbling about seems to be connected with Xiangli Yao. You must head it off at the pass before things get out of hands at the Moonlit Fair.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Is that a form of human connection too?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Sort of.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Are we sharing that kind of connection right now?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I'd say you've been haunting me. Like a ghost.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Haunting? Hmph! No way. Admit it, I'm just living rent-free in your head.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Sure, if you say so... Now back to the topic. We've been seeing Pascar and Xiangli Yao's past exclusively so far.

dialogue.quest: The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier
dialogue.desc: After the Carnevale, a voice in your head leads you to the supposed Martyred Maiden—Cartethyia. The encounter creates more questions than it answers. Who are your enemies? Who are your friends? Where is the Inverted Tower located? The helper Carlotta has found and the invitation from Fisalia may help you answer all these questions. The moment of truth seems inevitable...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: You there, Abster?

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: (Yawns)... What's up...?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (It's taking longer for Abby to react...)

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Hey, there's nothing to worry about... I'm just a little beat, that's all... Oh! Earlier when I was half-asleep, I came up with this great idea for finding the Sentinel.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Let's hear it.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Didn't the Sentinel say They're locked up in some kind of tower in the sky?

dialogue.summary:
=== Meeting Ciaccona ===
As Rover contemplates how to locate the Inverted Tower referenced by Imperator, Abby proposes an aerial approach, suggesting the cliff near Egla Town as a suitable launch point.

dialogue.desc: Cartethyia vanished in the Inverted Tower. Following the traces she left behind, you arrive at Septimont, one of Rinascita's city-states, steeped in glory and famed for its gladiatorial tradition. The city is hosting the Great Agon—a grand championship held once every four years. Yet beneath the grandeur, shadows stir. Multiple factions move in secret, each with their hidden agenda. To uncover the truth, you form a temporary alliance with Contender Lupa. Together, you set your sights on the championship...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Can you tell where these traces lead, Abby?

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Over there. But the traces are kinda messy. They feel unsteady too...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: That way… That's the archipelago across from Ragunna.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: The traces are still fresh. We should follow them to find Cartethyia before they fade.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Should we go now?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Yes. With the Threnodian's will gone, she wouldn't lose contact unless something's wrong. Really wrong.

dialogue.desc: Your forgotten past, hazy memories, and a strange dream... So many questions linger about your identity, and who you used to be. Meanwhile, a mysterious pull guides you to a hidden place on the distant sea...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Also... In my dream, I wasn't affected by the slowed time and could freely move in and out of the barrier.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: It's no shock that you have awesome powers, being friends with me.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Hmm... What was that place you dreamed about called?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I'm not entirely sure I heard it correctly, but in my dream, the Sentinel mentioned a place called Mt. Firmament.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Mt. Firmament? Never heard of it...

dialogue.quest: The Sacred Breeze So Often Breathes
dialogue.desc: After a minor twist in the journey, Ragunna, the Land of Echoes, unfolds its grandeur, extending a grand welcome to the traveler from distant shores.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (...You've been hiccuping for a while. Do Echoes get indigestion as well?)

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: (H-how am I supposed to know? I haven't had anything to eat since we left for Rinascita. So hungry...)

dialogue.desc: Shorekeeper might have some clues about Abby's weakening frequencies. Return to the Black Shores to find out.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Huh... Wait, what's that huge shadow under the water?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: It's getting closer.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Watch out!

dialogue.quest: Veils Off in Sun or Shadow
dialogue.desc: To understand Gilberto's part in the Echo incident, you trace his steps to the outskirts of the city. But the deep you delve, the more elusive the truth becomes...

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: So... was it all part of your plan?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: We were improvising.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Then you two sure have great chemistry... Anyway, those bad guys are still after us, so let's get out of here.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Didn't Carlotta say something about an island up north? Let's go check it out!

dialogue.quest: What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing
dialogue.desc: Following Carlotta's guidance, you arrive at the Penitent's End and reunite with the Troupe. Here, another buried secret of the Order awaits discovery...

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: I can't wait to explore! Oh, by the way, it's been a while since we last saw Zani and Phoebe. Wonder what they're up to right now...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Alright, let's go. We should also keep an eye out for anything unusual along the way.

dialogue.desc: You and Lupa follow the Lioness of Glory to the burial ground of the heroes and into a world of growing uncertainty. At the same time, you start to wonder if Lupa, your companion on this journey, is friend or foe. Cheers sound distorted. Fate has been woven. You have a choice to make, and your choice will determine how the story ends.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Phew! Finally, I can stick my head out! Rover, are you okay?!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I'm fine, Abby. What happened to you earlier?

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: I… wait, we're already in Septimont?

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: I was just talking to you, and then boom! It felt like something just... covered me!

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: First, it messed with my frequency, then... I just passed out. Wait! Cartethyia? And a girl I don't know?!

dialogue.desc: A Somnoire door has suddenly appeared in the Academy. Mornye has asked for your help investigating it.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I'm picking up on more of the abnormal frequency... Abby, are you alright?

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Ugh... Just a little dizzy. My body's startin' to feel so heavy...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Don't push yourself. If it gets too much, let me know.

dialogue.desc: You meet an old storyteller when you roam about in Hongzhen. While you listen to the the immortality tales about Mt. Firmament, you notice another interested listener...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (A ring, she wrote... Should be this ring-shaped ancient structure, I guess?)

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Wow, it's really huge now that we look at it.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Next, hanging eaves... If we look from here... Is it that pavilion?

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: It does look quiet. Should be a nice place for meetings... *yawn* Ugh, getting 'eepy again...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: That must be the place, then.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I'll get going.

dialogue.desc: A mysterious letter gently lifts a corner of the veil that shrouds the nights gone by. A faint whisper from the depths of the abyss waits for your reply.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (And this message… Is it a prank? Or is there more to this?)

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Ugh, what's this smell?!

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Nope, I can't take it… Gotta take a break…

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Ew, why do I still smell it down here? Wait, this weird frequency… It's coming from that message!

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Ugh, my head… so dizzy… I'm gonna lie down. Just... just holler if you need me…

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Looks like we've been hit by the weird frequency in that message. I should check out what's going on in Egla Town.

dialogue.summary: The twisted frequency within it affects both you and Abby. The lingering influence over you and Abby is lifted, and everything returns to its usual calm.

dialogue.desc: A mysterious girl approaches you on WavesLine, asking for your help to collect the scattered Feeling Capsule Shards. As you go deeper into this matter, a story surfaces about Hsin the Moon Fox, the Sentinel of the past.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: That's the first time anyone's ever said something so nice to me. Hehehe, I wouldn't go that far, but... teehee...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (I remember the Simulacrum Nexus is cut off from the outside, so how does she know about recent events in Xuanfang and Qingxiao's school? She's also with a Myriad Snare, but her clothes don't match any Celestial I've seen.)

dialogue.quest: If On a Rainy Night a Family
dialogue.desc: The bitter night lingers for the restless. An invitation from the Montelli family pulls you into its past, where new and old, balance and change collide. In the freest place of Ragunna, the host of the invitation awaits your arrival.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Anyway, I'll leave this to you then. But hey, if you ever need my help, just give me a shout, okay?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Hm, to locate me so precisely and deliver the invitation right into my hands... this Capollo Montelli knows what he's doing.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: And one of (him/her)!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Uh, that's alright, I'm good.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: See, (he/she) said it's alright! Good, even! I guess we'll have to take an entire set, please!

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Thanks, Suisui!

dialogue.summary: Rover and Abby decide to take advantage of a promotional deal at Yuan's Flavor on their day off. Whilst Abby was participating in a spicy food challenge, you overhear someone arguing and head over to see the commotion.

dialogue.desc: You receive a call from Fulmine, who was asked by a few mysterious "people" to send you an invitation...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: What are they saying?

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: They really like the picture you took, and they never knew such a large area existed behind the clouds. Hmm, you mean you guys couldn't see it before?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Maybe the Sonoro Sphere chooses who can and cannot see.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Rover, the Plushies want to get a closer look. They want to take a clearer picture to share with everyone back in the village. Let's go!

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: A Wingray. Up there! Maybe we can fly over there.

dialogue.desc: Ruins litter Penitent's End where the shadows of knights wander among the crumbling walls. A faint voice floats thought the sea mist, guiding your way. "Seeker, follow in the footsteps of the knights from long ago. Uncover the long-buried truth." Hidden rewards can be found in this area.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Oh, so this was the end of their quest. Did they really find the relic after all?

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Rover, why are you looking up like that?

dialogue.desc: Ask King Auto about the situation.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Seems like a little boy stayed here for quite a while...

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Could it have something to do with him?

dialogue.desc: You rescued a weak Aria Mummer near Septimont City. It entrusts you with four Melody Boxes, each carrying a piece of music. What story might they tell?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Let me know if you spot anything, Abby.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: I see it! Right over there!

dialogue.desc: The Sunken Warren was originally a prison for Tacet Discords, but voices of the living can be heard from deep within.....

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: You hear that, Rover? Someone's in trouble!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: What's anyone doing here? Did they just stumble in by accident? Let's check it out.

dialogue.desc: It seems like the nearby hunting camp was attacked. Go check it out.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Abby, Echo interpretation service, please.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Roger that! Your five-star Echo interpreter, at your service! Ahem... Let's try out my new emotional-adaptive mode!

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Beep—loading complete! Standing by for interpretation request...

scene.desc: After the battle of Norfall Barren, everything came to an end. Your friends are calling you for a meet-up with snacks at Panhua's Restaurant. It seems they like to know more about that "little one" from within your body...
A long-dead captain, a ship that cannot sail. Yet now, that captain has set upon an inevitable course, and the ship must sail once again...

A blue figure guides you through the mist-it's the Shorekeeper. The bad news you've brought from the Port City to Guixu has unveiled a looming threat now casting its shadow over the Black Shores. An imminent danger awaits both you and the Black Shores.

Beneath what was once a brilliant and harmonious starry sky, chaos and tragedy now prevail. As the boundary between the virtual and the real begins to blur, where will the remnants of civilization find their path?
It is the deity that commands time. It is the deity that bestows blessings. Now is your time to confront Sentinel Jué.

scene.quest: Do Echoids Dream of Electric Sheep?: Epilogue
scene.desc: Do Echoids Dream of Electric Sheep?: Epilogue

scene.quest: Do Echoids Dream of Electric Sheep? (Quest)
scene.desc: You found Cosmos, Encore's wooly companion, by a mysterious gate. Some kind of test seems to be running behind the gate and it needs your assistance. During the test, Cosmos will provide Echoids to significantly boost Resonators' combat power. You can complete the task with your friends.

scene.quest: John Wicktorio: No Debts for Old Men (Quest)
scene.desc: John Wicktorio from Egla Town is in a spot of trouble.

scene.quest: John Wicktorio: No Debts for Old Men—Epilogue
scene.desc: The tasks is complete. Wicktorio wants to discuss your... fees.
You retrieved a photo from the sphere inside the morph painting, which reveals clues to a hidden past...
Minna has just bought her very first Terminal, but doesn't seem to have the faintest idea how to use it... Find her in Bjartr Woods and lend a hand before she accidentally breaks it.

scene.quest: Thank you, and farewell, my other self
scene.desc: Near the infirmary, you spot a student who has posted a wanted notice on himself...
A squad in the Land of Xuanfang has repeatedly failed its combat qualification, and the Autopuppet leading it wants your guidance.
A strange school of pufferfish has suddenly appeared by the river. The researcher nearby might know what's going on...

Yuan's Flavors welcomes the pickiest diner in its history, and the Fillet Fairmaiden resolves to bring back Xuanfang's finest, freshest taste. But reviving the old recipe and tracking down the ingredients leads to one surprise after another...

Before Xuanfang Hold became operational, the Court of Savantae and the Ministry of Development built several testing grounds to verify the Hold's Autopuppets' ability to eliminate Tacet Discords. Once the Hold went into service, the trial Squarefields were abandoned, left to gather dust over the years. Lately, however, you've been hearing recordings from long ago in the area.
Stranded in the wilderness, a determined young woman strives to perform a sacred rite for the Sentinel's well-being. Help her fulfill the Rite of Offering, and uphold this ancient tradition.

scene.quest: Glorious Loong's Pearl: The Last Rite
scene.desc: Stranded in the wilderness, a determined young woman strives to perform a sacred rite for the Sentinel's well-being. Help her fulfill the Rite of Offering, and uphold this ancient tradition.

A melody, once scattered to the winds, is now sought by Soliskin who yearn to hear it whole again. Follow them to a place heavy with memory. Work with the Soliskin to restore the lost "music sheet." If the music returns, the story it holds may finally awaken.
You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?
Maji, the idea king, is back with yet another new campaign. This time, he's riding the tech wave and trying to create his very own smart assistant, Lollo Genie.

As the Moon-Chasing Festival approaches, you become aware of the "Moontree Lodge" tales under the Wishing Tree. An encounter with a strange robot links you to the mysterious wish granter at the Lodge...

mention.title: The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier
mention.text: Abby has a nose for these sorts of things. We came across Threnodian powers before in Jinzhou.
mention.source: Rover brings up Abby in “The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier” (8×)

mention.title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
mention.text: (But in that battle against the Journeying Paradise… Leviathan spoke Abby's name.)
mention.source: Rover brings up Abby in “Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides” (8×)

mention.title: By Sun's Burning Hand
mention.text: If anyone can sniff out the truth, it's Abby. But just to be sure, I'll send the data to Buling once we're out of here.
mention.source: Rover brings up Abby in “By Sun's Burning Hand” (7×)

mention.title: Shadow of Glory
mention.text: (But it's unstable, as if something else is interfering... Strange, it's just like Abby said.)
mention.source: Rover brings up Abby in “Shadow of Glory” (5×)

mention.title: Stagnant Dawn on Wastelands
mention.text: (The comms are cut... and Abby isn't answering.)
mention.source: Rover brings up Abby in “Stagnant Dawn on Wastelands” (4×)

mention.title: Starlights from Yesterdays
mention.text: Yeah. And Abby, if you think it's stronger than you, don't try to be a hero, okay?
mention.source: Rover brings up Abby in “Starlights from Yesterdays” (3×)

mention.title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
mention.text: By the way, earlier, I asked Abby to "analyze" the abnormal Autopuppet's kernel.
mention.source: Rover brings up Abby in “Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled” (3×)

mention.title: Song of the Heart Sword
mention.text: "Adorable"... You mean Abby?
mention.source: Rover brings up Abby in “Song of the Heart Sword” (3×)

timeline.quest: Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song

dialogue.desc: Your forgotten past, hazy memories, and a strange dream... So many questions linger about your identity, and who you used to be. Meanwhile, a mysterious pull guides you to a hidden place on the distant sea...

sample.speaker: Sanhua
sample.text: I have sent the coordinates to your terminal. Thank you for your kind help... I pray you will both return safely.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: I'm here.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Hey, did you notice how the mountain has a strangely pleasant smell? It doesn't look edible though...

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Not that I'm hungry or anything. I just tend to doze off easily. Feels like my body can only process what I consume while sleeping.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Well of course I'm reliable! Even if I do happen to fall asleep and can't hear you...

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Of course you can! When I'm already so cool. you must be pretty amazing too!

scene.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

mention.title: Dreaming Deep · event story
mention.text: "Look, Rover! Isn't that Sanhua? Finally, a familiar face!"
mention.source: Abby brings up Sanhua in “Dreaming Deep · event story”

dialogue.desc: You meet an old storyteller when you roam about in Hongzhen. While you listen to the the immortality tales about Mt. Firmament, you notice another interested listener...

sample.speaker: Changli
sample.text: I don't know. Maybe it's because... Your presence makes me feel at ease.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Wait... I smell Tacet Discords in that cave!

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: No... There's more... Tacet Discords, humans, and...

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Smells like a whole bunch of messed up frequencies... It's so... familiar...

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: C'mon, after all we've been through, you still don't trust my sniffer? Be grateful, I'm giving you a warning!

sample.speaker: Changli
sample.text: Rover? Did something happen?

scene.desc: With the great battle over, the Land of Xuanfang is slowly returning to how it once was, though plenty of aftershocks have yet to settle. Then one day, a WavesLine message from Yangyang arrives out of the blue: Suisui is about to head back to Mengzhou City...
You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

mention.title: Immortal Blaze
mention.text: Hey. Why are the people here so divided about Changli?
mention.source: Abby brings up Changli in “Immortal Blaze”

mention.title: The Lifer
mention.text: But there are only nine circles. Doesn't look like the kind of game you played with Changli.
mention.source: Abby brings up Changli in “The Lifer”

dialogue.desc: You meet an old storyteller when you roam about in Hongzhen. While you listen to the the immortality tales about Mt. Firmament, you notice another interested listener...

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Now that's much easier to understand. Why did she have to make it a whole riddle? *yawn *... I'm getting sleepy again.

sample.speaker: Xinyi
sample.text: Rover?

sample.speaker: Xinyi
sample.text: Nice to see you again. How are you liking Hongzhen so far?

sample.speaker: Xinyi
sample.text: The crisis at Mt. Firmament has been resolved, and the waterway between Jinzhou and Hongzhen is open once again. As a result, there has been an increase in visitors from Jinzhou, making the town more lively than before.

sample.speaker: Xinyi
sample.text: With the chaos subsiding, our town and city are now reconnected, allowing residents to live and work in peace.

sample.speaker: Xinyi
sample.text: We owe you a debt of gratitude, Rover, for your efforts in clearing the remaining effects of Temporal Disruptions in Mt. Firmament over the past few days.

scene.desc: It is the deity that commands time. It is the deity that bestows blessings. Now is your time to confront Sentinel Jué.

dialogue.desc: You meet an old storyteller when you roam about in Hongzhen. While you listen to the the immortality tales about Mt. Firmament, you notice another interested listener...

sample.speaker: Changli
sample.text: I know my limits.

sample.speaker: Wuli
sample.text: Rover, Lady Changli...

sample.speaker: Fuling
sample.text: Wuli is fine now, thanks to his doctor's help. As for me... Well, at least I can still walk a bit.

sample.speaker: Fuling
sample.text: After all, it's been almost five days...

sample.speaker: Wuli
sample.text: I never properly thanked you for bringing me back to Hongzhen. I heard about the attack by the Fractsidus in the mountains. I... I'm so sorry...

sample.speaker: Changli
sample.text: *chuckle* No need for that. I understand.

mention.title: Immortal Blaze
mention.text: Fuling has come to terms with her impending death. She doesn't buy into the legends of "immortality." Instead, she simply wants to make the most of the time she has left and fulfill her and Wuli's dreams together.
mention.source: Changli brings up Wuli in “Immortal Blaze” (5×)

mention.title: Immortal Blaze
mention.text: Rover, Lady Changli...
mention.source: Wuli brings up Changli in “Immortal Blaze”

dialogue.desc: You meet an old storyteller when you roam about in Hongzhen. While you listen to the the immortality tales about Mt. Firmament, you notice another interested listener...

sample.speaker: Wuli
sample.text: I've found a way to slow down your illness. No more pain, my love... We can finally be together, forever!

sample.speaker: Fuling
sample.text: You mean... that legend? It's real?

sample.speaker: Wuli
sample.text: Fuling... Are you... Are you not happy?

sample.speaker: Fuling
sample.text: No... I am... I'm so glad to hear it.

sample.speaker: Wuli
sample.text: Haha... Yes...

sample.speaker: Fuling
sample.text: ...Wuli!

dialogue.quest: Tales of the Past and Present: Averardo Vault
dialogue.desc: Fuling in Egla Town is collecting these pages of scattered books. Go and deliver the pages found in Averardo Vault to her.

sample.speaker: Fuling
sample.text: These seem to be the advertising brochures from Averardo Bank...

sample.speaker: Wuli
sample.text: Some notes on them are really interesting. Fuling even marked them.

sample.speaker: Fuling
sample.text: But it seems that the name Montelli holds a special meaning for them.

sample.speaker: Fuling
sample.text: These brochures are quite intriguing. Thank you, Rover.

dialogue.quest: Tales of the Past and Present: Whisperwind Haven
dialogue.desc: Fuling in Egla Town is collecting these pages of scattered books. Go and deliver the pages found in Whisperwind Haven to her.

sample.speaker: Fuling
sample.text: At that time, I truly felt like the clouds were within my reach... Sadly, that life is now behind me.

sample.speaker: Wuli
sample.text: Fuling...

sample.speaker: Fuling
sample.text: You're right. And I'm deeply grateful that you and Changli helped me find the courage to start again.

sample.speaker: Wuli
sample.text: Once I get the goldsmith's reply...

sample.speaker: Fuling
sample.text: Hm? Did you say something?

sample.speaker: Wuli
sample.text: Oh... nothing at all!

sample.speaker: Fuling
sample.text: ...Wuli.

sample.speaker: Wuli
sample.text: Y-Yes?

sample.speaker: Fuling
sample.text: I'm really looking forward to it...

sample.speaker: Wuli
sample.text: Once I get the goldsmith's reply...

sample.speaker: Fuling
sample.text: Hm? Did you say something?

sample.speaker: Wuli
sample.text: Oh... nothing at all!

sample.speaker: Fuling
sample.text: ...Wuli.

sample.speaker: Wuli
sample.text: Y-Yes?

sample.speaker: Fuling
sample.text: I'm really looking forward to it...

sample.speaker: Wuli
sample.text: Fuling... are you feeling all right now?

sample.speaker: Fuling
sample.text: Mhm, don't worry about me. The new medicine is actually working really well. I feel surprisingly energetic now!

sample.speaker: Wuli
sample.text: That's a relief... Kuiren mentioned that anyone who watches the Carriage Procession will be blessed with good fortune.

sample.speaker: Wuli
sample.text: Just let me know if you get tired, okay? I can carry you back.

sample.speaker: Fuling
sample.text: I-I'm fine, really... The doctor said I need to walk and stretch my legs anyway—Ah... look over there, Wuli! Isn't that beautiful?

sample.speaker: Wuli

dialogue.desc: A pair of constantly shifting spatial coordinates leading to an unknown location has caught your attention. Following the trail, you reach a metropolis... that had been erased long ago.

sample.speaker: Shorekeeper
sample.text: One points to an unknown location. The other... points here, to the Black Shores.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Whoever left that message knew exactly where to find the Black Shores. And if they do...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I'll check it out.

sample.speaker: Shorekeeper
sample.text: Understood. I will send the coordinates to your Terminal. I must remain here to continue isolating and tracing embedded messages in the surrounding frequencies. I entrust this to you, my star.

dialogue.desc: After you escaped from Honami City, Chisa, who had pushed herself to the brink of overclocking more than once, received treatment at the Black Shores. You've been apart ever since. Now, it's time to visit her again. For both of you, this will be a new beginning.

sample.speaker: Shorekeeper
sample.text: That I tried. Encore kept insisting she finish it, even remarking, "Your time has come, big bad homework!"

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Yeah, that's Encore alright...

dialogue.desc: The gateway to Lahai-Roi is now open! What burns beneath the frostlands is waiting for your return!

sample.speaker: Shorekeeper
sample.text: You may set out whenever you wish.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: What is it?

sample.speaker: Shorekeeper
sample.text: This? Chisa taught me how to make this beverage. I find it tastes better with more milk and sugar...

sample.speaker: Shorekeeper
sample.text: I just made a cup. Would you... like to try it?

sample.speaker: Shorekeeper
sample.text: Hm, very well.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Were you worried about something just now?

dialogue.desc: Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.

sample.speaker: Shorekeeper
sample.text: ...Is the situation in Lahai-Roi that dire? You look exhausted.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: My frequency loss has been resolved. But Lahai-Roi is under imminent Threnodian threat. I need your help, Shorekeeper.

sample.speaker: Shorekeeper
sample.text: Understood. For this purpose… both I, and the Black Shores, exist.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Any additional intel on the Exostrider within the Tethys System? Verified or not, I need everything you have.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I trust Luuk. You can speak freely.

sample.speaker: Shorekeeper
sample.text: Records confirm that Luuk Herssen has been providing critical assistance and intelligence to the Black Shores. I trust your judgment.

dialogue.desc: Shorekeeper might have some clues about Abby's weakening frequencies. Return to the Black Shores to find out.

sample.speaker: Shorekeeper
sample.text: It remained hidden until the core leak in the Tethys System was finally resolved.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (That message... I think I should trust it.)

sample.speaker: Shorekeeper
sample.text: Imperator is Rinascita's Sentinel.

sample.speaker: Shorekeeper
sample.text: It is also the solution Tethys proposes. As Rinascita's Sentinel, Imperator should have the knowledge to fix Abby's weakening frequency.

sample.speaker: Shorekeeper
sample.text: Rinascita, also called the Land of Echoes, is renowned for its Echo technologies. It's home to many like Abby who have physical forms.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (Rinascita? I may finally learn who Abby really is...)

dialogue.quest: Advance toward the Future from Today
dialogue.desc: The past is not without meaning—it shapes our hopes for the future. While the past cannot be altered, it forms the foundation for pavind a new path ahead. Break the chains of the past, and seize the promise of tomorrow—for those who have no future, for those who safeguard these shores, and... for yourself.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: That sounds familiar. I feel like I heard it before.

sample.speaker: Shorekeeper
sample.text: A long time ago, you taught me how to play it.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I see. But I... I have no memory of it.

sample.speaker: Shorekeeper
sample.text: I'll teach you...

sample.speaker: Shorekeeper
sample.text: Just like you did for me before.

dialogue.summary: To deter you from rescuing the Shorekeeper, who is on the verge of becoming its core, the Tethys System reveals three potential futures in its absence: and ice age, a cataclysmic disaster, and the total reconstruction of civilization. The Shorekeeper and you return to reality, landing on the very beach where you first arrived in the Black Shores.

dialogue.desc: Beneath what was once a brilliant and harmonious starry sky, chaos and tragedy now prevail. As the boundary between the virtual and the real begins to blur, where will the remnants of civilization find their path?

sample.speaker: Shorekeeper
sample.text: Grasping desperately for a tomorrow that never dawns.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: But why?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Why is this burden yours to carry?

sample.speaker: Shorekeeper
sample.text: I am the guardian of the Black Shores, the core of Tethys.

sample.speaker: Shorekeeper
sample.text: I was created for this purpose.

dialogue.summary: The Shorekeeper asks that you retrieve the Necrostar and restore balance at the Modulation Hall. With the Shorekeeper's assistance, you successfully retrieve the source of the chaos—the Necrostar.

dialogue.desc: Yuan's Flavors welcomes the pickiest diner in its history, and the Fillet Fairmaiden resolves to bring back Xuanfang's finest, freshest taste. But reviving the old recipe and tracking down the ingredients leads to one surprise after another...

sample.speaker: Shorekeeper
sample.text: As for taste preferences… "Yuan Fortress lies at low elevation, shrouded in fog year-round. Its people favored spice, to ward off the cold and damp." Dishes of that era were spicier than what we know today.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: So other dishes and tastes changed with the times, including Yuan's Flavors and its customers, but the Immortal's Medley stayed exactly the same.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Thank you, Shorekeeper. I think I found why.

sample.speaker: Shorekeeper
sample.text: I am pleased to have helped you, Rover.

dialogue.desc: You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: What's this?

sample.speaker: Shorekeeper
sample.text: This looks like some kind of data overflow. With access to the Abbowser Castle network, we should be able to make use of it.

scene.desc: Earth returns to earth, and ashes to ashes. The wandering souls within the Tethys System have finally found their peace, and the Shorekeeper is now free, thanks to your efforts. She wishes to speak with you—there's something she must share, something that concerns you directly.

The future is still unknown, and the past remains buried beneath the waves. After your journey across Mt. Firmament, all clues now point to a hidden island in the sea—the Black Shores. Yangyang's message hints that in the Port City of Guixu, you might find the Bloom Bearer now stationed in Jinzhou.

A blue figure guides you through the mist-it's the Shorekeeper. The bad news you've brought from the Port City to Guixu has unveiled a looming threat now casting its shadow over the Black Shores. An imminent danger awaits both you and the Black Shores.

KU-Lolo has a new idea to turn your fondest memories into unique Cube souvernirs in the Second Coming of Solaris! Head on over to the Memory Travelogue event, collect memories with the Cubes, and turn them in to KU-Lolo!

sample.text: Rover? Is that really you? You're back?

sample.speaker: Zhezhi
sample.text: Oh, thank goodness. Now that you're here, Rover, everything is going to be all right. You must've come back because you heard what happened to Yangyang and Chixia!

sample.speaker: Zhezhi
sample.text: Huh? You haven't heard? Chixia's still unconscious, and Yangyang... she's gone missing. And now...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: ...Can you be more specific, Zhezhi?

sample.speaker: Zhezhi
sample.text: O-okay. I-I only found out recently myself. There was a commission that passed its deadline, but nobody came to follow up on it...

dialogue.quest: Dreamscape Odyssey: The Mountain and Six Credits

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Do you remember when you painted the first Winter's Serenade in Bloom?

sample.speaker: Zhezhi
sample.text: Yes. I saw flowers blooming in the middle of winter, and birds were circling around...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: You worked really hard on it.

sample.speaker: Zhezhi
sample.text: And... that hard work should be noticed.

dialogue.quest: Chasing the Moon, Here and Now
dialogue.desc: Not far away from Yumyum Haven, you meet Zhezhi, who is troubled by a lack of inspiration for her paintings. Ask her about it.

sample.speaker: Zhezhi
sample.text: That's... that's okay. I prefer quiet places... Plus, I live right here in Jinzhou, not too far away...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (Leaving her alone here... doesn't sit right.)

sample.speaker: Zhezhi
sample.text: Me? I'm not really that hungry—

sample.speaker: Zhezhi
sample.text: Uh...

sample.speaker: Zhezhi
sample.text: Really? Thank you... But I still haven't finished my painting—

sample.speaker: Zhezhi
sample.text: You're right... Don't mind if I do!

dialogue.desc: Dianxiao is finally opening her Fan Drawing Stall. Go visit it. Unlock a new Companion after completing this quest.

sample.speaker: Zhezhi
sample.text: No, that might make it too blurry. The customers at the Moonlit Fair prefers more realistic detail...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (Zhezhi seems deeply focused. She should have no problem working on the painting. I'll get going and do Dianxiao's request...)

sample.speaker: Zhezhi
sample.text: Uh... Did I just see someone out of the corner of my eye?

sample.speaker: Zhezhi
sample.text: felt... familiar?

sample.speaker: Zhezhi
sample.text: Nevermind... I'm probably just seeing things after staying up too late.

sample.speaker: Zhezhi
sample.text: S-sorry! I, um... I didn't mean to be SO LOUD!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: ...Zhezhi?

sample.speaker: Zhezhi
sample.text: Huh? Rover?!

sample.speaker: Zhezhi
sample.text: I'm so sorry! I was just... in a hurry...

sample.speaker: Zhezhi
sample.text: I already delivered his commission! I really did!

sample.speaker: Zhezhi
sample.text: We agreed on the final payment, but he kept making excuses, dragging it on and on! He even claimed he didn't speak the Huanglong language, and then he just... DISAPPEARED!

scene.desc: A mysterious request, a lost delivery, an opening gateway... In a realm where dreams and nightmares intertwine, a massive shadow looms around you. It casts a darkness over reality, opening the gateways to dreams across Jinzhou. It asks you, if beauty is fleeting and salvation is futile, why not remain in a dream...

The Land of Xuanfang is thrown into turmoil following an unexpected riot of out-of-control Autopuppets. As you investigate, you uncover the mastermind behind the scheme—a mysterious Artisan who covets the Sentinel's technology. In the culmination of the event, this figure commands the rogue Autopuppets to launch an assault on Xuanfang Hold.

scene.quest: Wish Upon the Moon I: Cry of the Soul
scene.desc: Following the clues in the wish, you uncover the true identity of "Xiaosheng", and what he has to tell...

scene.quest: Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song
scene.desc: The frequencies building up within Patty have resonated with the environment and generated a Sonoro Sphere. The truth about the fourth wish may be hidden therein. The name Patty keeps mumbling about seems to be connected with Xiangli Yao. You must head it off at the pass before things get out of hands at the Moonlit Fair.

mention.title: The Wind Before the Storm
mention.text: Don't beat yourself up, Zhezhi. You've already been a big help.
mention.source: Rover brings up Zhezhi in “The Wind Before the Storm” (2×)

mention.title: Dreamscape Odyssey: The Mountain and Six Credits
mention.text: Zhezhi.
mention.source: Rover brings up Zhezhi in “Dreamscape Odyssey: The Mountain and Six Credits”

mention.title: Wish You Were Here
mention.text: (Zhezhi seems deeply focused. She should have no problem working on the painting. I'll get going and do Dianxiao's request...)
mention.source: Rover brings up Zhezhi in “Wish You Were Here”

mention.title: Star Bouncing · event story
mention.text: ...Zhezhi?
mention.source: Rover brings up Zhezhi in “Star Bouncing · event story”

timeline.quest: Wish Upon the Moon I: Cry of the Soul
Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song

dialogue.desc: It is the deity that commands time. It is the deity that bestows blessings. Now is your time to confront Sentinel Jué.

sample.speaker: Jué
sample.text: Rover, this battle is related to the fate of Jinzhou, and only you can open this Sonoro Sphere. The key to Jinzhou's future lies in your hands.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: ...If I open it, Jinhsi is bound to face you in the ultimate battle.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: The ideal outcome would be for her to absorb your power at the critical moment and restore the time flow without any loss of life.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: But there's also a chance that she could push herself too far and end up dying from Overclocking.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Though... if I do nothing, you'll use your remaining power to freeze all of Jinzhou in time.

sample.speaker: Jué
sample.text: Correct.

dialogue.summary: As the dust settles, Jué meets with you as promised. You learn that you were once Jué's master and established Jinzhou with its assistance.

scene.desc: Time resumes and the snow clears. Mt. Firmament emerges from its long seclusion, ready to embrace its revival.
According to the Sentinel's hints, three Flare Stones must be activated, and the Flare Crests be put out to remove the chains on them that are made of special Flare Crests.

mention.title: Rewinding Raindrops
mention.text: Jiyan the General, Jinhsi the Magistrate, and Jué, Jinzhou's Sentinel... Is there any kind of connection between them?
mention.source: Rover brings up Jué in “Rewinding Raindrops”

mention.title: The Sacred Breeze So Often Breathes
mention.text: (With that message left on Tethys... Could the Sentinel here be in a situation similar to Jué's?)
mention.source: Rover brings up Jué in “The Sacred Breeze So Often Breathes”

mention.title: What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing
mention.text: (He said she "once again resonated with the Sentinel," was that really a Second Resonance Awakening? Sentinel Jué had a trial with Jinhsi, but my permission was needed to transfer the Sentinel's power...)
mention.source: Rover brings up Jué in “What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing”

mention.title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
mention.text: Like the visions I had when I saw Jué's statue?
mention.source: Rover brings up Jué in “Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled”

dialogue.desc: According to the Sentinel's hints, three Flare Stones must be activated, and the Flare Crests be put out to remove the chains on them that are made of special Flare Crests.

sample.speaker: Jué
sample.text: Jinhsi, your journey has been an arduous one. Aside from aiding one in this predicament, surely there are other inquiries you wish to make?

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: I cannot bring myself to ask for more. All I seek is the truth.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: Mt. Firmament is in grave danger... Regarding the Temporal Mandate and your injuries... Please, do not keep the truth from me any longer.

sample.speaker: Jué
sample.text: One understands your concerns. The timing may not be optimal for this disclosure, yet in the midst of crisis, one must act with expedience.

sample.speaker: Jué
sample.text: For one will soon perish.

dialogue.desc: It is the deity that commands time. It is the deity that bestows blessings. Now is your time to confront Sentinel Jué.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: Yes, virtue must come first. Politics, commerce—it all must serve the people.

sample.speaker: Jué
sample.text: From now on, you shall be known as "Jinhsi," bearing Jinzhou's name as your own.

sample.speaker: Jué
sample.text: What do you think of this world?

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: Like... here. Darkness clings, but lights flicker in the gloom...

sample.speaker: Jué
sample.text: A guiding light is not easily lit.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: That's why they stand out so brightly against the darkness.

scene.desc: Time resumes and the snow clears. Mt. Firmament emerges from its long seclusion, ready to embrace its revival.

mention.title: Clashing Blades
mention.text: I have one last question for you. Abducting "Jué", stalking Rover, and setting up an ambush in Qichi Village... You couldn't have accomplished that all on your own.
mention.source: Jinhsi brings up Jué in “Clashing Blades” (22×)

mention.title: Grand Warstorm
mention.text: Now that we are facing such an emergency, I cannot sit back and wait for Jué to save us. I will act and see my duty through. This is my decision.
mention.source: Jinhsi brings up Jué in “Grand Warstorm” (3×)

mention.title: Truthseeker's Pass (Quest)
mention.text: ...I share a Resonance connection with Jué, but I never took the time to truly get to know it... I've been blind to its suffering for so long...
mention.source: Jinhsi brings up Jué in “Truthseeker's Pass (Quest)” (3×)

mention.title: The Wind Before the Storm
mention.text: Rover, given your deep connection with Jué, you should be able to use any of its artifacts freely as well.
mention.source: Jinhsi brings up Jué in “The Wind Before the Storm” (3×)

mention.title: Mianloong Chamber (Quest)
mention.text: Even Jué's decision to bring me back to life... Whether out of pity or not, I am truly grateful. The thought of it warms my heart every time.
mention.source: Jinhsi brings up Jué in “Mianloong Chamber (Quest)” (2×)

mention.title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
mention.text: Jué once mentioned that Hsin separated Her tail to create multiple Prisms of Fate. Each one contains a fragment of the Sentinel's power. If one is hidden in the Hold, it's no coincidence...
mention.source: Jinhsi brings up Jué in “Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled” (2×)

mention.title: The Commander of Time
mention.text: To accomplish her goal, Jinhsi must possess both strength and confidence. Revealing the truth to her earlier would only add to her troubles and not aid in improving her abilities.
mention.source: Jué brings up Jinhsi in “The Commander of Time” (11×)

mention.title: Mianloong Chamber (Quest)
mention.text: Jinhsi, your journey has been an arduous one. Aside from aiding one in this predicament, surely there are other inquiries you wish to make?
mention.source: Jué brings up Jinhsi in “Mianloong Chamber (Quest)” (7×)

dialogue.quest: Do Echoids Dream of Electric Sheep? (Quest)
dialogue.desc: You found Cosmos, Encore's wooly companion, by a mysterious gate. Some kind of test seems to be running behind the gate and it needs your assistance. During the test, Cosmos will provide Echoids to significantly boost Resonators' combat power. You can complete the task with your friends.

sample.speaker: Cosmos
sample.text: Ahem, I um...

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Did you say experiment? What experiment?

sample.speaker: Cosmos
sample.text: It's a stability test of the dream links. This is the entrance to the experiment zone. You will conduct the testing on the other side, Rover.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Rover, I smell something fishy about his offer.

sample.speaker: Cosmos
sample.text: Of course I... Wait, why that look?

sample.speaker: Cosmos
sample.text: I-I… Please, Rover, I have no one else to turn to. What can I do to make you accept? I'll do anything within my power.

dialogue.quest: Do Echoids Dream of Electric Sheep?: Epilogue
dialogue.desc: Do Echoids Dream of Electric Sheep?: Epilogue

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: I think we deserve an explanation.

sample.speaker: Cosmos
sample.text: Somnoire? Sorry, not my thing.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: You're not deceiving me!

sample.speaker: Cosmos
sample.text: That's why I hate sharp people...

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: What were you murmuring about?

sample.speaker: Cosmos
sample.text: Now you have all the rewards I promised and you must be tired after all these battles so maybe you should get some rest oh and I still got something to attend to so bye!

scene.desc: You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

dialogue.desc: Xisha asks you to make him the legendary fireworks. Seems like an easy job... maybe? Unlock a new Companion after completing this quest.

sample.speaker: Encore
sample.text: What's that, Mr. Li? Looks really yummy!

sample.speaker: Uncle Li
sample.text: It's called the Plumpcake. A traditional dessert passed down in Jinzhou for thousands of years. Try it, you'll love it.

sample.speaker: Encore
sample.text: Thousands of years... Then there's gotta be cool stories about it. Right, Mr. Li? Do you know any?

sample.speaker: Uncle Li
sample.text: Hmm... Actually, I do. Let's see...

sample.speaker: Uncle Li
sample.text: This is a story that dates back to the two Sentinels of Huanglong...

dialogue.desc: The future is still unknown, and the past remains buried beneath the waves. After your journey across Mt. Firmament, all clues now point to a hidden island in the sea—the Black Shores. Yangyang's message hints that in the Port City of Guixu, you might find the Bloom Bearer now stationed in Jinzhou.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: You, er, brought it up before.

sample.speaker: Youhu
sample.text: Aw, Yangyang's got a soft spot for you, huh? Are you her SPECIAL someone?

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Oh, come on. I-I just know it means a lot to you.

sample.speaker: Youhu
sample.text: Relax, I'm just teasing. So Rover, you're tracking the Black Shores too?

sample.speaker: Youhu
sample.text: Since we're on the same trail, how about teaming up?

sample.speaker: Youhu
sample.text: Let THIS master be your guide! You and me, dream team. Nothing is going to slow us down.

scene.desc: A blue figure guides you through the mist-it's the Shorekeeper. The bad news you've brought from the Port City to Guixu has unveiled a looming threat now casting its shadow over the Black Shores. An imminent danger awaits both you and the Black Shores.
scene.summary: She confirms that it was indeed she who saved you, Yangyang, and Youhu in the Port City of Guixu.

mention.title: From the Echoes of Destruction
mention.text: This is Youhu from Jinzhou. Like Mr. Chenpi, she's an expert in antiques.
mention.source: Yangyang brings up Youhu in “From the Echoes of Destruction”

mention.title: From the Echoes of Destruction
mention.text: Aw, Yangyang's got a soft spot for you, huh? Are you her SPECIAL someone?
mention.source: Youhu brings up Yangyang in “From the Echoes of Destruction”

mention.title: Hidden Between the Waves
mention.text: We couldn't reach you for so long! Yangyang was freaking out!
mention.source: Youhu brings up Yangyang in “Hidden Between the Waves”

sample.speaker: Youhu
sample.text: What? Ro...ver...

sample.speaker: Aalto
sample.text: Comm's dead? Don't worry. It happens a lot around here.

sample.speaker: Aalto
sample.text: The Black Shores sits atop a massive Tacetite, wreaking havoc on standard communications.

sample.speaker: Aalto
sample.text: Once we reach the Greenhouse, you can patch them in near our beacon.

sample.speaker: Aalto
sample.text: Only our beacons can cut through the Tacetite's interference.
