sample.speaker: Aalto
sample.text: No... I'll miss seeing my friend in action again.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Maybe that's why you saw the other you in that vision?

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: I... I'm so sleepy...

scene.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

Beneath what was once a brilliant and harmonious starry sky, chaos and tragedy now prevail. As the boundary between the virtual and the real begins to blur, where will the remnants of civilization find their path?
Shorekeeper might have some clues about Abby's weakening frequencies. Return to the Black Shores to find out.

mention.title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
mention.text: One more thing. Back in Jinzhou, Abby proved capable of absorbing the Threnodian's frequencies. This means, in theory, it could act as a temporary host for the Gem.
mention.source: Aalto brings up Abby in “Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides” (2×)

dialogue.desc: After you escaped from Honami City, Chisa, who had pushed herself to the brink of overclocking more than once, received treatment at the Black Shores. You've been apart ever since. Now, it's time to visit her again. For both of you, this will be a new beginning.

sample.speaker: Shorekeeper
sample.text: I'm glad to hear that. Your vitals are also within normal parameters now.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: ugh, this part of you feels completely empty. Let me check that out for you.

sample.speaker: Shorekeeper
sample.text: How can that be...? The readings tell me your vitals are within normal parameters now.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Hey, I'm still wide awake ya know, just a little beat. And this part of you feels completely empty.

sample.speaker: Shorekeeper
sample.text: The connection between your frequency and the rift has been cut off. You are out of immediate danger.

dialogue.desc: Beneath what was once a brilliant and harmonious starry sky, chaos and tragedy now prevail. As the boundary between the virtual and the real begins to blur, where will the remnants of civilization find their path?

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: This looks awful! Ugh, like the worst stew ever made!

sample.speaker: Shorekeeper
sample.text: This frequency...

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: W-what are you staring at?

sample.speaker: Shorekeeper
sample.text: It's the one.

sample.speaker: Shorekeeper
sample.text: This frequency has dwelled within you for millions of years.

sample.speaker: Shorekeeper
sample.text: I'll keep an eye on it. We have more important matters at hand.

dialogue.summary: The Shorekeeper, meanwhile, appears deeply concerned about you and Abby's unique symbiosis.

scene.desc: A pair of constantly shifting spatial coordinates leading to an unknown location has caught your attention. Following the trail, you reach a metropolis... that had been erased long ago.
The gateway to Lahai-Roi is now open! What burns beneath the frostlands is waiting for your return!
Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.

A blue figure guides you through the mist-it's the Shorekeeper. The bad news you've brought from the Port City to Guixu has unveiled a looming threat now casting its shadow over the Black Shores. An imminent danger awaits both you and the Black Shores.

Yuan's Flavors welcomes the pickiest diner in its history, and the Fillet Fairmaiden resolves to bring back Xuanfang's finest, freshest taste. But reviving the old recipe and tracking down the ingredients leads to one surprise after another...
You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

mention.title: Through the Sea Thou Break
mention.text: It is also the solution Tethys proposes. As Rinascita's Sentinel, Imperator should have the knowledge to fix Abby's weakening frequency.
mention.source: Shorekeeper brings up Abby in “Through the Sea Thou Break” (9×)

mention.title: The One that Impresses
mention.text: I cannot say for certain. Since Abby is full of mysteries, the possible inferences are complicated.
mention.source: Shorekeeper brings up Abby in “The One that Impresses”

mention.title: Flowing Starlight in the Iris
mention.text: ...Whoa, why the formality all of a sudden? Ahem. So you asked Shorekeeper to invite the Black Shores gang over for a party. They should be here pretty soon, right?
mention.source: Abby brings up Shorekeeper in “Flowing Starlight in the Iris”

dialogue.desc: The Land of Xuanfang is thrown into turmoil following an unexpected riot of out-of-control Autopuppets. As you investigate, you uncover the mastermind behind the scheme—a mysterious Artisan who covets the Sentinel's technology. In the culmination of the event, this figure commands the rogue Autopuppets to launch an assault on Xuanfang Hold.

sample.speaker: Xiangli Yao
sample.text: Yes, just happened by. Seems you two managed to find each other, Rover. Though... I hear you've stumbled into fresh trouble at Xuanfang Hold.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Mengzhou's Sentinel, Hsin the Moon Fox, has gone missing.

sample.speaker: Xiangli Yao
sample.text: Really...? I'm sorry that I can't personally assist with the investigation. But if you need help, contact Huaxu Academy at any time. Everyone here will do their utmost to help you.

sample.speaker: Xiangli Yao
sample.text: I should be returning to my lab. I wish you a swift and successful conclusion to this case.

dialogue.quest: Wish Upon the Moon I: Cry of the Soul
dialogue.desc: Following the clues in the wish, you uncover the true identity of "Xiaosheng", and what he has to tell...

sample.speaker: Xiangli Yao
sample.text: I hope this data can be of help to you. Once I've wrapped up here at the Academy, I'll meet you as soon as I can.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Well then... It's time to look for some Echoes.

dialogue.quest: Wish Upon the Moon II: The Elder's Promise
dialogue.desc: The wish that finds difficulty making a choice and seeks an answer starts to understand the weight of "choices" after you listen to it.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: What was that about?

sample.speaker: Xiangli Yao
sample.text: Hehe...It was just a little trick to get Mrs. Heying to join us at the Lodge. You probably sensed it after hearing her story.

sample.speaker: Xiangli Yao
sample.text: The promise between Mrs. Heying and her son wasn't just about seeing his wish granted but about finding peace in her life.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: In her grief, Mrs. Heying overlooked what her son truly wished for.

sample.speaker: Xiangli Yao
sample.text: I believe he wanted her to see Jinzhou uniting to defeat the Threnodian and the joy and security he sacrified himself to safeguard.

sample.speaker: Xiangli Yao
sample.text: His wish for his mother represents not just life's simple joys, but also the courage to keep living.

dialogue.quest: Wish Upon the Moon IV: Swan Song
dialogue.desc: The frequencies building up within Patty have resonated with the environment and generated a Sonoro Sphere. The truth about the fourth wish may be hidden therein. The name Patty keeps mumbling about seems to be connected with Xiangli Yao. You must head it off at the pass before things get out of hands at the Moonlit Fair.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Isn't that...

sample.speaker: Xiangli Yao
sample.text: Hello, Rover. Can you come to the Moontree Lodge?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Hey, you done deciphering that fourth wish?

sample.speaker: Xiangli Yao
sample.text: Yes... As I suspected, Patty's malfunction was caused by something else.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Understood. I'll be right there.

sample.speaker: Xiangli Yao
sample.text: Thank you. I'll see you in the usual spot.

sample.speaker: Xiangli Yao
sample.text: Unusual volume or distinct visual changes are both caused by it. Mm-hmm!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Then the effect on you is...

sample.speaker: Xiangli Yao
sample.text: ...A sudden verbal disorder involving the strange use of modal particles. Mm-hmm!

sample.speaker: Xiangli Yao
sample.text: That said, these changes won't damage your persona. They only affect your movements and combat styles until the effect expires.

sample.speaker: Xiangli Yao
sample.text: If you stay and explore further, it may be easier for you to adapt to these changes and uncover the clues you need. Mm-hmm!

sample.speaker: Xiangli Yao
sample.text: How do you see it, Rover?

dialogue.desc: As the Moon-Chasing Festival approaches, you become aware of the "Moontree Lodge" tales under the Wishing Tree. An encounter with a strange robot links you to the mysterious wish granter at the Lodge...

sample.speaker: Xiangli Yao
sample.text: It does have its challenges, but everyone's hopes and dreams for the festival are in these wishes. I don't intend to let them down.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (Yes, Yangyang and the rest... have set their hearts on this festival.)

sample.speaker: Xiangli Yao
sample.text: I appreciate the gesture... but I wouldn't want to trouble you.

sample.speaker: Xiangli Yao
sample.text: I see. Thank you, Rover. Well, then... The Moontree Lodge welcomes its newest member!

sample.speaker: Xiangli Yao
sample.text: Seems we have a new friend now, Patty.

scene.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

scene.quest: Wish Upon the Moon III: Dreaming of Heroism
scene.desc: A wish to become a hero. Now that you have your own interpretation of how to become one, maybe you can help him.

dialogue.desc: Jinhsi has gone missing, and you just had an enigmatic dream.... That Wayfinder at the ferry may hold answers to these mysteries.

sample.speaker: Xinyi
sample.text: To get inside Mianloong Chamber, we have to find the Cipher Key in Truthseeker's Pass and unseal it with the Keyforge.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: Understood. I will go bring back the Cipher Key.

sample.speaker: Xinyi
sample.text: You are injured... Please rest and leave it to me.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: The Fractsidus will most likely attack this place once I leave. You must stay here and guard it.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: I implore you, Xinyi. Help me keep our people safe.

sample.speaker: Xinyi
sample.text: ...Yes, I will, Madam Magistrate.

dialogue.desc: Jinhsi has gone missing, and you just had an enigmatic dream.... That Wayfinder at the ferry may hold answers to these mysteries.

sample.speaker: Xinyi
sample.text: It prevented the Sentinel from replenishing energy and eventually restricted its movement and perception.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: So... We must free the Sentinel from that force field first.

sample.speaker: Xinyi
sample.text: ...It would be a task more complicated than it sounds.

sample.speaker: Xinyi
sample.text: The people of Hongzhen have lived with the Sentinel for generations. We can usually tell if it's in good shape or not.

sample.speaker: Xinyi
sample.text: But now, the Fractsidus want to capture the Sentinel... They won't just stop at Mt. Firmament. Madam Magistrate, I'm sure you didn't come here just for the Sentinel...

sample.speaker: Xinyi
sample.text: Please tell us what you know, Madam Magistrate.

dialogue.summary: You and Jinhsi return to Hongzhen, and with Xinyi's help, unlock the Mianloong Chamber.

dialogue.desc: It is the deity that commands time. It is the deity that bestows blessings. Now is your time to confront Sentinel Jué.

sample.speaker: Xinyi
sample.text: Government must be guided by virtue. Hsi, do you keep this in mind?

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: Yes, virtue must come first. Politics, commerce—it all must serve the people.

sample.speaker: Jué
sample.text: From now on, you shall be known as "Jinhsi," bearing Jinzhou's name as your own.

sample.speaker: Jué
sample.text: What do you think of this world?

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: Like... here. Darkness clings, but lights flicker in the gloom...

dialogue.desc: A mysterious request, a lost delivery, an opening gateway... In a realm where dreams and nightmares intertwine, a massive shadow looms around you. It casts a darkness over reality, opening the gateways to dreams across Jinzhou. It asks you, if beauty is fleeting and salvation is futile, why not remain in a dream...

sample.speaker: Lumi
sample.text: I didn't notice anything unusual lookin' around, but...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: But what?

sample.speaker: Lumi
sample.text: I'm not sure if it's related... but ever since I've returned from the Whining Aix's Mire, I haven't had any dreams.

sample.speaker: Lumi
sample.text: Ah, it's my coworker. Sorry, I need to take this call.

sample.speaker: Lumi
sample.text: Yes? What? She's back at work already? But she's injured! ...Okay, please take care of her. Thanks.

sample.speaker: Lumi
sample.text: It's one of my team members. She crashed while delivering an express package.

dialogue.summary: In the dream, you come across Lumi, but it appears she can't hear you.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Lumi! Thank goodness you're safe!

sample.speaker: Lumi
sample.text: Rover!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Let's deal with it first and go find Tangtang.

sample.speaker: Lumi
sample.text: Let's do it!!!

dialogue.desc: At Lumi's invitation, you come to an unending party...

sample.speaker: Lumi
sample.text: I stumbled into this Sonoro a while back and found this extravagant place inside! And it's full of all these... "special folk."

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Special? They look pretty ordinary to me.

sample.speaker: Lumi
sample.text: We checked with HQ. Turns out this place was created by a Resonator's rare ability. The folks here sense it, kind of, but most just stop askin' questions and lose themselves in the Forever Fest.

sample.speaker: Lumi
sample.text: But nothing really lasts forever, does it? Even this Sonoro. See? It's already startin' to fade.

sample.speaker: Lumi
sample.text: They all know it. Even a "Forever Fest" won't last forever. But they've grown so used to the happiness here, they'd rather the endin' be a happy one, too.

sample.speaker: Lumi
sample.text: Before this place vanishes, they want to know what's weighing on the host's heart. They asked me to look into it.

dialogue.desc: I.R.I.S. seems to need your help. Maybe you should go check on her.

sample.speaker: Lumi
sample.text: Rover, you must be a wee bit tired lately! How about a breather?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: You read my mind.

sample.speaker: Lumi
sample.text: Aye! I was hoping you'd say that. Official announcement: Lollo Logistics is throwing a proper luxurious bash, and you're on the guest list!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: You mean a luxurious party? Don't tell me it's at the Distribution Center?

sample.speaker: Lumi
sample.text: No, no! It's somewhere you'd never expect!

sample.speaker: Lumi
sample.text: Plus, you'll get to hear a mysterious legend while you're there.

dialogue.desc: The Forever Fest has yet to end, but the Lollo Party is already drawing to a close. Moments of joy never last long, but beyond them lies a brilliant river of stars.

sample.speaker: Lumi
sample.text: I want to go somewhere I've never been before. Take my time, see the sights… and then, travel to places even farther. Of course, I'll be back before the holiday is over.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: That's a great idea, Lumi.

sample.speaker: Lumi
sample.text: Hehe, let me get a plan together first.

sample.speaker: Lumi
sample.text: I haven't decided yet, hmm... but if I can't decide, I'll just keep movin' forward!

sample.speaker: Lumi
sample.text: Who knows… maybe what's waitin' for me... is where a river of stars falls.

phoneSample.speaker: Lumi
phoneSample.text: There's one last wee thing I need your help with, actually.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: What is it?

phoneSample.speaker: Lumi

dialogue.desc: Return to Forever Fest to see which companions have shown up today, and see if Lumi has uncovered something new.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: What are you looking at, Lumi?

sample.speaker: Lumi
sample.text: Oh hi, Rover. I was just watchin' this pigeon.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Looks like Mr. Copo's lapel pin.

sample.speaker: Lumi
sample.text: Yes! I had the Pioneer Association do some diggin' for me. They told me there used to be a magician named Cobb Copo in Rinascita, and his most famous trick was creatin' illusions.

sample.speaker: Lumi
sample.text: Apparently, at one of his fests, a boy saw right through his act. That boy's name was Geisel.

sample.speaker: Lumi
sample.text: They say that Geisel cracked the illusion when he noticed a two-dimensional pigeon that was obviously out of place.

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: Nyarla, you do have a flair for dramatics. Ahem! Anyway, why don't you unwrap it?

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Th-this is...!

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: I took the liberty of having Nyarla custom-make this mask based on my impression of you. I hope it suits your taste.

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: I'm pleased you like it.

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: The Montelli family shares its wealth and opportunities freely, but I see your stage lying beyond the cutthroat games of power and fortune—toward a world that's far more boundless and free.

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: I'm pleased you like it.

dialogue.desc: Your old friend Maji is back again with his "Brand New Lollo Campaign Plan. You guess it... a friend indeed is a friend in need.

sample.speaker: Maji
sample.text: A new chapter for Lollo Logistics: The Maji Era is buzzing with excitement!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: What's the all-new approach?

sample.speaker: Maji
sample.text: Sure, it's just like last year, except we swap out some buzzwords on the slides to make them look impressive for the bosses.

sample.speaker: Maji
sample.text: Why are you looking at me like that? I have to report, you know. Besides, I've just been transferred to headquarters — I still need to put food on the table, right?

sample.speaker: Maji
sample.text: However, I've initiated an optimization plan for the entire Lollo Stamps exchange feature, making it easier to acquire Lollo Stamps without having to detour through the finance department for approvals.

dialogue.desc: The displaced long to rebuild the Old District into their new home, but evil clings like a shadow.

sample.speaker: Maji
sample.text: Boy, am I glad to see you. My friends over at Ragunna told me they were sending some help over from the Order. I never expected it would be you. I'm relieved.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Didn't you get promoted to management? Why are you still out in the field?

sample.speaker: Maji
sample.text: Come on, let's not put it like that. I'm still a courier at heart. When duty calls, I answer.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: So what kind of problem are we dealing with today that's got our Senior Regional Chief Advisor in a tight spot?

sample.speaker: Maji
sample.text: One of our construction material convoys was attacked by TDs while crossing Mournfell Canyon. The Gladiators in charge of escort said they came across "undying monsters."

sample.speaker: Maji
sample.text: That's right. They said those monsters would come back from the dead no matter how many times they killed them. They just wouldn't die.

dialogue.desc: The Day 1 Campaign content has been updated. Maji is ready for you to join forces and take on the new tasks.

sample.speaker: Maji
sample.text: Couriers can provide real-time feedback on road conditions to the "Lollo Navigator," which means the map is constantly being updated.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: So your plan is to combine the map with the various services mentioned earlier?

sample.speaker: Maji
sample.text: Exactly. We also have other new services currently running in their trial phases. You've done a great job today. Let's try out the rest of the features some other time.

dialogue.desc: Your old friend Maji swears he's found his break in Septimont with yet another one of his "genius" business ideas. But whether it takes off or crashes depends on your help.

sample.speaker: Maji
sample.text: You don't get it! Lose freedom, you lose a lot. Lose perfectly-aligned workflow, you lose everything!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (...Pretty sure that's now how the saying goes.)

sample.speaker: Maji
sample.text: Anyway! I jumped right into putting the plan into action.

sample.speaker: Maji
sample.text: But as I said, no matter what I try, I can't outrun melting ice!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Not even with coolers or ice packs?

sample.speaker: Maji
sample.text: No! Friend, no cooler and ice pack can withstand the blazing passion of the crowd!

dialogue.desc: The Lollo Campaign is facing an unexpected crisis! To save Maji's career, and to keep those convenient services running, help him verify the reliability of Lollo Campaign!

sample.speaker: Maji
sample.text: I bet you liked it, right? But that'll be the last of it.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: What?!

sample.speaker: Maji
sample.text: Whoa. First time seeing you give off a face like that. Didn't realize it'd be that big of a blow.

sample.speaker: Maji
sample.text: Don't you worry. There's always a silver lining.

sample.speaker: Maji
sample.text: Our accounting says there are a few things I need to iron out first. Things like, lacking user incentives, not enough granularity in the work flow, and not being able to capitalize data in private domains.

sample.speaker: Maji
sample.text: That's what happens when you're a cog in a wheel. Stuck spinning for life.

dialogue.desc: Bakethoven's dream is to belong to the Echo Depository of Averardo Vault. Can you help him out?

sample.speaker: Maji
sample.text: I see… So, what should we do now?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Let's head to the Vault tomorrow. You said you'd prefer to live a short but meaningful life, right? From where I stand, making food for others seems like a pretty meaningful thing to me.

sample.speaker: Maji
sample.text: Alright then! Let's meet at the Vault tomorrow! Thanks as always, Rover!

dialogue.desc: Go to Maji's place and check for new errands.

sample.speaker: Maji
sample.text: Rover! Rover! Something's off here... PLEASE SAVE ME!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Sounds like Maji is in trouble... I'd better go lend a hand.

dialogue.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Phoebe?

sample.speaker: Phoebe
sample.text: Ahh?!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Is everything alright? You looked like you were somewhere else just now.

sample.speaker: Phoebe
sample.text: Oh... I was just thinking how the Blessed Maiden's voice sounded just like the heavenly voice during the Carnevale...

sample.speaker: Phoebe
sample.text: So I was wondering... about the Sentinel's messages we heard before... Was it... Do you think Their advice... "Consume healthy food, such as the Laurus Salad..."

sample.speaker: Phoebe
sample.text: Huh?

dialogue.desc: Here, all fish gather—and since whales are also considered "fish", then...

sample.speaker: Phoebe
sample.text: Quick, let's check if anything was lost!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Nothing's lost, except now we've got this...

sample.speaker: Phoebe
sample.text: What a strange fish...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: How about we take it back to Planck? Maybe it knows what this is.

dialogue.desc: A long-dead captain, a ship that cannot sail. Yet now, that captain has set upon an inevitable course, and the ship must sail once again...

sample.speaker: Phoebe
sample.text: Rover...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: We're safe now.

sample.speaker: Phoebe
sample.text: Thank you, Cetus the Tidebreaker...

dialogue.quest: Veils Off in Sun or Shadow
dialogue.desc: To understand Gilberto's part in the Echo incident, you trace his steps to the outskirts of the city. But the deep you delve, the more elusive the truth becomes...

sample.speaker: Phoebe
sample.text: From what I know, the Fisalia family is deeply respectful of the Divinity. How could they commit such a blasphemous act? The Echoes are gifts from the Sentinel.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Have you seen this before?

sample.speaker: Phoebe
sample.text: A petal? The ritual one? No, wait... this frequency...

sample.speaker: Phoebe
sample.text: Oh, right! I think I saw this flower in the Cathedral of Mercury, and Priest Alessio was wearing it. Wait... Could he be involved with the Fisalia family's plans?

sample.speaker: Phoebe
sample.text: Imperator granted us Echoes, the skies, lands, oceans, and sustenance. To which we should all be grateful and reverent.

sample.speaker: Phoebe
sample.text: I request to join your investigation, Rover. As a servant of the Sentinel, I simply cannot turn a blind eye to their unholy acts.

dialogue.summary: Bidding Cristoforo farewell, you press on and encounter another familiar face - Acolyte Phoebe.

dialogue.desc: The crisis is over, but Rinascita still has a long road ahead of it...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (Looks like Phoebe is swamped at the moment. Better give her a hand before she gets overwhelmed.)

sample.speaker: Phoebe
sample.text: No, it's all right. I can take care of it.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Shouldering every responsibility can sometimes be irresponsible in itself.

sample.speaker: Calaris
sample.text: I couldn't agree more. Acolyte Phoebe, let us share the burden!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Leave the tasks in Septimont to me. I've gotten pretty familiar with the area.

sample.speaker: Phoebe
sample.text: ...Very well. I'll send over the locations and requirement shortly. Thank you, truly.

dialogue.desc: Not all treasure of the sea is left behind by pirates, some could have been left by ordinary sailors... or a captain.

sample.speaker: Phoebe
sample.text: What do you make of the clues, Rover?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Finding that Gondola might be a good start.

sample.speaker: Phoebe
sample.text: Good idea. The sailor may have vanished, but if his Gondola is still here we may be able to find some clues.

dialogue.desc: A sailor named Starbuck has fallen into mental turmoil—rumor has it, a fish drove him to this state...

sample.speaker: Phoebe
sample.text: O Imperator's blessings, gaze upon this...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: W-wait...

sample.speaker: Phoebe
sample.text: Huh? I did what was written in the archives...

dialogue.summary: Following Captain Ahab's instructions, you and Phoebe manage to find his old First Mate, Starbuck, but the man seems to have fallen under some kind of enchantment.

dialogue.desc: Through your hard work, meaningful changes have taken root in Plushie Village. In the meantime, the village receives a new visitor...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (What's this? The Plushies brought back a recipe for Baton Bread?)

sample.speaker: Fulmine
sample.text: Rover, are you in Plushie Village?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Yeah. I see a new member in the village. An oven Echo?

sample.speaker: Fulmine
sample.text: Oh, you've got sharp eyes. It's called Old Bake, an Echo for the apprentices in a bakery.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I happen to have a bread recipe. Can I ask Old Bake to make me some?

sample.speaker: Fulmine
sample.text: Hmm, that may be difficult.

dialogue.desc: You receive a call from Fulmine, who was asked by a few mysterious "people" to send you an invitation...

sample.speaker: Fulmine
sample.text: Bubble and Old Bake always get cold feet when it comes to visiting new places. Maybe seeing some of the unique views beyond the village would help them change their minds.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Easy peasy, lemon squeezy.

sample.speaker: Fulmine
sample.text: That's great! So...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: New adventures, here we come.

dialogue.desc: Through your hard work, meaningful changes have taken root in Plushie Village. In the meantime, the village receives a new visitor—a Tubpup.

sample.speaker: Fulmine
sample.text: Oh, Rover, you're here! Thanks to you, much of the painting's power has been restored. And look, a new friend has joined our little village!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: A Tubpup?

sample.speaker: Fulmine
sample.text: Yep. This is Bubble!

sample.speaker: Fulmine
sample.text: Bubble used to live in Egla Town, but it's master moved to the city. Unfortunately, it was too costly to bring a Tubpup along.

sample.speaker: Fulmine
sample.text: It's probably not a good idea to leave Bubble wandering around, so I brought it here instead.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (It's understandable to want a new tub for a new home. But it seems that Echoes are more than just furniture for people in Rinascita.)

dialogue.desc: Finally, the restoration of the Plushie Village is complete! There will be a small celebration party and you're invited!

sample.speaker: Fulmine
sample.text: Ah, Rover, here you are.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Are you doing this remotely now?

sample.speaker: Fulmine
sample.text: You see, some Echoes are still acting strange, even though we've restored the painting to its full power. I'm asking HQ to send more field investigators to get it sorted out.

sample.speaker: Fulmine
sample.text: Honestly, things could have been a lot worse without your help!

sample.speaker: Fulmine
sample.text: The Sonance Caskets you've collected have kept the village from falling apart along with the weakening painting. Otherwise, a lot more Echoes would be acting weird.

sample.speaker: Fulmine
sample.text: You gave me the chance to witness this beautiful scene where humans and Echoes live together in harmony.

dialogue.desc: After a long journey, the plushie squad is a mess… Let's help them freshen up and get sparkling clean again.

sample.speaker: Fulmine
sample.text: I'll leave this task to you, Rover. Let me know if you need anything!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: That being said... I've never actually tried going through the morph painting in the village...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Well... Here goes nothing.

dialogue.desc: In Septimont, you received a message from Fulmine: A tiny plushie expedition squad from Ragunna has somehow arrived here too...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: How did you guys get here?

sample.speaker: Fulmine
sample.text: The Plushies have been trying to tell me something lately, but I didn't understand a word of it.

sample.speaker: Fulmine
sample.text: So they grabbed my spare tablet, jumped into the Morph Painting, and just like that, they turned up in Septimont!

sample.speaker: Fulmine
sample.text: Turns out some of these Morph Paintings are connected to each other. This is big. I could make a big story out of this!

sample.speaker: Fulmine
sample.text: This is exactly what I wanted to talk to you about! Could you try turning in a Sonance Casket? We need to confirm if the ones from Septimont can power the Morph Paintings too.

dialogue.quest: The Sacred Breeze So Often Breathes
dialogue.desc: After a minor twist in the journey, Ragunna, the Land of Echoes, unfolds its grandeur, extending a grand welcome to the traveler from distant shores.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Are you okay?

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: The Vitreum Dancer suddenly lost control... Luckily, no one got hurt.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Now that I think about it, the frequency vibration I sensed felt a lot like... empathy.

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: Empathy...?

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Well, maybe telepathy? Not sure. It's hard to explain...

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: Telepathy... Yes, according to legend, the Sentinel speaks directly into the mind of the Laureate. Could that be what happened?

dialogue.quest: Veils Off in Sun or Shadow
dialogue.desc: To understand Gilberto's part in the Echo incident, you trace his steps to the outskirts of the city. But the deep you delve, the more elusive the truth becomes...

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: I see. A WingrayFlying Echo, that explains it.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Wingray?

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: Yes, it's a type of Echo that can fly. People in Ragunna often use them to travel quickly between locations.

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: If Gilberto set up this Wingray as an escape route, it should lead us straight to him.

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: Let's use the Grapple to hitch a ride on the Wingray.

dialogue.desc: You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: Zzz... Forgot to clock out...

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Ugh, that's rough! She's even thinking about her work in her dreams!

sample.speaker: Zani
sample.text: Okay... No problem. I still have plenty of time in my schedule...

You and Lupa follow the Lioness of Glory to the burial ground of the heroes and into a world of growing uncertainty. At the same time, you start to wonder if Lupa, your companion on this journey, is friend or foe. Cheers sound distorted. Fate has been woven. You have a choice to make, and your choice will determine how the story ends.

Cartethyia vanished in the Inverted Tower. Following the traces she left behind, you arrive at Septimont, one of Rinascita's city-states, steeped in glory and famed for its gladiatorial tradition. The city is hosting the Great Agon—a grand championship held once every four years. Yet beneath the grandeur, shadows stir. Multiple factions move in secret, each with their hidden agenda. To uncover the truth, you form a temporary alliance with Contender Lupa. Together, you set your sights on the championship...

The Dreamer seals her heart and surrenders to a world of dreams beyond mortal sight. In this hidden realm built upon melancholy melodies, she walks a path of fragile hope and delusions without looking back. But the dreams she longs to realize have long been tangled up in shadow and deceit. Beneath the lofty facade of the Orchestrator, who seems to have everything, is but a wretched, pitiful soul, drowning in her own illusions. In the end, will this dream of blooming and withering be a sweet reverie or a haunting nightmare?

Beneath the lofty facade of the Orchestrator, who seems to have everything, is but a wretched, pitiful soul, drowning in her own illusions. In the end, will this dream of blooming and withering be a sweet reverie or a haunting nightmare?

sample.text: I'm fine. What I saw, though…

sample.speaker: Brant
sample.text: Hmm... Sounds like the same thing happening to the people here.

sample.speaker: Brant
sample.text: From what I've heard, many Ragunnesi have been having peculiar dreams lately. Even some of our Troupe members too.

sample.speaker: Brant
sample.text: The details vary, but they all end the same way... the fall of Rinascita.

sample.speaker: Brant
sample.text: And it's not just in dreamland either... Rover, I'm not sure if you've heard, but there have been strange rumors appearing across Rinascita lately.

sample.speaker: Brant

sample.text: Someone will need to carry it in first, to reach the Anchor Stone and reactivate it.... I'll do it. As a captain, navigating through uncharted waters is second nature.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I know how to resist the Dark Tide's corruption.

sample.speaker: Cantarella
sample.text: The Fisalia family potion grants resistance. And I've endured Its whispersfor long enough. I know Its tactics. Let me face this...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: We don't even know where this Anchor Stone is. Finding it may take time, and your potion might wear off before you reach it.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: But I still carry the Sentinel's power. I can hold out longer than anyone. I have to be the one.

sample.text: The Montelli traitors used Lycoris in experiments to turn Echoes back into Tacet Discords... If they were successful, the "ghosts" seen ten years ago may have also been created this way.

sample.speaker: Brant
sample.text: "Ghost" is just a dramatic name given by the Ragunnesi for Tacet Discords. They look nearly identical to Echoes, especially in the mist.

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: With your help, Grandfather has thwarted their plan. No corrupted Echoes will appear at this year's Carnevale.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Order has allied with the Fractsidus to control the dragon... From what I saw when I connected with its frequency, they might be planning to command it to attack Ragunna during the Carnevale.

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: After the Tacet Discords took over this isle, the Order used them as an excuse to forbid any entry. It might be their way of concealing the dragon's existence.

sample.speaker: Brant
sample.text: But without the Lycoris, the Dragon of Dirge is now off the table.

sample.text: Look, there's something there…

sample.speaker: Brant
sample.text: May I have a look?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Is that a letter? Does it mean anything to you?

sample.speaker: Brant
sample.text: Hmm, yes. On these seas, there is only one legend about "D."

sample.speaker: Brant
sample.text: The story of Drake, the Golden Captain.

dialogue.summary: But worry not, Brant has come up with a wonderful plan as he puts something on you, and just like that, you've transformed into the superstars of tonight's Plushie Gathering, Cuddle Wuddle and Lottie Lost! He even considers catching you and Brant.

dialogue.desc: KU-Lolo has a new idea to turn your fondest memories into unique Cube souvernirs in the Second Coming of Solaris! Head on over to the Memory Travelogue event, collect memories with the Cubes, and turn them in to KU-Lolo!

sample.speaker: Brant
sample.text: Anyway, this is for you.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Is this… Drake's scroll?

sample.speaker: Brant
sample.text: Exactly! I figured it would be a good memento of our adventure.

sample.speaker: Brant
sample.text: Oh, and due to your stellar performance, I'm officially naming you our troupe's "Honorary Captain," as witnessed by this map!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: When do we sail again?

sample.speaker: Brant
sample.text: That depends on when the next adventure calls! You know that I'll be ready to join you, just say the word.

sample.speaker: Brant
sample.text: The performance is excellent and merits applause, but...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: But what? Is anything missing?

sample.speaker: Brant
sample.text: We still have to drink a toast to another better day! Are you up for a round, my friend?

sample.speaker: Cristoforo
sample.text: "Resentful of the Order's verdict, they committed to paper a curse upon Rinascita and Ragunna."

sample.speaker: Cristoforo
sample.text: "Those favored by the Divinity were the most willing to raise the blade of rebellion, for they alone knew how to make Divinity bleed and doctrines crumble."

sample.speaker: Cristoforo
sample.text: "Though they died in exile to a great fire, their resentment festered in their music and poetry, transforming into horrors known as Daemons."

sample.speaker: Cristoforo
sample.text: "Like the fire that dragged them to hell, these Daemons will spread throughout the land and burn all of Ragunna."

sample.speaker: Brant
sample.text: And now, we await the Holy Maiden's return...

sample.speaker: Phrolova
sample.text: And so we arrive at the "happily ever after," yes?

sample.speaker: Phrolova
sample.text: But we do not live in a fairy tale. There is no playwright to script a happy ending for us... What lies behind the curtain is but a cruel jest, a dark satire.

sample.speaker: Phrolova
sample.text: Let me reveal the truth behind that idyllic ending. The Holy Maiden has long succumbed to darkness, drawing power from a heretical force and leading her people into depravity.

sample.speaker: Phrolova
sample.text: And the minister, having uncovered this truth, has vowed to root out this corruption himself.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (And Fenrico... he knew innocents were here, but didn't hold back at all...)

sample.speaker: Fenrico
sample.text: Righteous One, I come to cleanse Rinascita of a traitorous demon and avenge the blood debts of my people. Why raise your blade against me?

sample.speaker: Fenrico
sample.text: Rinascita teeters on the edge of collapse. Now, more than ever, we must uphold the tenets of Unity and Salvation.

sample.speaker: Fenrico
sample.text: The path to deliverance lies within the Civilization Capsule. Entrust it to me. By the authority bestowed upon me, I will open... the gates to the divine Paradise.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Unless... You're not Fenrico at all. You... Who are you? What do you want?

sample.speaker: Fenrico
sample.text: ...Bloodshed cannot be avoided. Blood must pay for blood. The path born of injustice must be fortified with further transgressions.

dialogue.quest: What Yesterday Wept, Today Doth Sing
dialogue.desc: Following Carlotta's guidance, you arrive at the Penitent's End and reunite with the Troupe. Here, another buried secret of the Order awaits discovery...

sample.speaker: Fenrico
sample.text: Therefore, we must unify all beliefs, ensuring the purity and unity of our will to prevent another tragedy...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (He said she "once again resonated with the Sentinel," was that really a Second Resonance Awakening? Sentinel Jué had a trial with Jinhsi, but my permission was needed to transfer the Sentinel's power...)

sample.speaker: Fenrico
sample.text: I swear, my words are without deceit.

sample.speaker: Fenrico
sample.text: I see in your eyes that you have walked further on the path of justice than I anticipated.

sample.speaker: Fenrico
sample.text: O dear Sentinel... please forgive my transgressions.

sample.speaker: Fenrico
sample.text: The Dark Tide brought us a bloodstained lesson. To keep our people from faltering, I bound myself to silence, locking away what I witnessed on that fateful day.

dialogue.desc: The Dreamer seals her heart and surrenders to a world of dreams beyond mortal sight. In this hidden realm built upon melancholy melodies, she walks a path of fragile hope and delusions without looking back. But the dreams she longs to realize have long been tangled up in shadow and deceit. Beneath the lofty facade of the Orchestrator, who seems to have everything, is but a wretched, pitiful soul, drowning in her own illusions. In the end, will this dream of blooming and withering be a sweet reverie or a haunting nightmare?

sample.speaker: Fenrico
sample.text: The Fractsidus.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Ah, so you and the Fractsidus can't agree on how to split the Threnodian's residual energy.

sample.speaker: Fenrico
sample.text: I serve Their will. It is the only true path.

sample.speaker: Fenrico
sample.text: As for the hubristic faithless, they deserve no salvation... nor will they obstruct my course...

sample.speaker: Fenrico
sample.text: Despite our shared enemy, you still choose conflict over cooperation.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Ha, I trust what I see. There is no need for me to ally with you.

dialogue.summary: Yet given the past events, you choose not to trust him and reject the offer, upon which Fenrico throws you into the sea. She then reveals that Fenrico has the Threnodian's residual energy and offers a deal: since both of you seek to reclaim it from the Order, why not work together?

dialogue.desc: Cartethyia vanished in the Inverted Tower. The city is hosting the Great Agon—a grand championship held once every four years. Yet beneath the grandeur, shadows stir. Multiple factions move in secret, each with their hidden agenda. To uncover the truth, you form a temporary alliance with Contender Lupa. Together, you set your sights on the championship...

sample.speaker: Cartethyia
sample.text: And so will you.

sample.speaker: Cristoforo
sample.text: Heh... Madam, surely you know you alone cannot undo my story.

sample.speaker: Cartethyia
sample.text: Alone? Rover will come here and find a way to finish this.

sample.speaker: Cartethyia
sample.text: And I will make your so-called perfect play spiral out of control.

sample.speaker: Phoebe
sample.text: ... As it was in the beginning, and ever shall be.

sample.text: How did you first come to notice me?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: The Sentinel—Imperator's voice guided me to you.

sample.text: Well, Imperator called you "the Lost," and Primus Fenrico claims you are the Resonator for Leviathan, the Threnodian.

sample.text: Throughout this journey, I often saw the figures of Lupa and Mya overlap…

sample.text: (Surely they must be Phrolova and... Scar. But how is Scar in Rinascita?)

sample.speaker: Cartethyia

scene.desc: The Dreamer seals her heart and surrenders to a world of dreams beyond mortal sight. In this hidden realm built upon melancholy melodies, she walks a path of fragile hope and delusions without looking back. But the dreams she longs to realize have long been tangled up in shadow and deceit. Beneath the lofty facade of the Orchestrator, who seems to have everything, is but a wretched, pitiful soul, drowning in her own illusions. In the end, will this dream of blooming and withering be a sweet reverie or a haunting nightmare?

mention.title: The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier
mention.text: (The way she describes the head of Fisalia... reminds me of how Cartethyia spoke about the wandering figure by the barrier.)
mention.source: Rover brings up Cartethyia in “The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier” (20×)

mention.title: Shadow of Glory
mention.text: (After Cartethyia and Fleurdelys's frequencies merged, she got her body back. If she passed through here, people would've seen her.)
mention.source: Rover brings up Cartethyia in “Shadow of Glory” (16×)

mention.title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
mention.text: And she broke through the stained glass from the outside. Physically, not by tearing through the Sonoro Sphere. But Cartethyia has complete control over the Tower. If someone had intruded, would she really not have noticed?
mention.source: Rover brings up Cartethyia in “The Bygone Shall Always Return” (8×)

mention.title: Flames of Heart
mention.text: (Cartethyia arrived in Septimont alone, not waiting for me or attempting contact. Something must have happened to prevent her.)
mention.source: Rover brings up Cartethyia in “Flames of Heart” (5×)

mention.title: Rust, Sword and the Sun
mention.text: Abby, what do you think Imperator wants me to find? If Cartethyia's right, the last clues should be somewhere on the Sanguis Plateaus.
mention.source: Rover brings up Cartethyia in “Rust, Sword and the Sun”

mention.title: The Chant of Unseen Ties
mention.text: (Yangyang's condition... This isn't a normal Second Awakening like Jinhsi's or Cartethyia's.)
mention.source: Rover brings up Cartethyia in “The Chant of Unseen Ties”

dialogue.desc: To open the Sentinel's Relic, you head back to Ragunna once more...

sample.speaker: Cantarella
sample.text: She is still resonating with... something.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: A Resonator's frequency is usually gone when they die, right? This doesn't make any sense.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: There's something even stranger...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Cartethyia had her sword in hand... With her strength, how could she fall to an intruder like that? And... it doesn't look like she even tried to resist.

sample.speaker: Cantarella
sample.text: The Sword of Divinity, sealed with a portion of the Sentinel's power... Could what we're seeing be a result of that power of separation being awakened?

dialogue.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Phew... the Dark Tide, huh? I ate some back at the hunting grounds. It tasted kinda funky... made me super sleepy. Ever since then, I've been having the weirdest nightmares...

sample.speaker: Cantarella
sample.text: Abby does... carry the Dark Tide's frequency...

sample.speaker: Galbrena
sample.text: Abby must have absorbed many other frequencies. So while the Dark Tide's frequency lay in wait... it was masked by the others.

sample.speaker: Galbrena
sample.text: It makes sense. You two share life and energy. As the primary in this bond, your frequency has been overriding Abby's... Leviathan planned for this.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Rover, did I... did I do something wrong?

dialogue.quest: The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier
dialogue.desc: After the Carnevale, a voice in your head leads you to the supposed Martyred Maiden—Cartethyia. The encounter creates more questions than it answers. Who are your enemies? Who are your friends? Where is the Inverted Tower located? The helper Carlotta has found and the invitation from Fisalia may help you answer all these questions. The moment of truth seems inevitable...

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Oh, hey! It smells just as "unnatural" as that big gigantor back in Jinzhou.

sample.speaker: Cantarella
sample.text: The Sentinel of Jinzhou... If what our little Echo friend says is true, then the frequency that entered your Tacet Mark could be Imperator's powers.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Huh? But the Sentinel isn't even here.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: The power to split and manipulate space...

sample.speaker: Cantarella
sample.text: It is reminiscent of the moment of Tyrvine's creation. Only this time the place of confinement has become your Tacet Mark.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: But why would it do that?

dialogue.desc: A mysterious letter gently lifts a corner of the veil that shrouds the nights gone by. A faint whisper from the depths of the abyss waits for your reply.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Fine... I'll just go take another nap.

sample.speaker: Cantarella
sample.text: Hehe… Things have returned to normal, it seems. How delightful.

sample.speaker: Cantarella
sample.text: It's late… Would you care to come to my castle and rest for the night?

sample.speaker: Cantarella
sample.text: Oh, the pleasure is mine, my dear.

mention.title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
mention.text: Abby does... carry the Dark Tide's frequency...
mention.source: Cantarella brings up Abby in “Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides”

dialogue.desc: The kindness once sown now bears fruit.

sample.speaker: Lenore
sample.text: Ah, Rover. One moment, I'm just finishing up with these rocks!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Why are they having you break rocks? And this many?

sample.speaker: Lenore
sample.text: The man in charge of it wanted to help the Troupe of Fools unload supplies, so I switched with him!

sample.speaker: Lenore
sample.text: No, no, no. Not at all! Mr. Fratello said all I need to do is "ignite" the hidden perseverance inside of me, and these rocks will be done in no time!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Here, leave it to me.

dialogue.desc: It's time to leave. Have one last talk with Lenore.

sample.speaker: Lenore
sample.text: Restoration work on the main street is still ongoing, but everything's on track. You can leave it to us!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: When are you planning to reach Phoebe?

sample.speaker: Lenore
sample.text: Hehe, actually, I wrote her a letter last night. It'll probably come as a shock to her that not only am I alive, but I've become a Resonator too.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: You've become a Resonator?

sample.speaker: Lenore
sample.text: Yes! While singing with everyone last night, I felt a strange power rising inside me. When I checked, there it was, a Tacet Mark!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: So what's your Resonance ability?

dialogue.quest: Morning Star: Those Who Remain in the Night Part II
dialogue.desc: Luther makes a surprise visit to the Old District and seems to be after someone. You soon realize who that someone is…

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: If he is truly innocent, then all the more reason he should be standing trial.

sample.speaker: Lenore
sample.text: Then should I...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Alessio will be the spark that ignites the Ragunnesi's rage. Meanwhile, the one who could calm the flames is already behind bars.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Who then will stop this rage from burning the innocent?

sample.speaker: Lenore
sample.text: How exactly do we define "innocent"...?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: What's on your mind?

dialogue.desc: The displaced long to rebuild the Old District into their new home, but evil clings like a shadow.

sample.speaker: Lenore
sample.text: Please, Rover. I must answer for my sins... If it's to die by your hand...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Did you know that it was Medulius who saved you from the Dark Tide? He did it to thank you for your prayers.

sample.speaker: Lenore
sample.text: What?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Think of your parents who lifted you from the Dark Tide. The Acolytes who raised you. The Nimbus Sanctum ancestors who helped enlighten you. Even Medulius, who offered you a second chance.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: You are the continuation of all their hopes.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Lenore, it was Rinascita's kindness that carried you this far. This journey deserves a better ending.

dialogue.quest: Morning Star: Those Who Remain in the Night Part I
dialogue.desc: There seems to be a commotion going on in the Old District, with a noblewoman surrounded by a crowd. She looks all too familiar…

sample.speaker: Lenore
sample.text: The Septimontians don't seem to be bothered by it. Letting her go like that is practically a death sentence... What do you think, Rover?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Where there's light, there's always shadow. But that's not an excuse to pledge yourself to the dark.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: For Septimont to march into a new age, it must cut ties with the mistakes of its past.

sample.speaker: Lenore
sample.text: ...Am I one of Ragunna's past mistakes, Rover?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: People need a way to let out their anger. But the Threnodian is too abstract, so they need a face to blame. Julia is their scapegoat.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I'm more worried about Julia ending up like Medulius than getting herself killed.

dialogue.quest: Hymn of the Sea of Clouds: Rainbow
dialogue.desc: You run into Lenore, an acolyte of the Order, standing next to an Aria Mummer. She seems to be in trouble...

sample.speaker: Lenore
sample.text: Oh, I nearly forgot. "Do not gnaw on a fool's worries." Yes, off I go!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Hold up. What if I said I can help?

sample.speaker: Lenore
sample.text: I cannot accept such a thing! The Tenets of the Deep solemnly instruct, "A trial that is aided by an outside hand is no true trial." Verse 9, Chapter 12.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Consider it a collaboration. The musical records are yours, but the rest of the finds belong to me.

sample.speaker: Lenore
sample.text: Uh, I mean... I'm sorry, but may I ask why you're offering to help me?

sample.speaker: Lenore
sample.text: So you're Phoebe's friend. How time flies... That young girl who once hid behind me has grown into a capable Acolyte. O Great Sentinel, is this part of your grand design as well?

dialogue.quest: Hymn of the Sea of Clouds: Storm
dialogue.desc: The time has come to unravel the secrets of the Forbidden Archive...

sample.speaker: Lenore
sample.text: All I know is that the Sentinel gave us Rinascita as a home and the Common Echoes that help us live our lives. The order, guided by the Sentinel, saved me from the Dark Tide and gave me a name, a new life, and a place to belong.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: What you've been told has been twisted by the Order to suit its own ends. The true song of your ancestors is locked away, and you, like so many others, choose not to see it.

sample.speaker: Lenore
sample.text: I still don't understand...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: The Order uses everyone's belief in the Sentinel to manipulate, deliberately erasing the history of Rinascita's first people.

sample.speaker: Lenore
sample.text: Rover, this is very serious slander against the Order! According to the Tenets of the Deep...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Hasn't your Primus told you everything he wants you to do in Tenets of the Deep? You've followed those rules without question.

sample.speaker: Lenore
sample.text: Rover! What a surprise to see you again so soon!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Is this little pavilion the Minor Forbidden Archive?

sample.speaker: Lenore
sample.text: Haha, you always have such a way with words. The Minor Forbidden Archive is underground, you won't see views like this down there. No, I'm actually at the Tidal Sanctuary to finalize my transfer.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: You're leaving the Minor Forbidden Archive?

sample.speaker: Lenore
sample.text: Yes... well...

sample.speaker: Lenore
sample.text: Rover, I owe you an apology for how I acted that day... I was stubborn.

scene.desc: Now the storm has passed, let us celebrate again.

mention.title: Morning Star II
mention.text: Lenore, it was Rinascita's kindness that carried you this far. This journey deserves a better ending.
mention.source: Rover brings up Lenore in “Morning Star II”

mention.title: Morning Star Epilogue
mention.text: Go to where your heart tells you. And do what you believe is right, Lenore.
mention.source: Rover brings up Lenore in “Morning Star Epilogue”

mention.title: Hymn of the Sea of Clouds: Rainbow
mention.text: That must be the spot Lenore said the record would be. What are the Vitreum Dancers doing over there?
mention.source: Rover brings up Lenore in “Hymn of the Sea of Clouds: Rainbow”

dialogue.quest: Hymn of the Sea of Clouds: Storm
dialogue.desc: The time has come to unravel the secrets of the Forbidden Archive...

sample.speaker: Lenore
sample.text: O Sentinel, please forgive this humble, wandering servant. Forgive me for being moved by such a forbidden thing.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Rover, does the Sentinel here care about such little problems?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: We'll talk about that later..

sample.speaker: Lenore
sample.text: Rover, what should I do? Should I report this music as heretical to the Order? Why do I hesitate? Am I losing my faith?

dialogue.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: What about the others?

sample.speaker: Ciaccona
sample.text: We're good! The Lioness of Glory caught us! What a sight to behold!

sample.speaker: Cantarella
sample.text: The Dragon of Dirge lent its aid as well.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Alright. Let's all meet up ahead.

dialogue.quest: A Stranger in a Strange Land
dialogue.desc: In this battle that sealed the fate of Rinascita, its people rose in defiance. And among them stood another, a swordsman of Huanglong, guided across the seas by Huanglong Mingting to lend you his strength. He fought as one among the countless souls drawn to this hour, but the story of his own journey, and the shadows of his past, remain known to few...

sample.speaker: Ciaccona
sample.text: And while the dark hero has sadly gone, our Laureate is here for us to cheer on!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Ahem...

sample.speaker: Ciaccona
sample.text: Well, it was such an epic fight. If I can spin it into a song, maybe it'll live on in the hearts of Ragunna and Septimont, and all of Rinascita.

sample.speaker: Ciaccona
sample.text: Through this song, the land will rise anew, and the names of all the fallen will never fade...

sample.speaker: Ciaccona
sample.text: Heh, but there's another player in this tale...

sample.speaker: Ciaccona
sample.text: He was neither Ragunnesi nor Septimontian. Have you heard the story of this outlander?

dialogue.quest: The Maiden, The Defier, The Death Crier
dialogue.desc: After the Carnevale, a voice in your head leads you to the supposed Martyred Maiden—Cartethyia. The encounter creates more questions than it answers. Who are your enemies? Who are your friends? Where is the Inverted Tower located? The helper Carlotta has found and the invitation from Fisalia may help you answer all these questions. The moment of truth seems inevitable...

sample.speaker: Ciaccona
sample.text: Well... I suppose this won't count as me getting distracted, right?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: If Carlotta asked you to find me, has something happened?

sample.speaker: Ciaccona
sample.text: Lady Carlotta told me you encountered the supposed Martyred Maiden—Cartethyia.

sample.speaker: Ciaccona
sample.text: She dispatched search teams soon after, but there's been no sign of Cartethyia since.

sample.speaker: Ciaccona
sample.text: That's why she asked me to use my Forte to recreate the frequency you experienced at the time, to see if any details you might have missed become clearer.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Recreate the frequency?

dialogue.summary:
=== Meeting Ciaccona ===
As Rover contemplates how to locate the Inverted Tower referenced by Imperator, Abby proposes an aerial approach, suggesting the cliff near Egla Town as a suitable launch point. Along the way, Rover encounters Ciaccona, a wandering bard dispatched by Carlotta to assist in the journey.

dialogue.desc: A rumor about Daemons is spreading through the streets of Ragunna, with an article pointing to the former Poets Society—Golden Anthem. As you dig deeper, you uncover a tragic story deliberately concealed by the Order.

sample.speaker: Ciaccona
sample.text: Try it!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: It's a real apple...

sample.speaker: Ciaccona
sample.text: Later, when I finally decided to leave, I looked up through the gaps in the branches and suddenly saw a blooming flower atop a cliff.

sample.speaker: Ciaccona
sample.text: Turns out, even without an apple, inspiration may yet strike. But if I hadn't stood there, I might've missed that unexpected burst of beauty.

sample.speaker: Ciaccona
sample.text: So… maybe this is enough. Let's put aside heavy thoughts and continue our walk with a clear mind.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I'm starting to understand why Carlotta calls you "Topaz".

dialogue.summary: Carlotta then leads you to Ciaccona, who seems hesitant to involve you in the mystery. Ciaccona takes you to a moonlit shore, a place where Ragunna's poets and musicians are known to bury their instruments.

dialogue.quest: All Out! Towards the Peaks of Prestige (Quest)
dialogue.desc: A strange message draws your attention to a mysterious Echo dueling game called Peaks of Prestige. "Countless Echoes. Limiteless tactics. You could be the next Apex Duelist!"

sample.speaker: Ciaccona
sample.text: Haha, looks like the legend of the very first Apex Duelist won't end with me.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: If you had bested me, you'd be on your way to becoming the next legend.

sample.speaker: Ciaccona
sample.text: Haha, but no. That path isn't meant for me. I'm a wandering bard, remember?

sample.speaker: Ciaccona
sample.text: I don't become the legend. I walk beside it, witness it, weave it into song, and most of all, tell its story.

sample.speaker: Ciaccona
sample.text: And the hero of this story is you, Rover, the Apex Duelist.

sample.speaker: Ciaccona
sample.text: Look forward to the song I'll write, a song born from this duel, Rover!

scene.desc: To open the Sentinel's Relic, you head back to Ragunna once more...

mention.title: Your Summer Will Never Wither (Quest)
mention.text: We must have gotten separated. Ciaccona did say even a slight misstep could draw us into other melodies. Am I...
mention.source: Rover brings up Ciaccona in “Your Summer Will Never Wither (Quest)” (8×)

sample.text: If you're having trouble restoring the damaged buildings, Mr. Fulmine and I can help using our Fortes!

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: If Imperator were here, They'd be happy to see this...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Aren't you coming to the Moon-Chasing Festival?

sample.speaker: Calcharo
sample.text: No. I'll stay here. Festivities don't suit the Ghost Hounds.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: But people want to hear your stories.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Instead of just watching over them, letting them know you're here might bring them more peace of mind.

sample.speaker: Calcharo
sample.text: ...I'll think about it.

dialogue.desc: A strange message draws your attention to a mysterious Echo dueling game called Peaks of Prestige. "Countless Echoes. Limiteless tactics. You could be the next Apex Duelist!"

sample.speaker: Calcharo
sample.text: Mysterious one? I never hid my identity from him. Maybe he just enjoys adding dramatic flair.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Are you here for a mission or something? This spot overlooks the Ephor's Palace...

sample.speaker: Calcharo
sample.text: You might have misunderstood. I did come here on a mission, but it had nothing to do with the Ephor. And the job's already done.

sample.speaker: Calcharo
sample.text: Just a habit from the field. High ground's easier for scouting, and less chance of drawing attention.

sample.speaker: Calcharo
sample.text: More importantly, this place makes for a perfect stage for a duel with the Apex Duelist.

sample.speaker: Calcharo
sample.text: Take out your Terminal and let's see who walks away the victor.

dialogue.desc: You receive a message from Encore, saying that she has obtained something super amazing and fun, and that she's excited to share it with you. What could it be?

sample.speaker: Cartethyia
sample.text: I'm so sorry about all this. I never imagined that the whole anniversary would turn into such a mess!

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: Worry not. The ceremony is not finished yet. We can still light the candle to continue it.

sample.speaker: Cartethyia
sample.text: Yes, you're right! It slipped my mind!

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: However, we still lack some essential materials. To ensure a truly grand ceremony, we need to plan very carefully...

sample.speaker: Cartethyia
sample.text: That's alright, we can start the work first! Abbowser isn't done yet, so let's push forward. The materials won't be a concern.

sample.speaker: Cartethyia
sample.text: Because from here on out, I'll make up for my mistakes with action!

dialogue.desc: As the High Tide draws near, a lurking calamity stirs, with its gaze fixed upon the borders of Septimont. Ephor Augusta invites you to the Sanguis Plateaus for a fateful hunt, the one that may decide the realm's survival...

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: In return, should any complications arise, the Black Shores are to fulfill their side of the agreement and provide us with the necessary technical support.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: A Consultant active in Rinascita?

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: That's right. Her name is Buling. An interesting young lady. Left quite an impression on me.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: So it is her...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Why don't you let me handle contacting the Black Shores, Augusta?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: We... talk from time to time. It'll help make things smoother for us.

dialogue.desc: With the Sovereign slain, you attend the victory ceremony by invitation of Ceremonial Officer Bruno. The celebration honors the new Hero of Heroes and those who stood by their side amidst the crackling bonfire and joyous cheers of the crowd... Now that the countless petals are to be thrown into the sky to become the rain of glory and triumph, you might finally reunite with the girl you have never forgotten in a way even beyond fate's grasp.

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: Bruno has already filled you in on the Rosebearer matter, yes? How are the celebrations treating you?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Augusta, do you remember Iuno?

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: Iuno?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Yes, she was often by your side. The one with the bow like the moon. She joined our hunt for the Sovereign...

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: Everyone has forgotten... No, that's not it. Everyone says they've never even seen her before.

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: But you, you remember her. You remember everything that happened. You are certain she is real and cannot exist in your memories alone.

dialogue.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: Rover, your arrival is appreciated.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Oh, let me introduce you. Augusta, this is...

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: Iuno. We know each other.

sample.speaker: Iuno
sample.text: Å lot happened while you were off adventuring. You missed some fun.

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: It is strange... From the moment we met, it felt like we were cut from the same cloth. Like we'd known each other before. She might seem unmoored, but when the storm hits, she holds fast.

dialogue.desc: Cartethyia vanished in the Inverted Tower. Following the traces she left behind, you arrive at Septimont, one of Rinascita's city-states, steeped in glory and famed for its gladiatorial tradition. The city is hosting the Great Agon—a grand championship held once every four years. Yet beneath the grandeur, shadows stir. Multiple factions move in secret, each with their hidden agenda. To uncover the truth, you form a temporary alliance with Contender Lupa. Together, you set your sights on the championship...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (I kept seeing Lupa and Mya overlap with each other as well.)

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: Brilliant performance, warriors.

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: Remember, this is more than just a title. It is a testament to your own strength and wisdom in overcoming your opponents. You've earned the right to claim it.

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: This medal once belonged to a single champion, the last survivor standing in the ring.

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: I divided it into two to remind you that...

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: Just as we fight alongside Echoes, the glory of Septimont is upheld by heroes who support one another to remain steadfast.

dialogue.summary: During this time, you ask her about Ephor Augusta and Priestess Iuno.

scene.desc: While waiting for contact from the Ephor's Palace, you and Abby arrive at Solis Tavern, where you run into a blind wandering bard—Nestor. Having learned of the Ephor's invitation to the hunt, Nestor shares with you Augusta's stories before she rose to power.

scene.quest: A Stranger in a Strange Land
scene.desc: In this battle that sealed the fate of Rinascita, its people rose in defiance. And among them stood another, a swordsman of Huanglong, guided across the seas by Huanglong Mingting to lend you his strength. He fought as one among the countless souls drawn to this hour, but the story of his own journey, and the shadows of his past, remain known to few...

mention.title: By Sun's Burning Hand
mention.text: As the prophecy goes, "The Hero of Heroes wielding extraordinary power, rising from the dark tides." As I see it, you, Augusta, fit that image well.
mention.source: Rover brings up Augusta in “By Sun's Burning Hand” (20×)

mention.title: By Moon's Fated Light
mention.text: More than that, she wielded the Moon Bow and fought alongside me and Augusta in the hunt. We defeated the Sovereign together... Don't you all remember?
mention.source: Rover brings up Augusta in “By Moon's Fated Light” (4×)

mention.title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
mention.text: ...I wonder what's happening with the Dark Tide. I should check in with Augusta and Iuno.
mention.source: Rover brings up Augusta in “Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides” (2×)

mention.title: Rust, Sword and the Sun
mention.text: A messenger came this morning. Augusta is dealing with an emergency, so our meeting's postponed... looks like it'll be a while.
mention.source: Rover brings up Augusta in “Rust, Sword and the Sun” (2×)

mention.title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
mention.text: Augusta said the Dark Tide spoke to her when it swallowed her whole. Maybe... I can learn something that way.
mention.source: Rover brings up Augusta in “The Bygone Shall Always Return”

mention.title: Dream Of A Rusted Sword
mention.text: (But the tale of Augusta's trial only mentions an old hunter. Who's this second person?)
mention.source: Rover brings up Augusta in “Dream Of A Rusted Sword” (2×)

sample.text: Yes. It's been a long time. I never imagined I'd see my past like this.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Hmm... I'm curious...

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: About Manes Deep and the Oak Hollow?

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Yeah!

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: ...The name Fabianum once stood for glory.

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: As Septimont's frontline against the Dark Tide, it held the honor of receiving legends like Fabius, Atilius, and Valeria.

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: Rover... Keep your wits about you once you're inside the Dark Tide.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Don't worry! I'll stick with every step of the way!

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: Just remember, you're not going in alone, Rover. When the time comes, we will be right behind you.

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: If you're ready. Step forward.

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: May the eternal sun light your path. And may each step bring you closer to victory.

sample.speaker: Lupa
sample.text: So once that Anchor Stone is activated, the path should be clear, right? Great, then would you do us the honor, brilliant Lady of Potions, and get us there.

sample.text: Rover, this is Rinascita's fight. It is neither your duty to shoulder it alone, nor our desire to see you do so. We will not have you face the Threnodian alone.

sample.text: If facing Leviathan means being corrupted by the Dark Tide, then so be it.

sample.text: If we can stir up the mess in its gut, even with something small, we might just throw him off balance. And then, maybe we can wrest the Earthrend Wedge back and readjust it to—

sample.speaker: Iuno
sample.text: Terrible timing... Is there any other way to reach her?

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: It's the Dark Tide...

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: The entire frequency range is under its control. In other words, we're completely cut off here.

sample.speaker: Cantarella
sample.text: My family's potions are ready, but please, a word...

sample.speaker: Cantarella
sample.text: It's been crafted from the Threnodian's venom. Outside the corruption's reach, it induces hallucinations—warping your senses and clouding judgment.

sample.speaker: Cantarella
sample.text: If you aren't immediately entering the Dark Tide, I advise you all not to drink it.

dialogue.desc: As the High Tide draws near, a lurking calamity stirs, with its gaze fixed upon the borders of Septimont. Ephor Augusta invites you to the Sanguis Plateaus for a fateful hunt, the one that may decide the realm's survival...

sample.speaker: Iuno
sample.text: Well, there you have it. That's the gist of it. Ugh, finally some time together, and now it's all ruined...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I don't understand. Given Augusta's prestige, the Senate has no real advantage in seizing power. What's their angle?

sample.speaker: Iuno
sample.text: It all started when Augusta shook things up the moment she became Ephor. Especially in rooting out corruption within the Gladiator's Agon while ignoring the senators in the process.

sample.speaker: Iuno
sample.text: Naturally, it ruffled some feathers. Some even accused her of "undermining the spirit of Gladiating." In reality, they're just upset their piggy banks got smashed.

sample.speaker: Iuno
sample.text: More importantly...

sample.speaker: Iuno
sample.text: This is exactly the kind of chaos Augusta wanted. That idiot!

dialogue.desc: With the Sovereign slain, you attend the victory ceremony by invitation of Ceremonial Officer Bruno. The celebration honors the new Hero of Heroes and those who stood by their side amidst the crackling bonfire and joyous cheers of the crowd... Now that the countless petals are to be thrown into the sky to become the rain of glory and triumph, you might finally reunite with the girl you have never forgotten in a way even beyond fate's grasp.

sample.speaker: Iuno
sample.text: Chaos won't disturb us here.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Sitting just like that, huh? You're still just as... spontaneous.

sample.speaker: Iuno
sample.text: Shh, Unwritten.

sample.speaker: Iuno
sample.text: It's time for a rest. Come sit with me.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I've never said it properly before, and I don't know if you fully understand it now... but now that I've found you, I will bring you back. I won't stop until I do.

sample.speaker: Iuno
sample.text: Because you said it, I believe you.

dialogue.desc: With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

sample.speaker: Iuno
sample.text: Did you come straight from Ragunna?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I did. Has it begun here too? I see you're starting evacuations.

sample.speaker: Iuno
sample.text: An unannounced High Tide. But that term doesn't even begin to cover it.

sample.speaker: Iuno
sample.text: No signs. No patterns. The Dark Tide's spawn are surfacing at random... even outside the City of Septimont.

sample.speaker: Iuno
sample.text: It doesn't make sense. The Earthrend Wedge is still holding back the Dark Tide at its depths... At any rate, Augusta's already led a team to the Sanguis Plateaus to investigate.

sample.speaker: Iuno
sample.text: As for me, I'm helping out here. Someone has to stop the panic from turning into a stampede.

scene.desc: While waiting for contact from the Ephor's Palace, you and Abby arrive at Solis Tavern, where you run into a blind wandering bard—Nestor. Having learned of the Ephor's invitation to the hunt, Nestor shares with you Augusta's stories before she rose to power.

mention.title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
mention.text: ...I wonder what's happening with the Dark Tide. I should check in with Augusta and Iuno.

sample.speaker: Iuno
sample.text: Rest assured, we're not forgetting this transgression.

sample.speaker: Cartethyia
sample.text: Oh, I'm back to myself now. Let's meet in Ragunna City, (Righteous One).

sample.speaker: Carlotta
sample.text: Defeating Leviathan was just the start of Rinascita's "new era." There is plenty of cleanup work ahead for everyone.

sample.speaker: Cantarella
sample.text: Each day to come holds more hope than the last.

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: Septimont will have many matters demanding our attention. Ragunna will be no different.

sample.speaker: Iuno
sample.text: Leave Septimont to us. Ragunna's problems... Well, they're looking a lot more complicated than ours.

sample.text: Oh, what's your name?
