sample.text: ...Roccia.

sample.speaker: Cosmos
sample.text: Roccia! You and Pero must be the captains of the Cube Adventure Squad! I'm the vice-captain of the Wooly Adventure Squad. We should play together!

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Whoa!

sample.speaker: Ciaccona
sample.text: Ms. Margherita!

sample.speaker: Margherita
sample.text: Well, hello, hello! If it isn't Rover and Ciaccona!

sample.speaker: Margherita
sample.text: Oh, Miss Ciaccona is a regular around here, you know. I've even asked her to perform a few times. Helps bring in the crowds!

sample.speaker: Ciaccona
sample.text: Actually, I've come to ask a favor of you today, Ms. Margherita. I'm sure you've heard the rumors circulating lately...

sample.speaker: Ciaccona
sample.text: About the Poets Society's legacy. There's something important we'd like to share. Could you help us gather everyone?

sample.speaker: Margherita
sample.text: Not a problem at all! Did you make any big discoveries? I'm so curious about what actually happened. It's driving me nuts!

dialogue.desc: A rumor about Daemons is spreading through the streets of Ragunna, with an article pointing to the former Poets Society—Golden Anthem. As you dig deeper, you uncover a tragic story deliberately concealed by the Order.

sample.speaker: Cristoforo
sample.text: This speech you made just now... You're implying the poets of the Golden Anthem were framed and their works deliberately misinterpreted?

sample.speaker: Ciaccona
sample.text: Exactly. Someone used the story of the Golden Anthem to stir the public's curiosity. This is what created the Daemons.

sample.speaker: Cristoforo
sample.text: If memory serves, official records of the Order of the Deep state the poets were charged with blasphemy against the Sentinel.

sample.speaker: Cristoforo
sample.text: Surely you're not suggesting this was all the Order's doing? I dare say... such remarks would be considered a grave crime punishable by banishment.

sample.speaker: Ciaccona
sample.text: Are you from a noble family? The city's elite have a habit of siding with the Order.

sample.speaker: Cristoforo
sample.text: Haha, I'm afraid you misunderstand... I admit I do get that question quite often. I am but a traveling playwright.

dialogue.summary: While you and Ciaccona are separated in the crowd, Cristoforo appears next to Ciaccona, telling a story about a caged bird, as if hinting at something deeper. Cristoforo's words echo in Ciaccona's mind.

sample.speaker: Cantarella
sample.text: Scar from the Fractsidus... Did he escape again?

sample.speaker: Qiuyuan
sample.text: Unfortunately, yes. I see you didn't catch the mastermind either.

sample.speaker: Galbrena
sample.text: That Cristoforo got away… But don't worry, I will hunt him down.

sample.speaker: Augusta
sample.text: That Fractsidus... The calamity has passed, but our city-states are weakened. We must rebuild. Recover. We cannot join this hunt.

sample.speaker: Qiuyuan
sample.text: Survivors deserve more attention than criminals who deserve to die.

sample.text: What happened to him?

sample.text: He fell into Ovathrax's abyss.

sample.speaker: Fenrico
sample.text: And shared my fate...

sample.speaker: Qiuyuan
sample.text: Maybe when we first met, he still held on to a shred of goodness. But even so, it didn't stop his end from coming.

sample.text: You should have killed him when you had the chance.

sample.speaker: Qiuyuan
sample.text: History grants no second chances. And the dead do not return.

sample.text: That Primus got what he wanted. He fulfilled the fate he desired for Rinascita.

sample.speaker: Qiuyuan
sample.text: The Threnodian's creatures have been defeated. They never broke through our defenses. With the Dark Tide now receding, it seems that all is resolved.

sample.speaker: Qiuyuan
sample.text: I only played a small part. It was the courage of these warriors that truly held the line.

sample.speaker: Qiuyuan
sample.text: Now that you have returned safely, I'll continue with my mission.

scene.quest: A Stranger in a Strange Land
scene.desc: In this battle that sealed the fate of Rinascita, its people rose in defiance. And among them stood another, a swordsman of Huanglong, guided across the seas by Huanglong Mingting to lend you his strength. He fought as one among the countless souls drawn to this hour, but the story of his own journey, and the shadows of his past, remain known to few...

mention.text: The swordsman named Qiuyuan?

dialogue.desc: To reach Lahal-Roi in the midst of a Void Storm, you dive into the spatial tunnel, which pulls you into a strange dimension... Upon arriving in Lahai-Roi, you chance upon Lynae, a student who leads you to Startorch Academy. As you begin enrollment, everything about this "academic metropolis" unfolds before your eyes. Meanwhile, shadows stir beneath the Vold Storm...

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: Ah, what a rare visitor. I assumed the Void Storm, those Voidworms, and your admission would've kept you too busy to drop by.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: The Fractsidus have contacts inside the Academy. They're planning an attack on the Research Institute.

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: That's... certainly surprising news.

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: And what do you need from a school doctor like me? Or... should I say, why come to me at all?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Because I'm still new to the Academy. Professor Mornye isn't around, and I have no way to judge if I'm passing the message on to the right person.

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: And you trust me?

dialogue.summary: Luuk Herssen reviews your report: your frequency is stable and you're not in immediate danger, but the portion already lost cannot be traced.

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: The activation sequence was used only to seal hatches and lock equipment. After that... nothing.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Can you see who activated it?

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: Hold on... Yes. Clearance belonged to Clemente.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (The one who gathered the droplets...?)

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: That's all I can pull for now, but the Academy will run a full investigation later. I'll keep you in the loop.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Good. Keep me posted.

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: Even for the Fractsidus.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: You're saying the fall of Helios wasn't their real goal?

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: It was one of several. After your journey in Huanglong and Rinascita, I'm sure you've come to realize their true aim.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: The Threnodian. Aleph-1.

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: Correct. Given the Threnodian's unique nature, it's sure to catch their attention. Moreover, Aleph-1 is closely linked to the Stridergate, which may be our ticket to outer space.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Spying on the Fractsidus is risky. Why would I have chosen you for this task?

dialogue.desc: The New Solar Celebration is just around the corner. Yet, President Lucilla detects a mysterious frequency appearing in the Academy's Dark Side—one that does not belong to the Academy. You suspect it may be the "reward" once mentioned by the Grand Architect of the Fractsidus. Determined to uncover the truth behind this anomaly, you venture into the Dark Side alongside Sigrika, a student you encountered there...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Their Grand Architect tipped us off about their plans in Lahai-Roi, that he will play a game with us.

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: It seems the "game" she referred to is this riddle event our students are so fond of.

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: We've already tracked the participants. The effects of these riddles are already spilling into their real lives.

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: Some abandoned their research projects. Others are lashing out at classmates... and a few have lost control entirely.

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: These students have all become pawns in the Fractsidus's little show.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: You're one of them, Sigrika.

dialogue.desc: Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: I've been flooding their desks with reports. Your Academy investigation record, your latest test scores from Rabelle College, and a full physical adaptability eval I wrote myself...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: And? Were they rejected?

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: We got a meeting. But when that much money's involved, conflicts of interest make everything move very slowly.

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: Unlike Jinzhou or Rinascita, they've got far too many "cooks" in the kitchen.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I'm worried we don't have that kind of time.

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: Exactly. Which is why we're going to strike first. Besides, things have changed.

phoneSample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phoneSample.text: Things will get busy again soon. You'll need to stay focused, but not wound up like a spring. Stress leads to bad calls.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: I've rested up. Don't worry.

phoneSample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phoneSample.text: Good. I'm a psychiatrist, after all. Happy to know my patient is actually following my advice for once.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: I can't really relax until this is over.

phoneSample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phoneSample.text: I see. I sympathize, but can't say I approve. Once this is all settled, remember to give yourself a break.

phoneSample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phoneSample.text: As for the Exostrider plan we discussed earlier, there's been a development.

dialogue.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: Ah, Rover, perfect timing. We were about to go look for you if you took any longer.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Why's everyone...

phoneSample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phoneSample.text: Happy graduation! Hmm, I never thought I'd be saying that to you so soon.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: Is that regret I'm getting from you?

phoneSample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phoneSample.text: Saying goodbye to an old friend again will always be cause for regret. But in itself, graduation is a good thing. It's the start of something new.

phoneSample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phoneSample.text: I've seen off plenty of graduates over the years. Each time, including this one, I'm struck by the same sentiment. All that bright hope and energy... that's what has kept me here in Lahai-Roi all this time.

phoneSample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phoneSample.text: If I remember correctly, you're heading back to Jinzhou, yes? That city over in Huanglong.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: That's right.

dialogue.desc: A Somnoire door has suddenly appeared in the Academy. Mornye has asked for your help investigating it.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Something else on your mind?

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: During the examination, I noted Lucy's psychological state isn't stable.

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: She's vulnerable to external frequency interference. That unique Tacet Discord you mentioned seems to be targeting that weakness. Pouring salt in the wound.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Is there a treatment?

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: Conditions like these don't have a quick fix. Recovery comes from a sense of safety and support, as well as time.

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: All we can do is to hold space for her. The real work of healing must come from within.

dialogue.desc: Based on your feedback, Luuk Herssen has refined his waffle recipe once more. Yet, the fresh batch vanished mysteriously just two minutes after he left! What kind of being could act so fast? To recover the stolen treats, Luuk Herssen has sent you a "commission." Head to the infirmary and begin your investigation into this Case of the Missing Waffles.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Could it be that calico cat?

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: Nicely deduced. If it's a small campus animal, one that can easily stay out of sight, it's no wonder it avoided the cameras.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: If that cat is the culprit... it couldn't have finished the entire plate on the spot.

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: But when I returned to the infirmary, the plate was empty.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Looks like it packed the rest and left. Question is—where?

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: A place not far from here, quiet, undisturbed.

phoneSample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phoneSample.text: [System Notification] Unknown Contact: Abnormal Missing Waffle Case Detected—Please confirm your identity ASAP to obtain Reward Points. Immediate mobilization of Human Resources or Appointed Assistant Rover is recommended for on-site investigation. Otherwise, your Reward Points w

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: Where did this push notification come from?

phoneSample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phoneSample.text: Well, well. The system alert formatting really did make it look convincing. Hello, Rover. Would my "Appointed Assistant" choose to accept this mission?

phoneSample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phoneSample.text: We have a missing waffle case on our hands, and the suspect is still at large.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: You know I can see your name in the contacts, right?

phoneSample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phoneSample.text: Oh, I can't believe you figured it out! Looks like I need to work on my system alert formatting.

dialogue.desc: Luuk Herssen messages you that while he was relaxing at the celebration and scouting for potential adopters, the kitten got spooked and slipped out of its cage. A "criminal" like this cannot be allowed to roam free! For the safety of waffles everywhere, head to the teaching building, track down this fluffy fugitive, and bring it back to the infirmary.

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: Me?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I mean, "It can really help people unwind."

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: So this is the break you want me to enjoy?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: That's just my thought. It's up to you.

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: To be honest, I don't find the idea unacceptable. But bringing a new life into my own is something I shouldn't take lightly...

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: For instance, the cat would need its own space to explore, clean water, nutritious and balanced food, and of course, enough toys to play with.

phoneSample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phoneSample.text: My temporary booth got crowded so quickly, and the cat got so scared that it escaped during a cage transfer.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: Which way did it run?

phoneSample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phoneSample.text: Looks like it was headed toward the teaching building. I normally would have caught it, but it's just so crowded today...

phoneSample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phoneSample.text: The volunteers are managing the crowd, and I'm occupied as well. Could you bring it back to the infirmary? It should feel comfortable with you around.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: Understood.

phoneSample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phoneSample.text: Sorry to trouble you. I'll be back in a minute!

dialogue.desc: In the final stage of your detective game, you have deduced the identity of the thief who made off with the waffles in under two minutes, but the important waffles remain gone. Where would a tiny feline suspect hide its spoils? "A place not far from here, quiet, undisturbed." Following this lead, head to the preparation team's warehouse with Luuk Herssen.

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: Well, it's starting to feel at home now.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Since the Academy allows animal adoptions, let's take it to the shelter.

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: The standard animal adoption process for students is rather complicated. But there are ways to navigate it more smoothly.

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: For example, we could start with background checks for students and support staff. Then, we could invite a select group to the adoption event....

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: …So you already had everything figured out on the way back?

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: The young have the luxury of thinking one step at a time. But as adults, we always have to think a few steps further.

phoneSample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phoneSample.text: Feel free to come by and see it when you're free.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: Should I take some waffles?

phoneSample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phoneSample.text: As a doctor, I have to advise against it. Your company is more than enough.

phoneSample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phoneSample.text: If we surrender to its cuteness, I may have to face a dire consequence.}}

dialogue.desc: With the New Solar Celebration concluded, Luuk Herssen has stayed true to his word and taken a well-earned vacation. To mark the start of his break, he has prepared a fresh batch of waffles and invited you over. How will the new waffles taste, and is the doctor getting along with his new feline roommate? Head to the Infirmary to catch up with Luuk Herssen.

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: Perhaps some cats aren't really cut out for being indoor pets. The fact that it keeps coming back probably means it already considers this home.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Do you think it will always come back to you?

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: Maybe... Or maybe not. Well, it's not like I can have a counseling session with a cat and have it open up to me.

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: For such a free-spirited little creature, there's no controlling it. Perhaps all I can do is give it the space to be free and go wherever it pleases.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: So that's why you're not forcing it to stay.

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: Yes. It's a lot like life itself. We can only control so much, but there's so much more we can appreciate.

phoneSample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phoneSample.text: We both deserve a good rest and some relaxation before the next one arrives.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: We're not done yet...

phoneSample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phoneSample.text: Let me guess, did Lucilla ask you to handle the cleanup? Or were you given some kind of unavoidable assignment?

phoneSample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phoneSample.text: Well... sometimes these two can actually be the same. All I can do is wish you luck from over here.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: Are you on vacation too?

phoneSample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
phoneSample.text: I wish I could... But unfortunately, I still have some cleanup to finish and prepare for the upcoming Dark Side trip.

dialogue.desc: To match the warmth and wonder of the New Solar Celebration, Luuk Herssen has baked a fresh batch of waffles. A message arrives at your Terminal riding a beam of sunlight—an invitation as soft as a waffle and as rich as a latte. It's such a sunny day. While you have a moment, head to the infirmary to try Luuk Herssen's latest creation.

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: The New Solar Celebration is in full swing. The venues must be so lively right now. So, have you had a chance to join in the fun?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Already did.

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: I've heard the decorations there are just lovely. Makes me want to go take a look myself.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Haven't had the chance to go yet.

sample.speaker: Luuk Herssen
sample.text: Regardless, it's a rare festive occasion. Go and have some fun. Take some time off.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: So are you going?

scene.desc: With the Voldworm threat gone for now, and the commencement of the New Solar Ceremony, Mornye, a Research Institute project lead, invites you to witness the rise of the new sun. However, a distress signal tells you that not everyone is looking forward to this ceremony. To uncover the truth, you and Mornye set off for the Bjartr Woods...

scene.quest: Where Stars Cascade Down · event story

mention.title: At Dream's Edge
mention.text: This is Luuk Herssen. One of the Academy's doctors.
mention.source: Rover brings up Luuk Herssen in “At Dream's Edge”

dialogue.desc: The New Solar Celebration is just around the corner. Yet, President Lucilla detects a mysterious frequency appearing in the Academy's Dark Side—one that does not belong to the Academy. You suspect it may be the "reward" once mentioned by the Grand Architect of the Fractsidus. Determined to uncover the truth behind this anomaly, you venture into the Dark Side alongside Sigrika, a student you encountered there...

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: …I can call forth the power sleeping within.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: What invoked the one we saw before?

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: I have no idea... I tried to trace the source, but those runes seemed to come from nowhere.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: It's worth a closer look. We should go back into the Dark Side.

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: Then we're going to need this.

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: Hello? Can you hear me, Didi? Wake up. It's Sigrika. Time to work.

dialogue.desc: Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: Everything matches. I'm spotting every Royan rune site in Bjartr Woods on this map.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (But what about the other coordinates...)

dialogue.desc: Not long after the Stridergate incident, the Spacetrek Collective informs you that Denia is awake and being kept in isolation. To learn the Fractsidus's next step and open new directions for future research, you head to the infirmary to negotiate with Denia. There, she offers you a "deal." In exchange, you'll need to stay with her for her birthday...

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: What a terrifying thought, Nia...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (Taste aside, the operational procedure was very clear about food intake. I should check with Arman...)

sample.speaker: Denia
sample.text: I'm just going through the motions... She can eat it for me.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I happen to know a team that specializes in desserts. We could order a cake from them if you want.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: What kind of style are you thinking of?

phoneSample.speaker: Sigrika
phoneSample.text: If it's not too much trouble, could you check on her for me? I've been asking N.A.N.A. for updates, but she tells me the same thing every time... I'm worried.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: Got it.

phoneSample.speaker: Sigrika
phoneSample.text: Appreciate you, Senior! ヾ(ﾟ▽ﾟ)ノ}}

dialogue.desc: Though the Threnodian Aleph-1 was banished, Lucilla finds herself in yet another predicament. In the absence of the Exostrider, funders are questioning whether the Synchronist program—and even the Rabelle College itself—should continue to exist. As both a professor and the head of the Academy, Lucilla must now choose between harsh reality and her ideals.

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: Okay!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (So that's why she was drowsy in class... She's been staying up late tutoring other students.)

dialogue.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: You know... like, "So long, Startorch cafeteria food," or "Goodbye, student life"...things like that? Sometimes when I'm drowning in assignments, I daydream about moments like this...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I wish I could stay longer here at the Academy...

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: You'll get your chance! Besides, I heard President Lucilla say she wants to invite you back as a teaching assistant.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: It's time to meet what's ahead of me.

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: Oh, you haven't changed a bit, Senior. Always got something you want to do.

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: And that's a good thing!

dialogue.desc: A Somnoire door has suddenly appeared in the Academy. Mornye has asked for your help investigating it.

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: Mmmhmm...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Lucilla mentioned the Academy approved your request to keep the graffiti.

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: Yep. Totally thought they'd shoot it down. But it sailed right through every system review...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (Could that have been... Lucy?)

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: Looks like someone gave us a secret helping hand on their way out...

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: We'll make sure this special gift is kept safe.

dialogue.desc: Now that Denia's gone missing, Arman invites you to discuss something about her at the Research Institute.

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: It's been the kind of day that when I look back, I'll be able to say with confidence, "I'm finally on the path to making my dreams a reality!"

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I'm not talking about physical exhaustion, Sigrika.

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: Mmm. I know what you mean, Senior.

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: Lately ... whenever I have a moment to myself, I keep thinking about that afternoon we spent with Denia.

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: That's why I wanted to meet you today.

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: There's something I really want to make sure with you.

dialogue.desc: Even an island that has slumbered for years may hold sights that have withstood the test of time. At Sigrika's invitation, your journey into the unknown begins...

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: Hmm... These statues... I've seen them before.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Are they Royan?

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: That's right... But something feels strange...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: The statues and the shadows below the ice... They're facing different directions.

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: Hehe, I know how to solve this! My family taught me this trick!

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: Alright—drumroll, please! Currie's about to save the day! All we have to do is rotate these shadows until they're in the same direction as the statues.

phoneSample.speaker: Sigrika
phoneSample.text: Senior!

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: What's going on?!

phoneSample.speaker: Sigrika
phoneSample.text: Senior!

phoneSample.speaker: Sigrika
phoneSample.text: Oooh, I'm so sorry! The reception here is terrible...

phoneSample.speaker: Sigrika
phoneSample.text: Why does it keep sending the same message over and over?!

phoneSample.speaker: Sigrika
phoneSample.text: I didn't mean to do that. I swear!

dialogue.desc: Sigrika is practicing tirelessly at the training grounds, striving to sketch every rune with absolute precision. The weight of everyone's expectations propels her forward, but her nerves have stretched thin, tense as a bowstring pushed past its limit. Even so, she presses on, unaware that her stubborn determination is pushing her toward a suffocating mire...

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: How did I miss something like that before? After all the practices I had…

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Maybe you just needed a breather.

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: ...But I don't think I've fully mastered it...

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: So resting… is an important part of learning too?

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: Okay then, let's go watch birds!

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: Yep! It's the breeding season of Blubbin Puffin! They're everywhere on campus!

dialogue.desc: Sigrika returns to her room. Her moments of vulnerability in the Academy's Dark Side replay on a loop in her mind. Her cheeks burn with embarrassment. Even hugging her favorite plushie can't stop the blushing. (This is so humiliating... No, Sigrika! You have to apologize to Senior and the others who were worried about you.) With that thought, she opens your chat window on WavesLine.

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: Sorry for worrying you all!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: It's okay.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Relax. No need to be anxious.

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: Okay! I'll try to adjust!

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: By the way, are you free now, Senior?

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: I have a present for you. As an apology and a thank-you.

dialogue.desc: Sigrika sits in silence on the rooftop. The wind, which once brought her endless inspiration, now only brushes past her, stealing her warmth. Her heart of gold has grown heavy, each beat a soft whimper. Please, stop crying out, she prays, but it is to no avail. Just then, Sigrika hears the sound of your footsteps.

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: Though you told me not to think about it, I still ran away and hid myself here…

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Professor Lucilla, Dr. Luuk, and me, we're all here to help.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: So, allow yourself to step away and rest a little before you find the answer.

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: …Then, can you stay with me a little longer?

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: Thank you.

dialogue.desc: Sigrika leads you to a certain rooftop within the Academy. To any passerby, it looks completely ordinary. But only she knows just how many "spirits of freedom" love to pause and rest on this unassuming place. Every bird visiting the area carries its own character, but their size makes them easy to miss. Spotting them takes a sharp eye. She has one, undoubtedly. And so do you.

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: Okay... I'll just have to take more until I get a good one myself!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: You really like birds, don't you?

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: Mm-hmm! They're beautiful. And free.

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: Most of all, they're brave. They know exactly where they're flying to.

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: You have some that journey across entire continents, from pole to pole... and others that will brave storms to find a place they call home.

sample.speaker: Sigrika
sample.text: And they're not born knowing how to fly. There's always that first leap from a great height, that very moment the wind rushes through their feather for the first time.

scene.desc: With the Dark Side crisis resolved, Sigrika is in higher spirits than ever before. After rushing to share her joy with you, she heads back to her sanctuary, her heart still racing with excitement. This place has witnessed her expectations, her fragility, and her confusion. Now, it finally holds her happiness. As she tells the birds and the horizon the story of your journey together, she makes a silent vow to cherish these memories forever.

mention.title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
mention.text: Lucilla, Sigrika and I received this riddle from the Divinator at the celebration venue.
mention.source: Rover brings up Sigrika in “Gold Suspended in Shadows” (23×)

mention.title: Beneath a Melting Night Sky
mention.text: Sigrika and Nastasha's lives will change. They'll lose an important friend. No matter how they ultimately break from the shadows, what is lost... is lost forever.
mention.source: Rover brings up Sigrika in “Beneath a Melting Night Sky” (3×)

mention.title: Rabbit Reflected in Shades
mention.text: I'm here to talk about the Dark Side. Sigrika and I had an accident there, and I heard other students and professors experienced something similar.
mention.source: Rover brings up Sigrika in “Rabbit Reflected in Shades” (2×)

mention.title: Starlights from Yesterdays
mention.text: Right. I hope Sigrika is having the same luck.
mention.source: Rover brings up Sigrika in “Starlights from Yesterdays”

mention.title: Sunny Season
mention.text: I'm not talking about physical exhaustion, Sigrika.
mention.source: Rover brings up Sigrika in “Sunny Season”

mention.title: Essence of Tranquility
mention.text: (I wonder how Sigrika is doing…)
mention.source: Rover brings up Sigrika in “Essence of Tranquility”

mention.title: Ground Engravings
mention.text: Relax, Sigrika. Just focus on how to take them down.
mention.source: Rover brings up Sigrika in “Ground Engravings”

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Mornye?

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: My, my. Already caused a stir in the training grounds? Color me impressed.

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: I'll have people clean up the aftermath. You can carry on as you see fit.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: You were monitoring my comms with Mornye?

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: You're a person of special interest. Of course we keep an eye on your movements.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: "We"?

dialogue.desc: The New Solar Celebration is just around the corner. Yet, President Lucilla detects a mysterious frequency appearing in the Academy's Dark Side—one that does not belong to the Academy. You suspect it may be the "reward" once mentioned by the Grand Architect of the Fractsidus. Determined to uncover the truth behind this anomaly, you venture into the Dark Side alongside Sigrika, a student you encountered there...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Is it influencing them?

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: Maybe... the signal...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: President Lucilla?

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: ...Hello? Can you hear—

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: Find the clock... leave... wait for you outside...

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: I'm concerned other students might be getting similar riddles.

phoneSample.speaker: Lucilla
phoneSample.text: Very well. We'll trace it.

phoneSample.speaker: Lucilla
phoneSample.text: Focus on your investigation and be careful.

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: And you realized she was a fake when she said, "Should finding an answer really be so important?"

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: You got it all right... Amazing how much you learned just from that single card.

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: To me, your memories play like a film. I can pause and study them frame by frame.

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: So, what happened after the fake Sigrika revealed herself?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Then... there was a rabbit. I remember chasing it, the same one I saw right after entering the Dark Side.

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: I see. Thank you, Rover. I think I've found what I needed.

phoneSample.speaker: Lucilla
phoneSample.text: Sorry to bother you at this hour, Rover.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: The President using cute emojis? No way. Who are you, really?

phoneSample.speaker: Lucilla
phoneSample.text: Well, seems our dear student has quite an "interesting" bias against the faculty.

phoneSample.speaker: Lucilla
phoneSample.text: Maybe I should add a new course. Startorch Guidelines: From Strangers to Confidants.

phoneSample.speaker: Lucilla
phoneSample.text: As for its final exam, what about "How to spend a wonderful day with your teacher"?

phoneSample.speaker: Lucilla
phoneSample.text: Jokes aside. Let's get down to business. I want to discuss the Academy's Dark Side with you.

dialogue.desc: After the Dark Side incident comes to an end, Lucilla meets with Hiyuki at the auditorium. Lucilla suspects that the Fractsidus may be plotting something far more dangerous behind the scenes...

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: Long story short, we've found traces of Aemeath's frequency.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Huh?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Where?

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: In the active Voidmatter zone beneath Lahai-Roi. Do you remember that white-haired miko you met, the one with the blade?

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: Her name is Hiyuki. She's been helping the Collective survey the active Voidmatter zone. Simply put, she's in charge of protecting researchers and students who aren't equipped for a fight.

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: She's been helping us out with the investigation lately. Like you, she's trying to track down any sign of Aemeath.

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: Long story short, we've found traces of Aemeath's frequency.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Huh?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Where?

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: In the active Voidmatter zone beneath Lahai-Roi. Do you remember that white-haired miko you met, the one with the blade?

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: Her name is Hiyuki. She's been helping the Collective survey the active Voidmatter zone. Simply put, she's in charge of protecting researchers and students who aren't equipped for a fight.

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: She's been helping us out with the investigation lately. Like you, she's trying to track down any sign of Aemeath

dialogue.desc: Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: There's something else. I need a favor.

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: Go on, Rover.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: The Fractsidus is lying low. Even after failing in the Dark Side, they could move the moment the Stridergate opens.

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: Ah. That's what's on your mind. Well, I have an update. Remember Sigrika's friend? The… somewhat lackadaisical one?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: You mean Denia?

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: That's the one. She's gone missing. Our investigation points to her being the agent the Grand Architect referred to.

phoneSample.speaker: Lucilla
phoneSample.text: Are you back?

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: Still trying to wrap my head around everything.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: Yes, I'm back. About the Exostrider...

phoneSample.speaker: Lucilla
phoneSample.text: It's alright. We already know. Your safe return is what matters now.

phoneSample.speaker: Lucilla
phoneSample.text: Anyway, come meet us at the Research Institute. Everyone's been waiting for you.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: Got it.}}

dialogue.desc: Though the Threnodian Aleph-1 was banished, Lucilla finds herself in yet another predicament. In the absence of the Exostrider, funders are questioning whether the Synchronist program—and even the Rabelle College itself—should continue to exist. As both a professor and the head of the Academy, Lucilla must now choose between harsh reality and her ideals.

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: I need to stop by the Conference Hall before heading back. Care to walk with me?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Sure.

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: *A tired sigh*

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: When was the last time you slept?

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: Can't remember.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: The last time you ate?

phoneSample.speaker: Lucilla
phoneSample.text: Are you hanging in there alright?

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: I could ask you the same.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: Let's regroup ASAP.

phoneSample.speaker: Lucilla
phoneSample.text: Agreed. The space here seems to be constantly shifting. We'll need to rendezvous in a memory vivid enough for me. Keep this photo I'm sending over.

phoneSample.speaker: Lucilla
phoneSample.text: Find a suitable place. You know what to do... And keep your wits about you, Rover. Don't get yourself lost in a memory.}}

dialogue.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: You're all here...

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: Ah, Rover. I knew everyone would want to see you off, so I rounded up whoever I could.

phoneSample.speaker: Lucilla
phoneSample.text: So, Rover... which one are you?

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: You can bet I'll be back.

phoneSample.speaker: Lucilla
phoneSample.text: Heh, I knew you'd say that.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: What do you think?

phoneSample.speaker: Lucilla
phoneSample.text: You've always been a tricky one to read, but I think that for you, the answer doesn't even matter.

phoneSample.speaker: Lucilla
phoneSample.text: That's because you're definitely coming back.

dialogue.quest: So as the Melting Snow Desires
dialogue.desc: You receive word from Lucilla requesting your presence at the Academic Affairs office to discuss plans. In place of the busy President, Hiyuki will be meeting with you.

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: If you're free, meet me at the Academic Affairs Office.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Understood. I'm on my way.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Got it. I'll head over now.

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: Wait... Something just came up. You know, the usual pointless reporting and corporate rhetoric.

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: Hiyuki will meet you there instead.}}

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: Thanks for backing Lenie up, Rover. You went out of your way.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: You did, too.

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: Hehe... It's my job to look after my students. I owe you one for this, actually.

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: Let me buy you a drink sometime.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Is that even allowed at the Academy?

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: Absolutely. This is what we call "adult discretion." Perfectly above board.}}

dialogue.desc: After a long period of relentless work, Lucilla has finally carved out a good stretch of time off. Before the next busy season sweeps in, she seizes the chance to fulfill her old promise: watching that long-delayed film with you. "Time waits for no one. The final screening begins now!"

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: Rover, if you could only remember one thing a day, what would you choose?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: That's hard to decide.

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: Yes. It's something we can't answer until that day comes.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: So what did Laurene choose to remember?

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: She told herself, "I must never, ever give up."

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: She's brave.

phoneSample.speaker: Lucilla
phoneSample.text: Feels like the perfect time to watch that footage. What do you say, hero?

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: Sure. When?

phoneSample.speaker: Lucilla
phoneSample.text: Tomorrow afternoon at one. I'll meet you outside the auditorium.}}

dialogue.desc: On a day that started out like any other, you receive an unexpected message. The mere fact that the ever-busy Lucilla reached out at all is a rarity in itself. She brings two pieces of bad news: one concerns you, and the other... well, that concerns you, too. "If a movie trailer were written this way, I'd accuse the PR department of being lazy. Then again, some of the best films start exactly the same way."

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: Figures. They're always so reliable.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: So what is it, exactly...?

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: Footage from my Pioneer Association days, when I was leading a research team. Recorded on a bodycam.

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: Some of the data was damaged in an accident. I thought it was lost forever.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: You must really miss those days.

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: I miss every day that's already passed.

phoneSample.speaker: Lucilla
phoneSample.text: Well, I've got a double dose of bad news. Which would you like first?

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: I simply want good news.

phoneSample.speaker: Lucilla
phoneSample.text: Then let's start with the lesser of the two evils.

phoneSample.speaker: Lucilla
phoneSample.text: First up, my search for the perfect movie to share has come up empty.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: That's fine. We can take our time.

phoneSample.speaker: Lucilla
phoneSample.text: I agree. Now, the other one. My projector broke down in class yesterday.

dialogue.desc: Even with her schedule packed to the brim, Lucilla still made time to point you toward the Academy's finest view. Gardens are often where stories unfold—be they horror or romance—but on this campus, the faculty ensures they remain strictly for relaxation. Head to the garden and admire the greenery so meticulously tended to by the support staff. "Awaiting my message? I'm afraid I really am swamped this time."

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: Just as you can't change a movie by wishing at the screen, conventional treatments won't work for memory-type Resonators. She can only find her way out by herself.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: How long would that take?

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: Maybe by tomorrow morning. Maybe a lifetime.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: So she's...

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: Applying to quit the Academy.

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: Life here has simply become too heavy for her.

phoneSample.speaker: Lucilla
phoneSample.text: Oh right, you mentioned coffee keeps you up. How about trying some plant-based milk instead?

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: I'm interested.

phoneSample.speaker: Lucilla
phoneSample.text: The Academy swears by it for anyone needing to relax. Might be worth a shot.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: Not really interested.

phoneSample.speaker: Lucilla
phoneSample.text: That's too bad. I'll just have to find something better to recommend next time.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: Got a little time today?

dialogue.desc: Lucilla has hit a snag trying to pick the right film. She invites you to help her navigate the "vast sea of movies" to find the perfect one. Head to the library and pick out a film that catches your eye. "The movies we love are always connected to us in some way. Sometimes the link sparks an instant memory. Other times, it's like dust on a film reel, hidden in shadows the naked eye can barely perceive."

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Have you watched it?

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: That one? Not yet.

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: Too much going on. I'm not ready for distractions.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Why don't we watch it when you are free?

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: That sounds lovely. Once I'm done with the things at hand, let's watch it together.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Sounds good.

phoneSample.speaker: Lucilla
phoneSample.text: Since we'll be watching together, why don't you pick one?

phoneSample.speaker: Lucilla
phoneSample.text: It's a deal then. I'll meet you at the library.}}

dialogue.desc: The New Solar Celebration belongs to the students, not the faculty keeping order, and certainly not the president overseeing it all. You've grown used to Lucilla's packed schedule. That one movie you watched together seemed to be the only leisure she could steal. But today, just outside the venue, you spot her looking remarkably relaxed... "How's that for a teaser?"

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: So I've arranged for reliable people to watch over things. No need to panic.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: So, what really brings you here…

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: Simply to enjoy the festival.

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: Now, now, relax those shoulders, Rover. The New Solar Celebration doesn't come often. It'd be a shame to miss it.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: The venue's lively. You should check it out.

dialogue.desc: The Star Bouncing game has come to an end. It's time to meet the person behind its creation..

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: Well, even I find myself craving something fresh to break up the daily grind every now and then. And honestly, with so many brilliant students around, I never have to look far for a spark of inspiration.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: So adding Rainbow Bean Pop Rocks into the game was also part of your plan?

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: It works like a catalyst. Otherwise, the game would be far too boring and bland.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: And Dr. Luuk?

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: That's none of my business. He signed up for it himself.

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: He volunteered to make sure everything stayed under control. Makes sense to me. It's his invention, after all.

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: You don't plan to misbehave too, do you?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: That's not why I'm here. The Exostrider is critical not just to the Collective, but to all of Lahai-Roi. I wouldn't act without authorization. Not for "my own" sake.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: This is a gift from someone the miko once protected. Handmade. Think you could pass it to her?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: And tell her I do want to save Aemeath. More than anything. But I don't want anyone else getting hurt for it either.

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: Hah... You two might actually get along. Which is saying something. Hiyuki doesn't exactly do small talk.

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: Both of you have a "savior complex." As an educator, I'm here to tell you that isn't a good thing.

scene.desc: A Somnoire door has suddenly appeared in the Academy. Mornye has asked for your help investigating it.
President Lucilla introduces you to a student named Grahame. She tasks you with joining him on a "graduation trip" to the Dimmr Plains...

mention.title: We Choose the Sky
mention.text: (I want to do something for the Synchronists, but I've also got my responsibility to the Black Shores. I don't think Lucilla would put her students in harm's way, but still...)
mention.source: Rover brings up Lucilla in “We Choose the Sky” (14×)

mention.title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
mention.text: Lucilla, Sigrika and I received this riddle from the Divinator at the celebration venue.
mention.source: Rover brings up Lucilla in “Gold Suspended in Shadows” (4×)

mention.title: Rabbit Reflected in Shades
mention.text: (Lucilla mentioned that he's not on good terms with the management. I can't let him know I was sent here by her.)
mention.source: Rover brings up Lucilla in “Rabbit Reflected in Shades” (3×)

mention.title: The Star That Voyages Far
mention.text: President Lucilla, I don't appreciate being interrogated over a tapped line.
mention.source: Rover brings up Lucilla in “The Star That Voyages Far” (3×)

mention.title: Starlights from Yesterdays
mention.text: Hiyuki. Lucilla told me you fought a Threnodian in Ashinohara for a long time.
mention.source: Rover brings up Lucilla in “Starlights from Yesterdays” (3×)

mention.title: The Wind Before the Storm
mention.text: After the Exostrider disappeared, the Spacetrek Collective's investors even wanted to shut down Rabelle College at one point. But President Lucilla fought them tooth and nail, and the faculty and students let their work speak for itself. In the end, they saved it.
mention.source: Rover brings up Lucilla in “The Wind Before the Storm”

mention.title: At Dream's Edge
mention.text: These aren't normal Tacet Discords. Lynae, can you report this directly to President Lucilla? We need her insight.
mention.source: Rover brings up Lucilla in “At Dream's Edge” (2×)

mention.title: The One Who Chooses to Linger
mention.text: And you're Lucilla's...
mention.source: Rover brings up Lucilla in “The One Who Chooses to Linger”

dialogue.desc: As the High Tide draws near, a lurking calamity stirs, with its gaze fixed upon the borders of Septimont. Ephor Augusta invites you to the Sanguis Plateaus for a fateful hunt, the one that may decide the realm's survival...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Augusta spoke of the great surge we are about to face.

sample.speaker: Avidius
sample.text: The Ephor speaks the truth.

sample.speaker: Avidius
sample.text: And... this year's High Tide has come later than usual, which bodes ill.

sample.speaker: Avidius
sample.text: It's a shame even the sharp ears of the Senate could not chisel through the high walls of Tetragon Temple, to hear the whispers beyond...

sample.speaker: Avidius
sample.text: Heh, is this an auspice of calamity, or a prelude to a new legend? Only time will tell...

dialogue.desc: With the Sovereign slain, you attend the victory ceremony by invitation of Ceremonial Officer Bruno. The celebration honors the new Hero of Heroes and those who stood by their side amidst the crackling bonfire and joyous cheers of the crowd... Now that the countless petals are to be thrown into the sky to become the rain of glory and triumph, you might finally reunite with the girl you have never forgotten in a way even beyond fate's grasp.

sample.speaker: Avidius
sample.text: Ha, there's no one else here. No need to put on an act.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (He doesn't look like he's lying, but this is the first time I've been here. Priestesses, Tetragon Temple... Could this be Iuno's doing?)

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (For Avidius here, Iuno has also never existed. Whatever she did in the past is now my doing. That's why he thinks I'm behind all this.)

sample.speaker: Avidius
sample.text: Ha... Hahaha... At this point, what do I have left to hide?

sample.speaker: Avidius
sample.text: I always thought I was the hero who conquered Manes Deep. The one more worthy of ruling than even Augusta.

sample.speaker: Avidius
sample.text: Until the day I led the charge to Murmurstown, determined to stop my comrades from falling to the Dark Tide and prove I had what it took to be king. I walked to the door I had passed a thousand times only to find—

dialogue.desc: To open the Sentinel's Relic, you head back to Ragunna once more...

sample.speaker: Avidius
sample.text: That's a long story. Let's speak of more pressing matters. Are you after the Thundering Mephis as well?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: No. I'm tracking someone else.

sample.speaker: Avidius
sample.text: Silver hair and violet eyes... cloaked in cursed, shadowlit flame. So you seek the one they call "Discord Slayer."

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Discord Slayer? Sounds like you know something about her.

sample.speaker: Avidius
sample.text: Yes, she's on my radar. I suspect the recent Tacet Discord outbreak in Ragunna City is tied to her presence.

sample.speaker: Avidius
sample.text: Your Grace hasn't heard? It struck not long ago.

mention.title: The Bygone Shall Always Return
mention.text: Avidius shouldn't have had to bear such a fate... I will carry on his fight. I'll keep writing the story he believed in, the story that gives people hope.
mention.source: Rover brings up Avidius in “The Bygone Shall Always Return” (10×)

mention.title: By Moon's Fated Light
mention.text: (For Avidius here, Iuno has also never existed. Whatever she did in the past is now my doing. That's why he thinks I'm behind all this.)
mention.source: Rover brings up Avidius in “By Moon's Fated Light”

mention.title: By Sun's Burning Hand
mention.text: Avidius's team should be almost done, Augusta. I'll head over to join them.
mention.source: Rover brings up Avidius in “By Sun's Burning Hand”

mention.title: Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides
mention.text: You wrote Avidius and all of Rinascita into a tragedy, just to prove a point.
mention.source: Rover brings up Avidius in “Dawn Breaks on Dark Tides”

scene.desc: As the High Tide draws near, a lurking calamity stirs, with its gaze fixed upon the borders of Septimont. Ephor Augusta invites you to the Sanguis Plateaus for a fateful hunt, the one that may decide the realm's survival...

With the Sovereign slain, you attend the victory ceremony by invitation of Ceremonial Officer Bruno. The celebration honors the new Hero of Heroes and those who stood by their side amidst the crackling bonfire and joyous cheers of the crowd... Now that the countless petals are to be thrown into the sky to become the rain of glory and triumph, you might finally reunite with the girl you have never forgotten in a way even beyond fate's grasp.
To open the Sentinel's Relic, you head back to Ragunna once more...

dialogue.desc: To open the Sentinel's Relic, you head back to Ragunna once more...

sample.speaker: Galbrena
sample.text: By the Light of Imperator... REPENT!

sample.speaker: Avidius
sample.text: It's... the Light of Genesis?

sample.speaker: Galbrena
sample.text: Looks like the judgment is clear.

sample.speaker: Galbrena
sample.text: These hollow existences don't need your mercy.

sample.speaker: Galbrena
sample.text: Protect the Civilization Capsule. That's what they're really after.

The Dreamer seals her heart and surrenders to a world of dreams beyond mortal sight. In this hidden realm built upon melancholy melodies, she walks a path of fragile hope and delusions without looking back. But the dreams she longs to realize have long been tangled up in shadow and deceit. Beneath the lofty facade of the Orchestrator, who seems to have everything, is but a wretched, pitiful soul, drowning in her own illusions. In the end, will this dream of blooming and withering be a sweet reverie or a haunting nightmare?
With the Dark Tide's threat to Ragunna eliminated, you prepare to set off to Septimont City...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Someone you knew? Was she... also from the outside and got pulled into this Sonoro?

sample.speaker: Chisa
sample.text: You could say that. I don't know who she is exactly, but she understood this place far better than I do.

sample.speaker: Chisa
sample.text: She suspected the Sonoro doesn't just loop. It also has a different inner time flow than the outside world. To test her theory, she took apart countless clocks and logged everything. Even her wristwatch was...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: ...Her wristwatch?

dialogue.desc: After you escaped from Honami City, Chisa, who had pushed herself to the brink of overclocking more than once, received treatment at the Black Shores. You've been apart ever since. Now, it's time to visit her again. For both of you, this will be a new beginning.

sample.speaker: Chisa
sample.text: Now this place feels more like home than the world out there.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: It just takes some time to get used to an unfamiliar enviornment.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Just ask the Black Shores to help you keep digging. With enough time, you're bound to find those connections again.

sample.speaker: Chisa
sample.text: Since you're here, would you walk with me? I'd like to see what Honami looks like now... together.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Any particular places you have in mind?

sample.speaker: Chisa
sample.text: I haven't come up with an exact plan yet. Specific routes, time of travel, rest locations... None.

sample.text: I thought maybe...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: There were complications. Took me a while to get here.

sample.speaker: Chisa
sample.text: Phew... I'm just glad you're safe.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: When you came through, did you notice anything strange?

sample.speaker: Chisa
sample.text: Strange? Not really. I felt a little dizzy, but otherwise, it was normal.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (So I was the only one pulled into that strange dimension...?)

phoneSample.speaker: Chisa

phoneSample.speaker: Rover

phoneSample.speaker: Rover

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: I ran into some trouble, but I've arrived safely at the Academy.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: I'll come find you soon.

phoneSample.speaker: Chisa
phoneSample.text: Rover!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Chisa.

dialogue.desc: Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.

sample.speaker: Chisa
sample.text: When I saw you return from the Stridergate, I wasn't sure if I should say something comforting... I thought you would—

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Don't worry. I don't have time for self-pity.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I'll leave things here to you, Chisa. It's time for me to get back to my own mission.

sample.speaker: Chisa
sample.text: Right. See you later!

phoneSample.speaker: Chisa

phoneSample.speaker: Rover

dialogue.desc: Though the Threnodian Aleph-1 was banished, Lucilla finds herself in yet another predicament. In the absence of the Exostrider, funders are questioning whether the Synchronist program—and even the Rabelle College itself—should continue to exist. As both a professor and the head of the Academy, Lucilla must now choose between harsh reality and her ideals.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: What about you, Chisa? What have you heard?

sample.speaker: Chisa
sample.text: Me? Actually, I don't know the specifics of what's happening. I just wanted to help...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (So it's all just hearsay for now...)

dialogue.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

sample.speaker: Chisa
sample.text: This... reminds me of the party we had with everyone at Shashou Cafe.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: How so?

sample.speaker: Chisa
sample.text: Back then, all I wanted was to finish what I needed to do in Honami. No regrets. Then go home to see my parents.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I see.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Yeah, I remember you telling me.

sample.speaker: Chisa
sample.text: Yes. I'd even prepared myself for a final goodbye. But then we ended up coming here together... In a way.

dialogue.desc: After the end of Honami's looping crisis, Chisa heads to the Black Shores to recover. Namipon from Shashou Cafe contacts you to request your help in investigating a series of strange occurrences throughout Honami City. Assist Namipon with the investigation while also gathering supplies to help rebuild the Shashou Cafe.

sample.speaker: Chisa
sample.text: These are more actionable leads than the victims' psychological states... Apologies. I got caught up in thinking aloud.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Don't worry, you're making perfect sense, Chisa. Let's follow up on this.

sample.speaker: Chisa
sample.text: Okay. We need to watch for anyone else investigating this, and identify those present at the scenes before the unexplainabe events occurred.

sample.speaker: Chisa
sample.text: I find it strange too. But... there is no way to fix it for now.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: The next stop after Honami should be...

sample.speaker: Chisa
sample.text: It's Startorch Academy, right?

sample.speaker: Chisa
sample.text: We'll meet you there, Passenger.

sample.speaker: Chisa
sample.text: When the time comes, let's fight side by side once again.

sample.text: You haven't formally requested assistance. That tells us you want to handle this yourself. And we trust you.

sample.text: After what happened to Aemeath... and with the threat of Aleph-1, I know now isn't the time to be putting everything on the line.

Upon arriving in Lahai-Roi, you chance upon Lynae, a student who leads you to Startorch Academy. As you begin enrollment, everything about this "academic metropolis" unfolds before your eyes. Meanwhile, shadows stir beneath the Vold Storm...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: That artificial sun they spoke of...

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: In simple terms, it's our plan to replace the "sun" you see in the sky.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: You're planning to replace the Exostrider's Drive? Is that what the New Solar Ceremony is about?

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: You remember...? Did the Black Shores tell you this?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: It's the talk of the Academy now.

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: Right. Replacing it is critical to reactivating the Exostrider. And really, we can't stay wrapped in its warm light forever.

dialogue.summary: You see everything you've experienced since arriving in Solaris, along with scenes you don't recall, scenes featuring Mornye. Mornye hands you the finished Cassette tape, explaining that it serves as your ID and a Terminal that warns of Void Storms.

dialogue.desc: With the Voldworm threat gone for now, and the commencement of the New Solar Ceremony, Mornye, a Research Institute project lead, invites you to witness the rise of the new sun. However, a distress signal tells you that not everyone is looking forward to this ceremony. To uncover the truth, you and Mornye set off for the Bjartr Woods...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I'm fine now, Mornye. Sorry to worry you. You must need to get back to the Spacetrek Collective, right?

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: That's okay.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: But you just...

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: You looked... shaken just now. I'll stay with you. If it involves more frequency loss, I'd like to stay close to transport you to the infirmary.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Transport me?

phoneSample.text: Mornye, where are you?

phoneSample.speaker: Mornye
phoneSample.text: Has the feast finished already?

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: Yes, it is.

phoneSample.speaker: Mornye
phoneSample.text: I'm sorry if I worried you.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: I couldn't find you. I was worried.

phoneSample.speaker: Mornye
phoneSample.text: But... I'm the professor, and you're the student. It should be my place to worry about you.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (I'll bide my time. The right moment will come.)

sample.text: Has something happened, Mentor?

sample.text: I see. So the Reactor Drive's Core survived the crash?

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: It must be the key to reactivating the Exostrider. Of course, then the official stance is that it be returned. Startorch Academy and the Roya would both agree on that.

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: But, as you said, curiosity from the Institute is inevitable—

sample.text: Mornye?
