sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Why didn't you wake them up?

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: This class is difficult to follow, so it's normal for some to drift off. Still, it's rare for the entire class to go like that.

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: If only I could make my lectures more accessible...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: This isn't your fault.

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: It's like metal fatigue. These students are being tempered and pushed to their limits over and over. Eventually, the metal just snaps.

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: Should I have woken them? Reprimanded them? Or offered them assurance...?

dialogue.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: It's just... this is the second time I'm seeing you off from Lahai-Roi.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I'm sorry I've forgotten our past time together.

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: Don't be. I know you had your reasons, and I don't feel disappointed.

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: But last time you left, you said that Lahai-Roi will continue forward on its own feet. I've carried those words with me ever since.

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: So this time... may I be the one to offer a proper farewell?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: By all means.

dialogue.desc: A Somnoire door has suddenly appeared in the Academy. Mornye has asked for your help investigating it.

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: Mentor, I looked into this Somnoire you mentioned... it seems to be some kind of dreamscape, correct?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: It's usually guarded by two Gatekeepers. They make sure no Nightmare Tacet Discords or other frequencies cross into our reality.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Whenever there was a problem in the past, we handled it.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: But we've never come across a frequency able to rewrite space itself... Has the Academy been affected?

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: At this stage, the door's area of influence remains limited.

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: The Academy has cordoned off a danger zone and instructed everyone to keep their distance.

phoneSample.speaker: Mornye
phoneSample.text: The door itself poses no direct threat. However, an abnormal frequency leaking from behind it is slowly contaminating the surrounding environment.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: What do you mean by "contaminating"?

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: Abnormal frequency?

phoneSample.speaker: Mornye
phoneSample.text: It's rewriting the frequency of anything it comes into contact with, assimilating it as part of itself.

phoneSample.speaker: Mornye
phoneSample.text: ...As of now, we haven't found a way to stop it.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: Abnormal frequency, a door... This has the Somnoire written all over it.

dialogue.desc: In the Voidmatter-contaminated area of the Twilight Woodlands, you discover Helios's prototype, a machine thought lost long ago in a Void Storm.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Mornye, what's your take on this Augmented Resonance tech?

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: My research in this field is limited, but based on Professor Warren's theories...

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: If the conditions are right, the Augmented Resonance framework could actually shield instrument signals from any electromagnetic interference from the Etheric Sea.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I see... By the way, how did you know about the valve issue?

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: Professor Anselm mentioned it to me on Wavesline before I left.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: Mornye, I found this device with a student named Lenie. Does it look familiar?

phoneSample.speaker: Mornye
phoneSample.text: It might be the prototype developed for the Helios Project. Where exactly did you find this, Mentor?

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: The Twilight Woodlands, in the Dimmr Plains.

phoneSample.speaker: Mornye
phoneSample.text: I see. That prototype... it was actually lost in an accident during the initial testing. Vanished into a Void Storm. We've had no trace of it since.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: An accident? Do you remember what caused it?

phoneSample.speaker: Mornye
phoneSample.text: Hmm... the official records are light on details. But the conclusion at the time was an anti-Voidmatter system meltdown triggered by an unstable "Augmented Resonance" flow.

dialogue.desc: While the students immerse themselves fully in the Celebration, the faculty are run ragged keeping the gears turning. Even with thirteen different projects juggling for her attention, Mornye still finds a spare second to send a message checking in on you. To return the favor and help the ever-restless Mornye finally catch her breath, bring her the specific food she requested.

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: How is it?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: At first, it's sweet, like Dusk Honeypot… then smoky fish, followed by a greasy Skelecanth aroma. It's a creative flavor.

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: That's a relief…!

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: My apologies for getting carried away... I mean, if you like this, I can reserve a box for you when the development finishes.

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: Thank you for your insight. After replenishing energy, my mind feels sharper.

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: And... I'm feeling more relaxed. Resuming work in this state should be more productive.

phoneSample.speaker: Mornye
phoneSample.text: So you might take it easy now, Mentor. There's no need to overexert yourself.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: Understood, Professor Mornye!

phoneSample.speaker: Mornye
phoneSample.text: Surprise

phoneSample.speaker: Mornye
phoneSample.text: Since you say so, Mentor… please do take a professor's advice seriously!

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: Okay. Don't worry.

phoneSample.speaker: Mornye
phoneSample.text: That's a relief. I hope I haven't disturbed you.

dialogue.desc: Not long after your brief encounter at the library, Mornye sends you another invitation. The message is a word-for-word replica of her last one. It seems she is attempting to recreate your previous meeting to validate a specific theory. Head to the library to meet Mornye and assist with her experiment.

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: Ah, sorry. I didn't realize you had arrived.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Did I interrupt your work?

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: Not at all. That was my mistake.

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: I promised I'd only use fifteen minutes of your time. I should be using it more efficiently.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: You look troubled. Can I help?

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: No, it should be fine as long as you're here.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: What's new?

phoneSample.speaker: Mornye
phoneSample.text: Just want to inform you that all Dark Side parameters are stable now. No significant deviations are expected for the foreseeable future.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: Didn't this conversation happen before?

phoneSample.speaker: Mornye
phoneSample.text: My apologies.

phoneSample.speaker: Mornye
phoneSample.text: I was attempting to recreate the previous scenario to improve my work efficiency.

dialogue.desc: Mornye has sent you another invitation. Unlike your previous meetings, she has carefully selected a location designed for relaxation: "Lush vegetation and an open view." Can she obtain the experimental results she seeks in this new environment? Head to the Golden Spiral and meet Mornye.

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: …Sorry. Did I confuse you?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: When it comes to people, you have to try to understand the emotional aspect.

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: Understand the emotional aspect?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: That's right. Just leave it to me.

phoneSample.speaker: Mornye
phoneSample.text: Lush vegetation and an open view should promote "relaxation."

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: Okie dokie. Shall we go now?

phoneSample.speaker: Mornye
phoneSample.text: Yes. I'll wait for you there.}}

dialogue.desc: After some careful preparation, it is your turn to send an invitation to Mornye. Upon receiving it, she seems a bit nervous—she doesn't have much experience simply "hanging out" with others. As her Mentor, this is your moment to lead the way. Head to the screening room with Mornye to watch the film you specially selected for her.

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: So "understanding the emotional aspect" involves… watching a movie?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Yep, I figured you haven't watched many.

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: …If by "movies" you mean edited videos, then I'm familiar with observing experimental records.

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: Do you like movies?

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: I see. Then I'll watch carefully, just like you do.

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: Hmm... have to watch?

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: I've already come up with a good way to address the problem you mentioned last time. Wanna come?

phoneSample.speaker: Mornye
phoneSample.text: Okay.

phoneSample.speaker: Mornye
phoneSample.text: Will this involve a lot of talking to people? If so, I may need to script the entire conversation in advance.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: No preparations needed at all.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: Just come with me. Think of it as a brand-new adventure.}}

dialogue.desc: Mornye has sent word that her research is finally complete. After several twists and turns, the prototype of "Sylph" has finally been unveiled. Her brief message barely hides her excitement. She wants you to be the very first person to see it. Head to the Research Institute and share the joy of Mornye's hard-won success.

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: Though it's only a prototype, it functions perfectly. While it's not suited for mass production, I hope it can still help you capture a memory you truly cherish.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: (The memory I truly cherish… I'm curious myself. Using it once should be okay… as long as I don't abuse it.)

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Sure. Let's try it.

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: Alright. Powering on. Recording started...

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: Ah, wait! I forgot to delete my sample data!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Someday, we'll meet again.

phoneSample.speaker: Mornye
phoneSample.text: The prototype of Sylph is complete. I want you to be the first to see it.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: On my way.

phoneSample.speaker: Mornye
phoneSample.text: I'll be waiting in the lab.}}

dialogue.quest: Where Stars Cascade Down · event story

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: There are too many unfinished reports and not nearly enough time… Besides, her theory may lack universality. I may be an outlier.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Sounds like you've got the perfect opportunity to test it right now.

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: …You're right. A theory isn't proven or disproven until it's tested.

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: Mmhmm. You too, Rover.

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: Sustained research requires a clear mind and a steady supply of sugar to keep your brain fueled.

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: That's why a good, sweet coffee is always the perfect late-night beverage.

mention.title: Ode to the Second Sunrise
mention.text: I need to find out who he is, Mornye. Do you know any Roya who are familiar with the tribe's inner workings?
mention.source: Rover brings up Mornye in “Ode to the Second Sunrise” (12×)

mention.title: What Burns Beneath Frostlands
mention.text: Because I'm still new to the Academy. Professor Mornye isn't around, and I have no way to judge if I'm passing the message on to the right person.
mention.source: Rover brings up Mornye in “What Burns Beneath Frostlands” (7×)

mention.title: The Star That Voyages Far
mention.text: Then it was you. You're the one who saved Mornye when she was dying.
mention.source: Rover brings up Mornye in “The Star That Voyages Far” (5×)

mention.title: Starlights from Yesterdays
mention.text: Mornye, I'm fine. We had an incident. The Exostrider is still inside Voidspace beyond the Gate.
mention.source: Rover brings up Mornye in “Starlights from Yesterdays” (4×)

mention.title: Gold Suspended in Shadows
mention.text: Mornye, we need a safe zone. Now.
mention.source: Rover brings up Mornye in “Gold Suspended in Shadows”

mention.title: The Wind Before the Storm
mention.text: Thank you for everything you've done for me, Mornye.
mention.source: Rover brings up Mornye in “The Wind Before the Storm”

mention.title: At Dream's Edge
mention.text: Leave this to me. You get whatever data you collected back to Mornye. She'll need it to keep working on a fix.
mention.source: Rover brings up Mornye in “At Dream's Edge” (6×)

mention.title: Broken Dimmr Heart
mention.text: You're the one who tipped Mornye about the flow valve. Only person who knows that prototype inside out, besides Warren himself, is the one who ran the research back then.
mention.source: Rover brings up Mornye in “Broken Dimmr Heart” (10×)

dialogue.desc: The New Solar Celebration is just around the corner. Yet, President Lucilla detects a mysterious frequency appearing in the Academy's Dark Side—one that does not belong to the Academy. You suspect it may be the "reward" once mentioned by the Grand Architect of the Fractsidus. Determined to uncover the truth behind this anomaly, you venture into the Dark Side alongside Sigrika, a student you encountered there...

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: You need to take a "bad" rest.

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: No matter what happens, you, me, Rover, Dr. Luuk... we won't let the Dark Side ruin the Academy.

dialogue.desc: Take action... for the hopes of many, and for the paper plane that once slipped through your fingers.

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: I'm coming with you. Finding people is one thing, hauling them back is another. It'll be faster if we take my motorbike.

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: Status report, Professor Mornye.

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: The launch orbit has been confirmed. The Drive Replica is projected to launch in 16 hours, at which point it will initiate Duskveil.

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: Then we evacuate every remaining soul in Lahai-Roi before that window closes.

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: Check the ships at the Roya Frostlands port, in addition to the escape pods.

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: We don't know how long Duskveil will hold. No one stays a second longer than necessary.

dialogue.desc: Though the Threnodian Aleph-1 was banished, Lucilla finds herself in yet another predicament. In the absence of the Exostrider, funders are questioning whether the Synchronist program—and even the Rabelle College itself—should continue to exist. As both a professor and the head of the Academy, Lucilla must now choose between harsh reality and her ideals.

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: Yep, we even threw together a little welcoming thing.

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: Oh, you rascals... Alright, but follow my lead. If this auditor is a by-the-book type, then we—

dialogue.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: Ah, Rover. I knew everyone would want to see you off, so I rounded up whoever I could.

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: You weren't gonna just shoot us a WavesLine and dip, were ya? That'd be cold!

dialogue.desc: A Somnoire door has suddenly appeared in the Academy. Mornye has asked for your help investigating it.

sample.speaker: Lucilla
sample.text: The cat, the dog, even the Soliskin I can follow. But the tag signature... what's the story there?

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: Hehe, well...

mention.title: Ode to the Second Sunrise
mention.text: Ugh, I really wanna hit the road with you again, but I'm kinda on a "mental health watchlist." If I break even one tiny rule on day one, Miss Lucilla will be dragging me in for a "friendly chat."
mention.source: Lynae brings up Lucilla in “Ode to the Second Sunrise”

mention.title: Starlights from Yesterdays

sample.text: From its structure, it looks like a canister that can both store and emit energy.

sample.text: Ugh, it's so stinky!

sample.text: It smells just like that giant worm you fought! Didn't we deal with it already?!

sample.text: Giant worm... You mean the Voidworm?

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: I see. It's capturing frequencies with high precision, storing energy data.

sample.speaker: Mornye
sample.text: It's based on ecological models, tracking activity in natural environments, and reconstructing that data mathematically.

sample.text: Uh... but I can't tell what it is exactly.

sample.text: ...That smell might be coming from the frequency sample I just collected.

sample.speaker: Hiyuki
sample.text: I'm sorry.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: What for?

dialogue.desc: You receive word from Lucilla requesting your presence at the Academic Affairs office to discuss plans. In place of the busy President, Hiyuki will be meeting with you.

sample.speaker: Hiyuki
sample.text: Their plans for Denia and me may have failed, but it proves one thing. They have found a way to harness Threnodian power.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Spying from the shadows... that does sound like them. Thank you, I'll be careful.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: By the way, how is Denia?

sample.speaker: Hiyuki

sample.speaker: Rover

sample.speaker: Hiyuki
sample.text: ...I did.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Then you—

sample.speaker: Hiyuki

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: So that muttering earlier was... studying?

sample.speaker: Hiyuki
sample.text: Reading, memorizing terms... Rover, do you...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Sorry. That's one area I can't help you with.

sample.speaker: Hiyuki
sample.text: I see... No matter. The night is long. I will remember what I can.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: That's easy. Leave it to me.

In the absence of the Exostrider, funders are questioning whether the Synchronist program—and even the Rabelle College itself—should continue to exist. As both a professor and the head of the Academy, Lucilla must now choose between harsh reality and her ideals.

sample.speaker: Aalto
sample.text: You're telling me you've modified every bike here? That's insane.

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: Well, Waleo's been in the expedition motorbike program since day one. These bikes here are basically his family!

sample.speaker: Waleo
sample.text: Soulmates.

sample.speaker: Lynae
sample.text: So, whaddya say, Auditor Aalto? How about you order ten as a starter pack!

sample.speaker: Aalto
sample.text: (Ten soulmates sold in a pack, huh...)

mention.title: We Choose the Sky
mention.text: That Aalto guy... he's got a reputation in New Fed's circles. Known for handling intel, if you catch my drift.
mention.source: Lynae brings up Aalto in “We Choose the Sky” (2×)

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Suisui!

sample.speaker: Suisui
sample.text: Well, well, look who it is... I knew something good was going to happen when I left the house today.

sample.speaker: Suisui
sample.text: I wanted her to come with me, but she said she's busy. She's been holed up in her study all morning. I know, I know... My little sister is all grown up now, with her own plans to keep.

sample.speaker: Suisui
sample.text: Now you two have to try this Water Moon Bun! It's best fresh out of the oven, like right now.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: Wow! Check these out! And all those there! Can we really eat all this?

sample.speaker: Suisui
sample.text: Of course! It's my treat today, so help yourselves.

mention.title: A Chill Day Out
mention.text: —to show you my thanks! Seriously, Suisui, you're the best.
mention.source: Abby brings up Suisui in “A Chill Day Out” (4×)

mention.title: A Chill Day Out
mention.text: Actually, we—no, our friend Abby here can eat just about anything without batting an eye and wants to try your Ultimate Flavor Under Heaven.
mention.source: Suisui brings up Abby in “A Chill Day Out” (6×)

dialogue.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

sample.speaker: Suisui
sample.text: Before coming to Jinzhou, I'll admit I was a little nervous. After so many years apart, I wasn't sure we'd still be the same people we remembered. I never imagined...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Yangyang said the same thing to me.

sample.speaker: Suisui
sample.text: Oh? Did she now...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: You two are a lot alike, you know.

sample.speaker: Suisui
sample.text: Are we? In some ways, perhaps. In others, not so much.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: She's determined. She's never wavered or doubted her own choices.

dialogue.desc: The Land of Xuanfang is thrown into turmoil following an unexpected riot of out-of-control Autopuppets. As you investigate, you uncover the mastermind behind the scheme—a mysterious Artisan who covets the Sentinel's technology. In the culmination of the event, this figure commands the rogue Autopuppets to launch an assault on Xuanfang Hold.

sample.speaker: Suisui
sample.text: Hehe. Looks like Dumpling has taken a liking to you.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: You seem cheerful.

sample.speaker: Suisui
sample.text: Oh this is nothing. If I really put my mind to it, I could make Xuanfang Hold every bit as lively as Mengzhou.

sample.speaker: Suisui
sample.text: Although I do like the feel of this place. It's less flashy, maybe... but the people are kind. Genuine. Is Jinzhou like that too?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Next time there's a chance, Yangyang and I will give you a proper tour of Jinzhou.

sample.speaker: Suisui
sample.text: Oh? And when exactly is this "next time?"

dialogue.desc: With the great battle over, the Land of Xuanfang is slowly returning to how it once was, though plenty of aftershocks have yet to settle. Then one day, a WavesLine message from Yangyang arrives out of the blue: Suisui is about to head back to Mengzhou City...

sample.speaker: Suisui
sample.text: To think, that man sowed chaos on such a scale in Xuanfang, yet Mengzhou City Hall shows so little concern... Makes you wonder, doesn't it?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: So you're going back to Mengzhou to try to find answers.

sample.speaker: Suisui
sample.text: I am. That's where I shine. You have bigger fish to fry. Like tracking down a certain Mengzhou Sentinel I once made a deal with.

sample.speaker: Suisui
sample.text: She never told me where She was, but I've always had the feeling She was close to Xuanfang Hold. And wouldn't you know...

sample.speaker: Suisui
sample.text: The Elseway Shroud I entered before has appeared again.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: The Sentinel is our best chance at understanding what's happening in Xuanfang.

phoneSample.speaker: Suisui
phoneSample.text: Anytime you miss me, just take a peek. A little insight into my comings and goings, hm?

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: That was a unique situation. I needed to know where you were and if you were still alive. But now...

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: If I need to check on you, I'll reach out first. Using that to see where you are should be for emergencies only.

phoneSample.speaker: Suisui
phoneSample.text: All right, I was only teasing, darling. I know how you are. The locator has a range limit anyway, so it'll be useless once I'm in Mengzhou City.

phoneSample.speaker: Suisui
phoneSample.text: Speaking of which... I left in such a hurry that I forgot.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: Forgot what?

sample.speaker: Suisui
sample.text: I still remember the time Father brought back a little jade bird for me. She clearly loved it, but all she said was, "If my sister likes it, then I'm happy too." She never once asked for one herself.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Yep, that sounds like her.

sample.speaker: Suisui
sample.text: Right? That's just how she is—always putting others first, never giving a second thought to herself.

sample.speaker: Suisui
sample.text: But I can't have that. I'm her big sister, and a big sister's duty is to make sure her little sis is well-fed and well-dressed.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: So you gave her the jade bird?

sample.speaker: Suisui
sample.text: Nope. I took her to the market a few times, and we finally found one that looked just like it.

dialogue.summary: After business done, Suisui apologizes for involving Rover with work, but Rover consoles her that there is still plenty of time left to continue their carefree day together.

scene.desc: Days after the Autopuppet crisis was solved, Yangyang chooses to stay behind in the Land of Xuanfang to assist the soldiers and the civilians. As she's waiting on her Resonance Assessment report, a mysterious voice starts to whisper in her ears...

The Waking Moon Festival is drawing near in the Land of Xuanfang, yet rumors that "the Hold is doomed to fall" have begun to spread throughout the city. To find the Sentinel who has long been absent, you decide to head to where Hsin's presence was last felt—the Manifold Sanctum.

mention.title: Song of the Heart Sword
mention.text: (Suisui seems to want to discuss something. I'd better head to the Ministry of War and find Yangyang first.)
mention.source: Rover brings up Suisui in “Song of the Heart Sword” (9×)

mention.title: The Wind Before the Storm
mention.text: (Now that she mentions it, Suisui did give me... one of her letters?)
mention.source: Rover brings up Suisui in “The Wind Before the Storm” (4×)

mention.title: A Chill Day Out
mention.text: Don't worry. Let's go check on Suisui.
mention.source: Rover brings up Suisui in “A Chill Day Out”

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: My deepest apologies for not welcoming you properly, Miss Suisui. And apologies that your first visit to Jinzhou is under such circumstances.

sample.speaker: Suisui
sample.text: ...Well. Since Ms. Sanhua was telling the truth, I suppose I should apologize for my earlier rudeness. I came all the way to Jinzhou to see my sister, only to be told she's gone missing. I hope you can understand how that feels.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: I do. And I understand the urgency of the matter. Now that Rover is here, I'll brief you both directly.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: Recently, multiple people have gone missing across Jinzhou. All leads point to Xuanfang. Yangyang and Chixia were tasked to investigate Xuanfang Hold together. Chixia returned gravely wounded, and we've heard nothing from Yangyang.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: The moment I learned of this, I dispatched messengers via alternate routes to the Mengzhou City Hall, but they have yet to report back. I also tried sending elite Midnight Rangers to scout Xuanfang Hold once more, but their gates are sealed shut. No one knows what is happening in

sample.speaker: Suisui
sample.text: Xuanfang Hold... Of all places.

dialogue.desc: The Land of Xuanfang is thrown into turmoil following an unexpected riot of out-of-control Autopuppets. As you investigate, you uncover the mastermind behind the scheme—a mysterious Artisan who covets the Sentinel's technology. In the culmination of the event, this figure commands the rogue Autopuppets to launch an assault on Xuanfang Hold.

sample.speaker: Suisui
sample.text: Magistrate, may I ask if this frequency is the same as the one you gave to Rover?

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: Mm... Yes, the spectral pattern matches exactly.

sample.speaker: Suisui
sample.text: Then, about the Sentinel of Mengzhou... do you have anything more to share?

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: I am afraid I have little to offer. In recent years, Jué has shared very few updates regarding Hsin, and I can't confirm that what I do know is even true.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: However, if She summoned you to the Land of Xuanfang, then that soil must hold a deep significance for Her.

sample.speaker: Jinhsi
sample.text: Jué once mentioned that Hsin separated Her tail to create multiple Prisms of Fate. Each one contains a fragment of the Sentinel's power. If one is hidden in the Hold, it's no coincidence...

mention.title: The Wind Before the Storm
mention.text: My deepest apologies for not welcoming you properly, Miss Suisui. And apologies that your first visit to Jinzhou is under such circumstances.
mention.source: Jinhsi brings up Suisui in “The Wind Before the Storm” (4×)

mention.title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
mention.text: ...Miss Suisui, you are claiming you entered into a direct deal with Sentinel Hsin the Moon Fox?
mention.source: Jinhsi brings up Suisui in “Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled” (2×)

sample.speaker: Suisui
sample.text: Rover, I will meet you at Huaxu Academy shortly.

sample.speaker: Sanhua
sample.text: ...We're counting on you, Rover.

mention.title: The Wind Before the Storm
mention.text: ...Well. Since Ms. Sanhua was telling the truth, I suppose I should apologize for my earlier rudeness. I came all the way to Jinzhou to see my sister, only to be told she's gone missing. I hope you can understand how that feels.
mention.source: Suisui brings up Sanhua in “The Wind Before the Storm”

dialogue.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

sample.speaker: Liangyu
sample.text: There was a girl. Yangyang. Said she was an Outrider for Jinzhou's Midnight Rangers. Two days ago, during the civilian evacuation, she traveled with us.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: That's her. Do you know where she is now?

sample.speaker: Liangyu
sample.text: No. She volunteered to draw a large group of Autopuppets away so we could get the civilians into the Hold. We lost her after that.

sample.speaker: Liangyu
sample.text: I sent a few scouts to search the Eastern Xuan Peaks area, but we failed to locate her trail.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I see. Another dead lead...

sample.speaker: Liangyu
sample.text: ...Do you have anything on you that's connected to her?

dialogue.desc: The Land of Xuanfang is thrown into turmoil following an unexpected riot of out-of-control Autopuppets. As you investigate, you uncover the mastermind behind the scheme—a mysterious Artisan who covets the Sentinel's technology. In the culmination of the event, this figure commands the rogue Autopuppets to launch an assault on Xuanfang Hold.

sample.speaker: Liangyu
sample.text: I was wondering, did you come here alone?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: No. I had a companion. We got separated before I ran into you.

sample.speaker: Liangyu
sample.text: Was it because of the Disorienting Fog? Aren't you worried about her?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I am... But we agreed we'd stick to our own goals unless things got really bad.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: She knows what she's doing. This fog won't stop her.

sample.speaker: Liangyu
sample.text: Is that so... Then we should pick up the pace too.

dialogue.desc: With the crisis behind you, Liangyu seems to have something to discuss. Go find out what it is when you have a moment. You may soon be seeing that Nethermancer who worked alongside you at the Manifold Sanctum.

sample.speaker: Liangyu
sample.text: The Paragon's report to the Ministry of War mentioned a Nethermancer who has been a great help... That must've been him, right?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Do you know him?

sample.speaker: Liangyu
sample.text: Xianling is a small village. The young ones grow up together. You cannot help but know each other.

dialogue.desc: The Waking Moon Festival is drawing near in the Land of Xuanfang, yet rumors that "the Hold is doomed to fall" have begun to spread throughout the city. To find the Sentinel who has long been absent, you decide to head to where Hsin's presence was last felt—the Manifold Sanctum.

sample.speaker: Liangyu
sample.text: Intendant, my apologies for the earlier offense... The Ministry of War's rules say you still need an escort to enter the Sanctum...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I'll go in with her.

sample.speaker: Suoming
sample.text: I have no objection.

sample.speaker: Suoming
sample.text: The Prism of Fate grants its bearer the authority to enter the Sanctum. Your presence there may be the variable that shifts everything.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: And Qingxiao?

scene.quest: More Than a Warden: Part II
scene.desc: Qingyan seems to have a few things on his mind now that he's recovered. Go see what they are...

dialogue.desc: After the events in Lahai-Roi are resolved, you decide to return to Huanglong, only to receive news of Yangyang's disappearance. In order to find her, you join Suisui, Yangyang's elder sister, on a journey to the Land of Xuanfang in Mengzhou.

sample.speaker: Liangyu
sample.text: Once everyone is gathered, we move.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: I met the village chief just now. He wishes for this sword to be kept with the Xuanfang Wardens.

sample.speaker: Liangyu
sample.text: A sword? At a time like this? Retreat will be dangerous enough. I'd ask everyone only to protect themselves and those beside them, not cold steel.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Then I will carry it myself, for now.

sample.speaker: Liangyu
sample.text: You... Fine. Do as you see fit.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: I also never properly thanked you for saving me. And for giving me a room to rest.

dialogue.desc: The Land of Xuanfang is thrown into turmoil following an unexpected riot of out-of-control Autopuppets. As you investigate, you uncover the mastermind behind the scheme—a mysterious Artisan who covets the Sentinel's technology. In the culmination of the event, this figure commands the rogue Autopuppets to launch an assault on Xuanfang Hold.

sample.speaker: Liangyu
sample.text: You two...

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Liang-Liangyu—?! You're here too—

sample.speaker: Liangyu
sample.text: (I've been standing here for a while...)

sample.speaker: Liangyu
sample.text: Are you okay, Yangyang?

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: I'm... I'm alright. Liangyu, the civilians... did everyone make it back to the city?

sample.speaker: Liangyu
sample.text: They did. Thanks to you.

dialogue.desc: With the great battle over, the Land of Xuanfang is slowly returning to how it once was, though plenty of aftershocks have yet to settle. Then one day, a WavesLine message from Yangyang arrives out of the blue: Suisui is about to head back to Mengzhou City...

sample.speaker: Liangyu
sample.text: Watcher Liangyu, reporting for duty.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Liangyu? But your injuries...

sample.speaker: Liangyu
sample.text: Do not worry. My injuries have mostly healed. I was only staying at the Ministry of War because the medics insisted on quiet rest.

sample.speaker: Liangyu
sample.text: Word is, those roaming Tacet Discords have begun to close in on the Hold. I will not let you face this alone.

sample.speaker: Liangyu
sample.text: We will fight together. The new Xuan Triad... Well, duo, for now. I will not let Qingzhi and Duzhong down.

sample.speaker: Yangyang
sample.text: Yes. Shoulder to shoulder, once more.

scene.desc: The Waking Moon Festival is drawing near in the Land of Xuanfang, yet rumors that "the Hold is doomed to fall" have begun to spread throughout the city. To find the Sentinel who has long been absent, you decide to head to where Hsin's presence was last felt—the Manifold Sanctum.

mention.title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
mention.text: Say no more, Yangyang. Apologize to anyone you wish, but not to me. This burden is mine. This failure is mine. Let me bear it alone.
mention.source: Liangyu brings up Yangyang in “Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled” (11×)

mention.title: The Wind Before the Storm
mention.text: There was a girl. Yangyang. Said she was an Outrider for Jinzhou's Midnight Rangers. Two days ago, during the civilian evacuation, she traveled with us.
mention.source: Liangyu brings up Yangyang in “The Wind Before the Storm” (3×)

mention.title: The Nethermancer's Requiem
mention.text: I have recovered. Yangyang was with me in the last battle, and we made a good team. A few close calls, but we came through unharmed.
mention.source: Liangyu brings up Yangyang in “The Nethermancer's Requiem”

mention.title: The Wind Before the Storm
mention.text: In Xianling Village, I met Liangyu. She is young, yet she already holds the title of Xuan Watcher. She told me of the chaos that has swept across Xuanfang. Her squadmates were slaughtered in a Censure Court.
mention.source: Yangyang brings up Liangyu in “The Wind Before the Storm” (12×)

mention.title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
mention.text: Liangyu offered us her house. She said we could stay as long as we need… I tried to turn her down, but she wouldn't hear it. So I ended up taking the keys.
mention.source: Yangyang brings up Liangyu in “Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled” (10×)

mention.title: Song of the Heart Sword
mention.text: Liangyu? But your injuries...
mention.source: Yangyang brings up Liangyu in “Song of the Heart Sword”

mention.title: Simulacrum of the Heart
mention.text: Liangyu told me you went into the Sanctum with that Ministry of Sentinel Affairs Intendant... Are you all right?
mention.source: Yangyang brings up Liangyu in “Simulacrum of the Heart”

mention.title: The Wind Before the Storm
mention.text: If there's ever a chance, I'd like to meet Magistrate Jinhsi. Sounds to me like she's under a lot of pressure, but she's handling it very well.
mention.source: Sigrika brings up Jinhsi in “The Wind Before the Storm”

sample.text: (If I remember right, Xuanling Birds have been extinct since the Fortress and Gorges War two centuries ago...)

sample.text: No need for formality. A Cultivator seeks to live long and see true. Age holds little meaning to me now.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: You don't have to write WavesLine messages like letters. You can just talk normally.

phoneSample.speaker: Qingxiao
phoneSample.text: Understood. I only recently learned how to use WavesLine on the Terminal, so I'm still familiarizing myself with the proper etiquette.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: It's okay. Now that you've added me, we can chat whenever. You'll get the hang of it.

phoneSample.speaker: Qingxiao
phoneSample.text: Thank you.

phoneSample.speaker: Qingxiao
phoneSample.text: My training hall is at the summit of the Eastern Xuan Peaks. Are you available?

sample.speaker: Qingxiao

sample.speaker: Qingxiao

sample.speaker: Qingxiao
sample.text: It's just... I'm still not quite used to minding such lively little ones.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Does it remind you of when you first met Ruoyun?

sample.speaker: Qingxiao
sample.text: No... Hsin.

sample.speaker: Qingxiao
sample.text: But let's return to the matter at hand.

sample.speaker: Qingxiao
sample.text: I asked you here, in part, to talk about Hsin. These past few days... the presence I have sensed from Her has grown weaker than before.

phoneSample.speaker: Qingxiao
phoneSample.text: ...In plainer words: if you're free, I'd like you to come sit a while at the Xuanyuan School's new training hall.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: New training hall?

phoneSample.speaker: Qingxiao
phoneSample.text: Yes, only just raised, with room enough for the disciples to practice the sword.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: A whole new training hall already? That's my Master.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: Count me in for a visit, then. I'm available right now.

phoneSample.speaker: Qingxiao
phoneSample.text: Wonderful.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Master, this manual... you left it at Yuan's Flavors. I came to return it.

sample.speaker: Qingxiao
sample.text: ...I was planning to retrieve it myself. I did not expect it to fall into your hands.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: The techniques in it remind me of my own. What is its connection to you?

sample.speaker: Qingxiao
sample.text: It's a long story... Long ago, a village girl found this manual while tending livestock. She treasured it above all.

sample.speaker: Qingxiao
sample.text: In her spare time, she practiced with a branch in place of a sword. She had no teacher, just the pages. But over time, she grew skilled.

sample.speaker: Qingxiao
sample.text: That fortuitous training saved her when Tacet Discords destroyed her home.

sample.speaker: Qingxiao
sample.text: ...Very well. There is no need to worry about me. The flowers are in full bloom right now. You should stay a while and enjoy the view.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: This melody you're playing... It sounds like you're in a good mood.

sample.speaker: Qingxiao
sample.text: Perhaps. As I looked out over the Land of Xuanfang this morning, I happened to see clouds and mist ascending in the distance. A truly auspicious sign.

sample.speaker: Qingxiao
sample.text: It seems our journey to the Sanctum has finally resolved much of the karma left behind since the Fortress and Gorges War.

sample.speaker: Qingxiao
sample.text: My disciple, you accepted Hsin's power before, and your body still needs time to adapt to it. You have been running ragged across Xuanfang lately without a moment's rest.

sample.speaker: Qingxiao
sample.text: How do you feel now?

sample.text: Right, let's skip the chit‑chat. We're all hunting the same soulless fart, so why not team up?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: You've helped a great deal, and I've no reason to refuse. I need your intel. But you... what do you need from me?

sample.speaker: Jingran
sample.text: You get right to it, huh? Love it. I want to stick with you because it's better odds for making sure Muyu doesn't get away again.

sample.speaker: Jingran
sample.text: I don't have any of your "noble" motives, just an old score to settle with that bastard.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: That's your only condition?

sample.speaker: Jingran
sample.text: Yeah, well... if we trip over any Sanctum relics or Hsin's secret stash of treasure, maybe toss one my way? Hah. Kidding.

sample.speaker: Jingran
sample.text: The old coot made me promise that when he kicks it, no grave, no marker, no nothing. Tch, live clean, die clean. He locked himself away in some Mirage Realm, lamp and all.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Jingran, I think it's time... to give you this back.

sample.speaker: Jingran
sample.text: Nah, keep it. Call it a souvenir. Thing ain't worth much, and the Resonance Energy stuck to it just burnt out anyway.

sample.speaker: Jingran
sample.text: I mean, I could charge it up for ya. Maybe... three months. Tops.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Knock off throwing your life away, would you?

sample.speaker: Jingran
sample.text: Ain't many things in this world I give a crap about. But I gotta say, lately... I've finally met someone interesting.

sample.speaker: Abby
sample.text: (Didn't she say it would react if Hsin the Moon Fox wanted to do something against you?)

sample.speaker: Hsin
sample.text: Arbiter?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I'm fine. Just a bit dizzy from the emotional whiplash. Let's keep moving.

sample.speaker: Hsin
sample.text: Mm... this Labyrinth reaches into one's very soul. You have lingered in my Heartscapes for too long; some discomfort is natural.

sample.speaker: Hsin
sample.text: Once we are out, I will make it up to you. How does that sound?

mention.text: Ugh, why's it always such a mess... Oh! Come to think of it, that thing the umbrella girl was holding had Hsin's frequency in it, too. Only kinda different...
mention.source: Abby brings up Hsin in “Simulacrum of the Heart” (4×)

mention.title: Days Without Number
mention.text: Hmm, never smelled this one before. But it's weirdly familiar. Almost like… Hsin's frequency? Kinda?
mention.source: Abby brings up Hsin in “Days Without Number”

mention.title: Tales from the Capsule: Ashen Fox
mention.text: Reminds me of Hsin, but it's not quite the same... Weird.
mention.source: Abby brings up Hsin in “Tales from the Capsule: Ashen Fox”

dialogue.desc: With the great battle over, the Land of Xuanfang is slowly returning to how it once was, though plenty of aftershocks have yet to settle. Then one day, a WavesLine message from Yangyang arrives out of the blue: Suisui is about to head back to Mengzhou City...

sample.speaker: Hsin
sample.text: I believed he sought to extract the mainframe's core data. But to break my restrictions, he weaponized the Reverberations to collapse the mainframe itself.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Hold on. Back in the Sanctum, the Prism of Fate flickered. Was that you? Did you guide us into the Xuanyuan Domain?

sample.speaker: Hsin
sample.text: Only by stopping Muyu's chaos from within, together with my power, could we minimize the harm that spilled beyond.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: One more thing. Is the Hold's control mainframe actually Mengzhou's Civilization Capsule? Muyu certainly believed it was.

sample.speaker: Hsin
sample.text: Not entirely. It is merely one small part of it...

sample.speaker: Hsin
sample.text: This situation exceeded even my calculations. Fortunately, you two were there. You saved Xuanfang from far greater loss.

dialogue.desc: The Waking Moon Festival is drawing near in the Land of Xuanfang, yet rumors that "the Hold is doomed to fall" have begun to spread throughout the city. To find the Sentinel who has long been absent, you decide to head to where Hsin's presence was last felt—the Manifold Sanctum.

sample.speaker: Hsin
sample.text: Forgive me for forcing those memories upon you. I couldn't bring myself to tell you the truth before.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: What's happening in Mengzhou?

sample.speaker: Hsin
sample.text: Safe, for now. As long as I am still here and the Capsule holds, they won't dare make a move.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: If you are a fractal form of Hsin the Moon Fox, then what of the real Sentinel...?

sample.speaker: Hsin
sample.text: It will return once the Civilization Capsule is fully repaired.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Why didn't you ask the other cities for help?

dialogue.desc: A mysterious girl approaches you on WavesLine, asking for your help to collect the scattered Feeling Capsule Shards. As you go deeper into this matter, a story surfaces about Hsin the Moon Fox, the Sentinel of the past.

sample.speaker: Hsin
sample.text: I felt a change within the Nexus. It seems the seal on the last vestige of emotion has been lifted.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I was entrusted to deliver it to you.

sample.speaker: Hsin
sample.text: The Feeling Capsule...

sample.speaker: Xuanqing
sample.text: Hi, Hsin!

sample.speaker: Xuanqing
sample.text: We finally get to meet! All that searching for a gap in the Capsule to sneak this recording in was worth it.

sample.speaker: Hsin
sample.text: Resonator of Sentinel Hsin the Moon Fox... Xuanqing.

dialogue.desc: Entrusted by Hsin, Suoming invites you to revisit the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou. Although you still have many questions about Hsin's intentions, you embark on the journey once more...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Hsin. Suoming and I are at the Simulacrum Nexus.

sample.speaker: Hsin
sample.text: I suppose you have seen those phantoms by now, Arbiter?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I understand if you want to keep this from Suoming, but at least tell me what you're planning.

sample.speaker: Hsin
sample.text: To put it simply, I'd like her to meet the Ten Seals again... but truth be told, I am unsure if this is the right thing to do.

sample.speaker: Hsin
sample.text: Perhaps this is nothing more than forcing her to experience the pains of her past. Or perhaps she has simply kept all that longing locked away inside her heart.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: So that's why you asked me to accompany her, just in case?

sample.speaker: Hsin
sample.text: Arbiter! Where the Fox chases the Moon, all partings fade away!

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: That's the Moon Fox Society's code, isn't it? The next line goes: Where the Fox turns the wheel, fortune follows!

sample.speaker: Hsin
sample.text: Just so. Seems the Arbiter is a member of the Moon Fox Society too.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Hm? What does that mean?

sample.speaker: Hsin
sample.text: The Arbiter doesn't know? No initiations into the Moon Fox Society for you then, hehe.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: If memory serves, they're very fond of you. Fanatical, almost. Wait, did you actually go to meet them?

mention.title: Simulacrum of the Heart
mention.text: Everything you said is true. You really wanted to be with the people of Xuanfang. To see the sea of lights at the festival again. To see Hsin the Moon Fox once more.
mention.source: Rover brings up Hsin in “Simulacrum of the Heart” (66×)

mention.title: Song of the Heart Sword
mention.text: It may well be the source of this disturbance. If we're lucky, we might find the truth and some trace of Hsin the Moon Fox there.
mention.source: Rover brings up Hsin in “Song of the Heart Sword” (5×)

mention.title: Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled
mention.text: Speaking of... why did you convince Hsin to give the token to me?
mention.source: Rover brings up Hsin in “Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled” (3×)

mention.title: Moonlike Heart, Mortal Longing
mention.text: You're right, Abby. In this reality, Hsin wasn't hurt in the meeting with the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs, and Xuanqing took over the Civilization Capsule instead to assume command over Xuanfang Hold. She even started building Cloud Shuttles.
mention.source: Rover brings up Hsin in “Moonlike Heart, Mortal Longing” (16×)

mention.title: Past Dreams, Traced Seals
mention.text: Still, you have every reason to rest here a while. I believe Hsin wishes the same for you, knowing you won't lose yourself to the phantoms.
mention.source: Rover brings up Hsin in “Past Dreams, Traced Seals” (10×)

mention.title: Days Without Number
mention.text: In short, all of you are projections of Hsin the Moon Fox's memories.
mention.source: Rover brings up Hsin in “Days Without Number” (3×)

mention.title: Tales from the Capsule: Ashen Fox
mention.text: That hand... It looked like Hsin's. But there was no Sentinel's frequency on it. No Threnodian's either.
mention.source: Rover brings up Hsin in “Tales from the Capsule: Ashen Fox” (3×)

mention.source: Jinhsi brings up Hsin in “Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled” (6×)

mention.text: Xuanfang Hold's creator is none other than Mengzhou's Moon Fox Sentinel—Hsin. As Mengzhou and Jinzhou share borders, the two Sentinels laid down certain rules. One of which concerns an agreement regarding Xuanfang Hold.

sample.speaker: Jingran
sample.text: ...Why didn't you stop me? Coulda squeezed him for more info, if you'd wanted.

sample.speaker: Qiuyuan
sample.text: Matters of revenge, only the wronged can decide.

sample.speaker: Qiuyuan
sample.text: Besides... his corpse is not without use.

sample.speaker: Jingran
sample.text: Here. You lot'll put it to better use than me.

sample.text: See you around, Rover... If we're lucky.

sample.text: Paragon Qingxiao. You know Hsin the Moon Fox well. You understand what this token signifies.

sample.speaker: Qingxiao
sample.text: That's... a Vermillion Lock...

sample.speaker: Suoming
sample.text: It is a covenant. A deal between Hsin the Moon Fox and me. The time has come for Her to honor it. But as things stand, She may not even be able to save Herself.

sample.speaker: Suoming
sample.text: We don't have much time.

sample.speaker: Liangyu
sample.text: Paragon, what does all this mean...?

sample.speaker: Qingxiao
sample.text: It is Hsin's frequency within that lock. She speaks the truth.

sample.speaker: Suoming
sample.text: Watcher Liangyu... The way you carry yourself reminds me of an old friend.

sample.speaker: Suoming
sample.text: And that's precisely why the Fox Shadow's behavior is so strange.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: ...You suspect it's not acting on Hsin's will?

sample.speaker: Suoming
sample.text: Indeed. If that great shadow is the anomaly itself, then what has become of Hsin, who ought to be in control of this place?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: And this is...?

sample.speaker: Suoming
sample.text: A Providence Lock. Should Hsin the Moon Fox seek to do anything against you, it will react.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Why are you giving me this?

sample.speaker: Suoming
sample.text: Arbiter, was that Hsin the Moon Fox just now?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Uh-huh. She was the one who projected the phantoms of the Ten Seals here, and got worried it might be too much for you...

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: So she asked me to keep you company.

sample.speaker: Suoming
sample.text: I see... Have you finished taking the photo? Shall we move on, then?

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: You can spend time with them a little longer if you want. We're in no rush.

sample.speaker: Suoming
sample.text: No need to worry about me. Understanding what was on Her mind is more than enough.

phoneSample.speaker: Suoming
phoneSample.text: Hsin the Moon Fox asks that we reach the Simulacrum Nexus and complete... a certain task. I'll brief you on the details in person when you have the time.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: Understood, Seal Master! Where should we meet?

phoneSample.speaker: Suoming
phoneSample.text: That title... I'm afraid I hardly deserve to be called that by you, Arbiter.

phoneSample.speaker: Rover
phoneSample.text: No problem. Where should we meet?

phoneSample.speaker: Suoming
phoneSample.text: Let us meet before the Manifold Sanctum. That way, we can head straight into the Simulacrum Nexus after our discussion.

sample.speaker: Suoming
sample.text: Arbiter.

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: Talking to them?

sample.speaker: Suoming
sample.text: Mm. I was telling them how Suhsin made a Ninth of its own.

sample.speaker: Suoming
sample.text: Looking back, if it hadn't been so impatient, if it hadn't put words about letting go in Ninth's mouth, perhaps—

sample.speaker: Rover
sample.text: I don't think it would've swayed you. If anything, using the Ten Seals Covenant against you would have done the opposite, wouldn't it?

sample.speaker: Suoming
sample.text: Hehe. You hold me to quite a standard, Arbiter. But it's true. They're sealed in my Locks. I would not be deceived.

mention.title: Simulacrum of the Heart
mention.text: I missed my chance to ask where Suoming is... And there's more to that Intendant's assassination of the Sentinel than what I saw. I'll have to dig into that later.
mention.source: Rover brings up Suoming in “Simulacrum of the Heart” (15×)

mention.title: Past Dreams, Traced Seals
mention.text: You know her? Have you seen the phantom of a girl with her hair in double buns nearby? She's a close friend of Suoming's.
mention.source: Rover brings up Suoming in “Past Dreams, Traced Seals” (7×)

mention.title: Simulacrum of the Heart/Extra
mention.text: It's been a hundred years, Suoming, and what you feel for them is still strong. Does it hurt?
